ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଗଲା ଦୋକାନ
ସବୁ ଖୁସିର ପର୍ବରେ ପଡିଗଲା ପହଡ଼ ।

ବର୍ଷାରେ ଭିଜିବା ବଂଦ ହୋଇଗଲା ତା`ର
ମନଖୋଲି ଗୀତ ଗାଇବା ଭୁଲିଗଲା ସେ ।

ଭଳିକି ଭଳି ପାଟଶାଢୀ , ଲୁଗାଜାମା ,କୁଟିକମ ସୁନାଗହଣା , ଅଗଣିତ ଟଂକା ,ପାସ୍ ବୁକ୍ ,ବାକି ଖାତା ଏବଂ ଜମିପଟା
ଦୋକାନ ଭିତରେ ରହିଗଲା।

କିଏ ଜଣେ ଦୁର୍ବୁତ୍ତ
ରାତି ଅଧରେ ଦୋକାନରେ ପକେଇ ଦେଲା ତାଲା
ତାଲା ଉପରେ ଲଗେଇ ଦେଲା ଜଉ ମୁଦ ।

ସେଇ ଦିନଠାରୁ ସ୍କୁଲ ଆଉ ଯାଇପାରିଲାନି କି
ନିଜ ପସନ୍ଦର ଜିନିଷ ଖାଇପାରିଲାନି ସେ ।

ବାପା ଶୋଇଗଲେ ବିଛଣାରେ ମୂକ ହୋଇ
ବଳ ହରଣ କରିନେଲା କିଏ।

ସକାଳୁ ସକାଳୁ ଘରର କେହି ଜଣେ ବି
ଉଠେଇଲେନି ତଅପୋଇକୁ ନିଦରୁ
କହିଲେନି ଶୀଘ୍ର ଉଠିପଡ
ସ୍କୁଲ ସମୟ ଡେରି ହୋଇଯିବ।

ବେଣୀ କେହି ବାଂଧି ଦେଲେନି ବହଳ ତେଲ ଲଗାଇ
ବେଗି ବେଗି ପଖାଳ ,ଚକୁଳି ପିଠା ,ରୁଟି କି ଚୁଡା ଛତୁଆ ବାଢି ଦେଲେନି।
ଅଚଳ ହୋଇଗଲା ମନ
କିଏ ହରିନେଲା ତା` ଭିତରୁ ଚଂଚଳପଣ
ବହି ଖାତାକୁ ଓଲଟାଇବାକୁ ଆଉ ମନ କହିଲାନି,

ତଅପୋଇ
କେବଳ ବଂଚି ରହିଲା
ସବୁ ସ୍ବପ୍ନକୁ ପାଣିରେ ଭସେଇ ଦେଇ ।

ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଥିଲା ଛୋଟ ଭାଇମାନେ ଦିନେ ବଡ ହେବେ
ଫେରେଇ ଆଣିବେ ପୁଣି ଥରେ ବାପାଂକ ଦୋକାନ ।

ଏବେ ଭାଇମାନଂକ ପାଖରେ ବୋଇତ ,ଦରିଆ ,ଦ୍ବୀପ
ସବୁକିଛି ।
ସେମାନେ ଦେଶ ଦେଶ ବୁଲୁଛନ୍ତି
ଦେଶରେ ଦୋକାନ ବସେଇଛନ୍ତି ।

ଖୋଲା ଦୋକାନ ଭିତରେ ସେ ବାପାଂକୁ ପାଇଛି
ତଅପୋଇ ଏବେ ଦୁନିଆ ଦେଖୁଛି ।

ଚିରକାଳ ବର୍ଷାରେ ଭିଜେ ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଲୋକ !
ବର୍ଷା ଛିଟା ତା`ର ପ୍ରିୟ ବୋଲି
ଅନାୟସ ରେ ଆଲିଙ୍ଗନ କରେ,
ଆହ୍ଲାଦିତ ହୁଏ ,
ଯେତେସବୁ ଅକଥ୍ୟ ଉଚ୍ଚାରଣ କୁ
ଧୋଇଦେଇ
ଆଖି ପତା ରେ ଜମାଟ ବନ୍ଧା
ଲୁଣି ପାଣିକୁ ପଖାଳି ମିଠା କରେ ।
ସିନ୍ଥି ରୁ ଝରି ଆସୁଥିବା ଲାଲ ରଙ୍ଗକୁ
କଲମରେ ଭରି

କବିତା ବି ଲେଖେ ।

କେଜାଣି କେମିତି ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଲୋକ
ସବୁକିଛି ରେ ଭିଜେ, ଓଦାହୁଏ ଖୁବ୍,
ତମାମ ଆୟୁଷକାଳ କଟେଇ ଦିଏ
ଭିଜା ଲୁଗାରେ ।
ଆହା,ଭିତର କିନ୍ତୁ ଶୁଖିଲା ଥାଏ
ଖୁବ୍ ଶୁଖିଲା ।

ଏ ରହସ୍ୟ ଚିରକାଳ ଅପହଞ୍ଚ ।

ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଲୋକଟିଏ ହେବା ସହଜ ତ ନୁହେଁ !

ଏତକ ବୁଝିଲେ ବି
ଏରୁଣ୍ଡି ଡେଇଁ ବର୍ଷା ରେ
ଖୁବ୍ ଭିଜେ ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଲୋକ ଭିଜାଏ ବି,
ଭିଜୁଥିବା ଯାଏ ଜୀବନଟେ ବଞ୍ଚିଥାଏ
ବଂଚିଥାଏ ବୋଲି ହିଁ
ଶୁନ୍ୟରେ ପହଁରି ପାରେ ।
ଯାବତୀୟ ଦୁଃଖର ପସରା କୁ
ମୁଣ୍ଡେଇ ବିଛାଡ଼ି ଦିଏ ଖୁସିର
ଚକ ମକ ସୁନେଲି କିରଣ ।

ଆୟୁଷକାଳ ପୃଥ୍ବୀକୁ ଭିଜଉଥିବା ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଲୋକ
ନିଜ ପାଇଁ ମଜବୁତ ,ସ୍ଥିର , ସ୍ବର୍ଣ୍ଣାଭ
ଛାତଟିଏ ଖୋଜି ନିରାଶ ହେଇ
ଫେରିଯାଏ ଝମାଝମ ବର୍ଷାର କୋଳକୁ ।
ଆଉ କେବେ ନ ଫେରିବାର
କଥା ଦିଏ ନିଜକୁ ,
ସବୁ କୋହ,ମୋହ , ମାୟା କୁ
ହାତ ପାପୁଲି ରୁ ଘଷି ଘଷି ଧୋଇଦିଏ
ବର୍ଷାରେ।
ତାଳ ପତ୍ର ରେ ଲେଖାଥିବା ଲିତା ବିଲିତା,
ଗ୍ରହ ନକ୍ଷତ୍ର ର ହିସାବ କୁ ଭୁଲ ପ୍ରମାଣ କରି
ବାକି ଆୟୁଷ କେବଳ ଭିଜେ ଖୁବ୍ ଭିଜେ ।

ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଲୋକ ବର୍ଷା ରେ ଭିଜୁଥାଏ ଚିରକାଳ
ଭିଜଉ ଥାଏ ସଭିଙ୍କୁ ।।

ଲୋକମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଭୁଲିଗଲେଣି ତାଙ୍କୁ
ଯେଉଁମାନେ ଭୁଲିନାହାନ୍ତି ଭୁଲରେ ବି
ସ୍ମରଣରେ ନେଉନାହାନ୍ତି
ସାହିତ୍ୟ ସଭାରେ l

କି ବର୍ଷା କି ବସନ୍ତ ସବୁ ଋତୁରେ
ବିଦ୍ୟମାନ କବି ଚାଲିଗଲେଣି ଶୀତରେ
ଫୁକିଆ ତାରା ଦେଖା ଦେବାର କେଇ
ଘଂଟା ପରେ
ଶୀତର ପୃଥିବୀ କଡ଼ ଲେଉଟାଇଲାବେଳେ
ନିର୍ଜନ ବେଳାରେ l

ସେ ଗଲା ପରେ ଆଗ ଭଳି କୋଇଲିର
ସ୍ବର ବଳବତର ଅଛି ଆମ୍ବ ଡାଳରେ
ନଦୀର ଜଳଧାର ନିଜ ପ୍ରବାହରେ ଅଟଳ
ଅଛି ଧାରା ଶ୍ରାବଣରେ
ତା କକ୍ଷପଥରେ
ପୂର୍ଵ ଭଳି ଘୁରୁଛି ପୃଥିବୀ l

ଲାଗୁଚି ତାଙ୍କର ଯିବା ନଯିବା ନେଇ
କିଛି ଫରକ ପଡୁନି ପାଠକଙ୍କୁ
ତାଙ୍କ ଅତୀତ ସହ ସମୟର ଯୋଡ
ମୂଲ୍ୟହୀନ ହୋଇପଡିଛି
ତାଙ୍କ ଅର୍ଥପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ରଚନା ଆଗରେ l

ଅବଶ୍ୟ ସେ ଥିଲାବେଳେ ତାଙ୍କ
ପାଦ ତଳେ ଲଟକି ଥିଲା ଆକାଶ
ତାଙ୍କର ହାତରେ
ଝଟକୁ ଥିଲା ଗୋଲାର୍ଧ
ତାଙ୍କ କଳାର ନୁପୁର ଧ୍ଵନିରେ
କମ୍ପୁଥିଲା ଦିଗବଳୟ l

ତମେ ଆଜି ନାହଁ, ନାହଁ ଅର୍ଥ
ତମ ସତ୍ତା ବିଲୀନ ହୋଇଯାଇଛି
ଇଥରରେ, ହୁଏତ ବିମର୍ଷ ଓ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟହୀନ
ତମର ଭ୍ରଷ୍ଟ ଆତ୍ମା ଘୁରୁଛି ପଥହୀନ ହୋଇ
ଏଇ ଭିତରେ ମୁଁ ବି ପୂରାପୁରି ଭୁଲିଯାଇଛି
ତମକୁ ତମରି ଛନ୍ଦରେ l

ଜଣେ କବି ନୀରବ ହୋଇଗଲେ
ତାଂକ ବସିବା ପାଇଁ
ଉଦ୍ୟାନ ଅରଣ୍ୟ ଆଣିଦେଲେ
କୁଶାସନ ବ୍ୟାଘ୍ରଚର୍ମ କମ୍ବଳାସନ ।

କମଣ୍ଡଳୁ ଭରିବା ପାଇଁ ଆଗେଇ ଆସିଲେ
ଗଂଗା ନର୍ମଦା ସିନ୍ଧୁ କାବେରୀ
ମଣିଷଠାରୁ ଏଯାଏ ବଂଚେଇ ରଖିଥିବା ପବିତ୍ର ଜଳରେ ।

ଦୁନିଆର ଯେତେକ ନାମ ଜଣା ଅଜଣା ଚଢେଇ
ଭିଡ଼ କଲେ ତାଂକ ହାତରୁ ଆହାର
ଖାଇବାର ପ୍ରତିଯୋଗିତାରେ ।

ରାତି ତାର ସର୍ବହରା , ଅଭିଜାତ ସବୁ ଆଲୁଅ,
ନାଚ ବାଜଣାକୁ ପଛ କରି ଠିଆ ହେଲା
ତାଂକ ଝରକା ସାମ୍ନା ଘାସ ପଡ଼ିଆରେ
କବିତା ଗୋଟେ ମଣିଷକୁ ଲେଖୁଥିଲା ବେଳେ
କେମିତି ଦିଶନ୍ତି ଦେଖିବ ବୋଲି ।

ତାଂକ ବଗିଚାର ଗଛ , ଛାତର ଫୁଲକୁଣ୍ଡ
ଯାହା ତାଂକ ଦୃଷ୍ଟି ଓ ଉଦାସୀନତାର ଯୁଗଳବନ୍ଦୀରେ
ସନ୍ଦିହାନ ଦର୍ଶକ ଥିଲେ ଏଯାବତ
ଏଥର ମେରୁଦଣ୍ଡ ସିଧା କରି ବସିଲେ ବା ଛିଡ଼ା ହେଲେ
କବିଂକୁ ପୂରାଟା ଦଖଲ କରିବେ ବୋଲି ।

ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାହାର କେମିତି ହୁଏ କବି
କବିତାର ଆଖିକାନ ମନ ହୃଦୟ
ନାଭି ଜାନୁ ଶିରାସନ ତୁମକୁ ଲେଖି ଚାଲିଥାଏ
ଯେବେଯେବେ ପାଦ ଥାପ ମାଟିରେ
ଗଛର ରୁକ୍ଷ ବଳ୍କଳ ଛୁଇଁ ଅନୁଭବ ପ୍ରାଣରସ
ଆକାଶକୁ ଚାହିଁ ଅଧିକାର କରିନିଅ ସତ୍ତାର ସମଗ୍ରତା !

ତୁମେ କେମିତି ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାହାର କରିବ ନିଜକୁ

गांव का सुनसान प्लेटफार्म, 
बरसती बूँदों की छांव,
पटरी पर धीमे-धीमे 
गुजरती ट्रेन की थरथर ध्वनि।
आज फिर वही जगह 
जहाँ तुम छोड़ गए थे,
और अब भी प्रतीक्षा में हूँ,
कि लौट आओगे कभी...।

∎
जमशेदपुर

माँ का वो आगन
दिल रहता था कितना मगन
बचपन की वो कहानी
अब हो गई पुरानी……

अब माँ बनी, देखी अपनी छब्बी अपनी राज कुमारी मैं
तैयारी कर रही उसकी बिदाई की मैं….

होते थे तू तू मैं मैं दादी से या माँ से
रूठ के कमरे में छूप जाती किसी कोने में …

भोजन की थाली लेके माँ आती कमरे में
नख़रे थे मेरे ,मुस्कुराके मना लेती मुझे कमरे में…..

माँ की याद आयी आँखों से अक्ष बहाने लगे
बिदाई में बाबूजी ए सिर पर हाथ रख बिदाई देने लगे।

आज एक माँ को माँ की याद आयी
दिल पर पत्थर रख बेटी को
पराई कर आयी ।।

पराए को अपना बनाया
उनका आँगन सजाया.
बाबुल के आँगन का फूल
किसकी गुलदस्ते में सज गया ।।

∎

Which soil is my own?
The soil which my paternal grandfather left in East Bengal?
Or the soil of West Bengal where my mother's ancestors have lived for long?
Which soil is my own?
The soil where my father taught me to play and hold the first pen?
Or the soil of the house of a stranger whom I fell in love with?
Which soil is my own?
The soil of the city I grew up in?
Or the soil of the city that I have made my home in?
Is the smell of soil different in different places?
With the first monsoon setting in, is petrichor different in different places?
I scooped up a handful of soil and it smelt like Mother Earth.
∎

Filled with the blueness of the ocean is your radiance,
In the infinity of the sky merges your vast expanse.
Are you the imagination of a poet,
Or the purest reality?
For you, lamps are lit in millions of hearts,
And millions of voices sing your hymns and praise.
You are merely a little baby blue
Yet holding a handful of earth inside your mouth,
You show your angry, confused mother
Countless worlds and a vast cosmos.
From stealing butter to stealing garments,
And then stealing hearts is your art of attraction
And the wonders of your clever grace.
Sometimes your magical flute plays
The mesmerizing tune of divine love;
Sometimes in the groves of Kunja,
The tinkling of your ankle bells echoes.
Sometimes under the shade of the Kadamba tree,
Sometimes upon the banks of the azure Yamuna
The resonance of your eternal Raas Leela
rises in every house and heart.
Sometimes you are deceitfully playful,
Sometimes a profound philosopher
The foundation of all knowledge,
The inner conscience residing within.

Even so, O Krishna,
Through age after age,
You continue to captivate the hearts
of millions of souls.
Absorbed completely into your own self,
Where do you disappear
By the strike of the hunter Jara`s arrow?
Amidst the sands of the sea,
do you manifest yourself
Upon the Neelanchala
Waiting patiently seated upon
The bejeweled throne of yours?
In the voices of countless devotees,
Your melody comes alive with divine nectar.
With the ink of countless poets` pens,
Your sacred legend is inscribed.
Art, philosophy, literature, and architecture
All of creation`s dimensions
Unfold boundless and dedicated
Solely unto you.
You are, therefore, the true emblem
Of this universe`s higher consciousness.
You are an immortal wonder,
A creative, deep-blue cosmos.
May the venomous blue poison of this world
Dissolve into your blue divine form today.
O Neelamadhava, may the sweetness of your blueness
Keep filling every heart with eternal bliss.
∎

August melts in heavenly shower.
Tender authority of damp and drench
hums muddy musty love.
Fades soft pain of void and obscure.
Scribbled Earth`s poems of pain and pride.

Drowsy evening steps towards wild
sensational night.
Some depart, a few meet.
Vanishes petrichor.
Mold lichen bubble in their fragrance best.

Different syllables whispers wind.
Truth of soul basks at the mild sunrise.
Sometimes a bit of moon.
Sometimes shimmer of stars.
Shift the shrinking heart to the
drenched green love.
Hope carried through out.

Flowers and orchids celebrate supremacy.
Wings of optimism unfolds to the cool
ecstatic splash.
Footsteps of buried and beneath slowly
drink the dissolved elixir to fall in love
with life.
Melts August portion by portion.
Centre holds all the fallen aparts.
∎

Every evening 
late into the night 
I drink life 
draught by draught 
and its bitterness runs 
through all my veins 
till emptiness 
takes over everything
including my sleep.
Kafka emerges from the shadows 
dancing on the wall in the light 
of the wavering lamp 
and Camus within analyzes 
nothingness
pouring out from my restless pores
all night.
At daybreak I am convinced 
that nothingness 
can be converted into thingness 
though it needs a lot of love 
for undeterred pain and resolute anguish.
∎

At twilight I received a gift from you
a space that you have been creating
for a long time,
perhaps it was never meant for me
but most things on earth are predestined

I waited up there with a hope to listen
the stories of life and beyond,
the space that belongs to you has a
mystic essence that every human shall
experience soon...

Yet today when I was there I felt a kind
of selfless love that is carried by old souls
to spread the light and wisdom

You have the power to share with the world
the dreams that most humans wish to fulfill,
your pains and scratches have turned into
the pillars of others` destinies...

I am a soul just passing by yet I stopped at
your grounded farm, to meet the cat and
the dog, to rejuvenate my own visions...
I am a healer and I need a space where I
can be my true bare self...

I need the ground to hold the energy
coming directly from the universe, and
you have unknowingly tilled the soil, yet
kept the wild to restore my sacred inner core.
∎

On the first morning of school,
before the bells had learned our names,
I found you in the front row—
a bob of hair, a morning smile,
and a voice as soft as rain
falling upon an unfamiliar garden.

You spoke with your friends,
and though I was only passing through
the ordinary noise of childhood,
something in your laughter
made the morning pause.
Some moments arrive without announcement;
years later, we discover
they were beginnings.
You carried brilliance quietly.
Every lesson opened before you,
every difficult question
seemed to surrender its secret.
And English, especially,
rested upon your lips
like a language the heart
had taught you before the books did.
You were not merely a bright student;
you were the light by which
many of us measured our own horizons.
While we counted marks,
you seemed to collect possibilities—
and excellence followed you
without ever needing to be called.
Then school became a memory,
and college opened its wider doors.
The corridors changed,
the books grew heavier,
the dreams became taller,
but you remained the same quiet flame.
Again, you rose to the summit,
and the old legacy of brilliance
continued its unbroken journey.
Somewhere between those years,
admiration changed its name.
What began as a passing wonder
slowly became a tenderness
I carried without confession—
a small, unspoken hope
hidden beneath ordinary days.
I tried to walk a little closer,
to place my footsteps
beside the road you travelled.
But destiny is an invisible river;
it chooses its own direction.

You were already beyond my pitch,
and the ball of possibility
vanished somewhere
beyond the boundary of time.
No tragedy followed.
Only distance.
Life gathered its seasons,
and we followed different stars.
Faces came and went,
dreams changed their addresses,
and the years quietly built
their walls between yesterday and today.
Yet some memories
do not live by the laws of time.
They remain exactly where we left them—
young, luminous, untouched.
And so, when nostalgia
opens the old doors of my mind,
I return to that classroom:
the sunlight on the desks,
the murmur of young voices,
the front row,
your smiling face,
and that gentle voice
I never knew I would remember
for so long.
I no longer wonder
what might have been.
Some people are not written
into the future of our lives;
they are written into
the poetry of our becoming.
You are one such presence—
not a destination,
not an unfinished promise,
but a beautiful line
that time could never erase.
And perhaps that is enough.
For whenever memory turns back
towards the first page of youth,
there you are again—
smiling in the front row,
while the years pass silently by,
and somewhere within me,
that morning
is still beginning.
∎

source_fields.captured_title: Don`t Set The Rules For Her
source_fields.body_html:
Don`t draw a line for me
I`m afraid I can`t promise you 
Not to go beyond that line.

Don`t put a puzzle around me.
I`m afraid I may disappoint you 
By defying to take chances.

Don`t set the rules for me
I`m afraid I can`t give you my word 
To follow them blindly.

Don`t push everything
to the edge dear.
I`m afraid I may start to doubt 
our unequivocal bond.

Don`t acquiesce to a wider gulf 
between us.
I`m afraid I may fail
to bridge that gap.

Let the old enamoured feelings 
Reign between us.
To say,
Just set her free
Don`t clip her wings.

Trust her,
Despite her desire to fly,
She`ll keep coming back to her nest.
Eventually, at dusk.
∎

Why do I write
I have no answers
except that words thump
inside my head to be released
to give form to small ordinary things
to bring out what is left unsaid,
life in pause in, half
remembrance, in silent question.
I write to give shelter to
what history ignores.
My mother`s sigh, my grand
mother`s warm kitchen.
The veined cracks on the
walls of my ancestral home.
The ache of belonging and not
belonging,
of what I cannot hold.
I write to archive transient moment
stitch light on the canvas of night,
to savour the smell of old lace,
to decipher the pause between
words.
I write because it is the only place I
can return to undisturbed.
∎

This morning
I watch
cones of oleander

The oleanders open
their yellow
funnel

The funnel invites
honeybees
in clusters

In clusters they
enter the frills
of the flowers

The flowers
pour their honey
on the walkways

On the walkways
the sun draws
an invisible line

An invisible line
I listen to the music
float by

ପ୍ରେମ ବାଲିଗରଡା ପରି ଅକିନ୍ଚନ ଆଉ ସଙଯୋଗ ଦିବାସ୍ୱପ୍ନ ପରି ଉଭାନ୍ !!!

ସ୍ନେହ ଆସୁ ଆସୁ ବାଟ ହୁଡି ଯାଏ,
ଚିତ୍ରିତ ପୃଥିବୀ ପକ୍ଷପାତ ରୋଗୀ ପରି ଚିତ୍ ପଟାନ୍ଗ।
ଦେହଘଷା ବ୍ୟାକୁଳତା ପ୍ରେମ କି ଅନ୍ୟ କିଛି? ମନ ଦ୍ୱନ୍ଦ ରେ ପଡେ,
ଯେବେ ଯେବେ ମୋ ବଗିଚା ରେ ରକ୍ତ ଗୋଲାପ ଫୁଟେ।

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
हृदय के भीतर 
न जाने कितने ब्रह्मांड बसते हैं।
विचार कभी ग्रह बनकर 
परिक्रमा करते हैं,
कभी टूटते तारों-से 
बिखर जाते हैं।

कुछ स्मृतियाँ चाँद की 
शीतलता बनकर ठहरती हैं,
तो कुछ इच्छाएँ
 सूर्य-सी दहकती रहती हैं।

और मन इन्हीं अनगिनत 
आकाशगंगाओं में भटकता है।

और जो शब्दों में उतर आता है,
 आपके पास चला आता  है। 
 आपके स्नेह और दुलार के लिए।

∎

जमशेदपुर

pondside lizard
letting the heat build up
inside me

•

shallow sunfish nests
the dark rings
under soft eyes

•

tadpoles jiggle
remember the day we
found our legs?

•

the weight of bills
both carried away
in a riptide

•

spider man
in the pear tree
hand-me-down pjs

•

• • •

 

Floating World

afloat in the lake
up to my chin
mud turtle`s view

nature lookout!
the chipmunk pauses
for a second sip

a complaint about
my drift to the dock
heron squawks

eyes out of the water
just like me
nonchalant snake

chipmunk beach
they don`t mind me
offshore

•

 

∎

‎Unmeasurable is its power,

‎Some call it an absolute reality range.
‎
‎Neither is it dependent on you,
‎Nor is it absolutely independent-
‎An all-encompassing universal resource.
‎
‎Time also destroys...
‎Brings truth and resilience to play,
‎Reconciliation and acceptance.
‎
‎Wounds heal...

‎And discoveries humans have made.
‎

‎You find remorse in your palm-
‎That is the power, and it is timeless.

source_fields.captured_title: The River Never Returned Our Letters
source_fields.body_html:
There was a time when love travelled on folded paper,
when a heartbeat waited for footsteps instead of a ringtone,
when the shy meeting of two young eyes
could become the beginning of an endless universe.
In the fading sunlight of a village school,
a boy and a girl fell silently, beautifully, forever in love.
It was the late nineteen-seventies.
The world moved gently, untouched by glowing screens.
There were no instant messages, no hurried calls,
only stolen glances across the classroom,
shared smiles beneath old banyan trees,
and dreams too innocent to be spoken aloud.
Every evening the boy sat beneath a flickering lantern,
writing letters scented with hope and youthful longing.
Each page carried a promise of tomorrow,
each word whispered her name like a sacred prayer.
He believed love written with honesty
could never lose its way.
Trusting a classmate with his heart,
he asked another girl to place the letters in her hands.
But jealousy has often worn the mask of friendship.
One by one, the letters were torn into fragile pieces
and scattered upon the waiting river,
where the current swallowed every unspoken dream.

The girl waited through changing seasons.
She wondered why his silence had become so deep.
The boy waited through sleepless nights,
believing she had quietly rejected his love.
Neither knew that fate had borrowed the face of betrayal,
leaving two faithful hearts to suffer apart.
The years drifted like autumn leaves upon forgotten water.
Their school became a memory,
their laughter an echo lost among distant hills.
The boy grew into a man who never married,
for no other heart could replace
the first one that had become his forever home.
More than three decades slipped into history.
One quiet afternoon, destiny returned wearing tears.
The woman who had once carried those letters
stood before the old man, her voice trembling beneath the weight
of guilt.
& I have come too late,& she whispered,
& but I can no longer hide the truth.&

& I never gave her your letters.
I tore every one beside the river.
She waited for you. She loved you.
Had she received even one page,
she would have chosen you without hesitation.
Forgive me, if forgiveness still exists.&
The old man looked beyond the horizon,
where memory and twilight held each other's hands.
Not a single tear escaped his eyes;
some griefs become too ancient for weeping.
After a long silence, he smiled with heartbreaking tenderness.

& If she truly wished to spend her life with me,& he said,
& then come... let us walk once more to the riverbank.
Perhaps the water still remembers
the pieces of those forgotten letters.
Perhaps love never truly drowns—
it only waits for hearts brave enough to seek it again.&
And the river flowed, as rivers always do,
carrying secrets that no calendar can erase.
The torn letters were never found,
yet somewhere between the sky and the water,
two young lovers still walk home from school together,
their hands almost touching, their dreams forever unwritten,
while eternity gently whispers—
true love may be delayed by time, betrayed by fate, and
buried by silence,
but it can never be destroyed.
∎

Uncharted walk,  
back toward the home of memory,  
and the past rises to meet up,  
canvas-stretched and still.  
The flowers and leaves bear their wounds,  
torn and scattered by hurricanes.  
And still, how beautiful —  
held now in the quiet frame  
of a village built from passion`s archive.  
Walk hand in hand, without restraint,  
free spirits unbound.  
No fear. No secret codes.  
No hidden photographs.  
In the end, 
perhaps it`s hard to find one honest in love.  
But the one  
who loves  
with soul laid bare,  
unwavering, and entire.  
∎

Lo! am finished, out of gingery cares
Peeping throbs plan farewell for me
Bulky credence crying for concave balms

Ah! Rosy vibes battling tremors of aches
Your bouncing moves soaring heartbeats
Gear up your fancy smiles baby

Trust me i`ve aligned me well
Am busy mending injured emotions
Your wrapped whispers matter, baby !

Days , rolling being blind swagger
Hopes pitter patter on rust chamber
Don`t let crystal longings crumble

My nerves get overthinking
I wanna tie time for you
Just wishing a proxy hug !
∎
JAJPUR
ODISHA
9937207639

Now and then, in our lives
there comes this desire
to be with the universe all alone
with birds, with trees,
with small things that move and breathe
not knowing that they are part,
of that heart, we with our intellect, call God— but to them,
that's nowhere, and nothing.
They know nothing of the bright colours
upon them, the venom they are gifted with, or the honey
they'll dip headlong into flowers for—
now and then this desire, to be the sea,
the moon and the stars,
The eloquence of the wind that
dresses the night rocks with its drapery,
this want to be by your side loving you
as though I never truly loved you before,
to lay you on me,
as jasmine upon dark hair
making love with all its fragrance
seminal in a fluid night,
some desires, they have no end,
though they clock the bend
and somewhere, where no none knows or cares,
Time in a vagabond move
Builds you its slow fire.
∎

Some girls are born in to the woman
Before they even fully grasp
They are compelled to shoulder every duty of womanhood.

Being a mother to younger siblings
managing a multitude of responsibilities
Their lives trudge on tethered to the soil
Having heard words like "belonging to others"
and "destined to another`s home" since birth,
They can never truely bring themselves to believe
that the very home they inhabit is their own.

To whom does a woman truely belong
Whose life does she carry as her own
With whose identity does she move to another`s home
Unable to ever break free from these ties,
These daughters meet their end within that very cocoon.

These girls
with every breath, they seek the well-being of households:
Even in sleep, the burdens of two families weigh upon them,
In dreams, they gather the responsibilities of the entire world
Grappling with it all throughout their lives.

Like sweat evaporating over a burning hearth
They are curified again and again
yet, if the need arises, they return
Dripping their veils over backs bloodied by thorns
They set themselves once more to their daily toil.

These girls were born without a tongue
But some words remain, like coals
Deep within their burning,crimson hearts;
The impersonal lines are like poetry.

These lines burns to the girls
Though some may perish in the process
deep within those hearts,
Those embers find no solace,
no soothing touch of a sweet, flowing stream.

They have come to believe
that a vast ocean of a happiness
is forbidden to them
yet, even today they wait
awaiting the Bhagirathi of an unheared divine melody.

Let`s transform their silence
their endurance
and their sighs
in to a vessel for seeking happiness
let`s!
∎
Translated from original Odia by Bandana Sahoo

Rain everywhere,
On the groves and gorges, 
On streets and sewers,
On the thoughts 
And the dull, sombre eyes,
A few stars grope blindly for a niche
To store a secret box of sparkle 
In the flooding August skies.

Rain everwhere 
On the heaths and  hills and houses
Clouds are ripped apart
To bleed water and woe,
Shadows go brown and then dissolve
In the muddy overflow. 

Runnels of rain shyly slither
Down the window glass
A tremulous shimmer arch on a
Broken face looming over
A latent hairline crack,

Rain everywhere, 
On the face in a flyblown mirror
And on the portraits of the past,
Washing the paints off 
Leaving them  blurry and  faded 
On the threadbare canvas.

∎

I didn`t come here,
seeking for anything,
not even love.
But I came across
this land,
that`s so familiar
to my homeland!
Within you oh being!
I witness everything, –
that used to be mine!
Perhaps as a
realm of love!
And I bowed to your
soul, and that sight
became the oasis of
my soul!
This is another thing
that I am not
taking a single drop
of water from
this oasis!
All I am taking
with me is
the fragrance
of memory
of this sight,
I hope no land will
ever mind offering!
∎

I cannot receive calls promptly
I walk slowly
I fail to comprehend complexities
The cold wars, enmities, misunderstandings
I hesitate to welcome guests
Be a part of the group
I like to stay alone
In darkness
Meditating the joys of yesteryears
And awaiting to sleep silently forever. ..
∎

My wish is one in a million
milling around you,
of one among the
innumerable humans
humming around you.
How does it matter
and how does it bother you,
a tiny wish,
howsoever dear and tender !

After all,
It is not a glance at the moon,
but only at its reflection
which the waters,
wily and effervescent,
may mirror and hold
or hide away or scatter
as per its own strange
spontaneity of a desire.
Touched and tantalised,
there is no end to looking
at the river that you are !

Let me go home,
in a loss of words,
lonesome,
without looking behind,
in the muted murmur
of a protest to your busy-bee mind
that does not look beyond.

Let the music play on,
on the river
and on the moon.
Lonesome,
in the softest of silence,
let me go home.

∎

Off and on I savor the pure delight
of slipping far from those sharp-tongued companions
and dissolving into the deep green hush of pine-scented woods
or the quiet sweep of open, peaceful ground.
I simply roam the wild places,
never asking what or why,
yet somehow I rise on invisible wings
and climb the endless blue that has no edge.
I let myself float free—
sometimes carried by the loud crash of waves,
sometimes by the soft, repeating pulse of gentler water—
for I am only a wanderer
with no guiding blade,
and I never look for any safe place to rest.
I long to sing the old country tunes,
missing notes as they come,
laughing and squealing with pure delight
as the sound rises—
sometimes high and light, sometimes low and deep—
and none of it matters to me.
I step across the bright green undergrowth,
the rough gray heights of stone,
the soft, sorrowful fields of grass,
and I pass the flowers whose strange and foreign names
I never learn.
I simply move on.
All the while I wonder
who this self might be,
what purpose holds me here,
or why the great earth keeps turning.
Still I remain glad—
whirling beside the small fire of my camp,
joking along the dusty tracks
that begin nowhere

and lead to nowhere at all...
∎

source_fields.captured_title: The Bluish Splendour Of Your Eyes
source_fields.body_html:
The bluish splendour of your eyes
Gives a rare feeling
Your smiling face
Gives an altogether different feeling.

Sometimes gloominess appears in your firmament.
In this pleasantness sparkles
In your artistic hand
Philosopher`s stone reveals itself.

Where have you been so long
It was difficult to find you.
The tenderness of your hand
Fills the mind enormously.
The glowing emotion of your motivation
Fills the mind greatly.

∎

When the afternoon sheds
Upon the two palms of the dusk
It reminds me of your face
Your face as caring as river
Oh, river, you murmur and flow ceaselessly
I feel it touching by my fingers.

Oh, river, you laugh and talk like her
You flow like her touching the bosom
The bosom catches hold of it
In the moonlight soaked meadow.
∎

Sometimes droplets of poetic emotions
Penetrate the hard granite
To transform the rock into a soft flower.
Rains are like tears of dark clouds
Expressing intensity of joys
To celebrate primordial tranquillity
Amidst heat and dust of parched soil.

The dry earth unbearably
Becomes hungry and destitute
Like drought-affected emaciated people
Due to dearth of waters.
Rains come as boons of ambrosia
To create heart-throbs
In the decaying and dying earth.

Rainbow is like a necklace of colours,
A marvellous metaphor
Embracing the cloudy sky
To coax the angels of rim-jhim rains
For scintillating welcome
To rejuvenate the inanimate sky.

Yet the rainy season being rapturous
Enchants the earth like a magic
For an uncanny metamorphosis
To smile upon its pastoral beauties
And bounties of pervading nature.

Rains are sometimes raptures
Of sweet dreams and sensualities
Sometimes melting agonies
Of broken hearts and despairs of marooned victims
Due to ravages by heavy floods and cloud-bursts
To measure the abysmal depth of depression
And unstinted spirit of exhilaration.

∎
Sambalpur, Odisha, Mobile no. 9437457736

ଅବୁଝା ମନର ପ୍ରଗଳ଼ଭିତ ଉଦ୍ୟାନରେ
ସହସ୍ର ଭାବନାର
ସମ୍ମୋହନ ରେ
ଗୋଟିଏ ଶବ୍ଦରେ
ଲେଖିପାରନତିକି ତୁମ ପାଇଁ କବିତାଟିଏ
ଏବଂ ପାଲଟିଯାଆନ୍ତି
ସହସ୍ର ଫୁଲ ର ସମଭାରଟିଏ।

ଜୀବନର ରଙ୍ଗ ମଞ୍ଚ ରେ ନାଚି ନାଚି ଥକିପଡିପଡି
ଇଙ୍ଗିତ ରେ ତୁମକୁ ବୁଝେଇ
ପାରନ୍ତି
ଫୁଟୁଥିବା ଫୂଲଙ୍କ ଶବ୍ଦାର୍ଥ କୁ
ଫୁଟିସାରି ଝରିପଡିଥିବା ସବୁ ବୟରଥତାକୁ
ଅବୁଝା ବୋଝ କୁ ନେଇ
ବଞ୍ଚିବା କଷ୍ଟ।
ଶବ୍ଦ ମାନେ ଭାବନାଠୁ ଅନେକ ଦୂରରେ
କେବଳ ତୁମକୁ ପାଇବାର ଉତ୍ତର।
ଜୀବନଟା ଦୁଈ ଫୁଲର ପାଖୁଡ଼ା
ତୁମେ ଆଉ ମୁଁ ର ସମ୍ଭାରରେ।
∎

ବୋତଲରୁ ପରଫ୍ୟୁମ ସରିବା ପରି
ପ୍ରେମ ସରିବା ଦିନ
ଗୋଟେ ଆବେଗସିକ୍ତ ପ୍ରାଣ
ନିରାତ୍ମା ଶରୀର ହୋଇ ପଡି ରହିଥିଲା
ଯେମିତି ଗୋଟେ ଶୁଖିଲା କାଚ ଶିଶି ର
ଶେଥା ପଡିଯାଇଥିବା ଶିଶୁ ମୁହଁ।

ପ୍ରେମ ସରିବା ଦିନ
ବୃହତ୍ତ ଶକ୍ତି ସମ୍ପନ୍ନ
ଏକ ପରମାଣୁବୋମାର ଅହଂକାର ରେ
ଜଳି ଛାରଖାର ହୋଇଗଲା
ମନର ହିରୋସୀମା ଓ ହୃଦନାଗାସାକି ର
ଦୁଇଟି ଭାସ୍କର୍ଯ୍ୟମୟ ସହର।
କୋଣାର୍କ ର ଭଗ୍ନ ସ୍ଥାପତ୍ୟ
ଆଶ୍ଚର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଓ ରୁଗ୍ଣତାର ଖଣ୍ଡେ ନାଲି ମାଟି ହେଇ
ଠିଆ ହେଇଥିଲା ଦରିଆ କୂଳେ।

ପ୍ରେମ ସରିବା ଦିନ
ଶୂନ୍ୟ ସିଂହାସନରେ ସ୍ଥାପନ ହେଲା ଅନ୍ଧାର ଓ
ଅସହିଷ୍ଣୁତାର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ଗରିଷ୍ଠତାରେ
ଅନ୍ୟାୟ,ର ଅପରିଣାମଦର୍ଶିତା
ଟାଣିଆଣିଲା ଗୋଟେ ରକ୍ତ ନଈ।
ନାରୀକୁ ସାମଗ୍ରୀ ଭାବିବା ଭାରୀ ପଡିଲା
ଭରା ନଈରେ ଭାସିଲା ଭୋକିଲା ସମ୍ପର୍କ।
ଭିନ୍ନ ଦିଶିଲା ଆକାଶର ଛାଇ।

ପ୍ରେମ ସରିବା ଦିନ
ଧାନଗୋଚ୍ଛା ପିଟିଲା ପରି
କାରାଗାରର ନବଜାତକୁ ପିଟିଲ ଶିଳାରେ
ଅଗାଡି ହେଇ ପଡିଥିଲା ମୁଠାଏ ଆତଙ୍କର ରକ୍ତ, ମାଂସ
ଓ ଧାନ ଉଡ଼ିଗଲା ଧରିତ୍ରୀ ଛାଡି ଶୂନ୍ୟ କୁ।
ପ୍ରେମ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଶାରେ ପ୍ରେମ ହିଁ  ବାଜି ଲାଗିଲା ବାତ୍ସଲ୍ୟର।
ଅଷ୍ଟ ପାଟବଂଶୀ, ଷୋଳ ସହସ୍ର  ଗୋପ ନାରୀ
କାହାରି ଯୋଟକ ପଡିଲା ନାହିଁ କୃଷ୍ଣ ନାଁ ସହ।
ଯେମିତି ଜୟ ରାଧେ କୃଷ୍ଣ, ଜୟ ରାଧେ ହରି
ତୋ ନାଁ ଜପି ଜପି ଜୀବ ଯାଉ ସରି।

ପ୍ରେମ ସରିବା ଦିନ
ଦଳେ ଆତଙ୍କବାଦୀ
ଚାଉଳରୁ ଚଷୁ ବାଛିଲା ଭଳି
ପଚାରି ପଚାରି ଗୁଳି କଲେ ଗୋଟେ ଧର୍ମକୁ।
ଏଠି ମଣିଷ ନୁହେଁ କି ମାନବିକତା ନୁହେଁ
ଗାଈ, ବକରୀ କାଟିଲା ପରି
ଟିକେ ଆଇଁଶିଆ ସଉକ ପାଇଁ
ଶୂଳି ରେ ଚଢିଲା ଗୋଟିଏ ନିରୀହ ପ୍ରେମ।

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
कविताएँ महज शब्द नहीं, एक आवरण हैं,
परिधान है वो, जो ओढ़ती लेखनी है।
यह तो भावों का आचमन, एक समर्पण है,
इसे उघाड़ो मत, यह अंतर्मन की ध्वनि है।

कलेवर लगाकर पढ़ो इसे, बस विधा मानो,
कवि के निजी जीवन का इसे गवाह न जानो।
उन्हें महसूस करो, जिन्होंने इसे महसूसा है,
तभी तो यह सृजन समष्टि को समर्पित हुआ है।

माँ शारदे के आशीष से जो सुर मिला,
तभी तो कोरे पन्नों पर यह भाव खिला।
यह तूलिका महज स्याही का रूप नहीं,
यह तो बहता हुआ अस्थि-मज्जा-रक्त है।

इसी ने दामिनी की चीख को पन्नों पर उतारा,
यही किन्नर और वेश्या के दर्द का भक्त है।
कवि ने पात्र के हृदय को गहराई से जिया,
उसके दुखों को परिधान बनाकर खुद पहन लिया।

तड़प को महसूस कर जब भावों को पिरोया,
तब जाकर कहीं इन शब्दों ने आकार लिया।
समाज से ही तो शब्द और संवेदनाएँ पाईं,
फिर शब्दों का आवरण पहनाकर यह मूरत बनाई।

वह खुद हर दर्द की भुक्तभोगी नहीं होती,
संवेदना और वेदना के गहरे सागर में डूबकर,
आपकी ही अनकही, अनसुनी भावनाओं को,
उसकी कलम कागज़ पर मुकम्मल करती है।

आप भी इसे बस एक सुंदर आवरण बना लें,
इसे ओढ़कर, इसकी रूह को महसूस कर लें।
रचना का इस तरह निर्मम पोस्टमार्टम न करें,
कवि का मन दुखता है, रूह में सिहरन होती है!

∎

जमशेदपुर

I glanced at the window despondently,
Weary were my thoughts, wearier my body,
On flew a million thoughts peering and peeping,
I thought aghast at the atrocities of war, the tired and exhausted tents of Gaza,
The chill and hunger, weather beaten and parched shining bright like the golden sun which
shone on me,
The faces of the malnourished innocence to the despair of the experienced as they desperately
tried to keep rodents and illness at bay
I felt betrayed by the blue waters of The Strait of Hormuz,
Pondering what secrets lurked in their murky depths,
But then Peace smile on me smoothing my aching head,
While Gratitude waved to me followed closely by
Peace who smiled and reminded me that as long there was life we could depend on our dear
friend Hope,
∎

Betaal`s voice creeps in,
like static on a forgotten frequency.
“I ask you-
Who in this world is not a prisoner?”
The air tightens,
the room thick with something you can`t name,
something old,
something that`s been here too long.
“Who is the most faithful
the one who hides behind the truth,
or the one who speaks it and watches it burn?”
The silence hums,
a low, constant thrum in your ears.
You can feel it,
settling in your chest,
but you don`t say a word.
“Who is the most human
the one who wears the weight of their face,
or the one who lets it slip away,
leaving only the mark of a memory?”
The space feels smaller now,
air thick with the scent of things once alive.
The clock ticks,
too loud, too fast
but you cannot move,
you cannot breathe.

“Who is the true heir
the one who claims the future,
or the one who watches it slip into the past,
just out of reach?”
The question hangs,
unanswered,
like a flicker of light on a dying screen.
You are left with nothing but the echo,
the hum that never stops,
the riddle that never ends.
“You know,”
Betaal whispers,
“You`ve always known.”
And in the stillness,
you can hear it-
the sound of time slipping away.
He stays,
perched behind your eyes,
curled in your ribs,
a voice that no longer needs to ask.
Because now,
Vikramaditya isn`t the one
carrying the corpse.
∎

Before your voice entered my days, The sky was beautiful, yet
incomplete; Then every sunset found a deeper hue, and silence
learned a gentler heartbeat.
You came like rain on thirsty earth, A blessing neither sought nor
planned; The seasons gathered in your smile, and bloomed like
gardens at your hand.
Love is not the fire that fades, nor fleeting sparks that briefly
shine; It is the moon upon dark waters, Turning ordinary moments
divine.
I find your presence in the wind, that wanders softly through the
trees; A hidden music fills the air, Composed in notes of memory.
Though oceans stretch between our shores, no distance alters
what is true; The stars may travel countless years, yet still their
light arrives anew.
Your kindness leaves a trail of dawn, Across the landscapes of the
heart; A quiet grace that teaches hope, and keeps all shadows far
apart.
If time should write its silver lines Upon the pages of our days,
my soul would still recognize yours, Beyond the reach of age or
change.
And when the final evening falls, and earthly songs grow faint
and few, Love will remain—a timeless light, forever finding its
way to you.
∎

A seed of hope
a committed trust
like the words
of Casabianca`s father
that made the boy defy
the burning deck.

Myth is the witness
in man`s court,
when the naughty boy
left his fickle girl,
the separation suddenly assumed
a cosmic seriousness -

"I will return" the three magic words
of the cow herd weighed heavier
than the other magical utterances -
"I love you" etc. Suddenly
years piled up over the urchin`s age,
she riping into instant womanhood.

Today, in temple`s sanctum
Radha is made to stand
by Krishna, but she
cringes away in disgust,
"He is Rukmini`s husband,
not my Kanha."

But unlike abducted Puro of Pinjar
across the border,
who shouted back, "I will return".
Her people heard and rejoiced
but her promise ordained
an unrequited nationhood.

It kept hanging across
the cursed border - stitching
love, loss with threads of tears.
Life oscillating between
her past and present
she compromised with an inevitabilty.

Unlike the rain that returns
every monsoon, pouring its promise
into dreary lips of cracked mud.
A sigh of petrichor blows
to assuage the asphyxiated dry seed
down the earth`s womb.
∎

If bullets shot flowers
How it would be
The world would be a different one
One can feel at home
Wherever he wants to be
In place of cartridge and gunpowder,
There will be buds and petals
The fields once scarred by hatred
Will bloom with love and peace.

If bullets will be scented flowers,
The world would be filled
With fragrance of coexistence
And every battlefield would turn
Into a garden of hope trust and bliss

There will be no scent of sorrow,
No trails of blood, no wailing sirens
Only blossoms of hope and harmony
Will adorn the gardens of the earth.

The earth the sky and the water base
Will breathe in peace
As hatred will be bound to cease
No wounds to heal no tears to shed
The air will be filled with
The warmth of brotherhood
When love will take care if
Every battle cry
The Nations will vote for peace
The weapons will be thrown away

There will be no treaties or negotiations
Compassion will unite the mankind
The Global language will be love
Greeting cards of good luck
Will for ever be exchanged
∎

Towards spring`s end
another day is just starting.
I hear motorbike horns
shivering engines of old public buses
and voices from the local teashops
amid cycle bells
and squeaks of rolling shutters.
The day is getting off to a typical start.
It will follow the sun
with the same shadows as yesterday.
As I head farther away from the night
I must say goodbye to you.
Such is the nature of daylight.
We sink in it, see and think,
think more and move apart.
We begin to peep and grieve
and time passes over fields
taking away the shadows
of storm-beaten trees.
∎

The windows of the green room,
by a magic wand of discharge,
raises its curtains to
exhale exchanges that went on a hibernation.
Back to basics, we linger on aqua vitae
Single or Blended malt, notwithstanding.
∎

Is it fine with you, love, to live and negotiate
through the language of oblivion?
It`s a separate matter that
this is yet another love story for you.
And you can tell us, re-tell, re-tell more tales.
Some know parts of it, some not even a hint of it,
some compose their own editions of it.
Anyway,
I remember the primary version of the tale--
that clouds froze in dark nights.
Despite your claim
that I took your story and turned it into
whatever I needed to.
Fair enough, to make the world contented
of late
you began to amend
a simpler, happier life for yourself.
Fair enough, love!
I am glorious.
Proud.
More proud.(prouder)
Much more, tonight.
To love you is like going to
the battlefield.
One comes broken, bruised
from the battle, for sure.
Still, I feel like a lepidopterist, who has
Gloriously peeved an unusual moth.
We couldn`t have been written out of the past, right?
I know that you know that I know.
The untold and the told, I know it all.
Predictable, comforting, heartening sorrows,
but trustworthy, consistent ones.
Tonight
my city is tranquil;
as if the city is having its meditation classes
as if we all are gleaming from our Yoga sessions.

Tonight
the sky is the woodland of stars.
I wonder,
is another world possible?
Ever? Ever?
Life failed me in a nebulous yet fundamental way.
Let me embrace what you have given me
like we embrace old friends;
let me deal with your gifts like
we handle old enemies.
Perhaps it`s raining in my head
perhaps it`s my survival strategy.
I know that you know that I know.
This is how it has always been
between you and me.
I made you so tall, I needed to,
in order to live life;
and thus, you always act
as if I owe you a thing or two.
We have been simultaneously
sweethearts and former sweethearts
siblings and former siblings
lovers and former lovers
friends and former friends.
When it comes to the matter of heart
we always have had
an implicit jungle of safety nets.
Your knowledge has made you pessimistic;
your intelligence, tough and callous.
You think too much and believe too little.
And love even less.
You are my salvation; you are my nemesis.
In you, I have been swimming through layers of love.
With you, the heart suffers like a grey pebble
in an accumulating stream
rolling down, always in motion.
I have been your beloved madcap.
You know why.I don`t need to tell.
I knew love, the macabre, would visit upon me.
So, you did.
We knew that we knew that we knew.

And then the Judgment Day had been forestalled
a blessing received its place.
I wish life could be minus such determinations
and death minus such finality.
∎

Let them go who never came
Who never stood by the river`s shore alone
Holding hands in silence
The traveller on the journey`s path
Let them mingle in the bustling crowd
Let them see the world through others` eyes.
Let come close when alone and berefeet
Take them to the river`s shore,
And show the path to turn back

∎

She stood,
Barefoot at the edge of her name—
Not Draupadi, not Shakuntala,
But someone who remembered Ahalya`s stillness turned to breath,
Heer`s voice burned beneath songs,
And Sita`s exile: a wilderness of stillness and pausing.
She had been written in the silence between verses,
Braided into stories without even being heard.
Her identity had become a cloak borrowed from myth,
Or a garment stitched by hand,
not her own.

No gods spoke.
Only the echoes of a girl
who had once swallowed the sun,
now cradling the ashes of light.
Like “Prometheus Unbound”,
She bore the fire in silence,
her will, chained to stone.
She was neither the reappearance nor the unfortunate icon.
But an echo, and unspoken suffering between stanzas of canon.

The world called her by titles adorned with reverence—
Patience, virtue, sacrifice—
But each word was a sacrament of erasure.
She remembered how Keats once sang of “negative capability”:
to remain in doubt and uncertainty---
But even that---she thought---was a privilege.

Her doubt was an inundation.
Where she sank into the knowing
that she herself had always been the spectator of her own life,
And never the soliloquy.
Her plunge was slow, not a Lear-like rage against the storm,
But the still crumbling of Cordelia`s silence—
A melting inward,
So complete that even her frame began to overlook
How to belong to her own self..

The rituals remained.
She lit lamps in hollow evenings,
Folded clothes like folded prayers,
And wore her bangles like manacles of inherited expectation.
And when she wept,
It was not for pain,
But for the memory of joy she had once been told to feel.

They mistook her decay for discipline.
But she knew—
The fire inside her was not devotion.
It was undoing.
It was Kali—not the goddess of rage,
But the goddess of necessary ends.
To become, she had to un-become.

Hence, she let herself dissolve.
Each cell---a note in a requiem she wrote without ink.
Each breath--- a farewell to the selves she had lived for others.

Her frame—
Not resurrected, but reclaimed.
Not Eve seeking forgiveness, but Lilith
Walking away from paradise and into the unknown.

She rose--not as myth--but as surface rediscovered.
She did not need
Gabriel`s trumpet or Tennyson`s tides.
Only her own hands, now steady, pressing soil into seed.

She began again.
And again, and again.
Each morning,
A stanza unfurling
From the torn manuscript of her past.

The woman she became
was not Aphrodite rising from the foam,
Nor Cleopatra cloaked in seduction.
She was Draupadi, walking blood-stained
through a court of silence.
She was Durga,
Keeper of crossroads and quiet revolutions.

She no longer sought to be seen
But to see—
through mirrors,
through men,
through myths.

She fed on poetry,
Drinking the salt of Eliot`s Sea,
where “fear in a handful of dust” had once dried her mouth.
But now she tasted fire.

And when the world asked
How she emerged from such holy ruin,
She simply smiled, like a Sphinx who had rewritten the riddle.
No phoenix, no swan.
Just a woman—
Who melted down not to disappear
But to remember
That even ashes can whisper.
∎

ସେଦିନୁ ଗୋଲାପୀ ରଙ୍ଗ ମାନିଲାନି ମତେ,
ବାଦାମୀ କଣ୍ଟା ମାନଙ୍କ ଆଘାତରେ ଚିରିଗଲା ପରେ ଟିପ
ପ୍ରଜାପତି ପର ଆଡେଇ ଛୁଇଁବାକୁ ଇଚ୍ଛା ହେଲାନି ସେ ଡାଳ
ବୁଝିଲି,ମନ ଟିଏ ଥିଲେ ଭାଙ୍ଗ ପଡିବା ଥୟ
ଟିପ ଟିଏ ଥିଲା ଯାକ ଜିଇଁ ରହିଥିବ
ଆଘାତ ପାଇବାର ନିରୀମାଖି ଭୟ !

ସେଦିନ କଇଁବନ୍ଧରେ ରକ୍ତକଇଁର ଆଖି ଖୋଜି ବସିଲି ଯେ
ଦେଖିଲି,କେବେଠୁ ସେ ମୁଦି ଦେଇଛି ତାକୁ
ହାୟ,ଏବେ କିଏ ବୁଝେଇବ
ଆକାଶୀ ଜହ୍ନ କେଉଁ ଅଭିମାନ ବୁଝେ ଯେ !
କଣ ପୃଥିବୀକୁ ଧରି ଆସିପାରେ ସେ
ଜନ୍ମ ମରଣମୟ ଦେହ !
ସେଦିନୁ ନାଲି ରଙ୍ଗକୁ ବି ଭୟ,
ଏ ରଙ୍ଗ ଠି କାଳେ ମିଶି ଯାଇଛି
ଖୁବ୍ ଗାଢ଼; ଗାଢ଼ ରଙ୍ଗର ରକ୍ତଧାରେ
କେଉଁ ଅଫେରନ୍ତା ପ୍ରେମିକର, ପୁଣି ଏଇ ରଙ୍ଗରେ
ବିରହର ଅଷ୍ଟମ ସୁର,
ଏଇ ରଙ୍ଗ ଠି ହିଁ କାଳେ ବାସେ ପ୍ରେମ ଓ ପ୍ରଣୟ !

ଉଜୁଡା ସୋରିଷ ଫୁଲଙ୍କ
ଅପ୍ରେମରେ ଶୁଖୁଥିବା କେଉଁ ହଳଦୀ ବସନ୍ତ ଠି
ସେଦିନ ଦେଖିଲି କେଉଁ ହଳଦୀ ଗୋରୀର ଲହୁଲୁହାଣ ଦେହ,
କିଏ ଜଣେ ଫେରି ଯାଇଥିବାର ଅପାଶୋରା ସ୍ମୃତି,
ଆଉ ଆକାଶ ଛିଣ୍ଡି ପଡୁଥିବାର ତାତିଲା ପବନ ଓଜନର ଭୟ

ସେବେଠୁ,ହଳଦୀ ରଙ୍ଗ ବି ମାନିଲାନି ଆଉ ମୋ ଦେହକୁ
ବୁଝିଲି,ପକ୍ଷୀ ନଥିଲେ ବି ଜିଇଁ ଯାଏ ଆକାଶ
ଭୁଲିଯାଏ ପ୍ରିୟର ଉଡାଣଖୋର ଡେଣା ହଳେ
ଆଉ,ତା ଦେହରେ ବଢିଥିବା କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନିଳ ଅତୀତ !

ସେଦିନୁ ଖୋଜିଲି ମୁଁ
ଗୋଟେ ପୃଥିବୀ ବାସ୍ନାର ଝିଅ ପାଇଁ
ଟୋପେ କାକର ରଙ୍ଗର ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ,
କେଇ ଟୋପା ଉଷୁମ ଲୁହରଙ୍ଗର ନିବିଡ଼ପଣ,
ଗୋଟେ ଧଳା ପ୍ରଜାପତି ଡେଣାର ଅପହଞ୍ଚତାରେ
ସାଇତି ହେଉଥିବା କିଛି ବର୍ଷାପାଣି ରଙ୍ଗର ଅବସୋସ
ଆଉ,ଜମା ଜହ୍ନ ତାରା ଝୁରି ଶିଖି ନଥିବା
ଗୋଟେ ନିରୀହ ବୟସ !
∎

ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ କପେ ଚା ପ୍ରଭଞ୍ଜନ ମିଶ୍ର

ରାତି ଶେଷ ହେଉଛି,
ଏକ ବହୁବାର ପଢ଼ା ପୁସ୍ତକ।
ମୁହଁଟି ଗୋଲାପୀ, ଲାଭେଣ୍ଡର ଲିପା।
ଝାଳ, ଲୁହ ଓ ଲାଳର
ଧୂସର-ବଦାମି ଦାଗ ପୃଷ୍ଠାଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ
ଯେପରି ତିରସ୍କାର।

ମୋ ନିଦୁଆ ମନକୁ
ପୁଣି ସଜାଗ କରି,
ଯେପରି ଜାଲି ପଇସା
ଦେଇ ପିଲାଟିଏକୁ ଠକାଯାଏ,
ମୁଁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରେ ମୋର ଯୋଜନା -
`ସେଭ୍ ରେଡ୍ ରାଇଡିଂ ହୁଡ୍`।

ପ୍ରବେଶ କରେ ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ସାମ୍ରାଯ୍ଯରେ —
ରସୋଇଘରେ।
ସ୍ରୀ ଉଠି ବସନ୍ତି ଶୁଣି,
ବାସନଙ୍କ ଫୁସଫାସ ଟୁଁଟାଁ।
ତାଙ୍କ ମୁଁହ ଭାରି ଭାରି ଲାଲ,
ଭୋର ବେଳର ଅଭିମାନୀ ଜହଁ।

କିନ୍ତୁ ମୋ ହାତରେ
ଅବିଶ୍ୱାସନୀୟ ଚା କପ ଦେଖି,
ଚାର ଚୁମୁକ ନେଇ
ତାଙ୍କ ଅଭିମାନ
ଟର୍ନଷ୍ଟାଇଲ୍ ପରି ଘୁରି ଯାଏ,
କଠୋରତା ଜାଗାରେ ଫୁଟେ ହସ।

ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଢୋକ ପରେ
ତାଙ୍କ ମୁହଁରେ ଝଲସି ଉଠେ
ଖୁସିର ଲହର
ଯେମିତି ମୁଁ ଧୂଳିରୁ ଉଠାଇ
ତାଙ୍କ ମୁକୁଟ ପୁଣି ଚାଙ୍କୁ
ପିନ୍ଧାଇଦେଇଛି।

ସେ ମୋତେ କୋଳକରି
ଭିଜାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତି ସ୍ନେହରେ
ତାଙ୍କ ଦେହ-ଶେଜରେ।
ସେଇଦିନୁ ପରସ୍ପର
ସୀମାଲଂଘନ ହେଇଯାଏ
ଆମପାଇଁ ସାଧାରଣ।

ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ରାଜ୍ୟକୁ ମୋର
ନିୟମିତ ଜିବାଆସିବା,
ଚା ବନାଇବା ଏବଂ
ସକାଳ-ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାରେ
ତାଙ୍କ କୋଳରେ ଆମୋଦିତ ହେବା -
ମୁଁ ବନାଏ ଚା, ସେ ଦିଅନ୍ତି ପୁରସ୍କାର।

ସ୍ନେହର ତୀବ୍ରତା କମିଛି,
ବୟସ ବଢିଛି, ତଥାପି
କମିନି ଇଚ୍ଛାର ଉଷ୍ମତା —
ବାଳ ଝଡିଛି, ଆଖିରେ ଜମିଛି ଅଳନ୍ଧୁ,
ଧସିପଡିଛି ପେଶୀ, ଶୁଖିଛି ଝରଣା,
ଝୁଲିପଡିଛି ଫଳଭାର।

ତଥାପି ଚା ଏବଂ ଟୋଷ୍ଟ
ଆମ ଦାମ୍ପତ୍ଯର ନୈମିତିକ ଆଡମ୍ବର।
∎

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
मन में भरकर प्रीत तुम,कैसे रखते धीर ?
सुन ओ मेरे रांझिया,व्याकुल तेरी हीर ।।

श्वास श्वास में तुम बसे,तुम ही नयन समाय।
मुझको तुम्हरे नाम से,अब सब लोग बुलांय ।।

मान लिया अब आज से, मैंने तुझको मीत. 
आगे आगे तू चले,पीछे तेरी प्रीत।। 

लगते इतने गूढ़ वो ,जैसे कोई वेद,
समझेंगे कैसे भला, कहो नयन के भेद।।

बिखरी-बिखरी सी लटें,नहीं करें श्रृंगार,
कोमल कंचन कामिनी, करें न कैसे प्यार।

नैन मिले जो नैन से,झट हो जाती ओट।
हाय!!न रामा सोच लें,क्या हिय उनके खोट।।

कहने होंगे अब हमें,कुछ मन के उदगार ।
हृदय उपासक आपका,दिल बेबस लाचार।

प्रणय निवेदन कर रहे,कर लीजे स्वीकार। 
आज अभी से कर लिया, तुमको अंगीकार।। 

∎

जमशेदपुर

I trace the edges of their shadows
against walls that tremble with tomorrow,
mapping spaces I cannot reach,
the gaps where absence might arrive.
Death hums on a quiet train,
its ticket folded in another`s hand.
It stops too close,
stealing a voice, a gesture,
leaving only the hollow hum behind.
Every laugh is a grain of sand
slipping through a clock I cannot turn back.
Every glance a fragile coin
tossed into a well
that may swallow it silently,
leaving echoes to tremble in the dark.
I fear the silence
that would hollow my rooms,
the slow erasure of those I love,
the way a single absence
can bend the shape of all days.
I trace their lives
like maps drawn on fragile paper,
paths winding through streets and seasons,
paths that may vanish
in the blink of a night.
I want to memorize each line,
each laugh, each sigh,
before the ink fades into shadows.
Mortality is a hall of doors
I cannot open all at once.
I linger at the threshold,
clinging to the warmth of their presence,
writing maps of them
on walls that will outlast me,
for every page I may never turn.
And when the train comes,
quiet as a closing eyelid,
I hope the maps I made
are enough to carry them
through the spaces I cannot follow,
and that memory
becomes a room
where absence is only a shape
I have learned to honor.
∎

Torrential rain enlightens me about
the bygone of care. Bareness, punctuated
with fine, black threads, weave a design of desire.
Silver rays of golden moon caress the ascetic
and wake him from a slumber of aridity.

Exhausted from the onslaught of time,
his in-built curves could retain the slippery hedge,
where, once, neon lights shone through smoky days,
and, pleasure, splashed from the mug, transformed into
sonorous sounds of satisfaction.

Enroute the gorge, a magnet-like moment
stops at the globes; a pinkish brown terrain unveils
to shame the moist earth. Before I slip into a dream,
ambitious eyes – sleepy yet sharp – invite me
to a destination, unknown.
∎

One by one ,my plumage stripped and scattered,
I crumpled on the barren grass.
Like a betrayed Julius , I was shattered .

Was I too ambitious, too quickly revealed?
Or did I stand where their own dreams had failed?

Each time I tried to rise and take my flight,
They reached and dragged me swiftly to the ground.
My spirit suffered in silence.

While in shadows ,Hamlet`s question echoed within :
"To be or not to be..." in this existence

In this worldly race of humans 
Where honest truth is lost in cunning lies,
And shallow, false promises keeps deceit alive,
Hidden behind the smiles in their cold eyes.

The challenges of Lear whispers in my ear 
"Blow, winds, and crack your cheeks! rage! blow!"
Faith ,hope and courage must make it`s way .
Like the last flight of a Phoenix rising from the ashes of yesterday .
∎

Old memories masquerade, dream-like.
They write themselves
against the scarred flesh and muscle of Time.
Was it a tinge of taunting friendship
or a wild rendezvous of a short-lived,
whirlwind romance?
The molten grief of dead ones
who dwindled, by and by, like fallen leaves?
Forgotten lyrics and rhythms of a dying heart
that had once, throbbed with a symphony of fire?
In this dusty landscape now, my hissing prose
my rattling rhyme sings of absence,
the absence of the luminous wings,
the precarious secrets churning,
the rain of migrant music that welled as tears
the clamor of voices that tangled
the chilly evening air.
In absence, I find the note, the sound, the want
traversing through my every molecule.
I ingest the melting soul of the missing puzzles
and the music of nothingness bubbles up.
The nothingness that makes the flesh and bones,
the sinew and muscles of my nameless verses.
∎

source_fields.captured_title: Sashisena Temple, Sonepur – A Song of Love, Liberation, and Legacy
source_fields.body_html:
— A Poem in English Inspired by the Sacred Soil of Sonepur:
In the heart of Sonepur’s silent land,
Stands a shrine, so calm, so grand.
No doors it holds, no walls to bind,
A temple open to all of humankind.
Built in the year of nineteen twenty,
Not with gold, but love in plenty.
It tells the tale of a royal flame,
Of Sashisena and Ahi Manikya’s name.
She, the princess — fierce and free,
He, a minister’s son — brave as can be.
Their hearts met like the monsoon rain,
Flowing through joy, flowing through pain.
But fate was cruel, and spells were cast,
By Jema Dei, of the tantric past.
Ahi turned sheep by light of day,
By night, a man — in shadows’ sway.
Yet love stood tall, it did not break,
Not spells, nor fear, could it forsake.
In forests deep, in nights of cries,
Their love still danced beneath the skies.
This temple rose not for gods above,
But for the power of human love.
No priestly throne, no grand pretense,
Just silent walls with deep incense.
And in her name, the winds still sing,
Of freedom's flight, of woman’s wing.
For Sashisena, with spirit wide,
Chose her path, her love, her pride.
She spoke not words in whispered tone,
But stood for dreams she called her own.
In a world that told her to obey,
She carved her truth, her rightful way.
This temple now, a voice of grace,
For every woman in every place.
To rise, to love, to break all chain,
To walk through fire and dance through rain.

So come, dear soul, and bow your head,
Not just for gods, or tales once said.
But for a girl who dared to be,
A symbol of love — and of being free.
Nimuhi Mandir — a doorless shrine, where love walks in, unmarked by time.
A call to the heart, to remember that love liberates, and truth shines.
A woman once loved here — now, she leads.
Sashisena still lives — in every woman who dares to dream.
∎

I was blooming
In the garden of my own world.
You came into my life
Like a gust of wind,
Seizing my emotions
With fragrance and innocence.
Our two hearts became one life;
Without each other we can`t survive.
The thread of love bound us closely.
You adorn yourself with me,
Weave me in a garland.
My heart assures:
I am yours, I am yours.

 

∎

Love is a wonderful feeling,
Where the heart keeps reeling,

Love in childhood is Mother`s pride,
In adolescence beloved is the guide,

In youth the tiger hunts the tigress,
A soulful union is true bliss,

Creators magic spells,
Moods of the partner often compels,

Compels for a tight embrace,
To be lost within each other`s arms press,

Hold the beloved tight,
Never to leave her without a conjugal flight,

In hideous seeking a soulful union,
In deep embrace lost under the neon,

Love holds you mad in attraction,
Forget in each other`s arms for a breath-taking union,

Sighing like a furnace at the beloved,
In deep breath of palpitations lost & loved,

Behold by her beauty you turn a maniac,
A minute`s absence makes you sick,

Beseech her forever by your side,
Holding you tight in arms & closed eyes you hide,

Live, love & laugh is the mantra of life,
The planet holds in embrace as long as you live,
∎

After the aroma of a rapport  
 That is not being shaken
That is beyond the clutches of hugging 
That is afar the capacity of an  eye to grab 
Spreads anonymous wings,
With the backing of a conspirator cloud, the rain
Clapping its hands created a fake river.
Drawing the line of  partition while the river was flowing 
 Water bubbles burst with laughter.
Waves in the form of braids
Stretched from this bank to that bank.
Instead of causing landslips
 They turn into an overpass that touched both banks.
Getting the ford, getting the shelter, bonding grew up.
After the wrath of the unseasonable rain caved in 
After the vanishing of the bigoted river
The intricacy of rowing the boat
Since long is being mortgaged sans notice.
There is no dispute that could insist overpowering 
Not a viable trace is visible now. 
The flat chest of that dead river now adorns 
 Flowers and fruits  aplenty, fortune and affection 
Where sings the song of delight and contentment,
The time of a daughter, defiant and wild.
∎

source_fields.captured_title: ପ୍ରେମର ପୃଥିବୀ ଟିଏ ହଜି ହଜି ଯାଉଛି
source_fields.body_html:
ପ୍ରେମର ପୃଥିବୀଟିଏ ହଜି ହଜି ଯାଉଛି
ମୁଁ ଧ୍ବଂସାଭିମୁଖୀ।
ମୁହଁ ସବୁ ଅଚିହ୍ନା
ନା ଅଛି ଶବ୍ଦ ଓଠରେ ନା ହସ
ଆଖିକୁ ନେଇ ଲେଖିଥିବା କବିତା ଏବେ ଅସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ
ଅବିଶ୍ବାସର ପୃଥିବୀଟିଏ ବଢ଼ି ବଢ଼ି ଚାଲିଛି।

ନିଇତି ସଫା ହେଇ ଦର୍ପଣ ନୂଆଁ ମୁହଁ ଖୋଜୁଛି
ଗଡି ଯାଉଛି ନଈର ପାଣି
ମୁଁ ମୁହଁ ଦେଖୁଛି ,
ହେଲେ ଇଏ ସମାନ ପାଣି ନୁହଁ
ମୁହଁ ବି ଅଲଗା।

ମୁଁ ସ୍ଥିତପ୍ରଜ୍ଞ ପାହାଡଟିଏ ,
ଛିଡ଼ା ହେଇଚି
ମୋ ଦେଇ ସେମାନେ ଚଢ଼ି ଶୀର୍ଷକୁ ଛୁଉଁଛନ୍ତି,
ମୁଁ ସାଇତି ରଖୁଛି ପାଦ ଚିହ୍ନ ସବୁକୁ ।
ଚଢ଼େଇ ମାନଙ୍କ ଡେଣା, ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଉଡାଣ
ନିଇତି ନୂଆଁ ନୂଆଁ ଆକାଶ ଖୋଜା ଓ
ମୋଠୁ ଦୂରେଇ ଯିବାର ଗ୍ଲାନି
ମୋତେ ଭାରାକ୍ରାନ୍ତ କରୁଛି।

ନୀରବତା ଯଦି ଜଙ୍ଗଲ, ମୋତେ ଘେରି ରହିଛି
ସହର ଯଦି କୋଳାହଳ,ମୋ ଠୁ ଦୂରେଇ ଯାଉଛି।
ମୁଁ ଆଲବମ୍ ରେ ରଖି ଦେଲିଣି ମୁହଁସବୁକୁ
କାଁ ଭାଁ କେବେ କେମିତି ଦେଖେ
ପୁଣି ଟ୍ରଙ୍କ ଭିତରେ ରଖିଦିଏ ,
ଭାବେ ଆଲବମ୍ ର ମୁହଁମାନେ
ପରସ୍ପର ସହ କଥା ହେଉଥିବେନା ଟ୍ରଙ୍କ ଭିତରେ!

କେମିତି ଜମା ସେମାନଙ୍କ ବୟସ ବଢ଼ୁନି,
ସ୍ଥିର ରହିଛି
କେମିତି କିଛି ବି କାହା ସହ ନ କହି
ସେମାନେ କଥା ହେଉଛନ୍ତି ।
ଗୋଟାଏ ଜାମା ରେ ବିତି ଯାଉଛି ଜୀବନ
ସମୟ ସ୍ଥିର, ନା ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ନା ଉତ୍ତର
ସଭିଏଁ ନିରୁତ୍ତର।

ପରସ୍ପର ସହ ବୁଝାମଣା ବେଶ୍ ଅଛି,
ଆବେଗ, ସୁଖ ଦୁଃଖ
ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧିଷ୍ଟ ଏକ ସମୟରେ ଅଲଝି ଯାଇଛି।

ବାହାରେ ଅନ୍ଧାର, ଆଲୁଅ ର ଲୁଚକାଳି ଖେଳ
ବାହାରେ ଅସ୍ତ୍ର ଶସ୍ତ୍ର ର ଆଦାନ ପ୍ରଦାନ
ବାହାରେ ଆତତାୟୀ ଜହ୍ନ
ବାହାରେ ମିଛ ହସ ମିଛ ପ୍ରେମ
ବରଫରେ ଢ଼ଙ୍କା ମାଛର ଜୀବନ
ବାହାରେ ବଜାର,ଭିଡ଼,ମାଛି ଭଣଭଣ ।

ମନେ ପକେଇ କେହି କାହାକୁ
ସ୍ମୃତିରେ ରଖି ପାରେ କି?
ଉଇ ଖାଏ କି ପ୍ରେମର କାଠ ସିନ୍ଧୁକକୁ?

ରାତିରେ ସ୍ବପ୍ନ ରେ ଆସୁଥିବା ଚରିତ୍ରସବୁ
ପାହାନ୍ତି ସକାଳରେ ଉଭେଇ ଯାଆନ୍ତି,
ମୁଁ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରିଥାଏ ଅନ୍ୟ ଏକ ରାତିକୁ,
ଅନ୍ୟ ଏକ ସ୍ବପ୍ନ କୁ,
ଅନ୍ୟ ଏକ ଦର୍ପଣକୁ ଓ
ବହିଯାଉଥିବା ଏକ ଚପଳା ନଈକୁ ।
∎
ଟିକ୍ରାପଡ଼ା, ପୋ/ଜି ବଲାଙ୍ଗୀର,୭୬୭୦୦୧
ମୋ:୯୪୩୭୧୫୦୯୫୧

ତୁମେ ତୁମ ତମାମ ପାପର ଅଭିଶାପରେ
ଦିନେ ଧରାଶ୍ରୟୀ ହେବ,
ପାଟି ହୋଇଯିବ ପତନର ସ୍ତୂପ ତଳେ।
ଇତିହାସର ପୃଷ୍ଠାରେ ଚରିତ୍ରଟିଏ ନୁହେଁ,
ଦାଗଟିଏ ହୋଇ ରହିଯିବ
ଡୁମୁରା ଗନ୍ଧରେ।

କାଳର ବାଲିଝଡ଼ ଢାଙ୍କିଦେବ
ତୁମ ସବୁଯାକ ପାଦଚିହ୍ନ,
ପବନ ଉଡ଼େଇ ନେବ ତୁମ
ଶେଷ ହାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡଟିର ପାଉଁଶମୁଠାକୁ।
ଆକାଶ ଫରଚା ଦିଶିବ ସେଦିନ,
ଯେମିତି ଏବେ ଏବେ ପରାସ୍ତ କରିଛି
କଳା ମେଘର ରାକ୍ଷସଟିକୁ ମଲ୍ଲଯୁଦ୍ଧରେ।

ତୁମର ଯେଉଁ ସବୁ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନର ଚିଆଁ
ଦିନେ ଆଖି ମେଳିବେ ବୋଲି,
ତୁମର ଏତେ ସବୁ ଉଦ୍ଧତପଣ—
ସେମାନେ ଦିନେ ଅନ୍ଧ ମୃତ୍ୟୁର ଆହାର ପାଳଟିବେ।
ଭାଙ୍ଗି ରେଣୁରେଣୁ ହୋଇଯିବ
ଦିନେ ତୁମ କୃତ୍ରିମ ମିନାର।

ଦିନେ ଶୂନ୍ୟ ହେବ ତୁମ ରାଜସିଂହାସନ,
ଦାସଦାସୀର ବଂଶ ନିପାତ ହେବ।
ଧୂଳି ଚାଖିବ ଆଳଟ ଚାମର,
କିଛି ବି ନଥିବ ତୁମ ଚିହ୍ନବର୍ଣ୍ଣ—
ଜୟଗାଥା, ଶିଳାଲେଖ,
ସ୍ମୃତି, ଶୁଭାଦର।

ତୁମର ତମାମ ଯନ୍ତ୍ରଣାକୁ
ଦିନେ ଅସହ୍ୟ ଘୋଷଣା କରି
ପୃଥିବୀ ଝାଡ଼ିନେବ ନିଜ ଦେହ।
ଗୋଟେ ପ୍ରଳୟରେ ଧୋଇ ନେବ
ନିଜର ସମସ୍ତ କ୍ଷତାକ୍ତ ଚିହ୍ନ, ରକ୍ତଦାଗ।
ନୁଆଁ ଏକ କଳରବରେ ଦିନେ
ଘୋଷଣା କରିବ—
ମୁଁ, “ପୁନର୍ଣ୍ଣବା”।
∎

ମୁଁ ମଣିଷ ହେଇ ବି
ଡରାଇଦିଏ ମଣିଷମାନଂକୁ
କହୁକହୁ ମୁଖର ହେଇଯାଏ ଘା` ସବୁ
ପତା ପଡିଥିବା ଆଖିମାନେ
ଶୋଇଯାଇଥିବା କାନମାନେ
ନିଦର ପଂକରୁ ଉଠିଆସିପାରନ୍ତିନି
ଯନ୍ତ୍ରଣାର ବିକଟାଳ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ବଳ ଉତ୍ସବକୁ

ଲୁହଲୁହ ମେଘର
ଛିଡି ଯାଇଥିବା ରାଆ ଫେରିବା ଆଗରୁ
ଆଦିମ କୋହର ଘଷିମୁଣ୍ଡା ଜଳିବା ଆଗରୁ
ସେମାନେ ଖୋଜିଆଣନ୍ତି ସମୟର ଢେଲା
ମୋତେ ଫିଙ୍ଗିବାକୁ,
ମୋର ବାପ ନାହିଁ ବୋଲି
କଇଁକଇଁ କାନ୍ଦରେ ନିଦଭାଂଗେ ନାହିଁ ପୃଥ୍ବୀର
କେହିକେହି ବସିଯାନ୍ତି ପାଖରେ
ବିଶ୍ବାସ ଥୁଅନ୍ତି କାନ୍ଧରେ
ଜହ୍ନଟିଏ ଲୁହଢାଳେ ଗଂଗଶିଉଳିର ଛାତିରେ
ଅଚାନକ

ହଣା ଖାଇଥିବା ବଢିଲା ଡାଳ ପରି ଦିଶେ
ମୋର ଦିନସବୁ
ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଗଲାଆଇଲା ଚିହ୍ନାଲୋକ କୁହେ
ମୁଁ ଗୋଟେ ବିଷଣ୍ଣ କ୍ଷେତରେ ଶରତର ଧାନକେଣ୍ଡା
ମୁଁ ସହରିଆ ଆଡପାଗଳା
ଯିଏ ହାଣିଚାଲେ
ନିଜ ଡାଳ, ମୂଳ, ଚେର
ଚିହ୍ନିଲାଯାଏଁ ମଂଜି ମୋର, ମାଟି ମୋର

∎

ଫୁଲର ମହକ କବିତା
ଆକାଶର ନୀଳ ପରଦା କାନଭାସ୍ ରେ
ଲେଖି ହୁଏ କବିତା
ମୁଲିଆରେ ନିଗିଡ଼ା ଝାଳରେ
କବିତା ଗମ ଗମ ହେଇ ବୋହି ଯାଏ
କବିତାକୁ କ`ଣ ସତରେ ଲେଖି ହୁଏ ?
ତାକୁ ଲେଖୁ ଥିବା ଲୋକ
ନିଜକୁ କବି ନାଁ ଦେଇ ପାରେ?
କୋଇଲି ର ରାହାରେ
ଅନେକ ଦ୍ୱିପହର
ନିସ୍ତେଜ ନୁହଁ ସତେଜ ଲାଗେ
ଆମ୍ବ ନସି ର ବାସ୍ନା
ଉଡ଼ନ୍ତା ଧୂଳିର ପ୍ରଲେପ ବୋଳି
ମୋ ପାଖାପାଖି ହେଲା ବେଳେ
ଅଧା ଖଣ୍ଡିଆ କବିତା
କଞ୍ଚା ଜଖମ ନେଇ
ମୋ ଝରକା ଏରୁଣ୍ଡି ରେ ପିଟି ହୁଏ.

କଲମ ର କାଳିରେ
କବିତା ଘୋରେ ନିଜ ଦେହକୁ
ଅମଣ ଶବ୍ଦ ସବୁକୁ
ଅଳିକ ପ୍ରେମିକା ସଜେଇ
ବୋଲୋ ମନେଇ
ଧରିବାକୁ ହୁଏ
ଦିନରେ ଜୁଳୁଜୁଳିଆ ମାନଙ୍କୁ
କବିତା ଏବେ କବାଡ଼ିଆ ଘରେ ରଦ୍ଦି ହେଲାଣି
କବିତା ଏବେ ଶବ ମହଜୁଦ୍ ଥିବା କୋଠାରୀରେ
ବରଫ ହେବାକୁ ବସିଲାଣି
ପେନ୍ଥା ପେନ୍ଥା କବିତା
ବଜାର ଘାଟର ବିକଟାଳ ରଢ଼ିରେ
ନୀରବି ଗଲେଣି
କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଲୋକ ?
ନା କବି ହେଲା
ନା ନିଜକୁ ଓଟାରି ଆଣି ପାରିଲା
କବିତା ର ଗଳିକନ୍ଦିରୁ
ଖୁନ୍ଦା ବସ୍ତାରେ ଆଉ କେତେ ଖୁନ୍ଦି ହେବ
କବିତା ଲେଖି ବସିଲେ ତା କଣ କବିତା ହେବ ?
∎

ଗଛ ତଳେ

ସୂତା ଛିଣ୍ଡିବ ନାହିଁ ଦର୍ଶକ ସାମ୍ନାରେ କୋଉ ବା ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ଅଛି ସବୁବେଳେ
ମଞ୍ଚ ଉପର ଉପହାସ କି ଅପନିନ୍ଦା ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଆହୁରି ଢେର୍ ଦୁଃଖ ବହୁଛି

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
चलो आज कुछ स्वप्न बुनें,
मन-उपवन से पुष्प चुनें,
कर लें सूक्ष्म संचय हम,
मृदा-हृदय में भाव गुनें।

जब अंकुरित हों भाव-सुमन,
नेह-जल से हों सिंचित तन,
सहेजूँ स्पंदन अंजूरी भर 
हँस उठे हरितिम मधुवन।

जब-जब आए मधुप अलि,
पार्श्व बसाऊँ लज्जित कलि,
प्रीत-मकरंद संजो,
उड़े गगन ले सुवास चली।

पुष्प-पंखुरी से पुनः,
बीज रूप धरें जीवन,
मृदा-मिलन में लीन हो,
वृहत् वृक्ष से विकसित वन।

यह क्रम अनवरत ही चले ,
नव-रूपों में जीवन ढले,
यह शाश्वत गति अविचल,
लहरित हो सृष्टि के तले।

हम भी कुछ संकल्प गढ़ें,
संग-संग कुछ स्वप्न जड़ें,
स्नेह-लेपित धरा-तन पर,
एक प्रीति-विटप विकसित करें।

छाया तले फिर संग मिलें,
शांत हों संताप के छले,
जड़ दृढ़ हो अंतर-तल में,
ताप-दाह सब दूर चले।

दुःखाग्नि में दीप जले,
नेह-सिक्त उर दृढ़ पले,
मार्ग कठिन यदि आ पड़े,
पग न रुके, संकल्प चले।

∎

जमशेदपुर

source_fields.captured_title: When the Cannons Break the Sky
source_fields.body_html:
When the cannons break the sky,
Forgetting her lullabies the Earth helplessly cries
Smoke, the blackened breath of war, curls into the sky
Like a question that no one dares to answer

The borders blaze with fire
Call it patriotism, justice or victory
But the sky burns with false triumph
And the earth bleeds with sheer pain

Somewhere beneath the thunder,
a mother still hums the homecoming song
for her son’s return from the distant land
unaware of which uniform will bring him home.

War teaches the tongue of fury:
Loud, fierce and unquestioned
And the gentle dialect of compassion
Is the one we forget to speak

It lives in the soldier
Who lowers his rifle for a child
In the stranger
Who risks his life for the wounded

In the moment
when someone realises
that a heartbeat knows no nationality

Because tolerance is not weakness
It is the courage
to extend a helping hand to someone
when hatred commands you to turn away

For wars are not fought
only with bombs and bullets-
They grow quietly, sprouting from
the small betrayal of empathy

And the truest victory in any age
is not the land we conquer
but the horrible hatred
we choose to disown

So, when the cannons break the sky again,
May we answer softly-
with hearts that choose mercy
over the false triumph of hate!
∎

They signed their names
On an embellish eve:
Vows of eternity 
Reeled within . 
Promises swirled round
The majestic havan: 
Clamours of blessings
But the truth 
slept apart 
Naked as ever
Under a rug .
∎

Savage sun
thirsty river
sunburnt season
sizzling fever.
Tearful eyes
cloudy sky
wind laments
drizzles cry.
Laziness crawls
sprinting time
rustling shadows
suspect prime.
Woods sigh
songbirds scream
darkness whispers–
sorrows beam.

∎

Near the Autumnal foothills
Green plots of golden corns
Are separated from each other
By thin lines of wavy border
On which plentiful sticks
Grow from catkin grasses.
Beyond the fields long lines of trees
Are decorated with seasonal beauties,
Dirty dressed peasants diligently toil till
The Eye moves down the glowing hill,
Then humble peasants return homeward
When myriad feathers to their green world,
In darkness the villagers have a fear
Of wild but timid nocturnal creature
That recovers from day`s fever!
And also fear of the fair outsider!
∎

I didn`t write from childhood days but loved poetry;
For years, I felt it was the last thing I could do
Because whenever I tried, it lacked symmetry,
As if words had their minds to ensure I fell through.
I`d be cheered by daffodils, swept by the west wind,
Dreaming to leave my footprints on the sands of time;
The thoughts of Lord Ullin`s daughter would cross my mind
And make me visit an ancient mariner`s rhyme.
But when I came out of their sadness and delight
To live and love my own pain, I learnt how to write.
∎

My midnight story

My midnights often finds me a sole audience to its feats.

Last night it’s shadows waltzed,
To the serenade played exclusively for me.

In their darkest silhouettes
I found exuberant Vibgyor.

For sometime ,I bounced in the relished freedom of silence.

Shutting the cacophonous arguments in my mind.

However, Very soon I wanted to enter the threshold of sleep and it’s dreams.

I threw a last look at the dancing shadows, in the pale moonlight.

Felt the cool of the zephyr floating from the hills,

As sleep drenched me and wrapped me in her domain.

Eyelids closed,I travelled afar.

And in that world of dreams...

Midnight shadows surfaced, Hell bent on keeping my company.
This time started the dance to a divine rendition, straight from heaven.

And with them I walked ,I soared,I flew ,I spoke.

Through the dales,
The brook, the clouds,
The rolling hills,
The fields , the thick fog
The mysterious wood.

They eased the harsh knots of reality
By their dark ,strong , steadfast company.
And help me reach nearer to
The halo of my dreams.

But someone said midnight shadows are tentacles which badly traps you in its fold.

I wonder how...
When I find my midnights as exclusive moments of introspection and reveries.

∎

Time, how lucky are you
Your own timekeeper
With none to question you
And none to answer to!
If you were a person
What would you do
With all of you
Belonging to you?
Would you prefer
Your own company
Or would crave for
Something transitory?
Will pain and pleasure
Matter to you as much
If you had the power
To decide on its length?
How long would you
Live in a moment
Before you choose to
Step into the next!

∎

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
मत पूछो मुझसे प्रेम का अर्थ,
वह शब्दों में बँधता नहीं,
जो साँसों में मद्धम मद्धम
दीप सा जलता है! कहता नहीं।

तुम हो
जैसे साँझ में थिरकती छाया,
जिसे न छू सकती हूँ,
न खो सकती हूँ।
दृग के कोरों पर जो ठहर गया
वह अश्रु नहीं पहचान है,
मेरी मौन वेदना का
एक अकाट्य -सा प्रमाण है।

प्रीत में वचन कैसे लिखूँ,
जब स्वयं ही शेष नहीं,
मैं तो बिखरकर तुम्हारी स्मृति में
धीरे-धीरे विलीन हुई कहीं।

न राधा होने की चाह रही,
न कृष्ण तुम्हें कह पाई,
इन नामों से परे कहीं
मेरी आत्मा ने तुम्हें पहचाना,
और चुपचाप अपनाया।

अब न हार का कोई विषाद,
न जीत की कोई आकांक्षा है,
 अब मेरी परछाई भी मेरी नहीं ,
जो बचा वह तुम्हारी छाया है।

मैं हूँ,या नहीं यह प्रश्न नहीं,
अब `मैं` से मेरा कोई नाता नहीं,
तुम्हारी स्मृति की दीपशिखा में
मेरा अस्तित्व भी मौन हो गया।

∎
जमशेदपुर

सुख - समृद्धि का पर्व हो ऐसी सबकी अभिलाषा हो
बैरी-अबैरी संग-संग खेले ऐसी होली की परिभाषा हो
खुशियों वाली आंगन में अबीर-गुलाल की मस्ती हो
अधरों पर मधुमास खिला हो, आंखों में मधुशाला हो।




आया देखो महीना बसंत का
मंजरी, महुआ महक उठा है
हवाएं झूम-झूम फाग गा रही है
पकवानों की सौंधी खुशबू आ रही है
गली-मोहल्ले, नुक्कड़ पर
रंगों की आतीशबाजी है
लिए भावना संस्कृति का
धूम मचाती होली है।


फागुन तेरे स्वागत में
हर रिश्ता लगता भोली है
भाभी संग हुदड़ग की मस्ती
शाली संग हँसी ठिठोली है
पनघट पर गाँव की गौरी
नाच रही मस्ती की टोली है
लिए भावना संस्कृति का
धूम मचाती होली है।


द्वेष, क्लेश को कम करती है
रिश्तों में मिठास भरती है
दोस्त-दुश्मन को एक करती है
बिगड़े रिश्ते पर मरहम रखती है
अपनत्व और भाईचारा का
राग गाती अपनी होली है
लिए भावना संस्कृति का
धूम मचाती होली है........।

∎

अध्यक्ष, विश्व हिंदी परिषद, ओड़िशा प्रदेश

source_fields.captured_author: Tulika Bibidh Rang / तूलिका विविध रंग
source_fields.body_html:
आज मैराथन सी बन गई जिंदगी में ,
हर उम्र के लोग बिना तय की रेस का हिस्सा हैं,
अब बोर्ड की परीक्षाएं , हर कोई हर रोज देता हैं ,
हर दिन मशक्कत के वो बोर्ड मीटिंग्स का किस्सा हैं ,
ऐ आई ने विकास के सूचकांक को ही नहीं, मन की जड़ता को भी रफ़्तार दी हैं ,
मै , मेरा , मेरे लिए , मेरे से , मेरा तक ही दुनिया सिमट गई हैं।

कितना अच्छा होता अगर हम ,
परिवर्तन और बैलेंस की बहार बसंत से सीख पाते,
बिना कड़वाहट के प्रोत्साहन के फूल खिला पाते।
रिश्तों में मंदी और तनाव के ग्राफ को धराशाई कर
आपस में सौहार्द , बासंती उल्लास और प्रेम को बो पाते।

फर्ज़ करें ,
खुशियों के पीले फूल ,
फाल्गुन के गुलाबी गुलाल ,
बुआ , मौसी ,चाची की हंसी ठिठोली ,
बाबा , दादी , नानी की अनुभवी बातें ,
छोटों की किलकारी , बड़ों का आशीर्वाद ,
साथी के साथ से लाल हुए गाल ,
पड़ोसियों की गुझिया और दही बड़े की चटक लिए
आनंद और मुस्कान भरा एक बासंती बजट हो ,

जिसमे सबकी अपनी कहानियां , किस्से , प्रेम , उल्लास , विश्वास , साथ और सौहार्द हो ,
तो मैराथन भरी जिंदगी में भी हर दिन मानो ओलम्पिक अवार्ड का हो ,
सुनाने में शायद थोड़ा ज़्यादा लगे ,
लेकिन क्यों न हम आज से अपने अपने ईष्ट से ,
अच्छे स्वास्थ्य के साथ ,
बासंती रंग , बासंती उन्माद , रिश्तों की मिठास की बसन्तिका ,
बासंती प्रेम की बहार और बासंती खुशियों की बयार की प्रार्थना करें ,

My spiral thoughts
thrive for a deep longing
Of your flashing shadows
Oh! I can`t carry my vacuums
validate your hued murals ,darling!

You know sweetheart 
Your absence derails me
From healthy parkings
to hotchpotch roamings

Grinding your alluring smiles 
I hold a pool of elegant sighs
My pains often chant you
Only to inhale homely rhythms 

Hey baby! Don`t cling to fancy topings
It`s me to be deep -rooted in you
My holdings whisper yours embroidery 
It`s just a replica at no man`s land

Could you peep into my uptight throbs ?
Am overlapped with mundane take offs
Scissoring the dotted doses of tweets
Rekindle romancing candle pecked with perks...

When you smile I smile.
You have come to my life like a lucky girl.
You are my fulcrum.

You turned to be a love now.
You have given me big canvas.
I will paint my life.

We walk together.
We smile each other.
You are as mysterious as before.

It is better to love and die,than being alone.

above the dirt

that smell after rain

of a snail

moss blooming
the way moss blooms

crescent moon

undressed

The sandy, stony shore 
Is various more! 
When there is wide tide 
Something to hide
Little dazzling waves appear 
Embrace the shore 
With a sprightly dance 
They seem to be near ones. 
But, when they draw back 
Take away precious stones. 

Then ebb comes 
Naked pebbles, ribs, 
Dry roots and thorny plants
On the lonely shore 
When waves no more
Threaten the weary travelers. 

∎

Ramnagar College, WB. India.

In the spinning cycle of birth, death and rebirth.

We manifest so much
Without really understanding.

If they are garbages or the fragrance of flowers .

Similarly in the pursuit of the big I
Within this huge universe.

We end up with a big zero.
A big lonely O,
That is smile less
Which will get lost in the colossal O.
Today or tomorrow.
We have deafened our ears
And wrapped our eyes.
In our meaningless alleys.

So many vibrant smiles meet with death
In the pursuit of the big egoistic” I.”
So many luxuriant landscape die,
Under the pressure of drab, listless “I”
So many petals of life wither

Devoid of renewal from the bossy “I”

And before realisation dawns,
So many simple, humble, brimming homes
Becomes lifeless houses.

Can you hear the inanimate walls speak
And yearn for its old ,simple, living souls.
Before they left in the pursuit of the big” I”
In the inflated world.
∎

Bare-skinned she sits, in public eye, bent low,
She needs four walls, to let her power grow.
On one, she`ll paint the mountain eagle`s flight,
On next, the stormy sea, a home of light.
The third, she`ll fill with freedom, bold and free,
The fourth, a vacant space—just vacancy.
Thinking that she`s weak, do you cause such fuss?
And tear her peace, her toys, her joy from us?
Yet still she`s positive, a calm, clear breeze,
Though sad at heart, and raining tears with ease.
Clouded her mind, with thunder, mist, and rain,
She wept quite hard, and cried in yesterday`s pain.
Just look at her—the sheer relative humidity,
See how she rises, defying all rigidity.
Amidst the villagers, she bends not to the dread,
With highest-lowest temp, she lifts her head.
I watch her patterns, see her wings take flight,
I see her skill in tides, that craft and sheer delight.
∎
Siliguri
Darjeeling

कितनी बीती पूस की रातें,
कितने स्वप्न बसंत के,
याद दिलाती हर फागुन वो,
अंतरमुखी प्रिय उस कंत के।

पीली सरसों, पीत अमलतास,
बिखरे धरा पर रक्तिम पलाश,
हर रंगोत्सव का वह इंतज़ार,
वो रंग देता काश! यह एहसास।

दूर नेपथ्य से आते थे गीत,
तन-मन कर देते थे पुलकित,
लगता उस राग की नायिका मैं,
सोच-सोच हो उठती सस्मित।

कैसे कह दूँ तुझको साजन,
पर तुमने रंग डाला तन-मन,
देख गुलाल यूँ फेंकना हवा में,
बिन छुए ही बढ़ती धड़कन।

कितने गुज़रे फागुन रंगों के,
कितने बीते सावन-संग,
पर मन की पिचकारी अब भी
ढूँढे तेरा वो पहला रंग।

आया देखो महीना बसंत का
मंजरी, महुआ महक उठा है
हवाएं झूम-झूम फाग गा रही है
पकवानों की सौंधी खुशबू आ रही है
गली-मोहल्ले, नुक्कड़ पर
रंगों की आतीशबाजी है
लिए भावना संस्कृति का
धूम मचाती होली है।


फागुन तेरे स्वागत में
हर रिश्ता लगता भोली है
भाभी संग हुदड़ग की मस्ती
शाली संग हँसी ठिठोली है
पनघट पर गाँव की गौरी
नाच रही मस्ती की टोली है
लिए भावना संस्कृति का
धूम मचाती होली है।


द्वेष, क्लेश को कम करती है
रिश्तों में मिठास भरती है
दोस्त-दुश्मन को एक करती है
बिगड़े रिश्ते पर मरहम रखती है
अपनत्व और भाईचारा का
राग गाती अपनी होली है
लिए भावना संस्कृति का
धूम मचाती होली है........।

Month of Ramadan
Afruza sent some dates for me
In a packet marked brotherhood.

Written in a chit
`Relish the dates bhaijaan`.

I do not observe Roja
So no seheri – iftar either
Afruza sent me some dates
from her share of Iftar
In a packet marked brotherhood

Someone whispered in my ears
`Dates of Mecca is prohibited`.

Afruza sent me some dates from Mecca.
Taking the black dates in my hands
No thought of Allah or God crossed my mind
The picture of the date plants
Standing on a distant desert
Withstanding the scorching sunshine
Is flashing on my mental screen
The picture of the date plants
Standing bathed in the misty moonlight
Is flashing on my mental screen
Those that do not call out for Allah and God
They call out for human beings
Relentlessly

It is not known
To those date trees
Who is Allah?
Who is God?

Afruza sent me
Some dates

Afruza Afruza Afruza
That very Afruza
Who even after having a Mosque
Had built a temple in her bosom.

Month of Ramadan
Afruza sent some dates for me
In a packet marked brotherhood

At the address of
Secularism.

Time
Time, how lucky are you
Your own timekeeper
With none to question you
And none to answer to!
If you were a person
What would you do
With all of you
Belonging to you?
Would you prefer
Your own company
Or would crave for
Something transitory?
Will pain and pleasure
Matter to you as much
If you had the power
To decide on its length?
How long would you
Live in a moment
Before you choose to
Step into the next!

The silence eerie but more beautiful after the radio announced bombings,
The music pumping the heart as the anthem bled the ears with homeland longing,
The newsprint blurry smelling of kerosene for eyes welled with tears,
The list of names a riddle for the alphabets reverberated with fears,
The postman more a hangman for he brought wailings and wounds,
The medals deadly targets that tightened around the neck in the name of boons,
Morphine the elixir that numbed the senses and the pain,
Lyrics of every war song opiates that showered bullet rain,
The dappled water fiery and redder with the bloodshed although the sun just set,
The moon a torn Chinese lantern that with its intoxication got wet,
The heart a spinning chopper racing with hope that the motherland is a line,
Hands grappling the earth whose soil spreads sugar so fine,
The womb a trembling bag muttering prayers for every son to return,
Thoughts a cascade of words waiting to turn into missiles blasting brotherhood to burn,
Peace a faint bird song trilling with dreams crooning in the head,
Pillow mist a briney fragrance wafting from the beloved`s bed.
Eulogies a baggage that gets heavier with resigned acceptance,
Ashes and interments a long shoreline where history brought tides of wasted penance.

The field is green.
Thick with weeds, seeds
I did not ask for, waiting,
Playing for a new birth in the wind.
It must all be, because of the night rains.
The early sun probes the solitary leaf with a kiss
Such that it turns almost fluid with the see- through colour of love that is happy
To lie forever naked.
There are flowers here,
that look splendid,
but are born in misery,
such that their beauty has lost all respect,
and it is indeed strange,
that what happens with innateness,
sinks into namelessness.
Strange things happen here in the field.
Here are lives waiting,
just as if,
for your trespass upon them.
What is this Karma of small,
secret lives in hiding that glitter and wave,
or lie in camouflage all around,
in profound insignificance,
richly coloured,
wet with desires of the flesh,
yet outwardly colourless,
with eyes like ours,
stretching out to light,
a silent hunger,
and quiet breathing.
An outlier,
all masked from our lives,
that`s much more than butterfly iridescence or wasp sting, yet
earth within the earth,
in cenotaphic spaces,
secret galaxies on a cobweb,
its quiet hymns that hum on,
stirring bud, leaf, or wing,
that seem without purpose or meaning, yet, is creation on Spark.
Ferral, sublime, with continued hurt that continuously go living and dying,
beyond our sensorium,
shaping the breath of our very lives!
And,
all that we fathom are just the colours of the flowers in the wind in blossom,
the tip of the iceberg of beauty in passing.
But what makes the living and the dead,
together pulse this moment into the secret hull of life?
The field is green,
Thick with weeds, seeds
I did not ask for.

All I need now
Is a garden mower.

You`re nowhere 
so I have nothing to do, there`s 
nothing to talk to anyone about ;
silent I, bear the burden of 
loves birth and death. 

With the sunrise I will be free 
so I tear the bloodline map from 
my hand and stick it to your body. 
Your fingers are swinging... 
You are shining again and then
walk away to another stage 
like a musical drama. 

You`re nowhere
so there is no wound in me or
I`m not in the wound.

I sometimes wish,
I was the best mom in the world,
With no fault lines, even in my dreams,
Having no aspirations of my own,
No desire to see anyone but you,
No wish to think of anyone but you,
To keep on holding your fingers
As you walk towards your future…
But, I certainly, am not that mom-
I am rather a mom with a lot of weaknesses,
Which I am sure taught you to understand
That no one is perfect,
And you too will not be perfect-
If someone points your mistakes to you,
You know that you can simply smile.
I do have aspirations in life even at my age
Which I am sure will make you comprehend
That one should never give up in life,
And keep dreaming till the day you die.
I do think and desire to meet my well-wishers
Which, when you analyse, will make you think
That it`s a necessity in life to have friends
To not only break the monotony in life,
But also gather those drops of enthusiasm
Which, like nectar, gives one a new life every time.
I`ve always known that practice is better than precept,
So, rather than holding your fingers,
I leave you to face life little by little.
I am sure that when you see me struggling
For every little inch of space in my life,
I am sure that you know that nothing comes easily
And you have to toil your way to success.
I don`t know what kind of mom I am,
But the glint of happiness that I see in your eyes
When you meet me
Makes me sure every time, that I am not wrong!

They enquired
Soon after my birth
From where I came
Me told
From mother`s womb
They asked again
Where shall I go
I answered
To my epitaphic tomb.
I started my journey
my way
But throughout
I was queried
About my name
My dynasty
My surname
My caste
My creed
My religion
My belief
I had only one
Answer for them
I am a man a Human.
But it was not enough
For them.
I told leave me alone
Let me live my life
My way
Please stay away
But they never listened.
They always wanted
To confine me or hold
in a street
In house
In a town
In a state
In a country
In a world
In an universe
But no one listened
What I told.

I belong to the cosmos
I am a cosmic man
Defiant they were
Who still continued
Giving me strain
They had only
One intention
To give pain
To impose rules
And to reign.

ଆଜି ସକାଳର କଅଁଳ ଖରାରେ
ତୋଳି ହେଲାନି ଫୁଲ,
ତମେ କାକର ଟୋପାକୁ ଭଲପାଅ ବୋଲି

ସାବଜା ଦୁବଘାସ ତଳେ
ମୁଁ ମେଲି ଧରିଲା ବେଳେ ହଳଦିଆ ସୂତା କାନି ମୋର

ବାକିଥିଲା ତମ ଛାତିର କୁଳୁକୁଳୁ ନଈ ଧାରୁ
ମୁଁ କୂଳ ଖୋଜି ସୁଅ କାଟି ପାରୁନଥିବାର ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ,
ଆଖୋଜା ଥିଲା ଅସହଣି ତୁଠ ପଥର ଉପରୁ
ପାଣିରେ ଖସି ପଡିଥିବା ନାକଗୁଣା,
ପଳାଶର ବାସ୍ନାହୀନତା ଭଳି
ତମ ଭାଗର ଆକାଶ ପାଖରେ ବନ୍ଧା ପଡିଥିଲା
ମୋର ଆକ୍ତାମାକ୍ତା ଧାରେ ନିଃଶ୍ବାସ,
ହଜିଲା ମନର ବିସ୍ମୃତ ଠିକଣା !

ଜାଣିବ,
ସେଦିନ ବହିଲା ପାଣି ଠୁ ବି ଲୁଚେଇ ରଖିଥିଲି ଲାଜ,
ନଈର ଗଣ୍ଡ ଠୁ ମୋ ଗାଲର ଭଉଁରୀ,
କାଲୁଆ ପାଣିଛିଟା ଠୁ ମୋ ଓଠ ତଳ କଳାଜାଇ

ଅଥଚ,ସେଦିନ ନଈପାଣି ବି ଚନ୍ଦନ ବାସିଲା,
ମୋ ନିଃଶ୍ୱାସରେ ଗୋଳି ହେଇଗଲା ଆକାଶପୁଅର ରଙ୍ଗ,

ସେଦିନ ଖଣ୍ଡ ଖଣ୍ଡ ହେଲା ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟ,
