तुम बोलो या ना बोलो,
हमको सुनना है बात ख़त्म।

हो चाहे जिसके भी तुम ,
तुम बस मेरे बात ख़त्म।

चाहा बहुत, न चाहे  तुमको,
पर ये हो गया बात ख़त्म।

बिना छुए ही छुए हृदय को,
दिल में बस तुम हो बात ख़त्म।

दूरी, उम्र, बचकानी बातें
भर दिए बचपना बात ख़त्म।

जो कहना था, कह चुका मन,
अब क्या कहना बात ख़त्म।

∎
जमशेदपुर

I see schools of thought
Dividing in the process
Of creating a culture
In India as in the world
And the Vedic Brahmins
In their spiritual concern
Uncomfortable with
The scientific artisans
Materialism of the south
Using Ram as an instrument
Who was to bridge the gap
As was Mandara Parvata
To churn the ocean of wisdom
In which each end was to play
Its component part.

I see Drona, Shakuni and Krishna
Using Kaurav Kin
To reach their specific goals.
And warriors,
In spite of their historic role
Would not rise above the Ant-hill.

While gods would be made
To annihilate evil,
Their permissiveness
Would take new forms
To gather around storms
Putting thus in turmoil
Each contemporary unit;
Class war being a necessary evil
Like the war of minds,
For life is a struggle against sluggishness
And civilization a bi-product of clash
As are grains, brains or an offspring


Coming out of sport. 
∎

Heard our government has decided removal
Of the stray dogs from roads
So that rabies doesn`t spread often,
But oh what about those two-legged ones?
The two-legged ones who possess
Diseases as grim as that of rabies
In their filthy eyes,
In their distorted minds;
The two-legged ones who roam hither and thither
Without any shackles,
Usually in packs, sometimes singly,
On the sidewalks, on the station roads,
Or through the carriages of trains, on the buses.
Why don`t You poison their drinks?
Why don`t You explode the earbuds in their ears?
Why don`t You make them fall from trains?
Why don`t You paralyze their neck
Or burst its capillaries
When they turn it for a disgusting glance? —
So that our Floras can bloom
Without any worries of being stalked
Or sneaked up on or even hunted
in the cloaking shadows,
Without staying wide awake 24/7
For those street dogs and monstrous hyenas
Whilst walking alone.
I know it is neither a fairy-tale world nor a utopia
Here conflict is inevitable —
Be that as major as wars worldwide
Or as minor as frays within ourselves.
But oh Your mortals have become weak;
They have the eyes yet are blind,
They have the ears yet are deaf,
But verily You are the only Protector
Who can keep our Floras shield by Your will
Which is much needed
For it`s our Floras that make legends
With their motherly nurture,
With their loverly compassion.
∎

The world was contemplating,
A senile caterpillar kipping through an entire season.
Daylight turned into
Jaded hours of darkness,
And Jack Frost ended for reasons of his own.

They anticipated his forewings,
Painted with echoes of snow and summer.
Even so,
Fanny Adams came of it—
Neither a butterfly,
Nor the wriggling grey caterpillar.

The month was summing up.
Folks started gossiping,
Spinning their own skins about the caterpillar.
Some said he lost his dreams
And transmuted into a moth to the flame.
Some even whispered
That he had crippled,
That he was evanescing.

Then at once, in a pale aurora,
When the sun itself was slumbering,
Unnoticed by watching eyes,
The cocoon began to quiver.
A bird-winged butterfly lunged forth.

While folks were amused,
Busy condemning souls,
With mighty wings and playful longings
He glided away from an old fate,
Toward the sky—
In pursuit of a soulful mate.
∎

With a few dots
On a graph paper
Something`s drawn --

Remains outside
A few scrawlings
Abrupt, indistinct
Offering a clue
To an indelible story,

Story or narrative about
Some straggling moments
Saddled with the residue 
Of three tangible elements:
Some bricks, letters 
And trees;

Living or non-living
All`re almost the same
When extinct`s
Their tenure on earth!

Who bothers
To look backward
And recall
What these were worth?

The mason`s fingerprint
No more traceable
On the eroded bricks,

Erased also
The scurrying postman`s
Fingermark from
The useless letters
Stacked in
The dead letter office,

None cares to think
Of the felled oaks
Incapable of inviting
Rain anymore!

Erasable or perishable
Mortal or fragile
Some elements
Of impermanence
Streaked with matching colours
When in earthly existence
Get enwrapped 
Today or tomorrow 
In an invisible layer of time
In life`s abandoned zone....

Witness: 
The graph paper alone.
∎

Life brings new surprises,
Unravelling more mysteries & craziness,

That gives tons of inspiration,
Soul flies to the clouds in oblivion,

Poetry , singing & art my food for thought,
Love to embrace the trio my most sought,

Life is proving to be sheer miracle,
Hope piling up with the beauty of oracles,

Living life to the fullest,
The dream comes true & best,

Life is an enigmatic journey of surprises,
As age climbs up the surprises just unleash,

To amaze my mundanely existence in this material universe,
Every day I dream to create a wonderful verse,

My voice my wishes turn into fantom verses,
I just love to singout my heart to the vast universe,

My miniature existence in a mass universe,
∎

source_fields.captured_title: The wheels of time have run over them
source_fields.body_html:
The wheels of time have run over them.
I feel, this is not the place I wished to reach,
Many more miles I have to cover.
I am not sure how far my goal is from hear,
But I walk on, crossing many hurdles,
on my way.
On the either side of my path
Time spreads like a blue sky overhead,
Time spreads like green fields below.

∎
16, Srabani Residency, 1144, Gadasahi, Nayapalli, Bhubaneswar -12
Phone-9439750378

There is a sorrow in me that grows,
swells like the belly of a pregnant woman.
tomorrow.
the fungi-infested bark, with blossoms of white gossamer
here and there
like our memories,
waits patiently,
unlike me.
`tomorrow`
it whispers into the ears of ladybugs,
sleepy ladybugs filling with hope
moment by moment,
like me.

the moon that waxes at your sight,
waning with your retracting footsteps
when you turn and carve your lips into a word
and i, blurry-eyed,
always know.
"tomorrow"
the moon, its
craters full of sorrow, expanding.
Ripples in the water,
ripples in my heart.
The waters rising,
like a woman to avenge her disgrace
at the hands of hundred men,
or a hundred and five.
its ravenous claws clutching
at the shore,
carrying it home,
like children stuffing sand in their pockets.
this shore
our home of memories.

the belly grows,
never bursting.
always accumulating.
what if tomorrow
there is no shore?
what if tomorrow
there is no tomorrow?
∎

source_fields.captured_title: WHEN WE GATHER AT THE RIVERS
source_fields.body_html:
When I was young my mother sang a hymn
About the River Ganga flowing through Shiva`s jata
The saints had gathered there to worship Him;
We joined them singing praise to Him and Ganga to atone.

I saw this pious River in my mind,
Its waters flowing from Heaven to where sheep would graze,
Where birds might bathe, where worshipers might find
Amazing grace despite life`s hurt and haze.

But skeptics in the intervening years
Have called for war on hymns and saints and Gods;
Condemning hope with empty soulless fears;
Declaring faith as valueless as sod.

Many claim the River is no more holy
That those who see it have deluded dreams
Doubters say “perhaps” but just don`t care;
While cynics want it dammed for selfish schemes.

How are we to gather at the Rivers
When they remove the signs that show the way?
When they claim love but sneeringly deliver
Hatred, condescension and dismay?

Can we gather if the path is blocked?
I once was taught to turn the other cheek;
But when my love of God is cruelly mocked
I will not sit in silence. I must speak!

Even if I hesitate and quiver,
My fear means nothing—I love Heaven more.
Yes, my friends, we`ll gather at the Rivers.
Not one of them can keep us from its shores!

How beautiful, these Rivers none can damn,
Which flows beyond a world of spite and sin!
Its waters sing of beloved purpose of `Moksha`
Its holiness surrounds us from within
when Aarti flames reflect in the waters.
∎

The sun bid adieu
The Elysian in its gerua attire
the day gradually began to cease
the trees, like monks, whispered silent sermons.
the birds made homebound
squirrels and chipmunks
were safe in their abode
all was calm and reposed.
on this sedated evening
a shankhnad beyond the hills
broke the tranquility
a mystic hope in a fading dream.
far away, on a moonless, lonely night,
a light flickered from a pane
a mother`s prayers and a wife`s waiting –
each breath a prayer.
∎

The song is ended,

but the melody lingers.

Soldiers have returned home,

but the marching band is on.

The battle has been won,

but the fights are still on

in the narrow minds

of the leaders and their hangers-on.

The economy limps,

but the arguments are on.

The shops are closed

but the shopping is on.

Plates are empty,

but the meals are on.

The horse has fled,

but the carriages are drawn.

The clouds are gone

but the rains are on

The lamp is dry

but the light is on.

Hordes of people are on the street

but the noise is gone

Everyone bears a wound,

A silent procession is on.

Students wait in the classroom,

the teachers are gone,

buying a ticket to the state capital

where a big agitation is on.

Patients are left on the operation table,

the doctors have left

looking for dollops of ether,

the pains are on.

The roads have ended,

all hopes are gone,

still we keep marching

because the journey is on.

 

∎

source_fields.captured_title: यादों का पन्ना — एक लघु उपन्यास
source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
ज़िंदगी की किताब का पहला पन्ना जब मीरा ने पलटा,
तो सबसे पहले वही दो दृश्य उभर आए
काली जी की भव्य मूर्ति
और पुराना आम का पेड़,
जिसकी छाँव में समय जाने कब बैठ गया था।

पच्चीस से पैंतीस की उम्र के बीच!!दस साल बीते थे,पर मोहन शायद छह–सात बार ही उस जगह गया था।पर हर बार मीरा तक उसकी आहट पहुँच ही जाती थी।
दो परिवार—एक-सा अपनापन।
रिश्तों में सच्चाई इतनी कि
न कोई रोक, न कोई संकोच।

कुछ भी हो जाता,मीरा बस दरवाज़े से झाँककर कहती,“चल न, ऑफिस छोड़ दे… थोड़ा रोड पर घुमा ला।”मोहन बिना सवाल करे गाड़ी निकाल लेता।

उस दिन भी मोहन ने पुकारा“सुन, चल… आज थोड़ा तफ़री करते हैं।”मीरा मुस्कुरा दी।
यह मुस्कान सिर्फ़ उसके होंठों पर आती थी,
दिल में तो जैसे कोई अनकही बात
हवा की तरह उठती-बैठती रहती थी।

जून की दोपहर थी,ऐसी जब हवा भी साँसें गिनकर चलती है।मोहन ने अचानक गाड़ी रोकी।
सामने वही पुराना मंदिर…काली जी की शांत, गंभीर, निहारती हुई प्रतिमा।

मीरा ने चुपचाप सुमन अर्पित किए।मोहन भी चरणों में झुका।फिर पता नहीं कैसे उसने काली जी के फ़लक से ज़रा सा सिंदूर उँगलियों पर ले लिया।

मीरा हड़बड़ा गई“अरे, ये क्यों लिया?
कोई मान्यता होती है क्या?”

मोहन ने बस हल्की-सी मुस्कान दी।
उस मुस्कान में कोई जवाब नहीं था
बस एक छिपा हुआ कंपन था,जिसे वह खुद भी शायद पूरी तरह नहीं समझता था।

आम का पुराना वृक्ष
कुछ दूर बढ़े तो वही पेड़ खड़ा था,
शाखों पर जैसे पुरानी यादें झूल रही हों।

“इधर देख,” मोहन ने कहा।
“अबे तू भी देख ले न… जी भर कर।”
मीरा हँस कर बोली,
पर आवाज़ में एक अनजाना स्पंदन था।

और तभी
मोहन ने उस सिंदूर लगी उँगली से
मीरा की माँग भर दी।

दुनिया एक पल को थम गई।
समय जैसे हवा रोक कर खड़ा हो गया।
मीरा की साँसे अटक गईं,आँखें अपने-आप बंद हो गईं।

वह फुसफुसाया“आँखें क्यों बंद की?”
मीरा धीमे से “पता नहीं… खुद-ब-खुद हो गईं।”
यह `खुद-ब-खुद`दोनों के दिलों में
कुछ अनलिखा छोड़ गया।

डर, तड़प, और छिपा हुआ सच,सिंदूर की वह हल्की-सी रेखा मीरा के माथे पर सिहर रही थी।
उसने घबराकर दुपट्टा खींच लिया।
मोहन ने हाथ बढ़ाया “रुक… मैं साफ़ कर देता हूँ।
किसी ने देख लिया तो?”

मीरा ने उसकी कलाई पकड़ ली,पहली बार, बिना सोचे।“नहीं… अभी मत हटाओ।”उसकी आवाज़ काँपी।
मोहन थम गया।उसे पहली बार लगा मीरा की चुप्पी में कितनी बातें भटकी हुई हैं।

कुछ देर बाद मीरा ने कहा “अगर तुम हटाओगे…
तो लगेगा जैसे यह सब गलती थी।”
उस एक वाक्य ने
मोहन के भीतर लहरें पैदा कर दीं—जो वह किसी से कह भी नहीं सकता था।

घर के पास पहुँचकर मीरा ने शीशे में खुद को देखा,बाल थोड़े तिरछे किए,एक लट माथे पर गिरा दी ताकि सिंदूर का निशान उसके भीतर की तरह
छुपा रहे पर मिटे नहीं।

और सचमुच…किसी ने कुछ नहीं देखा।
पर दोनों के भीतरअब बहुत कुछ अनदेखा नहीं रहा था।
 मोहन घर का इकलौता लड़का था उसकी शादी की चर्चा शुरू हो रही थी।मीरा कभी नहीं जताती,
पर मोहन की शादी की चर्चाएँ उसे हर रात थोड़ा-सा खाली कर देतीं।तड़प थी,
पर वो तड़प कही नहीं जा सकती थी।
क्योंकि नाम कभी लिया ही नहीं गया था।

मोहन की शादी हुई—शोरगुल, रस्में, हँसी…
पर मीरा की चुप्पी उस दिन सबसे ज़्यादा मुखर थी।

कुछ दिनों बाद मीरा की शादी का समय आया।
पंडित ने हथेली देखकर कहा—
“इसकी तो पहले शादी हो चुकी है।”

मीरा जैसे अंदर तक काँप गई।
जो कभी बोला नहीं गया,वह उसकी रेखाओं में कैसे दर्ज हो गया?पर वह कुछ भी कह न सकी।

समय बीत गया,घर, ज़िम्मेदारियाँ, रिश्ते,
सब अपनी-अपनी गति से चलते रहे।
पर जो एक पल आम के पेड़ तले ठहरा था,वह कहीं नहीं गया।

सालों बाद,एक दोपहर मीरा को वह पुराना बक्सा याद आया।मोहन की माँ ने शादी के दिन
एक फ़ाइल दी थी और बोली
“यह मोहन ने दी है,समय मिले तो पढ़ लेना।”

मीरा ने फ़ाइल खोली वह डायरी थी,दस वर्षों का उसका मन,उसकी खामोशियाँ,उसकी अनकही तड़प।

हर पन्ना पढ़ते हुए मीरा के भीतर पुरानी रौशनी
फिर जल उठी,पर इस बार आँसूओं की धुंध में।
अंतिम पंक्ति में लिखा था—
 “कभी छूने की चाह नहीं थी…पर जब भी आँखें बंद करता था,तुम भरी हुई माँग में ही दिखती थीं।
पता नहीं यह बचपना था या कुछ और कब यह भावना दूसरी दिशा में बह चली समझ नहीं पाया।
क्षमा करना,अगर कभी तुम्हें भीतर से चोट पहुँची हो।”

डायरी मीरा की गोद में काँपती रही,मीरा की आँखें बहती रहीं।कहती रहीं बस एक ही बात—
“कहा क्यों नहीं…एक बार भी क्यों नहीं?”

कॉल बेल बजी।
उन्होंने पूछा—“फिर सूजी हैं आँखें? पापा की याद आई?”

मीरा ने सिर हिलाया,पर उसकी खामोशी में
पापा नहीं थे।कोई और था…जो कह नहीं पाया,
और जिसे वह सुन नहीं पाई।

उस शाम उन्होंने कहा “चलो… घूम आते हैं।”

गाड़ी अनजाने में उसी आम के पेड़ के नीचे रुक गई,जहाँ समय ने सालों पहले अपनी साँस रोकी थी।
मीरा डायरी साथ लाई थी,पर इस बार इसे छुपाने नहीं,छोड़ आने।

उसने डायरी पेड़ के पास रख दी,अतीत को अतीत में लौटा दिया।वर्तमान को अनछुआ रहने दिया।

गाड़ी में कुमार विश्वास की आवाज़ गूँजी—
 “माँग की सिंदूर रेखा तुमसे यह पूछेगी कल…”

मीरा की आँखें झुक गईं।दिल एक बार फिर
उस दिन की तरह भर आया।

अगली सुबह
बालकनी में वह चाय लिए खड़े थे।नदी रोज़ शोर करती थी,पर आज उसकी ध्वनि
अजीब-सी शांत थी।जैसे किसी अधूरे को स्वीकार कर चुकी हो।

मीरा भी शांत थी,पर उसके भीतर
एक कोना फिर से धड़क रहा था।

जो उस दिन नहीं धड़का था!पर मोहन की डायरी पढ़ते ही चुपके से अपना घर बना चुका था।

 

ज़िंदगी के सफ़र में कुछ रास्ते ऐसे होते हैं
जो साथ नहीं चलते पर दिल की मिट्टी में
अपने निशान हमेशा छोड़ जाते हैं।
कुछ पल ऐसे होते हैं,जो लौटकर कभी नहीं आते,
पर ख़ामोशी में हर रात वापस आ बैठते हैं।

∎

जमशेदपुर

जैसे दुनिया चांद पर पहुंचा, पहुंच तो मैं भी सकता था
कद्र मेहनत की होती तो पसीना मेरा चमक भी सकता था।

दिन तो जैसे - तैसे कट ही गये पर रात कटी तन्हाई में
यादों संग तू भी आ जाती तो रात मचल भी सकता था।

तुने मेरे दिल को पत्थर कह दिया, दिल पत्थर ही सही
तू सीने पर सर रख देती तो पत्थर पिघल भी सकता था।

यूं तो कई मयखाना पीकर भी मेरे पांव टस से मस न हुए
गर तू थामने को हाथ बढ़ाती तो मैं लड़खड़ा भी सकता था।

अब मैं कहानियां लिखता फिरता हूं दिल फरेबी रिश्तों पर
तू जरा साथ दे देती तो वफ़ा-ए-ग़ज़ल लिख भी सकता था‌।

जनवरी के महीने में तप रहा है जून सा बदन मेरा
तू जो माथा चुम लेती तो बुखार उतर भी सकता था।
∎

Bunyan Tree: Happy New Year K V Dominic

“` humans, most intelligent,
concerned of time in their life?
They greet each other good morning,
good afternoon, good evening
Today they greet happy new year.
In this infinite universe
how absurd is time and space!”
The immortal bunyan tree pondered.
She is sacred to human beings
who rest beneath her canopy leaves.
She has no death and enlarges her empire
rooting down from each branch.
She is a haven to innumerable birds and animals
and also to vagabonds and rishis.
“How idiot is a human being!” she thinks
“Always worried and sad and never content.
No meaning in his greetings;
empty words like din of a drum.
Those birds and animals are happy like me
Never bothered of time or age
Least concerned of death and departure
When one greets good morning

thousands face bad mornings,
fighting against poverty and sickness
or frightened of tortures and wars”

∎

I soak my heart in brine,
In all that sunshine.
Like sipping a fine
Bottle of red wine.

Mesmerized by the air,
And with not a single care,
I want to drift far
From this worldly fair.

Lost among the bushes,
Under the waterfall that gushes;
I get lost in the fog,
Drifting like a lost log.

Gathering the wild flowers,
Spending the warm hours;
From the green grass field,
Waiting to be yield.

I gather all pollen,
And snuggle in my woolen;
Like a carefree bee,
That wants to be free.

I stumble on a rock,
Waking to the clock;
With a big wide yawn,
Realizing it`s all gone.

But I will return,
To the same loving urn;
I long each night,
No matter how difficult it might.

∎

source_fields.captured_title: Under the Umbrella of Your Love
source_fields.body_html:
Under the umbrella of your love
I bloom like a fragrant jasmine
Scorching rays turn to soothing sunshine
Turbulent torrents are gentle shower
And rocky paths are carpet of flowers
Under the umbrella of your love
Each step is an earnest promise
Of a new world full of pleasant surprises
Every sorrowful song is a melodious music
Infinite love, life, hope being its lyrics
Under the umbrella of your love
I learned what truly a shelter is
No walls, no roof yet a heavenly bliss
You by my side I stride as a river unafraid
As if an earth guarded in shifting shades
Under the umbrella of your love
Every path no matter how arduous and dark
I can walk through, you being my unfading spark
The world around me be full of thorns
But I dare to rise to a rose with your pious presence
With the wings of your deep love
I can map the sky like a golden dove
Under the umbrella of your love
Life is an Infinite fountain of happiness
As all my fear evaporates with a glance of your loving face
Your eyes full of assurances in my difficult days
Melt away all my sorrows and disappointments away
Under the umbrella of your love
Life is a soulful song
Supremely serene
A journey, despite ups and downs
Splendidly sublime
A mellifluous music from a flute
Truly divine

∎

source_fields.body_html:
It can come in any form
In the TV screen
From the lips of a shrieking anchor

It can come in an unruly air
Uncontrolled rain, tear
It can come in a falling petal

Due to fear news can halt
Screens can be blank
Sounds may cease, hiss

Fear can have any colours
Red, white, purple, yellow
Like the falling grains from the failed beaks

It stays on no matter how much we evict
Its part of us,
No matter, how numb, how exciting, restless
∎

Kept thing.
No use left in it.
Still kept.

Not from hope.
Hope would require instruction.
This has none.

It occupies
the corner where intention once stood,
a remainder without arithmetic.

It does not ask.
It does not answer.
It persists, which is different.

I try to remember
what it was meant to do.
The memory fails,
but the keeping does not.

It is lighter than purpose,
heavier than nothing.
An object that has outlived its reason
and mistaken that for permission.

To discard it
would require a future
in which the absence matters.

So it stays.
Witness to a task
that never quite happened,
evidence without a trial.

Kept,
because release would imply meaning,
and meaning has already
been used up.

Still kept.
∎

GLACIER Bharati Hazarika

Have you seen the majestic glaciers
At the North and South Poles,
A true marvel of nature?

The world seems to be flying
A white sheet of cloth overhead;

A huge sheet of white snow,
A treasure trove of life.

But there is more to this harsh,
Cold landscape - animals thrive here,
A testament to nature`s incredible balance.

Glaciers play a crucial role
In maintaining this delicate balance,
A reminder of the importance of preserving our planet.

Now, the glaciers are melting unexpectedly,
A consequence of our actions,
The Earth is getting warmer.

The trees have been cut down, Firecrackers pollute the air zone, destroying the ozone layer.

People have dug into the heart of the earth,
Searching for gold, diamond, coal, and petrol,
Leading to more threats in earthquakes.

There is drought somewhere,
Heavy rainfall elsewhere,
Causing floods that destroy everywhere

But glaciers hold secrets -
They have suppressed many disease-causing germs ;
Hold the eggs of prehistoric creatures.

If these glaciers melt,
These germs and bacteria will come to life;
Plaguing humanity with unknown diseases.

Nature will be angry!
The remaining plants will die
due to strong sunlight.

People will succumb to heat strokes, No air conditioner will be able
to provide relief.

Science will give up;
People will cry out
for a sip of drinking water.

So, human race, if you are wise, wake up!
Remedy this situation
while there is still time

Plant trees as many as you can,
Let the earth live green
Allow the thick sheet of glaciers to be thicken

Let us breathe fresh air
O man, wake up to reality ,
Wake up….

The autumn rain touches gently,
Rose blooms in greenary,
The night jasmine carries fragrance,
In two little words of love

Are the aspirations lost?
Could the moonlit say
On the terror of darkmoon
Why stars fall silently ?

I hear your name

Your transparent love
A soft fierce drench to
my sheer existence.
Love to float being 
Mellow and mature.
Colourful drop-down.
Joy of blowing down with 
grace is my chosen ego.
I respect my enthusiastic 
acceptance, sublime submission 
as well as soulful strategy of
merging to own.
Self validation with soul`s approval.
Rise and fall is the calm susurrus 
of definite "To Be".
"Not to Be", is the fallacy where
life ignores self identity and 
true credentiality.
When numerous crimson dreams
soaked in misty waft of Autumn 
randomly connect and collide 
illuminates life`s twilight.
Comfortable becomes own skin.
Solitude star gazing turns a 
privileged hobby.
Enhanced loneliness starts 
passionate gap filling between 
Autumnal Earth and Autumnal Life 
Last decoration of Departure.

I have to be born again
To tell the story of many women
Through only one woman –
`Shakuntala`

I have to be born again
To payback the price
Of love, of sacrifice
As a woman, a daughter
A beloved and a mother!

I have to be born from
The seeds of a sage
The womb of a beauty
And show the world
That neither divinity
Nor beauty shapes destiny!

I have to be married
Not with family to bless
But with cosmos to witness
The union of flesh with desire
Of love born out of pelf and power!

I have to become a mother
Without the support of my child`s father
But with the care of abundant nature
The culmination of the ethos of nurture
Without the pathos of human touch

My life will narrate the truths of humanity
That an illustrious sage can be a victim of lust
That a divine beauty can be a ruthless mother
That a passionate lover can be a forgetful father
That a righteous ruler tests claims of love and seeks evidence
That a devoted mother even in adversity shapes providence

I have to be born again
To tell the story of many women
Through only one woman –
`Shakuntala`
To give birth to sons of Bharat
They will play with tiger cubs
And learn the meaning of power
And know what it means to conquer
To be adored by nature
To be abandoned by power
And in the end `a lost and found ring` for realization
Of fleeting human frailties and fixed bonds of emotion
A story as simple as the imagination of a child
And yet profound as nature and life in the wild

The story of `Shakuntala`
Of unflinching femininity

∎

In the hustle and bustle of life
It makes me a non-believer,
When to laugh;
When will I cry again?
He is far from an atmosphere of peace,
Every day, he calls out to me, waving his hand.

Feeling very restless in the hustle and bustle
This is my life;
With breathless eyes
I am waiting for him.
Far away........!!!!
Those proud eyes of his,
His two hands
The wind calls me in its passion,
In the touch of that evening`s coolness
To hold in your arms.

Do you know my helplessness?
That intimacy of seeing you every day,
Sometimes in the darkness of the evening twilight
And when in that gentle morning air.

Wow...!!
I am searching for the scent of experience.
Peace is at your feet,
With your touch,
That loose white hair of yours.
With a light smile,
And that wet sand
On the gray beach.

I will refresh myself once again.
The darkness is lost in the scattered leaves,
You will see countless dreams in these eyes,
In that gray sand
Thousands of footprints making themselves felt.

The feeling of lies is lost in the rise.
Joining hands with yours,
Dreams in the eyes are like flowers;
To the feet that are still on the thorny path
Covered in blood
Being an unadorned,
With selfless feelings
Draw has many colorful pictures,
To be lifted by the wet tide of love
With you,
That same fly is a false sandbar.

source_fields.captured_title: जीवन धार जहाँ ले जाती है
source_fields.body_html:
जीवन धार जहाँ ले जाती है
वो मंज़िल कहाँ तक जाती है!
कोई ले जाती है मरुस्थलीय बयार में
तो कोई ले जाती है पर्वतों के शीतल स्थान में
कोई ले जाती बासंती मौसमी कूक तक
तो कोई ले जाती है कोलाहल के कलयुग तक
पर ये ले जाये जहाँ तक भी
प्रश्न है जीवटता और जीवंतता का
प्रश्न है अनुकूलता के सिद्धांत का
प्रश्न है योग्यता के चुनाव का
नहीं तो धार सूख ही जाती है
जीवन के भागते दौड़ते रफ़्तार में,
या आपाधापी के सुलगते ताप तक,
पर जहाँ भी ले जाये ये प्रारब्ध
अनन्त की सत्ता पर विश्वास और जुझारूपन
और जीवनधार के साथ सबको सिंचित करना ही
मानवीय प्रकाश है।
वर्षा सरन @

∎

जीवन जंग नहीं, काँटों से
फूलों का भी यहाँ बसेरा है, 
कटुता ही सिर्फ नहीं इसमें,
मधुरता का भी यहाँ डेरा है। 


क्यों बैठे हो उदास होकर?
यहाँ उमंगों का भी घेरा है,
क्यों भाग रहे हो, तपोवन से?
यह उपवन भी तेरा है, 
जीवन जंग नहीं, काँटों से
फूलों का भी यहाँ बसेरा है। 


विचलित हो जाओगे, यदि बीच राह में,
लक्ष्य कैसे भेद, पाओगे?
पराजय से घबरा जाने पर, 
विजयी कैसे कहलाओगे?


अंधकार से, यदि डर जाओगे,
रौशनी तक कैसे पहुँच पाओगे?
हताश हो जाओगे दूरी से यदि,
मंजिल कैसे पास लाओगे?
जीवन जंग नहीं, काँटों से
फूलों का भी यहाँ बसेरा है। 


हारोगे यदि, हिम्मत अपनी,
जीत को कैसे पाओगे?
भयभीत होगे, यदि तूफानों से, 
उड़ान कैसे भर पाओगे?
जीवन जंग नहीं, काँटों से
फूलों का भी यहाँ बसेरा है। 
उठो.. साकार करो ख़ुद को,
यह जीवन सिर्फ तेरा है, 
बेकार करो न इसे रुककर
यह अमूल्य समय धन भी तेरा है, 
जीवन जंग नहीं, सिर्फ काँटों से


फूलों का भी यहाँ बसेरा है।

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
क्यों हमें आप यूँ सताते हैं  
हम तो हर ग़म में मुस्कुराते हैं। 

आप ये तो बताइए हमको 
भूल जाते हैं या भुलाते हैं। 

कर तो लेते हैं वादे वो लेकिन 
सारे वादे कहाँ निभाते हैं।

हमने उनको तो टूट कर चाहा 
अपनी चाहत मगर छुपाते हैं। 

वो जो बसते हैं मेरी आँखों में
दूसरा क्यों जहाँ बसाते हैं।

∎

जमशेदपुर

source_fields.captured_title: The Girl Who Walks in My Ink
source_fields.body_html:
I write because silence gnaws the walls.
The words come like insects—
they know where the wounds are.

Somewhere a girl was found
in the half-light of a banyan tree,
her small body folded like torn prayer paper.
The newspapers said nothing new—
only the familiar syllables of shame and shock.
Still, I cannot sleep without hearing her breath
stuck in the dirt.

Her hand was made of dusk.
How will I hold it?
Each time I try,
my fingers touch only ash and apology.

The streets outside blink with blind lamps,
their light trembling over puddles
as though the city itself is afraid to see.
Even the dogs have stopped barking.

They said she was fifteen.
I do not know her name,
only the way her story entered mine—
like smoke into lungs that never asked to breathe.
She had no voice left,
so mine began to stutter.

I write her because I cannot touch her.
Because if I did,
the weight of my guilt would split my arms.
Because her skin, in my mind,
is stitched with all the nights we refused to watch.

And when the page is full,
I see her shadow bending
over every word I made.
She does not forgive me.
She does not need to.
She just stands there,
half darkness, half dawn,
and waits for me
to finish writing her name.

∎

Where eagle`s dare

Catch the running water

The gloves of the stolen childhood

Debris.

Mutilations. Ashes. Temperament.

Accuse whom for the right crop?

Ashes. Ashes. Ashes.

Sarcasm.

Mothers, brothers join hands

Society in serious dilemma

Whereabouts are investigated

Monochrome.

Fullstops are common causes

The band of reds and yellows

Defying the moralistic,

Future.
∎

I dreamt of a flute,
heard a flutist playing somewhere
serenading the still night.

A shred of a melody
haunted the silent air
caressing its wounds.

Radha might have taken it
as her heartthrob`s fickle mischief,
Mira as her Lord`s soothing fingers.

Again my eyes heavy with sleep
saw a lonely lady weeping in a forest, the trees around holding helpless breath.

Unable to lift a finger, their covenant`s
peremptory condition, rooted to the soil,
but they drip dew to soothe her tears.

An old ascetic with a bamboo bow gave
shelter to her helplessness in his hut,
his bow holding predators at bay.

I woke into a nostalgic morning.
Pains of Radha, Mira, and Sita
haunted my guilt like scalding embers.

Radha`s lonely tears were turning
into hot and humid summer breath.
Her rage salvaging her yearning youth.

Mira collected her memory and folded
them back to her heart to carry them
to her grave that she waited with joy.

Sita felt betrayed but her husband
was a king. In his scale, she was pitted against thousands of his subjects.

Even love has been a tender politics,
its logo taking chimeral nuances, and
tongues from the strange rubric of time.

 

 

∎

source_fields.captured_title: I woke up thinking about you
source_fields.body_html:
I woke up thinking about you
And about your melodious tune
How beautifully you absorbed our relationship
In the lyrics and so also in the singing intonation 
The tone is graceful 
The tenor is elegant
The lyrical ballad is captivating
Those words run in my mind
Heart sings the rhyme 
Lips quiver time to time
I utter your name in silence a million time
 I connect your picture in different frames 
I see your face in different waves
The lyrical web is playing the game
Making me to explore
The words beneath the words

∎

A VISION OF THE PAST

I see schools of thought
Dividing in the process
Of creating a culture
In India as in the world
And the Vedic Brahmins
In their spiritual concern
Uncomfortable with
The scientific artisans
Materialism of the south
Using Ram as an instrument
Who was to bridge the gap
As was Mandara Parvata
To churn the ocean of wisdom
In which each end was to play
Its component part.

I see Drona, Shakuni and Krishna
Using Kaurav Kin
To reach their specific goals.
And warriors,
In spite of their historic role
Would not rise above the Ant-hill.

While gods would be made
To annihilate evil,
Their permissiveness
Would take new forms
To gather around storms
Putting thus in turmoil
Each contemporary unit;
Class war being a necessary evil
Like the war of minds,
For life is a struggle against sluggishness
And civilization a bi-product of clash
As are grains, brains or an offspring


Coming out of sport. 
∎

Mainstreaming of all as human resources with glee
Sans caste, race, sex and other biological identities
Or not being ever compartmentalized as he or she
Forms the basis of Gender Studies for human entities,
Where there will be no room for any gender biases
Nor will be there stereotyping on patriarchal routine
All attempts should originate from within, not on daises
Done, social justice n empowerment of all will get signal green. 

Livings now in a global village connected are we with all
Thru` the clicking of mouse on computer sitting on drawing hall
On issues related to migration, development and human rights,
From lived experiences of all genders with troubles, travails n fights.

Gender Studies helps much to promote true picture
Of interdisciplinary and intersectional issues near n far
Inviting attention to injustice meted on gendered identity
Or effecting abolition of triple talaq system with gaiety
Or highlighting the rapists of Nirbhaya n Abhaya to the fore


And it allows no external judge to dictate one`s life paths anymore.
∎

Origin of the universe evolved from the darkness as
Life starts from the dark womb of a mother
I know nothing about the secret of this universe
Except the weave of silence
Originated from dark

A big dot created by Syed Raja
Who knew the secret I guess.
Thousands of dots arranged in this magical circle
Turned into a large dark space called Bindu.
Bindu Theke Sindu, an old Bengali proverb
Taught me how a sea is born with drops of water.
Highly appreciated painter Jackson Pullock absorbed.
All kind of colors ,created a brilliant glob rather than a universe.
I admired him most . Dark mattered to him I understood.

A shaft of light came through the dense forest of dark sky
And touched my eyes .
I woke up at midnight, listened to the music of silence
Playing around me and had a sound sleep in the eternal dark

∎

ବୋଉ କୁହେ ଖାଇବା ଥାଳି ପାଖରେ
ଆମ୍ବୁଲ ପାଗ କରି
ଆଖି ଜକେଇ ଲୁଚି ଲୁଚି କାନ୍ଦୁଛନ୍ତି ବାପା
ତଥାପି କେମିତି କେଜାଣି
କାହା ଆଖିରେ ପଡେନି ତାଙ୍କ ଲୁହ ବୁନ୍ଦାଏ ।
ବୋଧେ କାନ୍ଦି ଜାଣି ନାହାନ୍ତି ବାପା ।
ମନ ମରିଗଲେ ବି
ମନମାରି ବସି ଜାଣି ନାହାନ୍ତି ବାପା ।

∎

नारी पुरुष में भेद कैसा ?
एक दूसरे का परिपूरक है।
नारी के बारे में क्या कहूं?
पुरुषों से अधिक सशक्त है।

एक बीज धारण करती नारी
दश महीने तक सींचती है,
बिगड़ जाता अपनी सुंदरता
पर मातृत्त सुख चाहती है।

देख संतान का मुख माता
ममता से भर जाती है
जन्म देते वक्त दर्द को
पल में भुला देती है।

नारी शक्ति का प्रतिमूर्ति है
पर ममता की मारी है
बच्चे और परिवार के लिए
अपना सब कुछ हारी है।

कभी डायन कह कर मार दिया
कभी बांझ कह कर रुला दिया
कभी दहेज के लिए जला दिया
कभी गर्भ में ही उसे मार दिया।

आज की नारी बदल रही है
अपना अधिकार मांग रही है
पुरुषों के साथ कंधा मिलाकर
कदम से कदम मिला रही है ।

इन चूड़ी वाले हाथों को तुम
कभी कमजोर ना समझना
जिन हाथों में कभी पालना डोलाया
जरूरत हो तो जानती तलवार उठाना।
∎
जमशेदपुर झारखंड.

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
कुछ बातें रहती हैं याद,
अनंत काल तक,
शायद वे घटित ही होती हैं
बस इसलिए,
कि जीवन में रहें
हर पल, हर श्वास,
जीवन पर्यंत।

जैसे कि
स्कूल के उन कोमल दिनों में
कॉपियों में रखे हुए
सोपनर से छिले
पेंसिल के कतरन,
बिलकुल गोलाई में कटे,
सूखे पीपल के पत्ते,
मोरपंख और
गुलाब की मुरझाई पंखुड़ियाँ 
जिन्हें आज भी स्पर्श करो
तो वे हो उठती हैं ताज़ी,
मुस्कुराती, जीवंत।

और हाँ, बचपन के वे दिन,
जब बिजली कड़कती थी
तो डर के संग खिलखिलाहट होती थी,
और किसी ने कहा था!!
“गोबर पर गिरे बिजली तो बन जाए सोना!”
क्या भोलेपन भरे थे वो पल,
क्या नासमझी थी वो मिठास भरी!

वही तो हैं वे सारी यादें 
पहला ख़त,
छुपाकर पढ़ना,
वो अबोध-सा प्रेम,
चाहे प्राप्य रहा हो या नहीं,
रह जाता है मन की तहों में
अनंत काल तक।

उम्र के हर पड़ाव पर
जब भी ये स्मृतियाँ लौटती हैं,
चेहरे पर
एक नई रौनक बिखेर जाती हैं।

यादों की यही निशानियाँ
रहती हैं हमारे भीतर 
अनंत काल तक।

∎

जमशेदपुर

स्त्री एक खूबसूरत मन है
केवल काया नहीं
स्त्री मन को छू कर उसे अपनाना
तपस्या से कम नहीं…

तन को पा कर ये न सोचो
तुम ने स्त्री को पा लिया
शरीर तो… बलात्कारी भी
जोर ज़बरदस्ती से छू लेता है
छूना है तो छुओ…
स्त्री मन
स्त्री की आत्मा...

उतर जाओ स्त्री के ह्रदय में
बहो उस की रगों में
बस जाओ साँसों में
जिस दिन तुमने ये कर लिया
समझ लेना
तुमने स्त्री को छू लिया...!

∎
स्वरचित, सर्वाधिकार सुरक्षित

हत्यारों के हाथ में नहीं हैं हथियार
नहीं हैं उनकी आँखे लाल
न वे दौड़ रहे हैं इधर- उधर
ढूंढते हुए अपना शिकार

बस उन्होंने तो
चुपके से
थमा दिया है
हमारे हाथों में
लालसाओं का पहाड़



अपराध

सामने रखे हों छप्पन भोग और
पानी की बिसलेरी बोतल
बदन पर हों ब्रांडेड कपड़े
बच्चे पढ़ते हों नामी गिरामी स्कूल में
तमाम सुविधाएं सहज उपलब्ध हों
इतना ही नहीं
बैंक में जुगाड़ हो
आने वाली सात पुश्तों का
ऐसे में
हाशिए पर खड़े
उन तमाम पीड़ितों
पर तुम्हारा सिर्फ दया दिखाना
तुम्हें बना देता है छोटा
और
उनका अपराधी भी ...

स्त्री

स्त्री एक किताब है
जिसका हर पाठ
नई कहानी बोलेगा
अपने समय का भेद खोलेगा


आज़ादी

जिस दिन स्त्री
चूल्हा चौका
संभालने से कर देगी इंकार
उसकी महिमा में गाए जाने वाले
तमाम गीत
हो जाएंगे
किसी डिब्बे में बंद
जिस पर बैठ
स्त्री
मनाएगी अपनी आज़ादी का जश्न
और लेगी
चैन की साँस



प्यार

उदासी के
बेहद बुरे दिनों में
मुझे खुद पर प्यार आया
इस तरह
मैंने अपने आप को बचाया।

∎

In the hues of amber dusk,
leaves surrender,
like whispered vows, trembling, slow..
each one a page from a story we almost wrote.
We loved in the pauses between seconds,
a flicker of breath over chai’s steams,
your laughter a chime in the quietude of mornings,
where syllables danced like dust fairies in Sun,
untouched, yet felt.
Conversations bled past midnight
into the silver silhouettes of 3 AM,
our words not seeking answers,
just company in the ache.
It wasn’t the fire, it was gravity.
Quiet, undeniable,
pulling stars closer
without ever asking them to fall.
You touched nothing of me
and yet held it all.
Friendship: the gentlest of thieves.
We wandered through memory like smoke
..hands brushing in the dark,
not holding,
just knowing.
That was enough, and not nearly.
I keep the jingle of your laughter
like wind through bare trees,
and your silences
where I built my hopes like fragile frost.
Autumn teaches the art of letting go..
but never promises it won’t ache.
Some leaves cling too long.
Some hearts too.
My love for you,
like the stillness of Autumn rain,
and morning’s light on a window,
deep,
quiet,
unreturned,
but never lost.
∎

(When the root is lifted, the branches no longer touch the earth)

As you move along
the continuum of ticking time
from the gravid womb
to the grave
gravity takes over
and you are tied down
with multiple weights
through your journey
from the start
when you feel
the weight of your new life
till the end when your body
is the only weight
and your finite self
merges with the infinite
and you finally become
weightless.

You look out of your window
to see the tree
shedding its leaves
which fall in heaps at its root
and its branches reaching for the sun
but then you realise
that you are an
inverted tree
your head being your root
and your limbs
hanging downwards—
and as you ascend
your spine from `muladhar`
to `sahasrar`
along your journey
you transcend
from the gross to the sublime—

you defy gravity
and become weightless
while you are
still breathing.
∎

Freedom is our birthright
You can not snatch away our pride

You can chain our feet to restrict the movement
But how can you chain our will power !?

You can chain our hands
How can you chain our minds!

You can stitch our lips
Can you chain our thoughts!

You can bind our eyes
Can you, can you bind our soul !!

Freedom is our birthright
You can not snatch our pride
∎

Darkness breaks and a speck of light
Dressed in clouds besmeared with fog,
Yonder the shore — thou a man in white.
White ants sprawl over thy briny bosom
White foam spray on thy face,
Yonder the white, Welkin a canopy,
A Man who crawls but never resigns from a race….
Chorus
Look down Apollo and gaze at the plight,
Thy light, thou and he..... all a
Man in white.
***
Sky breaks and afar a sight,
Dressed in autumn, besmeared with cold,
Yonder the horizon — thou a man in white.
It is winter on thy boughs,
frost down thy feet...
snow on thy head, icicles down thy cheeks,
but still thy rage to creep out of the pit...
Chorus
Look down Apollo and gaze at the plight

Thy light, thou and he...... all a
man in white
Epilogue And Oracle
***
Colours of the world abjure your pride
Never pass to oblivion that you have emerged from white,
Besides remember, what the mirror
Reflects today.... tomorrow is a
man in white.

∎

I stand waiting
By this cold, indifferent gate 
That opens to nowhere,
Nothing happens around
No body comes 
No body goes
The sky hangs like 
A canopy of pale silence
Over a degenerating landscape,
And the sun rests gentle on the 
Rusting autumn bones,

I stand waiting here,
For one lost moment
That holds death in it 
To come alive, 

I wait for the moment to return
Like a trickle of tear returning
To the corner of the eye,
Like a drop of blood spilled once
Making its way back to the stiffened vein,
Like a fallen star climbing up
To the sky of an endless night,
Like a forbidden breath crawling back into
An ancient grave,

 

I know no body will come
No body will go
Nothing will happen 
Except for that one forgotten moment
Returning to settle stubborn
In my autumn mood,
So I stand waiting here
For that moment to arrive


In this yellowing solitude!
∎

Sillage of a Saree Namita Rani Panda

From a rusty dusty trunk while rummaging the storeroom
I found amidst old clothes a neatly folded saree of my mom
More than five decades old and was fondly worn
That filled the air with the sillage of her perfume
Flashed back my memory like a classic film
That I lovingly cherish and relive in my dream

With a sky-blue body and dark blue border
The aanchal woven with much care, unique and rare
Intricate patterns of fish, leaves and lovely flowers
Not merely a piece of cloth , though lost her early, our secure shelter

I ran my fingers lovingly on the finely woven fabric:
As if the song of my life, each thread being a lyric
I held it tight to my heart and felt the rhythm of her heartbeat
The sudden spillage of her warmth was so solacing and sweet
The aromatic air around whispered my childhood lullabies
I drape myself in the sacred six-yard saree to replicate her grace
A heavenly bliss, as if engulfed in her tender embrace
The sillage that refused to vanish though temporarily filled the emptiness
Intensified the anguish of losing someone dear whom I forever miss
∎

Petals white, tender and pure
Bloomed in a bunch
On a Jasmine twig-
Fragrant, pleasing
Scenic!

A perfect sight,
Enviable bliss!

A calous hand
At the slender stem
Pulls and picks;
Pick, pick, pick!

The black skin
And palms turned white,
Full of corpses,
Catching the whiff
Of Jasmine;


Dead or alive?
∎

source_fields.captured_title: Ballad of the Land of Isis
source_fields.body_html:
A little girl with eyes so wide,
In Class IV`s dream-filled, gentle tide,
Read of Pharaohs` golden land,
Of mummies deep in desert sand.

The years rolled by, yet stayed that dream,
Like Nile`s soft whisper, silver gleam.
And Isis smiled from heaven`s height—
Her call became my soul`s delight.

From Kolkata`s arms to Cairo`s shore,
Where myth and mortal meet once more,
I saw the pyramids touch the sky,
Like prayers that never fade or die.

The Sphinx in silence held her grace,
The desert wind caressed her face.
At Philae`s isle, the goddess dreamed,
Her marble eyes in moonlight gleamed.

By Abu Simbel`s golden flame,
Ramses and Nefertari`s name
Still echo through the sunlit sand,
As Nile flows soft through timeless land.

O Egypt, mother of night and sun,
My heart and yours are now made one.
Forever shall my spirit be—
Bound to your song, eternity.

∎

In the courtyard,
two shadows trade their lengths
morning shorter,
evening learning to stoop.

The wind stands
at the curve
of a pause,
waiting to learn
which sorrow will pass first.

A kettle hums
on the brink of speech,
its vapour curling
like a memory
that won`t cool.

Even the pendulum
halts mid-swing,
as if time itself
forgot its direction.

Far away,
a river turns upon itself,
carrying yesterday`s shimmer
into a deeper hush.

Life
a small rotation of breath,
taking turns
to be vessel,
and then,
the thirst it once held.

∎

She searches herself in him,
he in her, only the two can join.
Thoughts on wings, words mute.
Hearts swing, oneness they feel.

The sea and the desert never meet,
that is when love turns out to be a crime.
Grief entombs dreams
all nine doors of hell shift to the earth
also the trees with swords as leaves,
life ahead difficult.
Soon they become
the accused, judge, executioners.

Sinners turn mourners
raise RIP epitaph
over their mortal remains
long after the invincible souls transcend,
their infinity scoffs at mankind
from higher echelons.

∎

ଖୁବ୍ ଭୟାକୁଳ ଏ ସମୟ,
ବିଚଳିତ ଏ ମନ।

ଭଟକୁଛି ମୁଁ
ଏ ପାଖ,ସେ ପାଖ
ଯେମିତି ଗୋଟେ ବିଶାଳ ଜଙ୍ଗଲ
ଟୋପାଏ ଆଲୁଅ ନାହିଁ,
ରାସ୍ତା ଅଦୃଶ୍ୟ
ପାଦ ମୋର କୁଆଡେ ଯିବ।!

ଆହାରେ ଜୀବନ
ଆଉ କେଉଁ ଦୃଶ୍ୟ
ଦେଖିବାର ଅଛି ମୋର,
ଆଉ କେଉଁ ଦୁଃଖର ଚୋଟରେ
ମାରିବୁ ମତେ,
ନିରବରେ ମଥା ପାତିଛି ବୋଲିତ
ଧରିବାକୁ ଆଞୁଳାରେ
ସୁଖ କାହିଁ ମୋର।

ନିରବରେ ଚିତ୍କାର କରୁଛି
ମୋ ଡାକ ସେ ପାହାଡ,ମେଘ
ଆକାଶ,ଦିଗବଳୟ
ସେ ପାଖ ପହଞ୍ଚି ପାରୁନି,
ଫେରି ଆସୁଛି ମୋ ଆହାତ ଅଭିମାନ,
ଫେରି ଆସୁଛି ମୋ ଅସଂଖ୍ୟ ଚିଠି,
ଅନୁରାଗ ଭରା ଶବ୍ଦ,
ତୀର ହୋଇ ମତେହିଁ ଭେଦୁଛି।

କହରେ ଜୀବନ,
ରାସ୍ତା କାହିଁ ମୋର
ମୁଠାଏ ଜଳବିନ୍ଦୁ କୋଉ ମେଘରୁ ଝରିବ,
ଆଗକୁ ଖୁବ୍ ଅନ୍ଧାର
ଗାଢ,ଗଭୀର
ମୁଁ ଧକ୍କା ଖାଇ ତାରି ଭିତରେ
ଅନ୍ଧାର ପାଲଟି ଯାଉଛି ଆହୁରି ଅନ୍ଧାର।

∎

ତ୍ରିରଙ୍ଗା ଉଡ଼ାଇ, କରତାଳି ଦେଇ,ଜନଗଣମନ ଗାଇ,
ପ୍ରମାଣିତ କରିସାରିଥିଲି ମୋର ଦେଶପ୍ରେମ।
ତଥାପି ଦେଶ କଥା ଯାହା ବାକିରହିଗଲା,
ଛଳଛଳ ହେଉଥିଲା ଏକ ନିରୀହ କିଶୋର ଆଖିରେ।

ପିଠିରେ ରିଫ୍ୟୁଜିର ଟ୍ୟାଗ‌ ବୋହି
ମଧ୍ୟପ୍ରାଚ୍ୟ ମାଟିରୁ ପାଦ ଥାପୁଥିଲା ଆଗକୁ
ଠିକଣା ଅଜଣା
ତା`ଚପଳ ମନରେ ଅବୁଝା ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ
ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ବୋଧହୁଏ ଶାନ୍ତି
ନା ଆଧୁନିକ ଉତ୍ତୀର୍ଣ୍ଣ ମଣିଷର ଆସ୍ପର୍ଦ୍ଧାର ପାଉଣା?
ପଛକୁ ଫେରିଫେରି ତା`ଅସହାୟ ଆଖିହଳକ
ଯୁଦ୍ଧର ବହ୍ନିଭିତରୁ ଖୋଜୁଥିଲା ଗୋଟେ ଦେଶ।
ନୀଳାକାଶ, ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ପବନ,ସରୁ ଲମ୍ବାରାସ୍ତା
ସାନଭଉଣୀର ହାତଧରି ଯେଉଁ
ରାସ୍ତା ଧାରେଧାରେ
ଫୁଟିଯାଉଥିଲେ ନାନାଦି ସ୍ଵପ୍ନରଙ୍ଗ ଅର୍କିଡ୍‌।
ଏକ ଅଟମସଂଧ୍ୟା,ସ୍କୁଲଘର ,ସାଙ୍ଗସାଥୀ
ସବୁ ଆଜି ଧ୍ୱସ୍ତ
ମୁଠାଏ ଦେଶ ବୋଲି ତୋଳିନେବ ଭାବୁଛି ଯେ,
ସବୁଠି ସ୍ଖଳିତ ଶବ ମାନଙ୍କ କବନ୍ଧ।

ଗୋଳାବାରୁଦ ନୁହେଁ ତ`

ମିଳାଇଯାଉଛି

ସେଇଠି ,

ବଣବିଥୀକା, ତଟିନୀ, ସୁନାସକାଳ,ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟମୁଖୀ,କାକଳି।

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
सितंबर... अहा!
नवाँ महीना, ऋतु-संधि का सेतु,
जहाँ स्मृतियों के दीप जलते हैं
और मौसमों की परछाइयाँ
एक-दूसरे से आलिंगन करती हैं।

नहीं, इसे विशेष बनाता
केवल मेरा जन्म-दिवस नहीं
बल्कि यह आकाश का नीलम है,
जिस पर बिखरे हैं बादलों के
श्वेत मोती,
और पुखराज-सा दमकता
सुनहरा सूर्य।

खिड़की से झाँकते ही लगता है
मानो तरु-शाखाएँ हँस पड़ी हों,
जैसे भुट्टे की परत हटते ही
मकई के दाने
किलक उठते हैं।

सितंबर कानों में फुसफुसाता है
सरसराहट से भरी वह आवाज़
जैसे कोरे गाल पर
पहला चुपका-सा बोसा,
जो हृदय में
सिहरन जगाकर भाग जाए।

यह महीना है,
मानो कन्या को
हल्दी-चंदन का उबटन लगाकर
विवाह-दिन के लिए
सजाया जा रहा हो।

बरसात के बाद की हल्की धूप,
धुले-धुले वृक्षों पर
फूटी हुई तरुणाई,
धान, मक्का और बाजरे की बाली
मानो प्रेमालाप करती हो।

और शरद, धीरे से
कानों में मुस्कराकर कहती है
“मुझे पाकर
तुम और निखर गए न?”

यही तो समय है
जब प्रवासी पक्षी लौटते हैं
अपने पूर्वजों के आँगन,
जब पितृपक्ष आरंभ होकर
पूर्वजों का आगमन होता है,
जब गणेशोत्सव गूँजता है,
माता का स्वागत होता है,
और फूलों से भरे बगीचे
बाहें फैलाकर
मानव को अपने स्नेह में
भर लेना चाहते हैं।

जैसे नौ महीने की प्रतीक्षा के बाद
नवजीवन शिशु
माँ की गोद में आता है,
वैसे ही सितंबर है
सृजन और स्मरण का मास,
खुशियों का आगमन,
नवप्रभा का उद्घोष।

सितंबर...
अहा, अनंत सौंदर्य का
जीवंत रूप!

∎

The chirping of the birds
The gazing of the calm herd
The wandering of the sheep in their fleecy fold
The sun rays on the mountains, oceans and greenery

The singing of the cuckoo
The rains and the rainbow,the inseparable two
The sloping,steep valleys
The red cherries like lollies

The greenery`s laden carpet
The ponds that are always wet
Everything awaits in nature`s gate
To be rejuvenated, thrilled and delighted it`s never too late.
∎

The Imperial Bower
that trumped all others
in course of time
loses its sheen
and gets morphed into
the Joker that doesn`t jest
nor does it clown
but changes its colour
caste and creed
when your luck is down.

They don`t belong to any suit
but yet appear
mostly in pairs in a deck
black and red
and are shuffled and dealt
as any other
though at times discarded
uncharitably as unwanted
and extras
only to be retrieved
as a replacement
of a lost or damaged card
assuming their identity
but while on their fools` journey
they sometimes bask and come alive
when played as wild cards
or even as an excuse.

The synthetic smile
with the hidden smirk
remains the same
and while searching for
its identity
the joker stays unfazed
waiting for its turn
to change its colours
like a chameleon
but not as it pleases
but as you will it to
and in its powerlessness
it empowers you
and makes your hands
stronger
and makes you the winner.

box canyon
the cowhand and his horse
face a cool breeze

•

names of friends
crayoned on paper bags
farmyard apples

•

white out
the only tracks in snow
behind us

•

cherry blossoms long gone
not easy turning
the other cheek

•

backyard croquet
the shell of a cicada
his cheerleader

I do not wish for success,
Nor for gold,
Not even for health,
Or a future untold.
I wish for him—
I wish for the time.

He signed my birth certificate;
I signed his death certificate.

He picked my first outfit;
I chose his last.

He witnessed my first breath;
I witnessed his last.

He took me on my first ride;
I stood with him in his last rite.

He heard my very first words;
I listened to his very last words.

He must have seen my first tear,
But I surely saw his last tear.

And I still wonder:
Am I lucky or unlucky
To be with him
In his every last thing?

He is my father.
I am a doctor.
Yes, he left—
Something to gain. ∎

No one forces you to do this, this craft
is one that must be learned from scratch each time.
Past experience cannot guarantee the future;
it cannot be foolproof. Every time
your rough hands must grope
through a pile of tools, some sharp, some dull.
Every line of each word, you must scrutinize,
pick it up, angle it, like a carpenter
with a red and blue pencil tucked behind your ear.
Wood shavings of words scatter at your feet,
and you occasionally blow away the dust, stop your hands,
listen to the instructions given by the dark mouth.
Perhaps after a bout of hard work,
things begin to take shape.
This is a craft that is not really a craft.
It is gradually being lost; technique can only guarantee
that even a master’s mistake is still remarkable.
Decades of toil might be written off in a single day,
but no one forces you to do this.
The components of the words are your surplus body,
surrounding you, like the buildings
that first grew around the house,
the barns and vestibules, these appendages.
They do not lead you toward death’s footsteps.
Slowing down a little will not bring
the fires of the universe to a halt,
nor will it ease human suffering by a single bit.
No one even notices your work.
But still, you must begin again and again, writing
these words, with caution, hesitation, almost solemnly,
as if the entire universe rests upon your shoulders.
And so, here you sit again, painfully writing
an opening that seems meaningless:


The sun is shining brightly today, things exist.
∎

I am seeking you,
ceaseless on the solitary sea,
straining Sisyphus-like
to keep the jinxes
of the journey at bay.
Sailing on and on
and dreaming of you.

With unknown origin and destination,
the ship sails on.
I look at a ballet of bobbing clouds
in a ballroom,
beautiful and blue !

A wild wayfarer am I,
not settled, civilised like you at all.
I keep wandering in the wide open seas
and wondering if I ever can
stand with you as an equal !

You shuttle between cities
and citadels of learning
with degrees and decorations,
all elegant and ashine in your urbane ways,
to which I am a stranger.

You touch me deep within,
all the same!
Elegant, yet empathetic.
Ornate, yet compassionate.
Elevated, yet so tender!

You keep walking on a track
and I, on some other
far away somewhere;
the tracks,
so different and divergent,
but dreaming always
to touch each other !

The classrooms and the seminar hall,
corridors of library,
the sprawling lawn,
the garden in full bloom,
with a book or two lying on the bench.
I can feel it all.

I keep sailing on in serenity and in storm,
in fog and mists,
light and shadow,
and under the canopy
of star-light at night.
Can you feel it ?

So much of talks and silence
to be shared between us.
I muse on as I sit at the table.
My middle finger touches the ebony top
and the glass of water on it shivers a little
In it,
there are rings and ripples.

You sit there
on the other side,
leaning on the table,
your eyes on mine,
tip of your ring finger
resting on the rim of the glass,
as the sea and sky
surround us,

A dolphin swims up
near the deck
and there is a sudden splash.
I am jolted back.

The ship sails on.
Life is an exploration.

source_fields.captured_title: Once I belonged to a zamindar family
source_fields.body_html:
Once I belonged to a zamindar family
As my ancestors said we l are blue-blooded and it`s our  legacy.

But I feel the life I`m living now, it`s me 
We`re now  fighting for bread and butter 
And it`s harsh reality,
I do admit it without any hypocracy.

Gone those days 
When we didn`t believe in mediocrity,
We belonged to that elit class 
Who never thought about  simplicity,
Aristocracy was the utmost priority.

My great Grandpa used to say 
Simplicity and mediocrity, these words are not made for us,
We belong to another class.

Abruptly, one day I said
" See Grandpa, looking so amazing those belwari glass,
Then smiled  and said "But full of rust and dust " won`t last.

He turn around  and said 
"Whatever we are , it`s your  identity 
"It`s your father`s advance thought and sagacity 
That reflected in you and fueled  your audacity".

Further he said, "In  society, we have another place 
Girl! Never try it to replace."

I murmured, " Yes, a dimly lit ancient place 
Even light refuses to spread,
People are not allowed to see our face 
Our feet binded in  silken thread.

I`m only trying to make some changes 
Can`t do much, I`m not that great.

I`m the last daughter
Of this legacy,
Who refused to stay in fantasy.

The world is transforming fast,


And I  chose mediocrity over aristocracy.
∎

I used to dance , I used to sing .
Now I can hardly stretch my wings.
They pierced my wings and blamed me for not being tough enough.
They plucked my feathers one by one and showed it to people
While I bled , hurt , and hollowed out with every plucking of the feather .
I saw him standing by with a bowl as he collected my feathers and put them on display on the mantelpiece.
My wings are of new use now.
I can`t fly, I can only flap them and then sit in one place.
I look overhead and see my peers fly. They wave to me asking me to join.
Yet I sit there still and unmoving .
My wings feel like a burden now since I have to drag them everywhere.
But I can`t fly. The sky beckons me , and my tears fall in an incessant stream.
Yet I can`t fly.


Seems like a death with the heart still beating.
∎

My yesterdays lay
soaked in cheap perfume
and salty memories
waves of hope
rode through my head.
they swam in random
despair
in silly desires,
in the broken moon
and blue waters in the backdrop.
my yesterdays
were a handful of droopy daisies,
how choked was I
when my heart swell in shame.
Today has dawned
the blue waters are serene
daisies have bloomed
the broken moon is resiliently beautiful
for on silence


have I learnt to flourish.
∎

You hold it all in the palm of your hands
The ocean storms, the desert sands
The ground beneath and the skies above
You hold in your heart perpetual love.

Eternal, omnipotent and divine
You exist since the very begining of time
Your love shines through and multiplies
Like the multitudinous stars in the skies

Cause you`re infinite, without boundaries
The unending waves that rule the seas
Countless like dandelions, blown in the breeze
Innumerable like the leaves of the evergreen trees.

You surround me, are all around me
All majestic, exalted and sublime
Diverse in this unending universe
Transcending the portals of time.

I`ll die and be reborn a hundred times
Yet I know you will always be by my side
For you exist and I always find you
In that little voice deep inside.

A voice that speaks only truthfully
Fill our lives with a sweet melody
You are infinity, the key to eternity
The door that opens and sets us free. ∎

Remember Viswanath? You
told me many times, "Kashi,
you suffer what-not
in my name,
from never-ending funeral processions
trampling your peace
to crematorium ash all over
your sacrosanct body,
from misfortunes of hapless emperors
to heartbreaking sorrow of vilomahs.

“You tolerate odd wars
over who is bigger, Ram?
or the knower of Ram?
and the confusion of local governance
whether to focus on the holy place or
on the devotees, and again,
from you, me
or you from me?”

Enough, Viswanath! Just remember, I am
your ethereal carving
on your own creation,
yet I am the holiest stop
to all your creations.
Now it`s all the same, whatever they say,
you are for me,
or I am for you,
beloved forever.
∎

Amidst the throngs of faces, one stood out so fair,
The one I missed, oh ! how I wish I could repair,
His eyes like stars, his smile like sunshine bright,
The one I missed, my heart still takes flight.

A heart so full of hope and cheer,
A love so strong, so pure and clear,
The memories of moments we shared,
Are etched in my mind, forever bared.

The thought of him, it still haunts me,
A longing so intense, it still taunts me,
Will he come back, and set me free?
Or will my heart remain captive, you see?

The days go by, and I still wait,
For the day he`ll walk back through the gate,
But time keeps passing, and I`m still here,
Left to wonder, left to fear.

The nights are long, and dark, and cold,
My heart is heavy, my soul is old,
I miss him so, it`s like a pain,
A pain that words can`t explain.

So I wait, and hope, and pray,
That he`ll come back, some day,
And bring with him, a brighter day,
And chase the shadows away.

His soul, a gem, a treasure to behold
His love, a fire, that never grows old
His strength, a mountain, steadfast and true
His kindness, a river, flowing pure and through

 

 

In slumber`s embrace, I find thee there,
A vision of beauty, beyond compare.
Thy visage, a canvas of grace,
Adorned with charm, in every place.

Thy lips, a rose`s gentle hue,
 Inviting all, to love anew.
Thy eyes, like pools of crystal deep,
Reflecting all, that`s pure and sweet.

Thou art a dream, a fleeting thought,
A moment`s joy, a love brought.
Thy touch, a spark, that sets my soul aflame,
And in thy presence, I am not the same.

But alas!thou art a dream, no more,
A fleeting vision, on the wind`s shore.
And when I wake, thou art but a memory,


A longing, that doth haunt my mind, so dreary.
∎

In the hush between heartbeats, where breath becomes memory,
Love`s lingering shadows drift like smoke..
weightless, but impossible to ignore.
They pass over the heart
the way light moves through old glass..
slow, fractured, soft with sorrow.
The hurts unspoken do not vanish;
they nest in the quiet spaces beneath the ribs,
where laughter once lived,
where the soul, torn but enduring,
learned to carry the weight of silence.
Music rises, not to fill the silence,
but to honor it.
A twilight tone,
each note a sigh,
each lyric an echo
that circles back long after the voice is gone.
There are no grand declarations here,
only the whispers of small stories
that contain whole lifetimes..
a glance that lingered too long,
a touch that trembled,
a silence that meant everything.
They are stitched together by time,
by tenderness,
by a sorrow that has grown wise,
and a hope that,
despite everything,
still stands quietly in the dark-
waiting.

∎

When the sun is away
Behind the darkness
The stars stare
The dry eyes of the girl
Who wanted to be a river.

In aquatic excitement of
Jazzy water body,
The unseen stream
Where the boat
Doesn`t pushed across,
The flowery anchal
Shines in alluvial island
Thrown away by the girl.

Sprinkle the moonlit
The moon goes away,
The indifferent wind carries
The indistinct cry of night jasmine.

Searching a trisul
The girl has been waiting devotedly
In the river side
To become Durga .

∎

ସେଦିନ ମୁଁ ନଥିଲି ସେଠି
ତମେ କି ସେମାନେ ନଥିଲେ
ହେଲେ ଆମେ ସଭିଏଁ ଥିଲେବି
କ`ଣ ବଦଳେଇ ପାରି‌ଥାନ୍ତେ
ସେଇ ବର୍ବର ନାଟକର
ଘୃଣ୍ୟତମ ଦୃଶ୍ୟ !
ଦୁଇଜଣ ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଲୋକଙ୍କୁ
ନିଃର୍ବସ୍ତ୍ର କରି ଚଳେଇ ନିଆଯାଏ
ରାଜରାସ୍ତାରେ ସହସ୍ର ଲୋଲୁପ ଆଖି
ସାମ୍ନାରେ ପଣ୍ୟଦ୍ରବ୍ୟ ପରି
ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଗୋପନ ଶରୀର ରହସ୍ୟ
ପରମ ଭୋଜ୍ୟ ପରି ପରଶା ହୋଇଥାଏ
ନଗ୍ରଜନଙ୍କ ହାତ ପାହାନ୍ତାରେ
ବିଷାକ୍ତ ସରୀସୃପ ପରି ଲହଲହ
ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଅଷ୍ଟାଙ୍ଗ ଶରୀର
ନାରୀତ୍ବର ଚରମ ନିରାଦର
କରନ୍ତି କେବଳ ନପୁଂସକ ମାନେ
ଜହ୍ଲାଦମାନେ ଜଳେଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତି
ନଗର, ଜନପଦ, କ୍ଷେତ, ଖମାର
ଜଳନ୍ତା ଯାନ ଭିତରେ ଜଳିଯାଆନ୍ତି
ନିରପରାଧ ମା`ଟିଏ, ପୁଅଟିଏ
କଟାମୁଣ୍ଡମାନେ ଝୁଲନ୍ତି ବାଉଁଶ ଅଗରେ
ହିଂସା ଓ ଘୃଣାର ତରଳ ଲାଭା
ବହୁଥାଏ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଧମନୀରେ
ସଂପର୍କର ପାଳଗଦାରେ ନିଆଁଲାଗି
ଧ୍ବଂସସ୍ତୁପ ପାଲଟିଯାଏ
ଫାନେକ୍‌ ଓ ଇନାଫି ପିନ୍ଧିଥିବା
ବିଷଣ୍ଣ ମହିଳା ଓ ବାଳିକାମାନଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟଥା
ପହଁରୁଥା‌ଏ ପବନରେ ବିଷାଦ‌ର ବାସ ନେଇ
ସେମାନେ ‌ହୁଏତ ଭୁଲିଯାଆନ୍ତି
ରାଧାକୃଷ୍ଣଙ୍କ ରାସ ଜାଗୋଇ ନୃତ୍ୟ
ବାଉଁଶ ଓ ଖଣ୍ଡାଧରି ହାତେ
ଡ୍ରମବାଜାର ତାଳେ ତାଳେ

ପ୍ରାଚୀ ମରିଗଲା
ନା ମାରିଦିଆଗଲା ।
ସେ ସେତିକି ଆୟୁଷ ଆଣିଥିଲା
ନା ସେଠୁ କିଛି କାଢିନିଆଗଲା ।
ତା` ଜନ୍ମ ତାରିଖକୁ ନେଇ
ଲଢୁଛନ୍ତି କବି, ଐତିହାସିକ, ଗବେଷକ
ନାନା ମୁନି ନାନା ମତ –
ସେ ଯେ ଅସଂଖ୍ୟ ଜୀବନ ପାଇଁ ଭାଗ୍ୟଦେବୀ ଥିଲା
ସର୍ବେ ଏକମତ ।
ଯେଉଁ ପଥରକୁ ସ୍ନେହଁରେ ଆଉଁସି ଦେଉଥିଲା
ସେ ଶାଳଗ୍ରାମ ପାଲଟିଯାଉଥିଲା;
ଯେ ତା`କୁ ପ୍ରେମ କରୁଥିଲା
ତା`କୁ ପରମ ପଦ ଯାଚିଦେଉଥିଲା ।
ସେ କାଳକୁ କାଦୁଅ ମୂର୍ତିରେ ଥାପିପାରେ
ସେ ପ୍ରକୃତିକୁ ନାନାଦି ରଂଗ ଦେଇପାରେ
ଆକାଶ ତା`କୁ ଛୁଇଁବାକୁ ସାଧନା କରୁଥିଲା
ମାଟି ମା` ହେବାକୁ ପ୍ରାର୍ଥନା କରୁଥିଲା
ଏଇମିତି କେତେ କ`ଣ ମହିମା ମହାତ୍ମ୍ୟ
ବେଶୀ ଶୁଣା କଥା; ଆଖି ଦେଖାରେ ବି
ଆଶ୍ଚର୍ଯ୍ୟ କମ୍ ନଥିଲା ।
ସେ ଦେବାକୁ ଆସିଥିଲା
ଦେଇ ଦେଇ ଚାଲିଗଲା ।
ତା`ର ମୃତୁ୍ୟ ଅପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଶିତ ନ ଥିଲା;
ମରଣର ମୁହାଣକୁ ସେ ଧିରେ ଧିରେ ଧାଉଁଥିଲା
ସେ ଯେ ମରୁଛି, ଉପମା ଉପସର୍ଗରେ
ସେ ଜଣେଇ ଦେଉଥିଲା ।
ଆହାଃ ଆହାଃ ଚୁ ଚୁ ଛଡ଼ା
ଆମେ କିଛି କରିପାରିଲୁନି ।
ପ୍ରାଚୀ ଚାଲିଗଲା ।
ଏବେ ସେ ବହିବ ରହିବ
ପ୍ରେମ ପୁରାଣରେ, ସ୍ମୃତି ସାଗରରେ
ଚେତନାର ଚିତ୍ରପଟଳରେ ।
ଆଜି ତା`ର କେତେ ତମ ଶ୍ରାଦ୍ଧବାର୍ଷିକୀ
ମୁଁ ହିସାବ ରଖିନି;
ସେ ପୁଣି ଫେରିବ, ହୁଏତ
ଭିନ୍ନ ଏକ ରୂପରେ
ଏଇ ବିଶ୍ୱାସରେ
ମୁଁ ଉଡିବୁଲୁଛି, ଚକ୍କର କାଟୁଛି
ତା` ଅତୀତର ଉପତ୍ୟକାରେ ।

ମୋ.୯୪୩୭୧୭୧୪୪

ଧାରେ ସରୁପାଣିର ବାଲିଆ ଜୋର,

ଭର୍ତ୍ତି ଏଠି ସେଠି


ଓସ୍ତଗଛ ମୂଳେ ଯେଉଁ ନାଲି ନେତ,

ସେ ବି ବାଟ ଜଗିବସିଛି ତୋର 


ବିଲ, ବାଡ଼ି, ଗୋବର ଗାଢ଼ 
ଗୋବର ଲିପା ଅଗଣା,

ମୋ ଗର୍ବ ଆଉ ହାରିଗୁହାରି ଜୀବନର 


ଗୋଟେ ବାଲିଚରା, ପାଦଚଲା ରାସ୍ତା ଉପରେ

କିଛି ଘରେ ଭାଗ କରା ହେଇଚି ଗଉଣି,

ତୁ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଦେଇ ପାରିବୁ, ଯାହା ଦୂରେଇ ଦିଏ 
ହୃଦୟରୁ ହୃଦୟକୁ !? 


ଦେଖିବୁ ନକ୍ସାକରା, ଦଦରା 
ସବୁଠୁଁ ପ୍ପୁରୁଣା ଯାଉଁଳି କବାଟ;

ପୁରାତନ ସ୍ମୃତି ଏବେ ପାଣିଖିଆ କାଠ 


ମୋ ନ ଥିଲା ବେଳେ

ନୂଆ ଭୁଆସୁଣୀ ପରି ,

ଯେ ଯା ଗଛକୁ ତା ନାଁର ପତର!

ଜଙ୍ଗଲି, ପାହାଡ଼ି ଗଢ଼ଣର ।

ମୋ ହାତରେ
ଏବେ ଖୁବ୍ କମ୍ ଅର୍ଥରାଶି,
ସମୟ ବି କମ୍,
ତେଣୁ ଭାବିଚିନ୍ତି
ଖୁବ୍ ହିସାବୀ ଭାବରେ,
ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ହେବ,
ଅର୍ଥ ଓ ସମୟ,
ପରିଣାମ ଲାଭଜନକ
ନ ହେଉ ପଛେ ,
ଅନନ୍ଦଦାୟୀ ହେଉ ମୋର
ଏ କିଣାକିଣି ର ଅନୁଭବ।
ଘର ବି ଭରିଗଲାଣି ଅନେକ
ଆବଶ୍ୟକ, ଅନାବଶ୍ୟକ ଚିଜରେ,
କିଛି ବାହାର କରି ଫିଙ୍ଗିବାକୁ ହେବ,
କିଛି କିଛି ନୂଆ କିଣିଥିବା
ଜିନିଷରେ,
ସଜାଇବାକୁ ହେବ
ଘରକରଣା,,
ବେଳେବେଳେ ଭାବେ ଏତେ ସବୁ
ଜିନିଷ,
ମୋର କଣ ସତରେ ନିହାତି ଆବଶ୍ୟକ?
ଏତେ ସବୁ କିଣିଛି କାହିଁକି??
ଏମିତି ଭାବି କିଛିଦିନ
କୋଉ ଅପଣି କି ବିପଣି କୁଆଡ଼କୁ
ଯାଏନା,
ହେଲେ ବେଶ୍ କିଛିଦିନ ପରେ ଏମିତି ଲାଗେ,
ଯେମିତି ମୋ ଭିତରୁ ମରିଯାଇଛି
ଜୀବନ ଜିଇଁବା ର ସ୍ପୃହା,
ପୁଣି ସମୟ କାଢି ମୁଁ ବଜାର ଯାଏ,
ଏଣୁ ତେଣୁ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ମନେହେଉଥିବା ଦ୍ରବ୍ୟ କିଣି
ଖୁସିରେ ଘରକୁ ଫେରେ,
କିଛି କ୍ଳାନ୍ତି ନେଇ ଦେହରେ,
ସୋଫା ରେ ବସିପଡେ ତ ଆଖି ଲାଗିଯାଏ,
ଛାଇ ଛାଇ କା ନିଦରେ
ସ୍ଵପ୍ନରେ ମିତ୍ର ପରି କେହିଜଣେ ଆସେ,
ପାଶରେ ବସି କହେ,
ଏସବୁ ତୁମ
ଛୋଟ ଛୋଟ ଖୁସି ର ଅନୁଭବ,
ଏହାକୁ ତୁମକୁ ଛାଡିଯିବାକୁ ହେବ
ତେଣୁ ନିର୍ମୋହ ହୁଅଗୋ ନନ୍ଦା,

ପ୍ରିୟ ତାପସ ମୋ`ର

हम अभी भी सोते हैं
तुम्हारी गोद में माँ
पर नींद नहीं आती
तुम इतनी ख़ामोश क्यों हो माँ
और लोरी भी नहीं गाती ।

क्या हो गया
वो खिलखिलाते फूलों को
कहाँ गईँ वो तितलियाँ?
ख़ून से लहुलुहान तेरी धरती
किस की हैं ये ग़लतियाँ?

तूने ही जना हमें
तेरी ही सन्तान हैं हम
पर क़िस्मत देखो
हम ही तेरे अफ़सोस
हम ही तेरे ग़म!

ग़ाज़ा की गलियों की चीख
त्रस्त युक्रेन की बेबसी
मुर्शिदाबाद का आर्तनाद
बयान करता है
तेरी चुप्पी की वजह!

हम सोते ही रहेंगे बेधड़क
गहरी नींद में
पर आँखें खुली होंगी
और शायद तुम्हारी खामोशी
जारी रहेगी
सदा के लिए! ∎

सुनो !
तुम मुझे मत देना ,
प्रेम में ,
खनकती चूङियाँ,
ये मुझे ,
एहसास दिलाती है,
बँधने का बंधनों में,
तुम मुझे ,
बस देना,
प्रेम में,
कुछ महकते,
गुलाब के फूल,
जिनकी महक से ,
महक जाए ,
मेरा अंतर्मन,
और महसूस
हो मुझे,
अपनी ,
उन्मुक्तता ,
का एहसास।

सुनो !
तुम मुझे मत देना ,
प्रेम में,
छनकती पायलें,
ये मुझे ,
एहसास दिलाती है,
बँधने का बंधनो में,
तुम मुझे ,
बस देना,
प्रेम में,
कुछ महकते,
रजनीगंधा के फूल ,
जिनकी महक से ,
महक जाए ,
मेरा अंतर्मन,
और महसूस
हो मुझे,
अपनी ,
उन्मुक्तता ,
का एहसास।
∎

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
सुनता जा, ओ निर्मोही पथिक,
क्यों किया तूने हृदय भ्रमित?
लोचन अब तुझको ढूँढ रहे,
मुझे बिसार कर है क्यों हर्षित?

टीस जिया की ना पहुँची तुम तक,
सूख गए अश्रु, नयन हुए थक।
हर आहट पर दौड़े ये पग,
पथरा गईं अखियाँ, देखूँ अपलक।

मिली नहीं पर दबी है चाह,
नहीं सुनी क्या मेरी आह?
ज़िक्र न कर पाऊँ पर हर पल,
लेता जा पथिक, दिल की थाह।

कई कई पाती लिख डाली,
पते में बस दिल रख डाला।
ओ रंगरेज, अब रंग भर दे,
मिली वो पाती दिल वाली?

रक्ताभ गुलमोहर-सा रंग भर दे,
बासंती अमलतास-सा तन कर दे।
धानी धरा-सी लहराऊँ, लजाऊँ,
सतरंगी चुनरिया अब तो कर दे।

∎

जमशेदपुर

Time is a dense cloud that can
rain countless times,
the patters echoing the
reality of earth-
the resounding reassurance of
the sure-footedness;
The gleeful gusto.

Time is a dense cloud that can
instantly vanish at the mere
touch of a gust-
the sudden burst of
the unlived breaths,
the wisps conveying the
illusion of sky;
The gnawing gloom.

Between the countless and cipher,
There lie many lives, many deaths. ∎

The green fields give us fruits, flowers, grains
We admire its beauty
And how do we repay them?
Do we really love them a week bit?
Or ruthlessly cut them down, turning it to a cruel, eccentric `Wasteland`?
∎

Women are blessed with the
consciousness of motherhood...

such a blissful energy on earth
such a powerful nurturing flow

I met two mothers : amma & ma

my life has been a blessed one,
a silent one - one which came to
experience life in all senses.

I lost them both, too soon, to tell
them what it means to be the
`mothers` to a daughter who could
win the world with words and
wisdom...

I was travelling through my own
karmic path and meeting the sages,
the wise souls and healers

I was creating communities with
the artists and visionaries...

but life has its own deals:
and I was unaware of its plan:
to call back both the women
in my life.

And everything changed,
nothing can be the same again,
the experiences, the people, the fact
that I am motherless...

the womb that carried me to this
world does not exist anymore...

I hope we shall meet again, in some
other space.

I will walk forward, since life will not
allow me to look back...

yet I wish that I had a mother alive,
to be loved and cherished,

not in memories but in flesh and blood.
∎

I carry the dust of a thousand dawns,
fingers stained with pigments,
each hue a silent witness to the wars I`ve waged
against the blank canvas,
that pale, indifferent face staring back,
waiting to devour or reveal.

I carry the weight of failures I`ve etched and erased,
ghosts of half-born visions hovering
in the silence between breath and brushstroke,
in the raw, unhealed spaces of my hands.

In the nights where sleep dissolved like smoke,
I forged my path through dark labyrinths,
a pilgrim of lines and colours,
seeking a truth too vast to name.
I bled for beauty, gave my bones to light,
only to find myself lost,
in love with the loss.

I carry the laughter of those who never understood
this hunger, this wound that would not close,
and the quiet scorn of a world content
with surfaces, afraid of depth.

But I also carry the moment I first touched eternity,
when my hands moved as if on borrowed grace,
and something larger than breath and body
flowed through me, a river of fire,
burning away all that was small,
leaving only the vast silence of stars.

I carry the peace of knowing
that I am nothing, and I am everything,
the hand that shapes the clay,
the clay that shapes the hand,
a speck in the storm,
a drop returning to the boundless sea.

And when the earth gathers me back,
I will leave behind the bruised weight of the world,
all the struggle and striving, the ache of want
but I will carry the light I have gathered,
the stillness that remains
when creation and creator are one.

What I carry to my rest
is not sorrow, not triumph, but this
a quiet flame, a seed of wonder,
and the faint whisper of all that cannot die.
∎

And no-one spoke and no-one smiled
There were too many spaces in the line. 
I can barely define the shape of this moment in time. 
The clock is ticking fast and beyond our control. 
Look at the strangers we`ve become
No doubt, without the love we need, we`re done. 
Yesterday somebody asked me whether I knew you, 
A million memories flashed through my eyes 
But I just smiled and said, I used to. 
∎

I bought them cheap
on a whimsy.
Testing with hesitant fingers
that the bind was not flimsy,
I put them on, white,
shining, waiting,
on the moodboard of
our coalescing, —
Snaking like a river
around my throat,
they waited on tiptoe
till scattered around the
bed, the flooring,
the disturbed pearls
lay happy in the breaking
apart, knew two people
had become one
in their disbanding.

All around the room
I picked them one by one,
in the hollow of my palms nestling.
Keeping each one in a box,
our memories shimmering.

∎

The bumblebee
came all the way
from the inmost of the hinterland,
flitting from briar banks
of mountain brooks
to rose blooms
and ultimately settled
on the lively marigolds,
in full bloom, in this garden,
maintaining its perennial mystique.
Wrapping them with its magic charmed wings, it felt satiated,
as if showers had lashed parched lands.
The butterflies around sensed
something great was happening,
clustered around them,
and made their presence felt in a big way.
∎

Your mind is like a silent shore-
Everyone believes that it`s calm.

An onlooker may lazily spend a few hours-
Sitting, sipping tea and even eating pyaaj-pakoras,
An ardent photographer may try to capture
The breath-taking beauty,
A weekend painter may come with his canvas
And paint the contours of the staid shore,
A notable poet may write on the reflections
Of the night lights that rhythmically shake in water.

What they`ll all assume is
That the shore is gracefully calm.

However, the inner turmoil may,
Like the overwrought waves,
Keep striking towards the poised surface
Again and again and yet again…

And if you don`t dip your meandering mind
In a sacred bottle of nirvanic nectar
And fearlessly face the inner turmoil,
The waves may also erode you,
Taking away your comforting charm.

∎

Silence is not something special.
It sits on the threshold between
thunder and lull,
it lives in the pause between
goodbye and forgetting,
in the coffee that waits to be drunk.
It is folded in the creases of my saree
still scented with jasmine and camphor,
in turmeric dreams and footprints
at the edge of Ganga.
It is there in the sound of a leaf falling,
in a smile in the cracks of time"s lip
long after the world has forgotten
our names.
∎

Fear, be my gatekeeper,
Let Hope not enter.
He is the harbinger of disaster.

The castle is deserted; the weather is still,
Birds sing not; no moonlight,
Owls and bats perch in pitch darkness;
Vision of the dark tastes glory in solitude,
Blinding light pains darkness and the inhabitants alike.

A flash of light, burning torches, make people restless
They dance like fools.
Soon light fades, too tired they become
To dance; darkness makes people falter and fall.

People lie and waste away,
As if they never had been!


∎

source_fields.captured_title: The Ego Maniac and the Empath
source_fields.body_html:
Grandiose narcissists 
devoid of empathy and compassion
 troop in and out of the world stage
creating a nauseating din; grinning.  
Why do they love themselves so much -
 these ego maniacs, 
manipulating everyone to their selfish ends? 

Bending backwards, 
forwards,
 sideways, 
left,
 right,
    right, 
left,
 always! 

Has a whimsical painter gone haywire, painting harum-scarum?
 humming some grotesque tune, sitting on the pavement, crooning?

 
The egomaniacs wonder, 
 looking condescendingly at the singer-painter,
crinkling their noses, striking belligerent poses,
 trying to downplay the artist.
 
" That splash of paint looks a little out of place,
 And your pitch is too high ."
One says arrogantly, a grimace on his face,
 kicking a skeletal dog 
  
But the empathetic singer-painter continues singing  and painting,
ignoring the egomaniac`s grandiose sense of self-conceit. 
He is not accountable to anyone.

 He has again started dabbing. 
 Splashing, singing - doing his own thing. 
 The resentful narcissist beats a hasty retreat,
 mumbling imprecations.

 The mongrel whimpers, nestling next to the painter.
The painter smiles, patting him on the head. 
 splashing vibrant hues in his painting.
 Life is, after all, a celebration. Is it not?   
∎

source_fields.captured_title: Dawn on the banks of Ganga
source_fields.body_html:
A narrow ripple folds the morning in half.
Palm shadows lie flat on the quiet water.
The village waits inside its own breath.
A dog yawns where the path meets the shore.
A sari flutters, catching pieces of sun.
The ferry rope creaks like an old sentence.
Wind brushes past the mud walls and stays.
Two herons trade places above the reeds.
The river keeps its voice low—
the land might be sleeping still.

∎

If there is one thing that has to be done
In haste
Like with an urgency
As if, your existence depended on it

Like an emergency call at 3am
Someone needs an ambulance
A bottle of blood
That sort of emergency

If there is one thing that has to be done
Now
It`s to find a way
To un-teach the hate

And yes I know you will say
Hatred in wombs for ages
Is now festered
The damage done
The tragedy of doing too little
Or too much of the wrong things
And calling it education

BIO

∎

My eyes are dull, my cheeks are pale.
No one sees, how I wither with time in pain.
You only see the beautiful flame
of youth pass by, in disdain.

Still, I bake and cook for you
The black dots or scars
from flames and oil, I gain.
Wash and dry all the dirt on the floor
Knees and knuckle darken with time.
I am happy, the clothes they wear
Are all sparkling shine.
Each moment, give my hands a wrinkle and a line

My eyes with the crow`s line grow dark
My sleepless nights to keep everything in order
is the cause.

Don`t you see? Even if you see, do you care?
But today, as I stand with my wrinkled face;
Darkened eyes, crumpled body with age;
scarred hands and body bent,
you only see an old withered lady, with discontent.

Yet, it is me who gives light to you all.
Nurtures you. Now I have left for me no more.

Still I sing, still I laugh
For the world is in my hands.
I never grow old from the inside.
For me, you are all my paradise.

∎

Did occasionally the temple say
Keep away Rahim,
Did the Majid say seldomly
Don`t utter the name of Ram!
Did the soil say once
The tale of not making slave 
in mere writing of someone`s name ,
The river never says
The tale that
The flowing water has
No boundary.

Does religion teach selfishness ,
Is Humanity tells about
The story of sadism!

Is the blue mountain
Under the control of Air,
Or is the blue sky dependent 
on the high mountain!


The colour of
No-one`s blood is changed
Though devastated in wild fire of violence ,
Can a desert become a sympathetic heart?

Is love become narcissistic ever?
Is the Inwit not the ultimate God!
Six feet of land reminds the reality
Though snatch the whole of the Earth,
The Soul is not the slave of anyone.
∎

I have always loved 
the silent streets of my small town.
The young evening with the sun
setting at one corner 
and the moon peeking on the other.
The wind hums a sweet song,
gently caressing the quaint houses
with their dodging moods.
A man noiselessly strolls 
with a string bag upon his shoulder,
Children merrily hop back home
with their soft giggles filling the street,
Women murmur the evening prayers,
Faint ringing of bells 
spread in the atmosphere, 
adding to the rhythm.
The near quietness is a safe haven,
undisputed and serene.
As though it were an enchanted
fairyland, 
blessed with mountains
glimmering in the moonlight
and whispering trees, 
where hope still dances in the air.
∎

river reunion
the kayak keel touches
rock bottom

back for another look
inside the hollow
owl eyes

beaching the nose
onto round pebbles
thunder, not far behind

even in kayaks
maintaining social distance
upstream sneeze

paddling downriver
for the home stretch
a quarter moon

∎

I am on my way to destruction.
Have you ever seen a cloud burst?
It was on that eventful day in June
the skies ripped open and let them
fall.  Caught in the cold they huddled
inside the temple, held on to the walls,
the pillars, each other, chanting mantras
and he watched.  Lord Shiva sat on his
pristine abode and let them fall. 

Nothing remained, but his third eye
settling scores.  Bodies swept away,
and so were the offerings, heavy bells
clanged on their own, hands seeking
ablutions drifted mid-air and only
Nandi survived to tell the story. 
Grim eyed Shiva picked up the seams
and let the river Alaknanda break into a
song - I am on my way to destruction. 

Home and hearth, birds, and cattle
bricks and mortar hear my call. 
All of them shivered with fright
only man refused to pay heed to
the gurgling fury as if he had turned
stone deaf.  He continued his tirade
against nature, against hills, against
rocks, against life. 
And is still paying a price. 

∎

ସବୁ ଠିକ୍ ଠାକ୍ ହୋଇ ଆସିଲା ବେଳକୁ
ଟିକେ ଆଶ୍ବସ୍ତ ଲାଗିଲା ।
୩୭୦ ଉଚ୍ଛେଦର କଟକଣା ବି ନ ଥିଲା ।

ପାଦେ ପାଦେ ବିପଦର ଟାଣପଣକୁ
ଉପାଡି ଫୋପାଡି ଦିଆଗଲା ।
ଆଉ କିଛି ସଂକଟ କି ଭୟ ନାହିଁ ସେଠାରେ
ମୁଁ ବି ମନସ୍ଥ କଲି
ତତୋ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ଯିବି ।

ଭାରତର ସବୁଠୁ ସୁନ୍ଦରୀକୁ
ତୋ ରୂପରେ କେହି ସରିହେବେନି,

ସେଥିପାଇଁ ଛଳ କରି ତତୋ ପାଇବାକୁ
ସମସ୍ତେ ପାଗଳ ।

କେବଳ ତୁ ଦିଶୁଥିଲୁ ଦାଉ ଦାଉ ହୋଇ ସେଦିନ
ସଇତାନମାନେ ଖୁବ୍ ନଗଣ୍ଯ କୀଟପତଂଗ ପରି ।

ଗୋଟେ ଦିନ ଆସିଲା ସେଦିନ ଏପ୍ରିଲ ୨୨ /୨୦୨୫
ଲୁହ ରକ୍ତକୁ ଦେଖି
ମାଟି ଥରିଗଲା
ଛାତି ଥରିଗଲା
ପହଲଗାମ୍ ର ଏ୍ଯଶ୍ବର୍ଯ୍ଯ ଦିଶୁ ନ ଥିଲା କି ସୌନ୍ଦର୍ଯ୍ଯ
ଅଶ୍ରୁର ଝରଣା ବହୁଥିଲା ଭାରତର ଆଖିରୁ ସେଦିନ ।

ସ୍ତବଧ ସ୍ଥିର
କାଶ୍ମିରୀରେ ଅବାକ୍ ହୋଇଯାଇଥିଲା
ନବବିବାହିତ ପତ୍ନୀର ସ୍ବର
ଗୁଳି ଶଦ୍ଦ ଶୁଣି
କୁନି ପୁଅଟି କହୁଥିଲା ମାଆକୁ
ତୁମର କଣ ହୋଇଗଲେ ମୁଁ ରହିବି କୋଉଠି ?

ବାପାଂକର ମୃତ ଦେହ ଦେଖି କହୁଥିଲା ପିଲାଟି
ଏହା ବାପାଂକ ଡୁପ୍ଲିକେଟ୍
