ଭୋକ ଥାଉ ବା ନଥାଉ ଖାଇନେବା କଥା।

ଯାହାର ଆଖି ନାହିଁ
ବାଆଁ,ଡାହାଣ,ଆଗ, ପଛ
ସବୁ ସମାନ ତା ପାଇଁ
ଗନ୍ତବ୍ୟ ସବୁ ରାସ୍ତା।

ଚାଲିଛି ରାଜଗାନ
ବଧିର ବା ଶୁଣିପାରେ କଣ?
ପଚରା ଯାଉଛି,ଅନ୍ତରର କଥା
ମୂକ ବା କହିପାରେ କଣ?

ଏ ଡାଳେ ସେ ଡ଼ାଳେ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ଗୁଞ୍ଜି ଥିବା ମାଙ୍କଡ
ଦଉଚି ରାଜ୍ୟର ଖବର
ଘର ସଂସାର କି ମଣିଷର ଦୁଃଖ ସୁଖ ଜାଣିବ ତ
ବାଇଚଢ଼େଇକୁ ପଚାର।

ଏବେ ଏଇ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରୁ ମୁଁ ଭାବୁଛି ରାତିକୁ ଭିନ୍ନ ଅର୍ଥ ଦେବି
ସୁରାସାକିରୁ ଅଲଗା କରି
ମୋ ପ୍ରେମୀ ସହ ମିଳନକୁ ରାତି କହିବି।

ଅନ୍ନକୁ ଖାଦ୍ୟର କାରାଗାରରୁ ମୁକ୍ତ କରି
ଭୋକ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ିବି
ସାରା ଦିନର ଖଟଣି ପରେ ଥକି ହାରି
ଫେରି ଥିବା ଲୋକର ପେଟ ଓ ହାତ ସହ ଗୁନ୍ଥିବି।

ମାଙ୍କଡ, ବାଇଚଢେଇ ମାନଙ୍କୁ
ଦୋଷ ଦେଇ ଲାଭ ନାହିଁ
ବଗିଚା ତ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ଖେଳିବା ଜାଗା,
ଛୋଟ ପିଲାମାନେ ଖେଳନାକୁ ତାଙ୍କ ମାଲିକାନାରେ ରଖିବା ପରି
ସେମାନେ ବଗିଚାକୁ ଭାବୁଛନ୍ତି ଯଦି ଭାବନ୍ତୁ,
ମୁଁ କିନ୍ତୁ ବଗିଚାକୁ ସୃଜନ ସହ ଯୋଡୁଛି ଓ
ଫୁଲ ମାନଙ୍କୁ ଛୋଟ ଛୁଆର ନୂଆ ଗଜୁରୁଥିବା ଦାନ୍ତ ବୋଲି ଅର୍ଥ କରୁଛି।

ରଙ୍ଗ ମାନଙ୍କୁ ମୁଁ ଧର୍ମରୁ ମୁକ୍ତ କରି
ଖୋଲା ଘାସ ପଡିଆ ସହ ଯୋଡୁଛି,
ଏ ଘାସ ପଡିଆ ଉପରେ
ଶବ୍ଦ ମାନଙ୍କର ନୂଆ ନୂଆ ଅର୍ଥ ମାନଙ୍କୁ ଧରି
ଗଢ଼ୁଛି ଆସର
ଥାଳିରେ ବଢ଼ା ହେଇଥାଉ ଅନ୍ନ
ବିଛା ହେଇଥାଉ ତକିଆ ଚାଦର I ∎

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
सघन तम में क्यों मन विकल,
नयन सूखते कभी सजल,
निज उर की  थाह न पाती,
अंजन मसि से लिखूँ मैं पाती।
तुम मुझ में और मैं हूँ तुममें,
ज्यों कृष्ण राधामय राधा कृष्ण मय, 
क्यों पल-पल अब यह समझाती,
हम तो ठहरे एक दूजे के थाती,
अंजन मसि से लिखूँ मैं पाती।
सोहे  ना तनिक कर्णफूल,
श्रृंगार लागे है  जैसे शूल,
मोम से  बँधी हुई एक बाती,
उष्मा से तेरे ही  पिघल जाती,
अंजन मसि से लिखूं  मैं पाती।
हर आहट से  चौंक पडूँ, 
कभी भागूँ  कभी लौट पडूँ,
कुंतल काली मुझे भरमाती,
अठखेलियां इसकी तनिक  न भाती,
आनन को मेरे  है तड़पाती,
अंजन मसि से  लिखूँ मैं  पाती।
∎
जमशेदपुर

उसकी झुर्रियों में उम्र कम और
अनुभव ज़्यादा थे,
उसका यौवन बूढ़ा हो चला था,
जैसे ढहती हुई नई इमारत,
उसने उम्र से ज़्यादा इमारतें बनायीं थीं,
अपने सिर पर ईंट, पत्थर, और रेत उठाये,
कंक्रीट की सभ्यता का बोझ ढोये,
जिसमें है न लरज, न धड़कन,
है ये बस एक बेरूह पैरहन। ∎

हम अल्फ़ाज़ हैं
कभी रोते
कभी हँसते हैं
कभी समझने पे भी नहीं समझ पाते हैं
कभी समझते समझते
भूला दिये जाते हैं

समझाना क्या हैं
कुछ कह नहीं पाते हैं
बोल के रह जाते हैं
बोलने से भी डरते हैं
बोल बोल के थकते हैं
लफ़्ज़ों को कहने से
हम ख़ुद से ही डरते हैं
बोलो ना
मुझे समझो तुम
मेरी असलियत
को देखो तुम
रोको ना मुझे
बोल जाने दो तुम
क्योंकि जब में बोलूँगा
मै समझूँगा
मेरी अंतर आत्मा में
अपने आप को परखूँगा

कि कौन हो तुम
कौन हूँ मैं
इस अजीब पहेली में
ज़िन्दगी को समझूँगा
फिर से जनम लेते हुए
तुम को मैं समझूँगा
पन्नों की स्याही में
नए रंगो में भरते हुए
फिर से तुममें अपनी कहानी
लिखूँगा ।
∎

Look how time has passed
The place where our childhood blossomed
Now remains only in memories.

The siblings who once played here
Have now left their childhood behind
Embracing responsibilities.

The breeze still carries old memories,
The water retains its sweetness
The greenery of the trees
Once filled our lives with colors.

It`s shadows used to
Protect us from sorrow.

With time we too have changed
Some bonds were left beneath this tree
In search of new friends.

∎

Mutual trust and understanding are needed must
To accomplish a joint move fast and just
Letting go to egos cements the  bond of confidence
A big tree is born out of a plant with a mutual fence.

Mutual trust and understanding are a prerequisite
To dive deep into a dream project solid and discreet
Doubts and shouts eat up the essence of a sweet relation
The plinths find not storeys built on it out of exasperation.

Mutual trust and understanding are of prime importance
To bring the teacher and the taught in cordial deliverance
The journey of knowledge transfer finds a contented route
True scholars abound in society as natural offshoots.

Mutual trust and understanding form the base of a conjugal life
To sail through the turbulent ocean happily sans any strife
The sharing and caring of feelings transform the house into a home
The siblings and other members find it as the heaven to recline and roam.

Mutual trust and understanding cannot be bargained
Neither can it be deemanded nor it be forced or strained 
It grows spontaneous and develops out of pure love 


Let`s enjoy its mellifluous scent and feel surrounded by a pleasant hub.
∎

It came and went away
Leaving behind, a land
Barely breathing,
And tired people.
We are a handful of living
In a dead world,
Shuffling about with heavy feet,
And stooping shoulders.
We are tired folks
With wills long dead and gone,
Facing the vast emptiness
Left by death and silence.
For a while, we rejoiced
That death spared us,
But with despair we realize
Death saved us for torment.
We dwell in a dead place,
Barely conversing,
Barely living
Flitting like furtive ghosts
Shuddering to confront
The silence and emptiness.
We would welcome
A change with glad hearts.
We are a few dying souls
In a dead world,
With wills, dead and gone,
Barely living, waiting for the end.

∎

Fellow of Social Science Research Council
Open Association of Research Society
USA

Spring betrayed me multiple times, 
And never showed up. 
So, I waited no longer. 

In a cold, windy, and cloudy winter,
As I couched,
Someone knocked,
A stranger.
I looked out of the peephole,
An apparition shivered and quivered.

She asked for the woodfire, 
Insisted on lighting the stove, and 
Demanded a cup of hot tea. 

Grumpily and grudgingly, 
I let her in, ignited a few pieces of wood, 
Made her sit near the fireplace, and 
Lit the stove to make her a cup of tea. 

As I put the kettle on the stove, 
Unexpectedly, spring bloomed. 

∎

The rustling of the trees
The humming of the bees
The blowing of the conch shells
The tinkling of the bees
The chirping of the birds
The lowing of the herd
The splish splash of the rains
The roaring of the lion
The cheering of the successful
The groaning of the painful
The ripple of the water
The murmuring of the preacher.
∎

There was a time
when passions subsided
like tides do
but soon they returned
but now when they retreat
they never come back.

There was a time
when you were thrilled
to hear the mindless encore
of the claque
but now the hall is empty
and the crow`s feet around
the corners of your eyes
can`t be hidden with
any make up.

A time comes
when your well wishers
ask you about your health
and your children insist on
booking the wheelchair for you
at the airport
when you rock on your recliner
on your balcony
vacantly looking at an empty sky
and feel that the emptiness within
mirrors that outside...

You wonder
what has really changed
what have you lost
along the way
and when you attempt a U turn
even down the memory lane
you get lost
in the meandering maze.

It takes some time
to realise that perhaps
it`s your youth
that has given you the slip
like sands of time
leaking through your
loose grip and
limp fingers.

You try your best
to look in every nook and corner
if you may retrieve it
once again
and someone says
age is just a number-
think young to stay young
but you know
that`s just a cliche
and doesn`t really help.

Then you receive an invite
from your old buddies
your batch mates
from your academy days
for a reunion
a get-together
in a remote island resort
and you gladly accept
and join them there
and as you meet and greet
and hug one another
in the exuberance
of the boisterous laughters
you rediscover and
find what you thought
was lost forever!

∎

Can a lie be like a fickle and capricious
lovely woman with thrills and frills,
or guised as an assertive man attired
in truth`s garb, quiet and lackadaisical.

Divinity, its most benign, convincing
mask, besides giving warm comfort, reassuring presence, available before asking, present before any welcome.

If soothingly warm ash in an oven
can belie a cat burrowing there for warmth, singeing it by the fire under
the ash that as well smokes potatoes.

A curtain of lies can be truer than
the truths in life . A motor mouth, giving away an unpleasant secret, can open
a Pandora`s Box, spilling harmful beans.

Availability of an exuberant and well-endowed woman could be like a lie,
a honey trap, a femme fatale; but could it be her cry for help, her last straw?

The interplay of the truth and lie, putting
on acts, or living the reality, create
a kaleidoscopic world, sweet and sour
of fun and frolic, to live and let live.
∎

Water!
How it washes all dirt!
Without a word.

Leaves the other clean
Fills all the rubbish in its own seams
And leaves.

What motive, what reward does spur
It to clean the world?
There is no recognition, no mirth.

Emerges pure from the womb of snow
And mixes with dirt
But stops not.

It is its nature to flow forward.

∎

The incredible fuel of ink inspires the world,
Writing is an art with inspiring words,

The reader`s eyes not only read them,
But shower their true happiness aplomb,

The heart`s content expressed through powerful verbatim,
Dictionary of thoughts leave their supreme beams,

The fuel of ink is a well dug deep,
The saphire of thoughts glowing with each leap,

The leaps & bounds of happiness radiates mankind,
The fuel of fire does not harm any kind,

The flames of the fire inspires the humanity,
Bards therefore are worshipped since infinity,
∎

In some frames of time I felt that
you did exist, yet I kept that thought
away and wandered through life...

In a mystic moment when I sensed
your essence, I held my beating heart
in my mind and walked through the
dreams.

In one moment you entered into my
world with pages to explore, I stopped
and wondered - will you stay long?

I have met none like you, the one
who builds castles for others and not
in the air but rooted deep in soil...

someone who nurtures magic and sails
through the turmoil of life without hoping
to find any pillars...

You hold each one close to your heart
and sing the songs of manifestation.

Now I found you... or did you find me?

And I watch you with my curious eyes to
know if we are part of the same destiny...

∎

ମାଟିକୁ
ଯାହାକୁ ସେମାନେ ମାଆ କହନ୍ତି

ଓ ସେ ମୂକ ପାଲଟି ଯାଇଥିଲା

ରଙ୍ଗଛଡ଼ା ସପନ କାନ୍ଥରେ
ଚିକ୍‌ମିକ୍‌ ଆଲୁଅ ଚେନାଏ କି
ସରନ୍ତି ପ୍ରଶ୍ଵାସ ପାଇଁ
ଧାପଟିଏ ଜୀବନକୁ ଉଧାର ମାଗିଚ?
କେବେ ଅନ୍ଧାର ଭୋଗିଚ?
ଠିକ୍‌ ଅରଣା ମଇଁଷି ପରି ସେ ଅନ୍ଧାର
ଫୁକିଆ ତାରାର ଛାୟାଚ୍ଛନ୍ନ ପଥଧାରେ
ଗାଢ଼କଳା ବିସ୍ତୀର୍ଣ ଚାଦର
ଅବ୍ୟକ୍ତ ବେଦନାରେ

ସେ କନ୍ଦାଏ ଆତ୍ମାକୁ

ପ୍ରତାରଣାର ହିଂସ୍ର ଚକ୍ରାନ୍ତ ସେ

କୁହ, ଉପେକ୍ଷାର ସେ ରଡ଼ନିଆଁରେ କେବେ ଜଳିଚ?

ପୃଥିବୀର ସବୁ ପିଜୁଳିଠୁ ସେ  ଭାରି ମିଠା
ଲାଜରେ ଖୁବ୍ ଝାଉଁଳିଯାଏ ତୁମ ମୁହଁ

ଯୋଉଦିନ ତୁମ ବାଡିପଟ ଗେଣ୍ଡୁ ବଗିଚା ଉଜୁଡିଥିଲା

କାଞ୍ଜିଆହୁଦାରୁ କାହା ଗାଈଟେ ଫିଟିଯାଇଛି କାଲିଠୁ ,

ଯାହାକୁ ମୁଁ ମାନିନେବି ଭୁଲ୍,

ଶେଷରେ ,ତୁମ ଇତି ଯାଗାରେ ;

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
मेरे इन प्यासी पलकों पर
ख्वाब सुनहरे किसके हैं,
क्या वही है जिनकी खातिर
हम रात रात भर सिसके हैं।

एक क्षण कभी ऐसा न बीता
आये ना जब तुम सुधियों में,
तेरी चाहत कुछ औऱ ही थी
पर हम न थे उन रतियों में।

इस अहमक की परिधि से
तुम तो कोसो ही दूर रहे,
फिर भी इस बिरहन के
तुम ही तो नैनो के नूर रहे।

प्रेम,प्रीत, चाहत अनुरागी
ये चकोर ही बन सकता है,
उसकी बाते वो ही जाने
किसकी क्या विवशता है।

रह गई उस पपीहे की भाँति
पानी के मध्य भी प्यासी,
तृषित उर की प्यास बुझाने
नहीं बनी किसी की दासी।

रख लिया विक्षोभ बहुत,
अब समर्पण भाव रखूंगी।
रुक्मण का अधिकार नहीं,
राधा सा प्रीत लगाव रखूंगी।

तेरे हर इक भाव को साजन
तुझसे पहले जान हूँ लेती,
तेरे हर इक दाव पे छलिया
जीवन अपना वार हूँ देती,
तुमसे जब चलती हैं साँसे
फिर मतभेद क्या है करना?
तुमसे आगे जब देखती न
फिर मनभेद क्या है रखना?

तुम चलो जिस भी डगर पर,
मैं भी अपना पाँव रखूँगी।
जीवन की गहरी तपिश में,
तुमपर अपना छाँव रखूँगी।
∎
(लखनऊ )

घुम आए चारों धाम पर मां - बाप के घर नहीं आए
तरसती आंखे वाट जोहे बच्चों के बच्चें क्यूं नहीं आए।

गर्मियों की छुट्टियां त्योहार जैसा है
ईद, होली, दिवाली के मान जैसा है
दादी-नानी ने बनाएं थे गजक, ठेकुआ
आएंगे बच्चें बिताएंगे साथ में छुट्टियां
नीम-बरगद के नीचे झूला लगाया है
गांव भर के बच्चों का मेला लगाया है
आस जोहती आंखों के वो पल नहीं आए
क्यूं मेरे बच्चों के बच्चें तुम गांव क्यूं नहीं आए

घुम आए चारों धाम पर मां - बाप के घर नहीं आए
तरसती आंखे वाट जोहे बच्चों के बच्चें क्यूं नहीं आए।

आंगन की तुलसी क्यूं अब उदास रहती है
सांझ को देहरी अब उजालों को तरसती है
सास बहु की, बहु सास की शिकायत नहीं करती
पायलों की झन-झन अब पनघटों पर नहीं होती
गांव आने वाले बुरी आत्माएं जो भाप लेते थे
अब चौपालों पर वो दिव्य आंखें नहीं दिखती
बहु, बेटी, बेटा गए जो परदेश, फिर नहीं आए
क्यूं मेरे बच्चों के बच्चें तुम गांव क्यूं नहीं आए

घुम आए चारों धाम पर मां - बाप के घर नहीं आए
तरसती आंखे वाट जोहे बच्चों के बच्चें क्यूं नहीं आए।
∎

भुवनेश्वर

बारिश की नन्ही बूंदें 
जब धरती पर आई
भीनी सी खुशबू जागी
रिमझिम रिमझिम स्वर लहरी
मानो वाज उठी शहनाई।
नवजीवन नव आशाएं
खुशियों ने ली अंगड़ाई।
ज्यों ज्यों सघन  घन छाये
एक मस्ती सी भी छाई
 वर्षा में क्रीड़ा करने
 बच्चों  की टोली आई
मस्तों की टोली मस्ती में
और भी धूम मचाई
बरसा ने वेग बढ़ाया
जो तीव्र झड़ सी लगाई
चपला ने साथ निभाया
हो तीव्र गति  थर्राई 
बह चला पानी नालों में
बच्चों ने टोली बनाई
छोटी-छोटी कागज की नावे
उन नालों में चलाई
ताली दे दे नाचत सब
जब-जब नाव लहराई
फसलों को लग गया पानी
खिल खिल कर मुस्कुराई
खिल गई प्रकृति संपदा
आई वापिस तरूणाई
वर्षा ऋतु सबसे प्यारी
 चहूँ ओर धूम मचाई। ∎

अब गुनाह कर ही लिया
इश्क़ करने का!!
अब तबाही से क्या डरना
सैलाब आये तो क्या डरना
इश्क़ का साहिल हूँ
किनारा तो नज़र आना ही है ।।

तुम्हारे बैगेयर ज़िन्दगी के मैयाने अधूरे हैं।
तुमसे से ही ज़िन्दगी है
तुमसे ही बंदगी है ।।

खुदा की दी ये ज़िंदगी है,
ये कैसी ज़िंदगी है
जहाँ अपने इश्क़ के
बैग़ैर जीना हो
वो कैसा क़िस्सा जहाँ कोई
अफ़साना ना हो।।

वो इश्क़ ही कैसा
जहाँ इबादत ना हो
वो मर्ज़ कैसा
जिससे दवा की ज़रूरत ना हो।।

इतनी इनायत करना ए खुदा
मेरे इश्क़ को मुझे ना होने देना जुदा ।।
इश्क़ ही मेरा खुदा
खुदा ही मेरा इश्क़ ।। ∎

The brewing tempest
Believed it was swelling.
Nothing mattered in its hazy eyes,
It thought it was supreme.
It armed itself with the deafening trumpet ,
To announce its arrival.
The tiny frail frames wore something more resilient.
FAITH...
Even in the face of the mighty opponent.
Came pelting rain,quietened the uproar.
The wild howls of wind didn`t flee,it got seized
In the downpour.

These ancient pillars as remnants of time
Stand mute and gaze at the fallen mankind,
All aware of rising and tumbling men;
They have left many a legend behind,
Written with sorrow and blood and valour.
Bring me those voices lost in mystery
And plaintive songs they carry beneath them,
With fine lyrics older than history.

You are so marvelous
I am speach less to narrate in words
You are full of brain
You are centre of attraction for everyone
That is you only,no else
You are only mother.

Amidst your beauty
You have created
In such a flawless manner
Who ever has taken shelter
With the genius
blessed upon by you
They have set their feet on the moon.

As strong he is and
genius as well
They could be no other than our beloved Bikram and Pragyan
Wandering on the moon
Seeking for water and air
Transmitting message day by day on exploration
With the intellect blessed upon by you.

They have already arrived there
Thus have they up held your name in highest esteem
Oh, mother you are
As infinite as heaven
I am simply numb in my speech
Singing your glory as ever.

∎
Junagarh, Kalahandi
8658740291

Salvation!
Who wants it?

Me?
Certainly not.

Let me live like a Prince
And die like a phoenix
To return to life again
From my own ashes.

And move around the lamp
Like a moth,

And live or vanish
As the lamp burns or dies

In a never-ending cycle
Until the moth and the lamp
Die together
On doomsday.

Till then
Let me come and go and come
And go and come

Like a moth circling around the lamp.
∎

Reel life is soothing 
As it aims to pull crowds 
But it becomes disquieting 
When cleared are the shrouds.

Reel life is entertaining 
As long as it serves as homilies 
But it ceases to be anymore enchanting 
When characters infiltrate in families. 

Reel life is a dream journey 
Fitting with the subconscious self 
But it ends with unlocking of the key
That prioritises own power, position and pelf.

A tussle between the real and the reel 
Is there always in life but often in hibernation 
But everyone is bound to know the difference and to feel 
The moment, he/she is in active conscious session.

∎

Kolkata

Old wisdom runs deep
Like rivers through our bodies
Heart speaks what mind knows

Blood carries stories forward
Through time`s gentle flow

Love flows in our veins
Like songs sung by our parents
Nature keeps its course

What we learn in quiet labs
Hearts knew all along

Joy dances inside
Breaking walls we build so high
Love proves its strength

Each small part tells bigger tales
Of hearts growing close

Minds light up like stars
When we share each other`s joy
Friends grow strong as one

Learning shows us day by day
How hearts learn to dance

Old paths glow like dawn
In minds that remember love
Finding the way back home

Children carry forward now
These heart-written truths

Hearts mix and match well
Like colours in rainbow light
Love flows pure and true

Through eyes that see deep within
Nature shows love`s way

∎

This silence is breaking me a lot.
How can I forget someone
Who was a part of my life, my story and so much more?

Those cheers and closeness
I`m missing them...
Don`t you miss my words?

The poems I wrote with pieces of you
Do they still echo in your heart
or have you muted every memory too?

You once said my voice was your calm
Now it drowns in your quiet
while I search for your shadow in every psalm.

I wasn`t asking for forever...
Just for you to stay a little longer
as the man who once listened.

If radio could speak
If radio could speak ;
It would cry like a child
In someone`s grieve.

If radio could speak;
It would have jumped with a hurray
For that gold medalist .

If radio could speak;
It would have raised its voice
For every injustice.

∎

source_fields.body_html:
सुबह होते ही आपाधापी
थोड़ी देर लग गई क्या आँख
कोसती खुद को हजार बार
हमेशा अव्वल आने की है चेष्टा।

थोड़ी सिलवट रह गई बिस्तर में
झाला थोड़ा सा लग चुका,
चलो पहले बना लो चाय
खुद से ही होती प्रतियोगिता।

हम देते रहते खुद ही परीक्षा
फिर करते आँकलन समीक्षा
खुद का करना है मूल्यांकन
कब हो खुद के जीने की इच्छा।

दूध उबल कर बन गया खोआ
कोई बात नहीं क्या बिगाड़ेगा मुआ,
बन गई सब्जी थोड़ी झाल
क्या करना हो जाये बवाल।

जब से मिल गया मुझे विकल्प
समस्याएं मेरी हो गई अल्प
अब नहीं होती आपाधापी
कब और कैसे काहे की परीक्षा?

परीक्षार्थी परीक्षक समीक्षक,
बनी अब खुद की खुद ही
हो गया जब ये आत्मसात
फिर लोगों की क्या बिसात।

रहतें हैं अब मस्त मलंग
सीख लिए जीने का ढंग।

जमशेदपुर

हम दोनों मिलकर घर बनाया
मेहनती हाथों से सजाया
सपने बुनने लगे हम दोनों
फिर तुम्हें दुनिया में लाया।
जब मां के गर्भ में पल रहा था
नींद मुझे भी नहीं आती थी
गर्भ में लाते हैं मारता था तू
तुम्हारी मां भी मुस्कुराती थी।
जब तुम इस दुनिया में आएं
खुशियों के आंसू छलक पड़े
नन्हे नन्हे उंगलियों को हम
बड़े प्यार से छूने लगे।
बहुत जल्दी तुम बढ़ रहे थे
कपड़े जूते छोटे हो रहे थे
पकड़ कर मेरी उंगलियों को
अपनी कदम तुम बढ़ा रहे थे।
हमारे बीच तुम रहते थे
तुम्हारे लिए ही हम जीते थे
हमसे भी आगे बढ़ जाओ
हम दोनों यही चाहते थे।
एक दिन ऐसा भी आया
हमें पीछे रख कर तुम आगे बढ़े
जाते हुए तुम्हें देख रहे थे
घुट घुट कर आंसू पी रहे थे।
"आऊंगा लौटकर" तुमने कहा था।
जाकर परदेस तू बस गया था
सपनें सजाकर जो घर बना था
धीरे-धीरे सपना टुट रहा था।
सब कुछ था पहले जैसा
बस! हम दोनों ही चुप हो गए
आएगा तू एक दिन लौट कर
अब यहीं सपना देख रहे थे।
∎
जमशेदपुर झारखंड।

बुढ़ापा आ ही नहीं सकता मेरी एक नसीहत याद रखना
सदा बच्चे बने रहोगे तुम अपनी मां की आंखें साथ रखना।

रास्ते खुद-ब-खुद चलेंगे, मंजिलें तेरे पांव के नीचे होंगे
घर से निकलते वक्त मां - बाप की दुआएं साथ रखना।

रात अंधेरी, सघन अंधेरी हो रही है, गम नहीं होने दो
सूरज उगेगा, तुमसे उगेगा, धैर्य का दीया साथ रखना।

सावन है तो हरा-हरा दिखेगा पर पतझडों में ध्यान रखना
एक चेहरे पर कई चेहरे हैं इन चेहरों का तुम ध्यान रखना

खुशहाली में खुश सभी हैं पर तू कुछ चेहरों पर ध्यान रखना
कुछ मुस्कानों के अंदर गम है, ऐसे मन का तुम ध्यान रखना।

क्षणभंगुर सा इस जीवन में, बहुत कुछ मिला, कुछ छुट गया
कुछ मिल कर भी नहीं मिलते ऐसे रिश्तों का तुम ध्यान रखना।

बुढ़ापा आ ही नहीं सकता मेरी एक नसीहत याद रखना
सदा बच्चे बने रहोगे तुम अपनी मां की आंखें साथ रखना।

Can you see the kite flying high?
On Tides of wind it rides
Everyone holds a different spool
Our journey`s thread unfolds, in hues of life.
Yet, to judge another`s path, we must refrain,
For each soul`s voyage is theirs to explain.
Their joys, their pains, their struggles unseen,
From birth to death, our paths entwine,
Yet, they vary, like the stars that shine.
In another`s world, we have no right, To cast our shadows, day or night,
Their stories unfold, in their own time, A lesson learned, a heart`s chime.
Respect the boundaries, far and wide, Let love and kindness be our guide,
We often form opinions about people based on superficial interactions, Unaware of the battles they may be fighting behind closed doors,
We fail to recognize that everyone has a story, a struggle, and a secret.
We assume that the person who always wears a smile is living a perfect life,
In reality, they might be hiding tears of sorrow.
We assume that the person who is always late is irresponsible,
But in reality, they might be dealing with a family crisis.
We judge people based on their appearance, their job,
Their social status,the material possessions they hold
We form opinions about them without giving a thought
To what they might be going through a lot.
We forget that everyone has a different journey, a different story to tell.
We forget that everyone wears a mask to hide their true emotions,
Their true struggles, and their true fears.
Let`s not be judgemental ,give them space.
Who are we to decide their fate?
©️Leena Thampi

A mulish life I lead
Unlike most homosapiens
Don`t conform to laid down norms
Nor any kind of rule or regulation

Some adduce this to madness
Some label me as funny
For I break rules so often
Without an iota of contrition or guilt feeling

Getting up early is not my kind of thing
I laze around with eyes half opened
Don`t leave bed, till my
Slumber quota is met with

On some days I have a tete e tete
With a resplendent dawn
Decorate morn with chirps and twitters
But those are very few, I genuinely reckon

On some days the sprightly sun
Stings me like scorpion
But I don`t change my pace a bit even
Continue with my lazy disposition

My food habits are unique for that matter
I gulp down morsels
Only when I receive pangs of hunger
I detest following time table for lunch and dinner

I may be indisciplined to the core
But there is a method to my madness
This much I am convinced about my character
Shall adhere to offbeat track till the last breath of my sojourn.

Beneath the wide smile ,

Behind the loud laughter,

Below the fine velvety textures of the words ,

Besides the vibrant demeanor

Of your statue .

I can see dried eyes ,icy aura, fractured words and still heart.

Masquerading as an elixir ,as a breezy song, with honeyed grace.

Were you trying to stitch,mend and repair with your efforts,
Only to exhaust you,
Weigh you down,
Without an iota of reciprocation.

Maybe your silence could have resounded more louder .

And then you could have signed off
effortlessly.

Today a new tractor is itching
at the western corner
of this two acre land,
the property of Lord Lingaraj
will no more be ploughed by hand.

I will serve no job
it seems
amidst the roaring march at work
and the gigantic silhouette at night
of the machine watch-man.

I mimicked from my painted clay face
waving my straw hands,
maybe my lame feet offended the padded paw,
it crawled back and crushed
my degradable presence.

Lord Lingaraj save!
You have designed my fate
to scare away birds,
at least now send your bull to eat me all
except the skull.

valley emptied,
except
for dying echoes
in the chambers
of a palpitating heart

I lie down
on sorrow`s floor
and let it slip through
the sticky surface—
that you are no longer here

all bare except what
was placed there to stay:
celestial blue, the green carpet soft,
and your voice
clinging to windblown silence

Things here, there, or at high or nigh
They may lie scattered as you pass by
Never be tempted, even if they lure
As per your karma, your reward`s sure
The clouds `ll vanish and the sky `ll be clear
The sun `ll shine and bring a good weather
Your ways be well-lit, and destination be clear
Time `ll heal your wounds and bring you cheer
Never wait for the other shoe to drop for you
Rather run with the one, the proverbial shoe
And try your luck and knock every door
You `ll get your princess lying on the floor
The Cindrella of your life, always a prized treasure
So faithfully live with her in every possible measure.
∎
Odisha, India.

global warming alarm
boiling seas cry aloud
thick clouds celebrate
violent applause
with lightning and thunder
heavy rain day and night
plants and trees dance
birds chirp fly flutter
thirsty lands quench
rich celebrate monsoon
sleepless nights for poor
on sloppy hills
and angry beaches.
∎

Sometimes, it means I write.
Sometimes, it means I think.
Sometimes, it means I put a lot of thought
Into everything I think.
I do a lot
But sometimes, it doesn`t show
I do nothing
And then it shows too much
As a writer,
I want to balance how much I show
With how much I do not
So, that`s show and tell
Which you learn over time
And sometimes it doesn`t come out well
But that`s okay, too
A writer`s biggest challenge
Is to remember
Whether it shows or not
`Tells` or not
It is not about the writer`s worth.

Every loss is fine if time`s long enough
To match its gain in coming years;
Every loss is fine if the path once rough
Finds its own smooth course amid fears.
Every loss is fine if its sorrow sparks
A change unattainable otherwise;
Every loss is fine if its indelible marks
Prove to be blessings in disguise.
Every loss is fine if it hasn`t a goal,
But still humbles the human soul.

Abandoned homes are always finished
Dust returning to dust
Jambs with missing hinges witness the fall of fallen things
Words get stuck in telephone coils
sighs pass through borders.
Trespassers.

Hard, plastic monkeys get crushed
They don`t beat their drums
Teddy bear arms live without their bodies or their owners
Tears debris blood debris charred bones debris
A set of false teeth debris
homes debris
homelands debris.

She folded a letter to the sky
and called it spring,
a paper boat of wishes
sailing through blue.

In it, she wrote of
gulmohar lanes,
jasmine breaths,
and the lavender hues,
once lost in the wind.

She pressed petals between lines,
each word tinted with tulip blush,
each comma a falling leaf of apricot.

And then,
a hummingbird carried a full stop
in its beak
and dropped it on her windowsill.

The sky read slowly,
turning pages
with breeze-fingers,
raining down pauses and pollen.

That night,
the moon blinked twice
as if it knew the reply
was dew-dropping beneath cloud-veils.

By morning,
her garden had grown
a new language,
one only butterflies could read.

And so, every spring,
she writes to the sky,
knowing even letters wear flowers.

What if the sun has drunken all the waters of the earth!
What if in the darkest cloak
is the entire sky enveloped!
What if has gone to sleep
the whole family of the birds!
What if not anymore do any playful fawns jump!
What if the time has stopped to spin
tales of beautiful plans!
What if the youth is forced to live
sans a devoted glance!
What if the world has grown too old
to hold a mirthful babe,
What if appears it does impossible
to joys of life save!
Am I supposed to be dependent on merely their grace?
That would be a disgrace!
Let the world forget to smile
Let the providence be so vile
I shall have my fill, anyway!
What if it does have to be
in the sparsely scattered wild array
of vague expressions and foray
into the vaster, universal ray
of loving the self and
drinking from the falling drops of rain!
The beauty of my heart
I surely must sustain.

I arrived late,
or he came much earlier ?
How does it matters, where we land?


What if no Tulips left for us in flowerbeds
or in contour,
to cherish at this time of summer?

He made me standing
under a Southern Mangolia tree
with my wings widened,
these flowers are out of my humane reach and regrets,
he leaned shadowing me
wooing at a secret corner
like sunrays kissing a fluttering butterfly,
Floral avenue paved
arms in arms leading to heaven.

The most precious sight he laid - vulnerable part of his heart,
the floral songs-botany of love he inks
in different dialects vegan pagan lyrics reprised,
crafted with care
the surkh chinar curved motifs on me, all over
tangling my veins
veiled my vision with vanity,
since then
I don`t find myself anywhere!

source_fields.captured_title: मैं एक वृत्ताकार सी तिलिस्म परिधि में
source_fields.body_html:
यूँ ही सम्मोहित सी चलती हूँ
वही शून्य जिस पर बारंबार
निस्तेज सी आ गिरती हूँ
हाँ,वही वो प्रथम बिन्दु है
जिस पर से शायद एक
यात्रा का श्रीगणेश करती हूँ
पर हा! ये अबूझा मन!
हर बार ही घूम घाम कर
उस गुब्बारे से पारदर्शी जाल में
ठोकर खा ,
पुनःआरंभ से
प्रारंभ करती हूँ
ये चक्राकार से मौसमी परिवेश
वही रात,
वही शाम,
वही फागुनी खेल,
पर, एक सूक्ष्म सा अबोला मन....
दूर खड़ा सब तकता है।
बस मूकदर्शक सा....
कभी कभी कुछ इशारे भी करता है,
जिसे देखकर और समझ कर भी,
बस नज़रंदाज़ ही करती हूँ।
फिर और फिर `मैं`
वही अर्थहीन क्रिया करती हूँ,
पुनः ,उसकी प्रतिक्रिया भी सहती हूँ
हा, मै व्यर्थ ही तो चलती हूँ!!
उस शून्य से चलकर
फिर उसी शून्य पर भटकती हूँ।
हाय, मैं बस एक बोझ लिए
सदियों से चलती हूँ!!

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
गुनगुनाती दुपहरी ढ़ल चुकी,
आ गयी सर्द सघन यामिनी।
मृण्मयी नैनों में इंतजार लिए,
प्रतीक्षारत विकल कामिनी।
काले कुंतल अब हँ स रहे,
आनन को ये तो डस रहे।
नागिन सी इसकी है लटें,
बेवजह ही ये तो उलझ रहे।
आ जाओ कि बिरहन तके,
सुने निलय में सेज सजे.
इंतजार है पर उर सस्मित,
हर आहट पर होती चकित।
वेणी के गजरे महक रहे,
मिलने को अलि से चहक रहे।
गजरे से पराग मधुप पिए,
खड़ी हूँ अंजुरी भर धूप लिए।
शलभ गजरे की ओट खड़े,
पीने को रस वो हैं अड़े।
वेणी से पुष्प बिखर गयी,
काया कंचन हो निखर गयी।

जमशेदपुर

मैं नव चेतना, नव सृजन लिए, मैं ओड़िशा हूं
मैं सनातन का अंतिम ध्येय, मैं पुरी धाम हूं।

मैं उत्कल की माटी, मैं कलिंग का विस्तार हूँ
मैं कोणार्क, मैं लिंगराज, मैं स्वंभू श्रीहरि हूँ।

मैं राजा ओड की अभिलाषा, मैं भागीरथ वंश का पोषक हूँ
मैं ललितगिरि, मैं रत्नागिरि, मैं खण्डगिरि, मैं उदयगिरि हूँ।

पूर्व में बंगाल की खाड़ी, पश्चिम में है नीली पहाड़ियाँ
चारों तरफ है फैला यहाँ सुंदर धान की बाली हूँ।

सभ्यता संस्कृति जीवंत है यहाँ के स्थापत्य कला में
विज्ञान का अद्भूत विरासत लिए कोणार्क का मंदीर हूँ।

युद्ध नहीं विकल्प किसी का कहता यह उत्कल की माटी
धौली है परिवर्तन का साक्षी, बुद्धम शरणम् गच्छामि हूँ।

विश्व प्रशिद्ध है रघुराजपुर का क्राफ्ट और संबलपुर की साड़ी है
गुणकारी क्षेना पोडा, दाल्मा, पखाल और रसवंती रसगुल्ला हूँ।

महानदी केवल नीर नहीं है यह ममता का आकार है
बैतरणी के बूंद-बूंद में संजोए जननी जैसा प्यार हूँ।

यह धरती है फकीर मोहन एवं उत्कल गौरव मधुसुदन की गाथा का
माटी देवत्व और परमार्थ का रूप लिए, उपेन्द्र भांजा की कर्मभूमि हूँ।

मैं नव चेतना, नव सृजन लिए, मैं ओड़िशा हूँ
मैं सनातन का अंतिम ध्येय, मैं पुरी धाम हूँ।

On our way home from the Cloverdale Recreation Centre we
pass a ditch that`s about a block long.
I quite often see at least five large green plastic garbage bags
lying on the side of the ditch.
Does anyone check to see what`s in them?
Garbage?
Cut up body parts?
Weapons?
Dead animals?
Who throws them there? Do people just get out of their cars,
open up their trunks and toss them out?
I also see lots of plastic bottles, tin drink cans and vegetable cans.
Paper cups and plates, cardboard boxes of all shapes and sizes.

The ditch is covered in green slime
No animal would be caught dead swimming in its water

It`s an eyesore!

While searching for the peace
A body stitched with plastic rupees
The aim of life is robbed
Unfathomable moment of joy dropped
An art of living dare to stink
A fasting soul started to drink
A cup of cold blood as honey
All the rituals and rites sold with money

While searching for peace in alcoholism
A couple of toxicants atoned metabolism
A folk flag swims in poison
The fertility of the mind is in the process of erosion
Nothing is in time and ritual
For the adoration of a grave that has no transparent visual

While searching for the peace in religion
A holy temple imbued
A saint of the church seduced
A tranquil idol of Buddha reduced
A shrine of a mosque fused
When the light of men wipe-out
By the memory of the little many-frame brain
The fresh volume of memoir is in the gap of salvation
A howl of rage and love are in dreary oblivion

While searching for the peace in ritual
The delightful blessing of God missed by the priest
Who rode on nuns like the beast
Mokshya is climbing up Sinner Hill
Sins of gutter tempted oneself to kill
While searching for the peace through luxury
His rotted body arrived at the palace
Whose empathy and sympathy prolonged in somebody`s shoe lace
And his soul hurling to swing through ripped heart
Whose roots lie no longer but apart

While searching for the peace in humanity
A man is a cannibal
His descendants are animal
God be serf
Serf is god`s dwarf
While searching for peace through good relation
Father has kissed daughter`s breast
A servant puts stink maiden in his hit least
Whiz kids sing and laugh with opium fete
And cheers as urging men to live or die as their wish before departing from heaven`s gate

While searching for the peace in science
Moon crumbled for future shelter
Universe captured as for theatre of robotic act
The sea will have a jug of filthy water
For bathing mask-and costume robot

While searching for peace in emotion
Many intimacies burn with a heap of anger
Loads of desires provoke to lead with a single finger
Usual theory and principles drag to link with murder
And a half-size brain fools billions with its seductive order

While searching for the peace in beauty
A half span of life swings behind the curtain
Half-life line is limping for birth`s pertinent
A string of peace jingles within a wink of the eye
Obscurity of life foams through the auction of cry.

ସବୁ ଦୁଃଖ କ`ଣ ବଣ୍ଟାଯାଏ?
କିଛି କ୍ଷତ ହୋଇ ରହୁ,
ସେଇ କ୍ଷତର ରୁଗ୍ ରୁଗ୍ ଦରଜ ବି
ହୃଦସ୍ପନ୍ଦନ ପରି ବତେଇଦିଏ
ଅବଶ ଶରୀରରେ ପ୍ରାଣର ଅବସ୍ଥାନ।

ନିଶ୍ଵାସ ପ୍ରଶ୍ଵାସର ଚଳପ୍ରଚଳରେ
ଛିଣ୍ଡିଯାଏନି ଜୀବନ,
କଡା ମାନସାଙ୍କର ଅଛିଡା ଅଙ୍କରେ
ଅଙ୍କାବଙ୍କା ନଈ ପରି ଧାରାରେ
ମିଳିଯାଏ ସମାଧାନର ଜୀବନସୂତ୍ର।

ଏଇ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ଏମିତି ରହୁ,
ମୁହଁ ମୋଡି, ବାଟ କାଟି ଯିବାର
ଅବସରଟିଏ ନ ମିଳୁ
ଜଳି ଜଳି ଶକ୍ତ ହେବାର ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାରେ
ପୀଡାପର୍ବର ଏଇ ଯାତ୍ରା ଜାରି ରହୁ।

शाल, कंबल, स्वेटर कहीं दुबक गये
कुहासों का धुंधली चादर ओढ़ कर
जाने कहां ठिठुरती सर्दी चली गई।
मौसम में नया रंग घुलने लगा-----

देखो देखो नव रंग लिए
बसंत द्वार खटखटाने लगा।

जो तरुवर बिन पात का
अपनी तन छुपाए खड़ा था
पहन हरियाली की चादर
खुशी से कैसे मुस्कुराने लगा।

देखो देखो नवरंग लिए
बसंत द्वार खटखटाने लगा।

कोयली कुहू कुहू तान छेड़ने लगी
अपनी प्रेयसी के लिए तड़पने लगी
भंवरा गुनगुना रहा वन उपवन में
पलाश बन जंगल में खिलाने लगा----

देखो देखो नवरंग लिए
बसंत द्वार खटखटाने लगा।

पीली सरसों का खेत झुमने लगी
मंद मंद पुरवइया बहने लगी
महुआ फूलों के गंध से हर कोई
प्यार का नशे में बोराने लगा-----

देखो देखो नवरंग लिए
वसंत द्वार खटखटाने लगा।

सूरज भी मीठी धूप देने लगा
शाम भी सुहानी लगने लगी
प्रियतम का प्रीत पाने के लिए
हर प्रेमी तरसने लगा----

देखो देखो नव रंग लिए
बसंत द्वार खटखटाने लगा।

शीत लहरी जाने कहां चली गई
अब बसंती हवा बहने लगी
राधा संग होली खेले कन्हाई
वृंदावन की गलियों में फाग उड़ने लगा----

देखो देखो नव रंग लिए
बसंत द्वार खटखटाने लगा।

लाल पीला हरा नीला रंग फागुन का
फगुआ में रंग उड़े प्रेम प्रीत का
ढोल मंजीरा झांझ बजने लगा
होली में हिय सतरंगी होने लगा-----

देखो देखो नवरंग लेकर
बसंत द्वार खटखटाने लगा।

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
चारुलता चञ्चल चितवन
कजरारे से कमल नयन
काले केश घुँघराले
रमणी धारती पित वसन।

किंकिनी बजती छन छनन
इठलाती चले नूपुर पहन
हो जाते सब मतवारे
कटि पर बलखाते करघन।

अधर दहकते से गूलर
पवन उड़ाते हैं चूनर
मदमस्त हो जाते सभी
जीना हो सबका दूभर।

सुनयना पर सब फिसल गये,
देख कामिनी मचल गये
वो बिलकुल भोली भाली
वो बिलकुल अल्हड़ निश्चल।

Let this world collapse
Rocks may remain,
Cries may congregate ,
Quake may arise,
To blow up and to grow up again,
Let another Ocean originate .
Let this world collapse
Endless sorrow here,
Must have ended,
Broken into pieces,
Must have spread in space again,
Let another vacancy originate.
Useless all without you
Earth, Heaven and Life ,
I care none ,I desire none
Cheer, luxury , future ,
Maybe you may come back again
As a comet, who knows?

A Poet has no land
No borders
No barriers
Of nationality
Caste creed
And colour.
He knows
Blood is red
No matter
What you are.
Love is life
Life`s love
For him
Always.
Love blooms
Like flowers
All the seasons
Say it spring
Autumn
Or winter
Life`s beautiful
Each moment.
He wages war
Against all those
Involved in
Bloodshed
Genocide
Crime against man.
He`s the ambassador
Of peace
And humanity
Love and compassion
Beyond the borders
Dividing the globe.

Sometimes I freeze,
Turned into stone,
Cast into darkness.
On the breath,
Someone has thrown glass shells.

We call it injury—
It is liberation for blood,
Sinking into soil
From the prison of the body,
An unstoppable festival.

The freezing of time is like
The loss of motion in me.
Words fly from the lips,
Graves of memories on the heart,
Followed by a rope of tears.

To move the body,
Well of tears should be dug
By cracking eyes.
Put fire on the tongue
And burn the words;
To the blood, I have to teach the feelings—
A weapon that liquefies anyone:
Fire.

When you see sculpture,
Rain stops.
It was an involuntary act
That my body melted
Into rainwater.

It doesn`t matter though,
You,
Who are the cause of motion in me—
Tearful greetings.

I saw five today
Sitting atop lamp posts
Waiting to swoop down and grab their prey
Be they moles, mice, rats, snakes, squirrels and even songbirds
A tasty morsel for lunch

Hawks are revered for their keen sense of sight and ability to
fly at great heights
Seeing a hawk denotes guardianship and power
They are known as the protectors and messengers of the air

Hawks display aggression by holding their body level to the ground
Drooping their wings
Raising the feathers on their heads, neck and back
They are agile flyers, that when hunting, may also take to the
ground, running and hopping to seize their prey

I also saw fifteen or twenty ducks enjoying a grassy lunch
on a farmer`s field
Having a gab session with their playmates
And the same lone duck I see every week was going for a swim
in very shallow water

They are all magnificent creatures in their own unique way
Created by the Master of the Universe!

They say water symbolizes the flow of life,
But for me, this form of water symbolizes my dream;
Like this waterfall my dream will keep flowing in my veins,
I won`t stop until the day comes that I achieve my dream.

Even if it is far and difficult to reach,
I will do everything to succeed;
I know the journey will not be easy,
Many hurdles and barriers along the way.

The path is rocky and steep,
Lots of grass and wild animals around;
But no matter how dangerous the sorroundings,
And I may fall or stumble many times,
I will repeatedly get up and stand.

Again and again, I will continue to climb until I reach the top.
Whether sweaty and tired,
I will watch with a smile in the beautiful atmosphere,
As I savor the sweetness of success.

source_fields.captured_title: इरादे बुलंद कर लेती तो अच्छा था
source_fields.body_html:
चुपचाप से सहना, दर्द को पाल कर रखना
घर भर की उम्मीदों को आंचल में बांध कर रखना
खामोश लब है पर चल रहा अन्तर्मन में द्वंद
खुद ही खुद से लड़ते रहते हो रोज नई जंग
तू सहना छोड़, कहने का इरादा कर लेती तो अच्छा था
तू अपने इरादे बुलंद कर लेती तो अच्छा था।

तेरे आंखों में आंसूं है ये सब जानते है पर
जल रहे सीने में शोले, ये सब जानते है पर
अरे पगली....................….....अरे पगली
कोई आयेगा बुझाने को, किस उम्मीद में है तू
तू इन शोलों में अपने गम जला लेती तो अच्छा था
तू अपने इरादे बुलंद कर लेती तो अच्छा था।

जूल्मों के बोझ को कब तलक सर पर उठायेगी
अपने आंखों को कब तलक दरिया बनायेगी
काश...….काश...................काश तू एकबार
इन आंखों का तेवर दिखा देती तो अच्छा था
तू अपने इरादे बुलंद कर लेती तो अच्छा था।

ये फीका रंग, सूखे होंठ, चेहरे पर ये उदासी
तू अपनी एक नई सूरत बना लेती तो अच्छा था
तेरा जीवन मुझे उजड़ा हुआ एक चमन लगता है
तू अपनी जीवन में रंग-बिरंगी झालरे लगा लेती तो अच्छा था
तू अपने इरादे बुलंद कर लेती तो अच्छा था।

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
वासंती ने प्रीत सिखाया
उफ्फ फागुन द्वारे पर आया।
बिखरे बिखरे से है पलाश
आम्र मंजर भी बौराया ।

उफ्फ फागुन द्वारे पर आया या।

रमणी मुख पर सोहे अञ्जन
फागुन से तन मन अतिरञ्जन,
रंग दिया था तुमने कैसे
सोच-सोच कर सिहरी काया।

उफ्फ फागुन द्वारे पर आया।

गुजरा वह क्षण याद मदन क्या,
कितना करते थे मनुहार।
सकुचाती शर्माती सी मैं
दिल अपना तो गई थी हार।
नैनो से कर नेह की बारिश
मीत ने प्रीत से था नहलाया।

उफ्फ फागुन द्वारे पर आया।
उफ्फ्फ फागुन द्वारे पर आया

कल तक हम समझते थे,
मुट्ठी में हैं हमारी दुनिया।
कौन हूँ मैं और कौन तू!
यह वक्त ने समझा दिया।

न फ़कीर मैं न तू कोई बादशाह,
एक हाथ की बस उँगलियाँ।
वक्त के हाथों की हम सब,
नाचती हुई कठपुतलियाँ!

आज हैं यहाँ,शायद कल नहीं होंगे।
जगमगाते हुए नए चेहरे सजे होंगे।

यह चक्र है चलता हुआ,
एक जगह नहीं टिक पाएगा।
किसी दूसरे की ताल पर,
थिरकता हुआ रह जाएगा।

साथ चलकर कुछ कदम,
बढ़ जाएँगी ये दूरियाँ।
वक्त के हाथों की हम सब,
नाचती हुई कठपुतलियाँ!

नाम मिट जाने से पहले,
अपनी छाप कोई छोड़ जा।
अहं के पिंजरे के सारे,
बंधनों को तोड़ जा।

मौसमी फूलों पर, मँडरातीं हुई तितलियाँ।
वजूद तेरा जब तलक,खिंचतीं रहेंगी डोरियाँ।

कर्म बस रह जाएगा,
मिट जाएँगी सब हस्तियाँ।
वक्त के हाथों की सब,
नाचती हुई कठपुतलियाँ!

Molten hell seethes within me
Still, it fails
To spill out of
A wrenched heart.

My own disabled arms
Seek to preserve in vain
Wilting bubbles
Of my lost self

Unhomed ever since
It has chosen a wrong place.

In twilight`s hush, where shadows dance
Eve`s eyelids grow heavy, her soul`s ember
flickers, dwindles, as sloth`s sweet whisper
lures her to surrender, to let go

The garden`s vibrancy, its colors, scents
fade into the background, as Eve`s senses
numb, her heart rate slows, her breathing deepens
In this languid state, she`s vulnerable, open

To Satan`s subtle suggestions, his whispered lies
that effort`s unnecessary, that rest`s the ultimate prize
Eve`s mind, once sharp, now clouds, her thoughts disjointed
as sloth`s dark magic weaves its spell, unrelenting

In this torpor, Eve forgets her purpose, her role
as guardian, caretaker, of the garden`s soul
Her connection to Adam, to the natural world
frays, unravels, as sloth`s insidious grip unfurls

Let me know what you think! I`ve tried to capture the essence of sloth as it corrupts Eve`s soul.

Next, I can help with Eve`s greed and lust, or Adam`s gluttony. Just let me know!

source_fields.captured_author: Ashok Kumar Singh/ ଡ଼ଃ ଅଶୋକ କୁମାର ସିଂହ
source_fields.body_html:
Waited whole day for you
My guest!
I dosed off while waiting
In dream came my God
Also my prayers
In dream came my demon
My drowning in mud

I spread the grains
Beyond the window pane
The parrots flew away into the sky
They may come someday
Hounouring my invitation
When they trust me
And I am not in their harm`s way

Look I have kept the
Whole house lighted
My guest !
When the darkness is engulfing the street,
The distant bushes, and river front
I may jump into that darkness
To answer the bell when you come

Look at the pride I had
Inviting you, waiting to receive
The prides of hard stonewall cracked
With the tender touch of this
Indolent creeper to creep into the room
Despite her showing the way
Still you did not come

What will change
If you do not come
I will be in the room
Keep it lighted. But may forget,
that I had invited you
I may open the door
And from light, venture into darkness.

You sat beside me,
The moon slipping mercury
Upon your naked breasts.
Such a moon, such shining,
That I ain`t seen before.
That was my first time.
You were dense.
We talked not of battlefields
Left to conquer.
The tapioca green was wild around us.
We just held hands.
It was then,
That you suddenly took me whole.
Just a few feet away from us
Was Krishna,
With all those flower pots around him
Bursting to bloom.
I remember,
With these hands
I had Him painted all silver.
Fluteless, Radhaless, he kept watching us
As we turned the night
into Vrindavan.

Abandoned by big cruel world cold
bewildered orphans of wars unfold
soundless shrieks tearlessly mourn
yearning mom who with hope is gone

Know not they`re a number statistically
150 plus Million orphaned globally
18 Million have lost both parents, family
homes are razed rubble, shaken is stability


Tiny collaterals in war, disaster, poverty
unprotected children mired in unpredictability
under threat of abuse, trafficking travesty
lack basic food, clothing, warmth, security

Greed unchecked has broken bounds
sidelining peaceful existence sound
for geo-economic power grab unsound
shattering neighbourly love on ground

Mute, wide eyed babies beseech
for bullies to create & keep peace
for Kindness, compassion to unleash
for freedom birth-right to forever freeze

The street sings a requiem
for departed soldiers;
a little cormorant dives
into the lake,
swims subaquatically,
and discovers a kingdom of golden dream.
The street is a forest
where past and present meet in secrecy.

2.

It rains in the city,
the soul flies past
skyscrapers and song,
the prophets dwell
in my heart—
the shepherd walks
with enchanted sheep.
The rag-picker tardily lifts the clouds
at the concert of sand.

3.

The lamp creates silhouettes of leaves
on the glass,
it is peaceful;
blue horses
weave into the velvet piano night.

4.

The ballerina of dawn
speaks to a gazelle.

Inside my ears,
a waterfall breathes.

Afar, flowers bloom
in a field of wounds.

5.

In the house
covered with moss,
past and present meet again,
I write to you letters
on a nectarous afternoon
and gather the flotsam
that we could not forget.
Your name has a limpid sound
that I could not forget.

6.

He has lost
his crampons
and now unsteadily
climbs;
in the mesh of his dreams,
even the snow
is encrusted with fire.

While searching for the peace
A body stitched with plastic rupees
The aim of life is robbed
Unfathomable moment of joy dropped
An art of living dare to stink
A fasting soul started to drink
A cup of cold blood as honey
All the rituals and rites sold with money

While searching for peace in alcoholism
A couple of toxicants atoned metabolism
A folk flag swims in poison
The fertility of the mind is in the process of erosion
Nothing is in time and ritual
For the adoration of a grave that has no transparent visual

While searching for the peace in religion
A holy temple imbued
A saint of the church seduced
A tranquil idol of Buddha reduced
A shrine of a mosque fused
When the light of men wipe-out
By the memory of the little many-frame brain
The fresh volume of memoir is in the gap of salvation
A howl of rage and love are in dreary oblivion

While searching for the peace in ritual
The delightful blessing of God missed by the priest
Who rode on nuns like the beast
Mokshya is climbing up Sinner Hill
Sins of gutter tempted oneself to kill
While searching for the peace through luxury
His rotted body arrived at the palace
Whose empathy and sympathy prolonged in somebody`s shoe lace
And his soul hurling to swing through ripped heart
Whose roots lie no longer but apart

While searching for the peace in humanity
A man is a cannibal
His descendants are animal
God be serf
Serf is god`s dwarf
While searching for peace through good relation
Father has kissed daughter`s breast
A servant puts stink maiden in his hit least
Whiz kids sing and laugh with opium fete
And cheers as urging men to live or die as their wish before departing from heaven`s gate

While searching for the peace in science
Moon crumbled for future shelter
Universe captured as for theatre of robotic act
The sea will have a jug of filthy water
For bathing mask-and costume robot

While searching for peace in emotion
Many intimacies burn with a heap of anger
Loads of desires provoke to lead with a single finger
Usual theory and principles drag to link with murder
And a half-size brain fools billions with its seductive order

While searching for the peace in beauty
A half span of life swings behind the curtain
Half-life line is limping for birth`s pertinent
A string of peace jingles within a wink of the eye
Obscurity of life foams through the auction of cry.



An untold tale of street

She was left as an orphan
And remained as abandoned trash in the nook of the street
Who was unaware of her father
Nor she had seen the face of her mother
She didn`t know where was her abode
And from where she came to nearby an oak tree

As days passed, often fighting with astra dogs for a living
Sometimes, being playful with gnats and frogs
under the shade of a tree
She rejoiced her loneliness within crowded faces

One day, when her tender hands were being taken
The tree`s leaves flutter to seek her for seasons
The dogs get mourned for days
Birds forgot to sing from the branch of the old tree
None have seen where she is been
After years, the same street named `Red Light Street
Where like her, many nestlings are being caged!!

source_fields.captured_title: A haiku sequence: five individual haiku
source_fields.body_html:
sprouts just up
the curvature
of rainwater

distant thunder . . .
long leaves curl in
on themselves

sunlit kernels
pour into the wagon
sky ablaze

some of the harvest
spilled at the STOP sign
a clutter of starlings

rising sun
new snow between rows
of stubble

•

five haiku or senryu:

a grandson`s drawing
now I can speak
firefly

•

ballet dancers
crowd a backstage doorway
snowflakes

•

a bruised pear
returned to Mother`s basket
day of atonement

•

catching up
with the two-year-old
grandpa`s day bed

•

knee high corn
a sparrow out of its nest
too soon

Phalguni`s slingshot broke,
the charcoal block she aimed
fell at her feet, and split
and made their own places
to rest on bed of mango-flowers
that spread last night.

Last night`s drizzle was slight,
it brought down all ripe things,
mango leaves,
Spanish-cherry leaves,
it came in her dreams
like Aladdin`s carpet
from “Arabian Nights.”

Arabian nights, no more though
comfort or calm, mostly play blood
these decades for Holi
and Phalguni`s rangoli;
wait, this yellow leaf be her drape
hiding her longing,
the separation, the pining,
her tears of grieving.

Tears of grieving
are the mango-flowers of March,
the aborted births,
the gone-fruits of truth
worshipped as dead,
in vermilion red;
the split charcoal block,
pearled tears on her chest,
this Indian season`s mid-March gift.
[According to the Hindu calendar, today, the 13th of February, marks the beginning of the month "Phalguna"… ]

O Sculptor!

On a mild winter night
A copper coloured moon like your shade
Bathing in the sea.
I pluck the wet rainbow
In a handful water,
He who turns into a white swan
With the touch of my finger.
Feet, wings, neck, eyes
Everything is alike yours!

He then splashes the handful of water again
Towards the mirror facing the sky
The mirror returns a red fish.
Palms, navel, chest, lips
as soft as I
An elegant - Red fish.

The white swan looks with flashing eyes,
Between seeing and not seeing
In the waves of body and folded expansion of the mind
And the red fish floats on the edge of the mirror.

As if a saree is spread all along the ground
The earth is wrapped in vines, branches and leaves
flowers, pollen, twigs
Stalks, petals, hives
The carefully inscribed intricate landscape.
Entire sky is bowing down
lying on the lap,
Red fish blushes in the mirror.
Dark shades of white swan
Moves away from itself.
Where is the shade?
Lies, lies... lies
A mirror always lies.

O Sculptor...

The picture of the crafted chest
Washed away the shyness from the sublime red fish
Red fish Faintly smiles are like silver coins
in the tail
The drunken sea yawns.

The tidal moonlit night is dancing
in the eyes of the white swan,
On the layered water bed
Quietly sleeping the fascinating - Maunavati.
The ocean melts inside the mirror,
The red fish backstrokes in the sea.
The white swan kisses the mirror
Mirror in passion
Who never has a body of its own.

O Sculptor!

Winter is coming to an end.
The red fish is returning into the aquarium
The sea is silent with all its tears
The white swan cannot see the perimeter of the aquarium
Aquatic plants of a millennium are in his eyes!

My life sails
Pass by, the days, months and years
Who keeps their records?

These are my treasure
I give them away with no bounds
Take it
As much as you wish
But leave
Only a day for me.

This day
I shall leave aside
All fears and doubts
And devote it only to myself.

This day
I will give to myself
the sweetness of love
tenderness of affection
And I will open before myself
All words spelt-unspelt.

This day
I will collect
the pollen from flowers
colors from butterfly wings
to adorn my face
and beautify my being.

This day
I will decorate myself
With my songs and poems
And from the cuckoo
I will learn my language.

I will ask the clouds
To lend its black
For my eyes` decor
I will ask the rain
to wash me pure.

I will ask the sky
to lend its vastness
and ask the ocean
to give its depth
for my poems.

This day
I will be only me
With not an iota of
apprehension or pretension
and my heart be blessed with
heavenly illumination

This day will be my day
May it be my last night
or the last day.

The body, deserted at the dead of night,
on a quiet street of the town,
was noticed by an early morning walker,
he thought he knew the person,
he looked uncannily familiar.
It was probably a prominent leader,
who fought for the poor and the deprived.

The walker called the police,
they came and took the body away,
and displayed it at the police station.
Soon the word spread
that an unknown body had been found on the street,
unwanted and abandoned.

The curious onlookers came in hordes,
and wanted to know whose body it was.
The man looked like a padre, a mulla and a priest.

The Women`s association came rushing,
somebody had told them
the man was an anti-alcohol crusader.
The Dalit groups came with large bouquets,
the word had gone round that
perhaps the man was their spokesperson.

The town went into a frenzy,
No one could know who he was,
Yet everyone fought to claim his body,
suspecting that he was someone big.
Till a little boy, all of eight years of age,
came there dragging his small feet,
He remembered to have seen
the man`s image in his school book.

In his simple uncluttered mind
there were no conflicting claims.
He knelt down and in honour of
all the deserted, abandoned bodies of the man,
In villages and towns, in offices and court rooms,
he paid his homage, tears flowing down his cheeks for his beloved Bapu,
he said in a clear voice of an innocent child, "Mahatma Gandhi Ki Jai"!

Confined within the pricked boundaries,
Chains on my legs, kept shackled for centuries.
But agony and restlessness find their way to me,
The moonless night and sun set in, with misery.
They are horrified to witness the dark, unmasking itself,
Shedding the blood of terror, the suspensive silence dwells.
Disposition is always in doubt, the society scorns and mocks at me, leaving no way to rebel.
The epic fateful war of Mahabharata was fought to uphold my morality and respect,
But today only the lighten candles, handcuffed hands rise for me, even though in thousands in number fail to reflect.
The only thing that comes up in many minds,
If I were a boy, free from chains and despair,
At liberty to dream, rise and repair.

source_fields.captured_title: थोड़ी जरूरी दूरी है करीब आने के लिए
source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
वो कहते हैं कि दे जाओ कोई निशानी
बिन तेरे हमको है अब कुछ दिन बितानी
आई थी जब तो बीते थे सोलह सावन
संग तेरे ही तो बीती है सारी जवानी।

अब भी कहते हो दे जाओ कोई निशानी?

ये दरों दीवारें और ये आंगन ये चौखट
उन पर स्पर्शों की सभी तरफ है सिलवट
नरम हाथों से अपने उसे तुम सेंकना
सुनो कान लगा कर आएगी वो ही आहट।

चाहो तो कर दो शुरू अभी से आजमानी
अब भी कहोगे दे जाओ कोई निशानी?

हमें भी तुम बिन है कुछ दिन गुजारनी
पर पास मेंरे हैं कई यादें रूहानी
सर्दी की गुनगुनी धूप वो सावन की बूंदे
रखा है समेटे उन सारे लम्हों की कहानी।

तुम ही तो हो मेरी सारी जिंदगानी
हमारे पास तो है सहेजी धरोहर पुरानी
यादों के उन सारे पन्नो को पलटूँगी
तो क्यों मांगू भला हमें दे दो कोई निशानी।

Sense and sensibility
peace and rest
adrift floatsam and jetsam

They don`t weep
sigh or sob in silence
gone dry and gritty

I lose things, my glasses,
mobile, watch and pen
I find a few, others yet at large

I look for your eyes, breaths,
susurration of your sari rubbing my flank
the space lies like an empty morgue

The dying moon at small hours
of the night, the wind`s cautious steps
seem pretences and proxies

My damned and cursed silences
sleeplessness and heart`s missed beats
go chasing you along your shoreline

Coasting to a safe harbour
you have built there are my broken
bits and ends of crumbling ego

They try bringing you blue feathers
quiet ripples and yellow petals
and the last line of a poem of ours

You to add `The end` or your own
lines of smile or sulk, and my wishes
can`t be horses; I reduced to a begger.

Then you asked me, why do I shine so bright?
I said, my love, because I amyour agenda of the light!

Then you pondered, how can my love be such a delight!
I said calmly, because love, at once, is opaque and clear daylight.

You brooded, “how can someone, how can someone
be a lover of your poise, your repute!!”

I said,Samudra Manthan, the churning of the ocean, was accomplished to extract
the Amrit, celestial nectar, where the Devas and the Danavastook part.

In a tug of war challenged to roil the elixir from the ocean
bed to attain immortality and eternal life beyond bereavement.

The medieval Hindu Theology encompasses this legend
that the Devas were carrying the amṛitaway from the Asuras, adamant.

Drops of nectar fell at four places on the Earth--Haridwar, Prayaga (Prayagraj),
Trimbak (Nashik), and Ujjain, in their divine right.

In the churning of the ocean delightful treasures,the archetypes
for their earthly and heavenly complements were brought.

Oceanic depths broughtChandra, the moon,Parijata, the tree fragrant,
the four-tusked elephant Airavata, Lord Indra`s mount.

Amid all that glory and glee of me, your Lakshmi, you churned our fate,
using Mount Meru as the rod and Vasuki as rope, the king of the serpent.

You became Lord Shiva, you chose to devour the poison, you drank it.
In my `manthan`, you elected glory for me and for yourself, venom was kept.

Nandini`s conjecture--love churned me, this love was my `manthan`.
Love took me out of the darkness of coalfields, like a granite.

My adorable, love is ember, love granite, love murky pebble,love-- a stone bright.
Love devotion, love renunciation, love merger, love—a prayer from the heart.

Long after he is gone, he puzzles me,
Dharama, the teen extraordinary,
Who jumped from Konark, the Black Pagoda
In the dead of the night,
So that at the daybreak none can show a finger towards him
And certify that there was the prodigy,
Who solved the puzzle finally,
In settingthe Pinnacle.
He was the wonder child,
(Mother`s darling having missed father`s love)
Tried to save the reputations of twelve thousand craftsmen and artisans,
Who had given their sweat and blood for twelve years,
Forgetting their homes and hearths,
He bothers me hundreds of years after the jump,
Like another enigma, Socrates,
His mistake was that he was crazy after knowledge,
Made the youth mad for knowledge,
To question all things in sight, all things in their quest for the Truth,
To remain always insatiated Socrates,
Not a content or pleasantly satisfied pig,
But the hero like our adored Shiva,
Gulping the hemlock to the finish,
To make his quest alive and method of search survive for ages.
They are puzzles as they did not know compromises, accepting things on face,
Their sacrifice was just not for the contemporary, but for the future.
From Home to Society to Universe of Power all over the world,
Don`t we see the orthodoxies and arrogances,
The status quoists, the nay-sayers,
Privileged in their comforts & luxuries,
To force the Dharmas & Socrates to make way for them!

Writing poem is not a home task
And one is not duty bound to write
The sky is a poem
The sea is a poem
The poet is an invisible entity
Who writes a poem with out writing
The way sprouts the blade of grass
The way flows the murmuring brook .

Erect a mature word and name It mountain
Poetry a lifesize image of thing
Wait for the opportune moments for the poetry
to come to heart`s deserted street .

Poetry graze all the grasses and weeds
Make sure,ears are alive to bleating
Don`t get disturbed
In poetry frogs do croak when the sky is overcast with rain
Poetry is a stream of consciousness that flows like words,water, paper boats
And swim like fishes .

Poetry is water deep
Poetry is word deep
Poetry is meditation deep
Body mind and soul becomes one.

Just go away from yourself at least for a while
Stroll, talk to tree, makes leaves your feathery wings and fly
The sky is the limit .

Beehives and ants creates poetry
Not the gigantic trees,skyscraper buildings
Poetry is always with the children of the lesser God .

Open your eyes the way the flower opens its Petals
Talk to a new born kid
Talk to an aged sick tree
Talk to a dead body
Be the ocean yourself
Create your own tidal waves
Make your own shores
Create temple of sands and destroy
Make your own traces through your feet and erase .

Find a poem every now and then
Write a poem every now and then
And if you fail to find
Be the poem yourself.

Lies are our staple food.
We feel convulsions
When we occasionally turn to truth
Those who encounter it
End up in hospitals,
Or on the pistoled pier,
If the dose of truth was higher.

Literature is the realm
Of the partial truth
Even history has no history
Of telling the impartial
Unqualified truth does not let us sleep
Try the balm of poetry
Where the wounds are too deep.

Literature introduces us
To the best parts of humanity,
And history to the worst
Yet we love history
Though it always acts like a wamp
Tempts us with its perilous glory
Which bears the death`s stamp.

Our silence can make stones speak,
And also shut whirling tempests
Of verbal extravagance.
History is the warbling noise
Of the river of life
In its glorious as well as meanest flow
Poetry interprets and modifies the show.

The silver crust of teardrop 
embellished with gray flowers
And bunny ears
Brings solace to my melancholy
For eons, for eternity.
The hallowed mate 
To my solitary hymns
The tranquilizing shawl of dews
On the dying embers of my soul..
Moon.
In its myriad forms,
It`s the trusted keeper,
The confidant,
of my unuttered thoughts
And the melting oceans 
beneath my eyes.
The witness of silent wincings
And scintillating jingles 
of memories,
Moon.
The morsel of nectar 
To my ravenously yearning soul,
The lunar friend of mine
Who chooses to stay
Sharing my vigil through 
The blur of night,
Gazing by the window forevermore,
Moon.
Look up westward,
Into the horizon!
My Moon has returned to join me..
Like always.

Let me go to the hill top-- I make friends with loneliness. The Moon touched my shoulder as I remember her voice addressing me like running water.

From a distance as I rise after each time that I fall. Watch me how I crawl, sneak and emotional recall. Watch me from a distance as my poems are rejected.

Don`t you watch me from a distance as I lose sleep every long night? Some thousands years later, and maybe little sooner, watch my prayer modes. I won`t ask for more.
What possibilities has the earth forever covered behind the poems, what bare faces? I hear them breathe, watching. The tulip buds are ready to bloom. I smell their patient waiting. Where are you now? Take a look and you`ll see into your imagination on my faithless doors.
Living beside our long-lived haours of faith, you will be free watching if you truly wish to be.

Every winter the last of the Siberian cranes keeps returning to Iran.
To search for his beloved Arezoo, who is no more.
Every winter Omid the crane flies back 6000km to meet his mate.
Maybe he still believes that his dear one is waiting for him.

Cranes unlike us civilized humans, mate for life.
They are monogamous and pair with their partners lifelong.
Omid and his mate Arezoo used to migrate together in the winters.
They danced together and expressed love with gentle and resonant voices.

Alas! Fifteen years ago the lovelorn cranes were separated as Arezoo died.
But Omid has been flying to Iran every winter.
Maybe like his name he still hopes that he will meet his beloved.
Every winter, he wishes he will meet his mate.

But this year he was not seen by the birders.
The last Siberian crane did not migrate this winter.
Where is he, where is the lovelorn crane?
Is he alive or has he at last met his beloved?


Cheerio
Gopal Lahiri

 

I have a wooden door in my room
in the shape of a halo, an open key.

In the night, the silence is tuned to a different
mode, it feels strange echo by echo.

Like the hush after a local train passes by
I open the door and there is nothing left

to see except the darkness; the silence
then touches me, once, twice, thrice perhaps,

the half-moon enters now through the door
shine all along with waxing and waning.

Only a rhythm remains, a movement, a turn,
you are sailing off into the distance,

I unwind like a fly catcher and glide in the open
to clasp air, to wave cheerio.

Complete oblivion,
or do wisps of memory lurk
in the shadows?

Down flows the tide—

Eternal amnesia
or reminiscences?
Ero and Thanatos
engage in a violent duel,
desolation
while the warm wine spills from the brimming goblet.
Conjecture is eternal.

Daughter of Eris
You are indeed an offspring of
Strife.

The boat sways
does it set sail?

I need : 

An escape from this tattered life
An escape from the years of waiting 
An escape from the primordial needs 

 

I desire:

 To elope alone 
With the weight of buried memories
Along with the burdens 
Of unfulfilled dreams 

I wait: 

To reunite with the desired one
I have been here 
For years together in the void 
Just because 
it`s a thousand years of waiting 
Nobody can tempt me 
to stay behind 

 

I hope 
To embark on a secret journey  
of so many years of pain
Now the impatient body
 is hoping to get 
peace atleast 
Of crumbling values, shattered hopes
Towards a path of solitude 

 

I wish 

 I could heal from 
the trauma of the
 death and birth 

An ultimate path of 
renunciation is not 
that we all desire 

To merge with the Infinite Being 
While leaving our mortal longing 
We have to escape 
from this land of suffering.

Life evolves  under the unlimited sky 
Under a cover of  clouds 
and other illuminating cellestial bodies
And continue evolving 
Till the last breath.

Every living being  is no doubt  born free
But every where in chains 
Of  primary elements of the universe
With peace,  pleasure and pain.

The soul in it`s  earthly existence
Stays on a short sojourn
After which it returns to its origin
 Leaving some sweet and sour memories
That marks an  intensive impression.

Presences, absences or silence here
Do not imprint  
The  archetecture of  any commitments 
Or  draw  any pattern in a delapilated heart 
To  crave for drops of rain to console
The madness of my infinite soul!

source_fields.captured_title: Waiting For The Red Soil On My Skin
source_fields.body_html:
I will take a rebirth with
green valleys on my eyes;
red soil on my skin
and black magic on my hair,
not inside my brain.

I will not take any rebirth inside
what you call society; inside what
you call universities; or on the upper
pedestal from where people look
vague and hazy and tiny.
In this birth, I have laws peeping into
and smashing
my bones; education to make me
distant and laughable; manners to
separate me
from red soils, green valleys.
In my next birth, laws will flow
like water to the thirsty mouth;
wretched soil.
Education will be only trees,
branching out to the sky;
Universities will be oceans; humans
will be animals of the
close-knit herd.
Waiting for the smell of new soil;
for the smile of new skins and bones;
for laws to illuminate a new mind,
a new, cherished magic.

In my world, laughter rises early
like birdsong calling in the light,
steady and untiring, it spreads,
wakes voices softened by sleep and dreams.

Here, neighbours speak with open faces,
even strangers nod, their gaze warm,
as if kindness, no longer rare,
is just breath we share.
Roots reach and bind the earth as we walk
trees bending in generous shelter,
air sweetened by gardens where people dig
shoulder to shoulder, soil and sweat alike,
hands growing calloused, but soft to hold.

This world makes room for soft hearts
for quiet times and unhurried days
for conversations that need no rush
eyes meeting in real, human time
giving moments the space to breathe.

I plant what I hope will thrive
fruit trees in empty lots
flowers in vacant windows
words that nurture or heal
small acts that ripple beyond me
one good thing feeding another.
To me, each step substances, each hand counts,
not a single gentleness goes unnoticed.

I know that it`s the water inside the ship
That drowns it, not the water around it.
A perfect relationship is nothing
but the chimera of the mind.
Thus, I have a slow burning will of my own
like the moon.

I build optimisms with the parts of me
that still remember grace.
I am strong, deep like the blue
and am beautifully complex.
I am a beautiful ruin, beautiful because of
all that I have been through.
One door opens for me when one closes,
and I see diamonds in the dust of the past.
In the cracks in my heart, I let
lights in.
I am actually living
in the lost pieces of myself.
Now I am like a nail—waiting for a hammer,
holding my breath.
These are my diluted pleasures.
I am learning to live with it,
finding new ways of coping.
An audit of the heart is the need of the hour,
my sense of the world
Is the new world-order--
what/who is the `constant`?
Do I inherit
the wasteland?

source_fields.body_html:
न जाने उस बक्से में क्या, रख देती थी मेरी मां।
जब भी उसको खोले तब तब, मुस्का देती मेरी मां।।
मैं भी सिरहाने बैठ गई, जब वो बक्सा खोली थी।
देखा उसमें अपना बचपन, यादों की एक झोली थी।।
एक में थी दीदी की गुड़िया, और भाई की बंदूक।
उन सारे बीते लम्हों से, भर चुकी थी वह संदूक।।
आंखे छिपाकर बच्चों से जब, देखा बनारसी लाल।
नैनों के कोरो के अश्रुजल, बता दिए हृदय का हाल।।
माता-पिता दोनो भूमिका, कैसे भला निभाई थी।
पिता तो होते हैं मजबूत, तब ही नीर छिपाई थी।।
रो ले मां अब तू जी भर कर, इस कंधे पर रख ले सर।
भीग गए सारे ये कांधे, भोर हो गई रो रो कर।।
प्राची से फिर निकला दिनकर, दे डाला सबको संदेश।
दुख के दिन तो क्षणिक मात्र है, जीवन होता अति विशेष।।

जमशेदपुर

तू तोड़ दे बेख़ौफ़,
वो बंदिशें, वो रोक-टोक !
चली चल बेपरवाह एक नयी राह पर दबंग तू।


दिखा ज़माने को परचम लहरा कर ऊँचा
अपनी हर फ़तह,
हर मील के पत्थर पर
बेबाक़ तू जश्न मना !


तू यूँ कर हर सितम,
हर चाल और सवाल,
तू यूँ खिलखिला, कर यूँ सरगोशियाँ।


नाच बेबाक़, मनचली हवा सी बन दबंग
ले चल सारा हुज़ूम साथ अपने तू
एक तेज़ इंकिलाब और आँधी सी बन !


तू छू ले बुलंदियों से
फ़लक की हर ऊँचाई।
पैठ ले संमदर की गहराइयों से उजले मोती।


तू पंख फैला अपने आजा़द नील गगन में,
भर ले परिंदों सी ऊँची उड़ान!
जी ले जिँदगी अपने ही दम पर तू बेफ़िक्र।


हर आँसू जो लुढ़कता है तेरे नैनों से
बना शब़नम उसे फि़र हँसकर दिलेर।
तू हया है। ख़ुमार है!
तू कशिश और नज़्म है !
तू ईबादत और पूजा है।


तू बहती नदी है। ख़ुशनुमा समीर है,
फ़िज़ा की गूँजती आवाज़ है तू !
रूह की दिलकश पुकार है तू।

कलम तेरे हाथों में है
तू हर पन्ने पे लिख़ !
मजा़ज अपनी हर दास्तान !
कू खुद में सल्तनत है।


ज़माने से नहीं तू। ज़माना तुझसे है !
तू सदियों से क़ैद नही,
ख़ुद की बुलंद पहचान है !!!

When the sinking days of wintry twilights,
Metamorphose into a black curtain,
Jatinga is offered on her platter a vapoury spread.

Swirling fog hang heavy,
Lurking and beckoning you with thick lashes,
The cold chill touches you with a gentle caress,
It offers a feast to the eyes,
The eerie silence and white curls ,
Produces a mysterious sight before the iris.

The green canopy and the Blue hills reverberates a echo ,
As nature basks in exuberance.
The luscious thrill of foggy spells are a savoury spread with sketches of fairy tale sights.

The winding road takes you either uphill or downhill,
Brushing you with wet, slippery strokes
Against your skin,
Particularly your countenance.

The cloud capped hills
Are dressed with cottony fluffs,
And you can find yourself in the lap of cumulus.
White blankets dresses the peaks
And fly slowly.

When you talk of the hills calling,
Barial as the glorified picture is etched in our minds,
Yes, the Barial of Jatinga,
The Barial of DimaHasao,
Whose loving embrace you will cherish.

The serpentine road of Jatinga,
The blurry, virgin fog of Jatinga,
The yonder forest of Jatinga,
Which soaks you in the petals of enthralling serenity,
Erasing the mad rush of time count.

The mellifluous streams drenches you with its ecstatic sprinklers,
The swishing trees emanates whispers , you try to decipher,
Jatinga thus sits blissfully in the throne ,
Of one of the pages of Haflong`s story book,
Showering basketful of tranquility as you approach it`s door.

Our pride lies in growing big,
growing really big and beautiful
with an empirical attitude to life,
not in erasing the historical process
in our proactive projection
of animosity and false prestige.

It is in being distinct in our objectivity
and cosmopolitan creative genius
that we can excel in our world
in every sphere; in art, craft, literature
 science, technology and architecture
as we had excelled in days of yore,
rather than following blindly
the footprints of the prejudiced.

Those stupid snobbish despots
who cannot do anything monumental
in their ride in power
to be remembered, go to the past
and defame their predecessors,
pinpointing their weaker side
ignoring all the good work they did.
They even defame century old men of mettle,
deface and destroy their monuments
and boastfully taste a sense of pride.

A strange call it was
With a trembling heart filled in fear
It was a prayer,
`Oh! Mother` my life is at stake ,
Please help me , I am in distress
And that I know you are my only saviour` .

The throb in her prayer
Must have quiverred someone`s heart
The spring must have ceased
awaiting the rain ,
Yet not known,
If anyone who heard these inocent prayers
In this city of violence
Really bothered not letting it in vain.

A new morning succeeded
To welcome again a rising sun in the far east horizon
The twilights helped identifying a burning ambulance
Beyond a recognizable state
With a half charred body inside
While many others might have been
Left unidentified
In the the esteemed city of ruins .

Unseen dreams of many adolscent girls
Might have been left unnoticed
Under the heaps of the charred colloids
And
The city of glamour
Now would turn to a desert
Soaked with the blood and tears of the unmatured motherhood...

Convincingly seemed,
An easy possibility to reply,
The query by a lady chum, not more
Than half a cycle of 12 months

Whilst, its intimacy extended
With the ghosts inside the core and depth;
A concord of conflict corroborated
Betwix` the then unconcerned mood
And later fathomed sensitivity

These differences accounted to blast
An irreplaceable incomprehension
Of the layers hid in that suspicion;

Do the peripheral waves or
The inherent ease of expression,
Invited a cohort into such compulsion
To give birth within
A paranoia about my own being

Because you are right there
in the middle of the rounded teardrop
that hang vulnerably
at the edge of the mother`s eyes.
I do not know the genesis of the tears.
I blame it on the pangs of motherhood-
the erratic play of hormones
mixed with the dash of a sublime joy-
to have held a wriggling bundle,
to have called it my own.

As I look back,
I see the years went by
when you were simply the breathe I inhaled a little further away from my body.
As easy, as unobtrusive like the air flowing in the lung, as inherently imperative for my soul.

I risk your eye-roll as I tell you this in a clear day of autumn,-the fall season where the trees write farewell letter to the leaves,
it was worth every moment to be called your mother ,
you are the best poem to have come to me.
