तू ही था जो मनस में निशिदिन महका
तू प्रणय की कथा में और प्रेम के भूगोल में
तू विछोह की व्यथा में और मिलन की कल्लोल में

तू कब नहीं था
तू शरीर में तू छाया में तू रक्त के प्रवाह में
तू मंदिर में तू माया में तू चर्च में दरगाह में
तू वास्तव था तू भ्रम भी था
तू सहज था तू श्रम भी था
तू पुण्य में तपस्या में तू था जीवन के कृत्य में
तू शून्य में प्रतीक्षा में तू समर्पण के सत्य में

तू कब नहीं था
तू कल्पों से मेरा था युगों तक मेरा ही है तू
तू सृजन से मेरा था विलय तक मेरा ही है तू
तू अंधकार तू प्रकाश तू अनुराग तू विश्वास
तू ही भूत तू भविष्य तू वैराग तू ही सन्यास

तू आरम्भ तू अंतिम तू ही होगा जब कुछ नहीं होगा
तू आभा है अप्रतिम तू रहेगा जब कुछ नहीं होगा
तू था ..तू है ..तू ही है

source_fields.captured_title: भक्तिन के नयनों में अमर प्रेम रहने दो
source_fields.body_html:
भक्तिन के नयनों अमर प्रेम रहने दो,
भर के इंद्रधनुषी रंगो को,
बेला से महके अंगों को,
चरण रज से आलिंद सुरभित,
अक्षत श्वासों का पुलकित,
मृदु हृदय में गीत प्रेम का पलने दो।
भक्तिन के नयनों में...

अपेक्षा,उपेक्षा के भंवर को छोड़,
मसि-सागर की अविरल धार को तोड़,
फेर तेरे ही नाम की माला को,
राह तकती इस बृज की बाला को,
विजन वन के कंटक पर चलने दो।
भक्तिन के नयनों में...

सांध्य प्रार्थना सुबह का अर्घ्य बनाकर,
मिथ्या को स्वर्ण सत्य थाल में सजाकर,
जीवन के अंतिम मधु की मधुरता,
नीर नदी से हरके सारी नीरवता,
स्मृतियों का संदल पुजारिन को मलने दो।
भक्तिन के नयनों में...

source_fields.captured_title: काश अगर मैं इंसान नहीं होता
source_fields.body_html:
काश अगर मैं इंसान नहीं होता
दिल मेरा क्लेशों से भरा नहीं होता
न मैं किसी के प्रगति से जलता
न किसी के खुशियों पर आहें भरता
काश अगर मैं इंसान नहीं होता।

न मैं हिंदी-मुस्लिम करता
न मंदीर-मस्जिद के झगड़े में पड़ता
न गीता की झूठी कसमें खाता
न बाईबिल, कुरान पर तंज कसता
काश अगर मैं इंसान नहीं होता।

न सियासत में तीन-पाँच करता
न भ्रष्टतंत्र का हिस्सा बन आँखें चुराता
न धन – शोहरत का लालसा रखता
न छल-कपट, प्रपंच रचता
काश अगर मैं इंसान नहीं होता।

न जात-पात करता, न लिंगभेद करता
न ऊँचे होने का दंभ भरता
न नीच होने का अवसोस करता
न करता कानाफूसी, न चापलूसी करता
काश अगर मैं इंसान नहीं होता।


न नौकरी की आस, न व्यापार का नुकसान
न ओहदे का अहंकार, न पढ़ालिखा बेरोजगार
न ख्वाईशें, न फरमाइशें, न जोर, न अजमाईशें
न सुख में इतराता, न दुख में आँसू बहाता
काश अगर मैं इंसान नहीं होता।

हर दिन हर हाल में बस अपने दम पर जीता
उन्मुक्त गगन में उड़ता, कुदरत से बातें करता
न भूत-भविष्य की चिंता करता
न वर्तमान से खफा-खफा रहता
काश अगर में इंसान नहीं होता
दिल मेरा क्लेशों से भरा नहीं होता।

My God wears nothing.
My love wears nothing.
The maverick living
in my shrine wears nothing.
But I wear the sky, my attire,
fire, the kohl for my eyes.
I question even God`s
peremptory commands.

From Kabir I took a bit of cloth for my cloak,
from Tuka ropes to hang my hammock,
Mira`s lullabies put me to deep sleep,
Salabega* cross-stitched my bhakti.

I roam my memory lanes
looking for toys I buried under innocence
in our pastoral land. I often see
my father`s silhouette walk out of dust
whorls.
I ask God for a `made easy` kit of moksha,
ready to rerun, rejoice, and adopt.
Some mischief at the courier`s delivery -
I got a `DIY` Kit*, packed with emptiness.

In my shrine the all time impassive Lord
wears a tease, "Serves you right, jerk".
The riddle reduces Mona Lisa
to a lesser conundrum, her fig leaf showing.

He seems as insecure, as unsure,
in his mystic avatar, almost her doppelganger,
I bite my tongue, "O, I shrunk you, Lord."
But I love you as an insecure toddler in buff.

(Salabega* - an ardent devotee of Lord Jagannath, born of a
Brahmin mother and a Muslim father, a Bhakti poet from Puri br> in the 17th century AD. DIY Kit* is a kit of parts to `Do It
Yourself` or assemble the parts Yourself)

When one day bleeds into the next
like a mechanical robotic exercise
cold air wafts into life`s clumsy and fetid space
fessing up no palpable respite
dark clouds hover over
iridescent hues of vast expanse like a curse
my bright day headily metamorphoses to a bleak night

How quickly things change
at time`s behest!
that was balmy then and this is torrid of late
But why does this befall me all the time!
I am more or less clueless, believe me
the slither takes me away from seatherny
and I plummet like a doomed kite

My fine boned face framed by long flowing hair
seeks comforts in small wisps of air
to revel in sirimiri and nature`s misty clad oeuvre
croon a few aubade rhythms of jouissance
festooning my dawn in the susurrations of the beatific.

The Autumn of her life begins,
Bidding goodbye to the cacophony of screams and sobs.
Pain can never be love
It`s a mystic difficult conundrum, just move
Oh look! That necklace adorning her neck is pure
and made out of pearls that fell down from her eyes.
She tresured them to show the world
how strong women can be made,
She picked those shells of emotions from the sand
And constructed her backbone to stand.
Ray florets of sunflower smiled,
dew drops crowned her head
dignified,
She never bowed down or let others fix her crown
She had rivers to swim and mountains to climb
There were no strong ropes to tie her down
No water to extinguish her fire burning inside.
She spilled her knowledge to the world outside.
Letters became her refuge and confiding souls
Pain was turned into poetry and sold.
Now her name is written in gold.
In every nook and corner of the world,
finally on the book that you hold.

Tempests of wars and violence
have broken wings of doves--
harbingers of peace on earth
Hundreds of doves have sacrificed their lives
Warmonger rulers of world are vultures
eager to tear bodies of innocents
Jungle rule of might is right
prevails even now in homo sapiens
Exploiting patriotic feelings of citizens
vicious rulers hush up protests of wars
and win support and applause for massacres
killing thousands of innocent civilians
Cold blooded indifference of us
Least felt when hundreds
of innocent children and women are
bombed to death or maimed everyday
It happens far away and
It `s not our kith or kin, we justify
Protest against wars is seldom seen
We have lost our concern for fellow beings
Unless we feel those murders as our own
humans will never be humane

Of trillions spent on war every year
not even ten percent is needed
to wipe out poverty from the world
and fill the planet with happiness and peace
Sadly, we can only dream of such bliss
For, wars are nothing but weapon business

The fiery damsel who tries to be unique
In her neat and crisp uniform making people notice her and greet
In showbiz, people notice first your outer appearance
Not bothering where and what is your inheritance
Donning the cap of the perfect mate
She uses her ethics with efficiency and elan
Her beauty, her brain in perfect sync
It seems like a piece of cherry on the cake
People appreciate and value her efforts
The whole office shuttles on her command

Her colleagues often compliment her as boss
Thinking she must be ruling similarly at home
Smiling with rye she just keeps mum
In her homely domain, she barely had her say
As and when she is back home
she needs to finish all the homely chores
Others mostly sit lazing around
She juggles hard to cook for all
Hardly have the energy to carry on!
How she wishes to have a helping hand
when asking for help she is advised
If can`t manage just sit at home
Dreaming of being the entrepreneur of the year
She gulps a glass of water and carries on...

a desert is crawling
in to my eyes.
Like a snake returning
to its den.

All the dreams
flee from eyes
like the fearful birds
who abandoned its nest
due to heavy storm.

When the dreams die,
the eyes become barren land.
I can see the cactus are growing thickly
hither and there.

When the thorny edges
pierce in to my heart
all the emotions of humanity
drains away.

The humidity of kindness
evaporates.
The heat of love
burn in to ashes.
The snow of sympathy
never falls down
to cool down.

When the sun
with its reddy eyes
gazing at me,
the fountain of mercy dries.

I can see my life is hiding away
to some where.
I can feel my charriot of death is
arriving without any siren.

ଶୋଇପଡୁଛି।

ଥରେ ପଢ଼ିଲେ  ଭୁଲିବା କଷ୍ଟ l

ସଭିଙ୍କୁ ସଂଖୋଳିବା ମାନେ ତ ସଂସାର
ସବୁରି ମୁହଁରେ ହସ ଫୁଟେଇ ପାରିଲେ ତ
ଜୀବନ ଲାଗେ ଭରା ଫସଲର କ୍ଷେତ !

ଯେମିତି ଶହ ଶହ ବର୍ଷରୁ
ନିଜକୁ ବାଣ୍ଟି ବାଣ୍ଟି ଶୁଖିଯାଏ ନଈ ଜଳ

କଳା କିଟିମିଟି ତାଉଆଟେ ହେଲେ କଣ ହେଲା,

ତମେ ମୋତେ ଶବ୍ଦ ମାଗିଲ ନା !

କାଳେ ମାଟି ଫଟେଇ ଫୁଟିଯିବି

ନିଜକୁ ଉସକେଇଲି

ମୋ` ପୋରିହା ହାଡରୁ ଶବ୍ଦ ସବୁ ଘୋଷାରି ଆଣିଲି, ଶାଣ ଦେଲି

ଆକାଶର ତାରାଭର୍ତ୍ତି ମଲାଟରୁ ଖସି ପଡିଲେ ନିଶାଗ୍ରସ୍ତ ଫୁଲମାନେ ହଲିଝୁଲି

ସବୁ ସାଇତି ଦେଇଛି ତମପାଇଁ
ଆସ, ଶବ୍ଦ ମାଗନାହିଁ !

ମୋର ସବୁ ଶବ୍ଦ ତ ଘୋରି ଘୋରି
ଚନ୍ଦନ କରିଛି ତମକୁ ଚର୍ଚ୍ଚିତ
କରିବି ବୋଲି,
ତମେ ଆସିଲେ ବସିବ ମୋ` ସଜଡା ବେଦୀରେ
ସେଇଥିରେ ଚିତ୍ରିତ କରିବି
ଛାଇଦେବି ଫୁଲ ପାଖୁଡ଼ାରେ,
ତମ ନୀରବତାକୁ ହୋମନିଆଁରେ
ସ୍ବାହା କରୁଥିବ ଶବ୍ଦଭୁକ
ନହେଲା ଯାଏ,
ଖାଲି ଓହ୍ଲେଇ ଦେଇ ଆସିବ
ମୁଁ` ତ୍ବ କୁ ।

source_fields.captured_title: आओ कभी यूं ही मिलते हैं
source_fields.body_html:
सुख दु:ख की बातें करते हैं
लेते हैं चाय की चुस्कियां
बचपन की यादें ताजा करतें हैं।
आओ कभी यूं ही मिलते हैं-------

बैठते हैं, किसी पेड़ के छांव में
या भिंगते हैं, रिमझिम बारिश में
और मिलकर गाते हैं, गीत कोई
चलो गम भूला कर हंसते हैं ।
आओ कभी यूं ही मिलते हैं-------

ना शिकवे हो ना शिकायत हो
बस प्यार भरी एक मुलाकात हो
ना अमीरी ,गरीबी बीच में आएं
बस निर्मल स्वच्छ दोस्ती हो।
आओ कभी यूं ही मिलते हैं-----

कहने वाले कहते रहेंगे कुछ भी
हमें एक दूसरे पर पूरा भरोसा हो
हर हाल में साथ रहेंगे हम दोनों
कोई हमारे साथ हो ना हो।
आओ कभी यूं ही मिलते हैं-----

बिछड़ जाने का कोई गम नहीं
एक दूसरे की दिल में रहेंगे।
आंधी आएं या तूफान आएं
एक दूसरे का साथ निभाएंगे।
आओ कभी यूं ही मिलते हैं----

ऊँची ऊँची इमारतें बड़े बड़े मकान
बेहद खूबसूरत औ बड़े आलीशान
फैशनेबल लोगों की निराली है सजधज
साज सज्जा सुंदर, अनूठी आनबान।

जगमग बिजलियाँ जमीं पर उतरा आसमान
घात लगाये बैठे ठग ऊँची है दुकान
दो के दस करने में, ज़रा न करें लाज
पत्थरों के इन शहरों की अद्भुत है शान।

देखा जाना नगरों को रह गई हैरान
भागता सारा नगर, रख हथेली पे जान
घड़ी की सुइयों के संग करें सारे काम
विवेक कहाँ, सुख शांति, ज़रा नहीं भान।

कैसा दौर चला था, छोड़ अपने गाँव मकान
उजाड़ डाले थे स्वयं अपने कामकाज, दुकान
नगरों का आकर्षण जो था बड़ा रंगीला
पछताते सिर धुन अब, कहाँ गाँव, खेत,खलिहान ।

ये एक नगर की बात नहीं, सारा हिंदुस्तान
गाँव छोड़ भागते शहर, बसना पड़ता श्मशान
समय आयेगा ऐसा भी, न था ज्ञान किसी को ,
पत्थर के नगरों में बसेंगे, पत्थर के इंसान ।

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
जो आ जाऊँ तो मूक उधर
जाने को कह दूँ तो बेखबर,
कैसे समझूँ जज्बात प्रिय
किस विध लूँ तेरी थाह प्रिय|

इठलाती बलखाती एक नदी
फिर भी प्यासी जैसे कई सदी,
मिलने की दरिया से चाह नहीं
समझो क्या है प्रवाह प्रिय
किस विध लूँ तेरी थाह प्रिय|

कहते थे लौट के आऊँगा,
दिल खोलकर दिखलाऊंगा,
पलकें देहरी को ताक रही
अनिमेष वहीं पर झांक रही,
अपलक निहारूँ राह प्रिय
किस विध लूँ तेरी था प्रिय|

मन की वीणा के तार हो तुम,
कर दो झंकृत झंकार हो तुम,
गूंजेगा फिर वही साज प्रिय
किस विध लूँ तेरी थाह प्रिय|

असीमित अनंत अपरिभाषित
अव्यक्त महाकाव्य सी,
रच कर फिर एक महा काव्य
बन जाओ कालिदास प्रिय,
किस विध लूँ तेरी थाह प्रिय|

Such a cryptic`s man, always shifts the blame
He`s forever right, so doth he always claim!
Never looks into him, rather blames the stars
Whenever he`s left with some unhealing scars

The stars are surprised at the silliness of man
And smile, how unworthy he grows in his life span
Since they don`t harm him rather illumine his path
And ever been silent and never shown their wrath

`Karma`s dharma`, how silly it`s that man forgets 
And as per his action he always tastes the results 
Hell and heaven both lie in the purview of the mind
If it`s heeded alone, he`ll surely turn blind

Character`s destiny, and man himself is the maker
The fault`s in him only, if he turns out to be a loser.

An unscrupulous poem
that deviates from the track,
enters a bush of thorns.
A lingo that is untidy
totters, faints and perishes.

Mind gets entangled
in the net flung by paranoia;
not unexpected this is.
The heart that loses discretion
bogs down in the slush of ire;
no sudden a happening this either.
Rope-serpent hallucination
engenders turmoil;
the heart gets upended.
A thick cloud of churlishness
covers the brain.

Life`s beauteous journey has so much to offer
Joy balanced with woe is served on our platter
incandescent glow on one hand
while pitch darkness floats on the other !
faces illumined with the rays of piety
shares the same roof with the concupiscent ones...
is it not a thing for humans to bother ?
minds so polluted with rancour and rapacity
how come they inhale freely among altruists and men of sagacity ...!

O man ! its high time to brood over and ponder
when will these infamous elements be rooted out
and all the sorrows be assuaged ..!
when will man abjure the wrong doings
that are irrevocable ..?
Let combined hands of honesty and piety triumph over these diabolical designs ...

Even after having a mosque in the bosom
Afruza Akhtar was not at peace
Till she had a temple in her bosom.
Many stories are making rounds
Many hearsay and whispers.
But one thing is true that Afruza asked me-
Wherefrom `d the bricks be brought to build the temple?
I said –
It needn`t be brought from Ayodhya or Vrindavan
Just fetch from the nearby kiln
Said –
Get Cement and sand from the petty shopkeeper
Near your hour house, the poorest one
The one who remained with the smallest shop because he couldn`t lie
And you need not fetch water from the river
Countless corpses floated down the river
in the clash for temple-mosque
How troubled the river was being forced to carry down those dead bodies
The rivers do not remain river any more Afruza
So to mix the mortar get water from the well
Filling into a pitcher

After the temple was made in the bosom of Afruza
How excited she was to tell me
Now Allah and Bhagwan relishes food
From the same plate in her bosom
Shares the same bed to sleep

I asked her –
How are they to look at?
Afruza said –
Both are in fact twins.
So now it has become rather difficult for her
To identify
Which one is Bhagwan
Which one is Allah

Translation ; Bibekananda Choudhury

I am born different
Because my wilderness listens the melody of wood
My echoes made me awake in night and groove
I often feel the whispering breeze
Binging near me and the sound of dirt
Swinging as the storm
The wild grass in me creates molehill
Flowers bloom in my branches with style
I dream of sunshine
I dream of rhyme
I take shelter in my verse
I console myself from the engraving norms
My wings aspire to flutter
Beyond the cloud
I want to expand the radius of my round
The hurricane of my eyes doesn`t rest
My contestant feet aspire to run on the track
In the 4*100 relay race
My hips are not acquainted for the extra mile walk
Hence they ache and I cajoled them by soothing ointment
Then I pause
Wait for the tap from the brain cap
Comfort myself with three letter word
I am born different.

Seductive clouds draw near
Dark wings unfold, whispers clear
Enchanted, mystic snare
In your arms, my hands entwine
Empty moments, time`s disarray
Intoxicating kisses seal our sway
Two souls entwined, trembling free
Tangled locks bind me to thee
Lost in passion, I succumb
To memories, a futile quest
A captivating, sweet deceit.

this crack
on the wall
thin line to begin with
searching for expanse
eating into the paint
hiding old wounds

way we
slowly drifted apart
along fault lines
our celluloid laughter
no longer bold enough
to heal

Looking Back in Ecstacy
Humming a soft Tune
Unfolding My Days from
A Toddler to Immaculate Adult

Each Second of Transition
Flashes Back in Desperation
Some Have Been Too Heartening
To Note and Cherish in Elation

Beautiful Mornings Created Vibration
Hot and Humid Days Brought Exasperation
But Like A Sweet Sour Candy Resolution
These All Winged Away with Utmost Contemplation

All that Life Has Taught
Functions As A Lighthouse
To Stay Tune to the New Challenges
And Breaking Barriers to Move

Growing from Pink Green to Grey
Each Colour Has Adorned Me
Inculcating A Powerful Emotion
To Recall All Value Addition

Leaving Behind Its Footprints
So, Embrace Everyrhing in Adoration

On this day that invites grief...
I weave together... change and silent fear,
Loss and hope,
vulnerability and self discovery...

Mundane thoughts flow with the profound...
endless summers of flowers and hurricanes of destinies.

I hold on to trees I see, without leaves,
all ablaze with vibrant floral glory..
I hold on to hope..
like a simple glowing earthen lamp I see, spreading light...
even as the sky is covered with a duvet of grey and black print..
I hold on to a fistful of river earth...
from here I know a living plant will grow...
I hold on to the simple beauty of a bird song.. for that uplifts my soul...
I hold on to life lessons learnt from all my teachers...
hold on to the balance of holding on and letting go....!
I hold on to awe and wonder...
for from here I know..
miracles are born.

Please give me
a fistful of clouds as a gift
I`ll keep them safely
in a chest

Please give me
two meters of fog
So I can cover up myself
before the sun rises too high

Please also give me
some raindrops too
So I can use them
to embellish my braids

I`ll like to adorn myself
With the notes of Sargam and
the melodies of a cuckoo
I`ll like to dance with
a striking lightning

I`ll fasten a waterfall`s
burble to my ankles
I`ll play `Holi` borrowing
colours from the rainbow
I`ll be friend with
the first few rays of the Sun

I`ll beg you a thousand times
throughout all the seasons
to accept all of my
incomparable emotions.

Every year I`ll send you
Some of my time in an envelope
But you have to visit me once
This is my only condition
You`ll come to visit me, nah?

Listen, O` Dear!
I`ll like to dedicate to you
the sweet lunar smile
for a worthy meeting
of yours and mine!

Oh! Mother`
my life is at stake ,
Please help me ,
I am in distress
And that I know
you are my only saviour.
The throb in her prayer
Must have quivered someone`s heart
The spring must have ceased
awaiting the rain ,
Yet not known,
If anyone
who heard these innocent prayers
In this city of violence
Really bothered
not letting it in vain.
A new morning succeeded
To welcome again
a rising sun in the far east horizon
The twilights helped identifying
a burning ambulance
Beyond a recognisable state
With a half charred body inside
While many others might have been
Left unidentified
In the esteemed city of ruins .
Unseen dreams of many adolescent girls Might have been left unnoticed
Under the heaps of the charred colloids
And the city of glamour
Now would turn to a desert
Soaked with the blood and tears
of the immature motherhood...

source_fields.captured_title: LOST IN THE SHIMMERING GLOW OF DREAMS
source_fields.body_html:
In her exuberance of youth
She was always fascinated by dreams
On the splendid wings of her dreams
She sailed in wonderment
Ecstatic in their allurement
Over the years
As she became more mature in her thoughts
She was amazed
to realise how very childish she had been
in her school girl crush for dreams
True dreams give zest to life
But what use are dreams
If no effort we do make
For their attainment
Life is for real
Not to squander it in the shimmering halo
Of dreams that leave us
Exhausted and dejected
Never ever allowing those dreams
To take root in our minds
For us to diligently strive
So much so they remain
Not as dreams ephemeral in nature
But in deeds
That pave the way for enriching our lives.

The passing of time cannot subtract the bond
we shared from beginning to what seems to be the end.
August will keep coming.
They weep for you and feel your spirit each day
and month the sun shines.
It`s August again.
How can it be?
It`s raining memories and
twenty four is written all over my arms.
Love does not fade It is not weathered nor seasonal.
Must we pour spice on anniversaries of everything?
anything?
or nothings?
must we lather these days and months
with suds and foamy words that do not reach
the root of the soil or the blood of the heart.
I breathe you.
I can never forget you
My sweet bird in the heavenly clouds
who was an original everything and mine!
It is August once again.
We are reaching for you with the fingertips
in our minds pores and essence.
Tear ducts make a river leading to the you
that is forever with me..
in August and always.

Keshav, I am lost
Drifting helplessly
Losing my way to home
The woods are deep
The darkness thickening
Crawling in the darkness
Desperately look for your Light
Where are You?
Why have You disowned me?
Am I not worthy of Your love?
Splinters of wood, caught my eyes
I fail to see the path
Stuck in the pathless wood
Yearn for my Krishna, my Saviour
Pleading rescue, from the haunting darkness
My heart craves for Your Bliss
Darkness has stretched everywhere
Leaving no space for Light
I fear this endless gloom
Road to Liberation is blocked
Huge impediments, stand between You and me
Like the great wall of China
How shall I reach You?
Floating in the sea of uncertainty
I still cling to my unbeaten faith
Holding It amid the absolute darkness
My dauntless faith, continues to pray
That, Your Light will ultimately conquer

source_fields.captured_title: मेरी खिड़की के बाहर की दुनिया
source_fields.body_html:
मेरी खिड़की के बाहर की दुनिया
कितनी असली कितनी नकली
कितनी रंगीन कितनी रंगहीन
जैसे हो बोगेनवेलिया के फूल
दूर से खूबसूरत
पास से गंधहीन और कागज़ी
कहीं बहुमंज़िला इमारतें
कहीं झोपड़ियों के सिसकते
दरकते आहते
न कोई समाजवाद
न कोई रामराज
न कोई भी समानता का अधिकार
बहुआयामी दुनिया
बहुआयामी लोग
पर खिड़की के भीतर भी
क्या दुनिया चिरपरिचित और समान है
यहाँ भी तो द्वंद है
यहाँ भी युद्ध है
कुछ परिवार में
कुछ स्वयं के स्व से
मन की खिड़की के भीतर भी
एक अलग दुनिया विचरती है
जो शायद , इससे भी विस्तृत और अनन्त है
कई बह्मांड को समेटे
मन की दुनिया के मकान अजबोग़ज़ब हैं
जिनकी खिड़की को बंद करना मुश्किल भरा काम है
क्योंकि इच्छाओं, अभिलाषाओं की अंधडनुमा हवा
बार बार इसे खोल देती है
और मन तो चाहतों का गुलाम है
फिर भटकता इसी के हिसाब से
दुनियावी प्रपंची हवा से हिलोरें खाता मन
अपनी ही दुनिया में भटकता है
इस पर चिटकनी लगाना आसान तो नहीं
पर दृश्य जगत को आत्मसात कर
उसके सृजन को प्रणाम कर
आत्मविलीन होना और मन पर विजय हासिल कर
आत्म साक्षात्कार करना ही परम लक्ष्य है।

At night waves of words come
from the shores of your books,
all frothing in meanings
with the foam of feelings.

I scoop up an ocean
in the cup of my mind,
you can hear the lapping
on the sands of my being.

Early in the morning
when I wake up I find
in the waves of my dreams
our wavelengths were one.

Nestled on branches hanging low
Heavy with the load they carry
Drooping like golden chandeliers
Are the gentle flowers of summers

Competing with the sun…
Shining on Earth
Brighter by the day
As the sun`s chariot races
Across the skies of May.

My heart swirled anew
Seeing the flowers bedecked
In their golden finery…
Like stately men in silken robes.
The same that Lord Ram saw blooming…

Awed he stood by the golden flowering
Near the hermitage of Sage Matanga
In the mountains of Rishyamukha
On his way to seek help from Sugriv
On his quest to rescue Sita.

Sugriv, the brother
Banished by Bali
For assuming the throne
When he didn`t return for 28 months
After entering a cave to fight Mayavi demon.

Sugriv, who sought refuge
in the mountains of Rishyamukha,
Where Bali was forbidden to enter by Sage Matanga
For polluting the ashram with a slain demon`s blood.
And the Amaltas flowered on Rishyamukha…

a seed burst
a tiny life twirled forth
soaking in the sun
fed by wet soil
with the playful wind
goat bleats, chomps…
one life ends to sustain another

a brush moves over a pot
smearing art to utility

the hand that paints
the hand that creates
comes together in prayer
humble in heart
for it knows
action sees completion
only
when the creator of all creations
complies!

source_fields.captured_title: AGE CAN BE WASHED LIKE A GARMENT
source_fields.body_html:
Age too, after washing like a garment
has to be dried
on the ropes of life

But if the age itself is older
than the garments
Then the soap`s foam
must turn into a peacock`s feather,
And the body must be cleansed
with the handkerchief of mind

But if the garment itself
has reached its age
Then, separating the threads
of the worn-out garment,
like bathing a child lightly with hands,
it needs to be cleansed
And weaving with a needle, with love,
the patches need to be stitched again
And, at the final moment of soap,
it needs to be handed over to
the waves of the mind

And, to the evening
waiting on the shore,
the tired day of life
needs to be surrendered
forever, with pleasure

This is nirvana
This is salvation.

You cry, laugh, feel, smile;
Do a lot that`s worthwhile
Because you`re a magical being,
Truly mystical human being.

You make everyday count;
Every moment without discount
Because you know life`s precious,
Everything`s auspicious.

Kindness, matchless as no other;
Like that of a mother or brother.
This gift of caring for each other,
Is the best, mankind has ever!

At times, it`s true we fall
From divine attributes and all;
Yet, that`s what makes us human,
Humble men and women.

We see in each other wisdom,
Forgiveness, care and freedom.
Through each virtue we give,
A heaven on earth we live!

Noakhali is a landmine in her memory
that only reels backward. Sits like a

land spreading its river of sorrow. A land
thrice partitioned. Each time she shuts

her eyes, a trail like breadcrumbs of fear lead
her back. What happened to Zoya, my

daughter? Who knows who took her away?
Who knows where she sleeps? And her

brother? What have you done to them? Who`ll
bring my message to them? In the naked

sunlight of a Kolkata camp, she sits, sticking to
the lamppost, like a flapping poster. Draping

a hand over her breasts. Raped, like her land.

Nameless, counting the scars of hell. The stories
she saved from 1971, knotted at the end of her

sari squeezed into the tiniest of knots. Lest she
may forget. Stories of people gone missing.

Like the lace torn off the hem of her grey petticoat.
Gone. Disappeared in a gaping hole.

Killed like mosquitoes. Countless times, she murmurs
the names of every single lost soul.

A database of death. Lives torn to bits, reduced to figures.
Like the abandoned pages of history,

long archived. Refusing acknowledgement. Her abused
flesh knows no hope of escape. It sits like

a stringless, torn kite, forever exiled on the tramlines.

You dear poet,
you, with whom I walk empty streets
and Yet
we found no one to cry with, cry on-
You,
who never slept on broken park benches,
curled in hunger,
or anger
walked till the last drop of water dried in railway platforms-
you, who never screamed,
cried out loud,
wept for another-

Who, where, why and how, did we walk out of each other?

All around me,
this great restraint,
this white, harsh dreamlessness,
this immense propensity at indifference-

I begin and end with madness,
and like Poppy seeds fall asleep, deep-
without germination, water, or hope.

No song here that I haven`t heard ,
no truth
no love
no running wild
no madness
no searching eyes
no anger
no peace
no change
no solitude
no walks
no failures
as if a mountain had walked within us,
while you and I, we slept.

Unfinished, dear poet,
We

I wish to hold more than one branches of
The Olive tree into the hollow of my
Closed palm to distribute them amongst
The bloodthirsty wolves in the garb of humans;

I long to hold white doves into my
Lap and ask them to fly in the
War zones and the strife- torn areas
Where the citizens live in constant fear;

I want to bring peace into this world,
But every time I miss my target;
Neither the Olive branches nor the
White doves are able to perform miracles;

One fine morning I realized that the peace
Can only be achieved by the people 
Involved,  by holding each-other`s hands,
In the unbreakable bonds of love.

ଆଗରୁ ମୋ ଖଟରେ ଶୋଇଲେ
ମୋତେ ଆକାଶ ଦେଖୁଥିଲା
ଓ ଆକାଶକୁ ଦେଖୁଥିଲି ମୁଁ ।

ଏତିକି ଥିଲା ସମ୍ପର୍କ,
ଏକୁଟିଆ ବେଳାରେ
ପରସ୍ପରକୁ ଦେଖୁଥିଲୁ ଆମେ ।

ମୁଁ ଦେଖୁଥିଲି ସକାଳର ଆକାଶୀ ନୀଳ
ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାର ଲାଲ,
ରାତିର ଅନ୍ଧାର, ଜହ୍ନ, ତାରା
ଓ ଖସୁଥିବା ଉଲକା,
ସେ ଦେଖୁଥିଲା କିଛି ଅଡୁଆ ଗାରରେ ଅଙ୍କା
ଦୁର୍ବୋଧ୍ୟ ଚିତ୍ର ପରି ଖଟରେ ପଡିଛି ଜଣେ ।

ମୁଁ ଦେଖୁଥିଲି କେବେ ଉଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ
ତ କେବେ ପଲେ ଚଢ଼େଇ,
କେବେ ସେଉଠୁ ଡୁଙ୍ଗି ମାରି ଜହ୍ନ ଅନଉଥିଲା ମୋତେ,
କେବେ ଲମ୍ବା ଅପରାହ୍ନର ବିରକ୍ତ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟ
ମୋ ଖଟର ତେଲାଣିରେ
ତା` ତତଲା ଲମ୍ବା ପିତ ପାତିଆରେ ଭାଜୁଥିଲା ମୋତେ ।

କେବେ ସେଇ ଆକାଶୀ ନିରୋଳା କାନଭାସରେ
ସୁନେଲି ଡେଣାର ପଲେ ଉଡ଼ନ୍ତା ପରୀ
କିଏ ଜଣେ ଆଙ୍କିଦେଉଥିଲା
ଗୋଟେ କଳା ଲୋମଶ ହାତ,
ପୃଥିବୀରୁ ଲମ୍ବି ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ଧରିଲା ବେଳକୁ
ଅଧ ରାତିରେ ମୋ ନିଦ ଭାଙ୍ଗୁଥିଲା ।

ସେ ଆକାଶ ଆଉ ଦିଶୁନି
ଛିଡି ଯାଇଛି ସବୁ ସମ୍ପର୍କ
ଏବେ ଆମ ଦୁହିଁଙ୍କ ମଝିରେ
ଇର୍ଷାଳୁ ପଡୋଶିନୀର ଅସନା ବୋଳା
ଡେଙ୍ଗା କାନ୍ଥ।

ଆଜିକାଲି ମୋ ଖଟରେ ଶୋଇ
ସାରା ଦିନ, ସାରା ରାତି
ସେଇ ଅସନା ଚି଼ହ୍ନଙ୍କ ବଦଳୁଥିବା ରୂପ ମୁଁ ଦେଖୁଛି
ବିଛଣାରେ ପଡ଼ି ସେ କାନ୍ଥରେ ମନେ ମନେ
ଜହ୍ନ, ତାରା ଚଢ଼େଇ,ମଣିଷ ଓ ପରୀମାନଙ୍କ ସହ
ଉଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ, ଉଲକା
ଓ ତମ ମୁହଁର ଚିତ୍ର ଯାହା ଆଙ୍କୁଚି ।

କାନ୍ଥକୁ ଆକାଶ କରିଛି।

ଦିନସାରା ଏ ଆଲୁଅ
କୁଆଡେ କୁଆଡେ ମିଳେଇ ଯାଏ

କୋଡିଏ ବର୍ଷ ପରେ ହାରିଯାଇ
କିଏ ଜଣେ ଅଦାଲତରୁ ଫେରେ

ଟ୍ରେନ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେଲା ପରେ କାହାର କେଜାଣି
ସେଇସବୁ ଲୁହ ମନେ ପଡେ

ଧୂଳି ଉଡେଇ ଉଡେଇ ଢେର ରାତିରେ
ଆମ ଗାଆଁ ବୁଢ଼ା ଟ୍ରେକରଟା ଫେରେ

ସେଇସବୁ ଫୁଲ ଭିତରେ
ଶବ ଭଳିଆ କଣ ସବୁ ଦେଖାଯାଏ

କେଉଁଠି କେଉଁଠି କଣ ପାଇଁ କେଜାଣି
କିଏ ଖାଲି କାହାକୁ ଦିନରାତି ଡାକେ

ରାସ୍ତା ପାର ହେଉ ହେଉ ଏ ଜି ଛକରେ
ଛୁଆଟି ପବ୍ଲିକଠାରୁ ଅହରହ ଗାଳି ଶୁଣେ

ଏଇମିତି ଘଟଣା ଭିତରେ
ବୋଉ ମରିଯାଇଛି ତିନିଦିନ ତଳେ

ମୁଁ ଅଯୋଧ୍ୟାକୁ ଜାଣେ
ସେଇଠି କେବେ ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ହୁଏନାହିଁ
ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ହେବା କଥା ନୁହେଁ ।

ସହସ୍ର ବାରଣ ରେଖା ଡେଇଁ
ଚାଷବାସ ସାରି
କେହି ଧର୍ମ ଅର୍ଥ କାମ ମୋକ୍ଷ ଚର୍ଚ୍ଚା କରେ
କେହି ବସେ ତପସ୍ୟାରେ
ମୃତ୍ଯୁକୁ ଖାତିର ନକରି ।

ନଗରର ପଥ ଗଳି ଦ୍ବାର ଦ୍ବାର ବୁଲି
କବିତାକୁ ସଂଗୀତ କରି
ଅପମାନିତ ମାଆ ପାଇଁ ନ୍ଯାୟ
ମାଗିପାରନ୍ତି ବାଳୁତ ତନୟ ।

ରାଜପୁରର ଲୋଭ ଖୋଲାମେଲା ପଡିଥାଏ
ପ୍ରଜାମାନଂକ ଆଗରେ
ସେମାନଙ୍କ ପକ୍ଷ ଥାଏ
ଖଣ୍ଡିଏ ଲୁଗାରେ ସିଂହାସନ ଛାଡି ଚାଲିଯାଉଥିବା
ଯୋଗ୍ଯ ନରନାରୀଙ୍କ ସହ।

ଅଯୋଧ୍ୟାର ଭବିଷ୍ୟତ ପାଇଁ
ହୀନବଳ ପକ୍ଷୀଟିଏ ବି ଯୁଝିଯାଏ
ବାହୁବଳୀ ତ୍ରିପୁର ବିଜୟୀ ସହ ।

ଜୟ କି ପରାଜୟ
ଗୋଟିଏ ଗୋଟିଏ ଶବ୍ଦ ସହ
ଶେଷ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ ଯେଉଁଠି
ତାର ନାମ ହିଁ ଅଯୋଧ୍ୟା ।

source_fields.body_html:
ନୂଆ କରି ଉଡ଼ି ଶିଖୁଥିବା
ପକ୍ଷୀର ଶାବକ, କି ଜାଣେ ??
ଦିଗନ୍ତ ବିସ୍ତାରି ଆକାଶଟା
କେତେ ଉଚ୍ଚ, କେତେ ଅପହଞ୍ଚ !!

କିଚିରି ମିଚିରି ହେଇ
ଉଡୁଥାଏ ଯେତିକି
ସେତିକି ଗଛ ଡାଳରେ କ୍ଳାନ୍ତ !!

ନୀଡ଼ ପାଇଁ ଘାସ ଗୁଳ୍ମରୁ
ସାଉଁଟିଲା ବେଳେ କୁଟାକାଠି
କୁନି ଶାବକର ଚପଳାମି
ଦେଖୁଥାଏ ମା` ପକ୍ଷୀ

ପତ୍ରଟିଏ ଝଡ଼ିଗଲେ
କେଉଁ ଶିକାରୀ ଧନୁରୁ ତୀରଟିଏ ଭାବି
କେଉଁ ଅଜଣା ଶଙ୍କାରେ
ଡ଼ରୁଥାଏ, ମରୁଥାଏ ମା` ମନ !!

କ୍ରମେ ବଡ଼ ହେଇଯାଏ କୁନି ଶାବକ
ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ଥଂଟରେ ତା`
ପରିପକ୍ଵ ଫଳ ପରି ଦିଶେ ପୃଥିବୀ
ଶକ୍ତ ପଞ୍ଝାରେ ତା`
କ୍ଷୁଦ୍ରାତିକ୍ଷୁଦ୍ର ଗ୍ରହ ଓ ନକ୍ଷତ୍ର !!

ଇଚ୍ଛା ହେଲେ ଆକାଶକୁ
ଫୁର୍ କିନା ଉଡ଼ିଯାଏ
ମେଘ ନଈରେ ଦେହ ଧୁଏ
ଦୂର ଦିଗବଳୟକୁ ଭାବିନିଏ
ପାଚିଲା ମାଣ୍ଡିଆ କ୍ଷେତ

ଅପହଞ୍ଚ ବୋଲି କିଛି ନାହିଁ
ପକ୍ଷୀର ଜୀବନେ
ହଳେ ଡେଣାରେ ତା`
ଅମାପ ଶକ୍ତି ଓ ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟ !!

ଏବେ ଏବେ ଅରମା ବଣରୁ
କୁଟାକାଠି ସାଉଁଟି ଗଢ଼ି ଶିଖିଲାଣି
ମନ ଲାଖି ନୀଡ଼

ଶିଖି ବି ଗଲାଣି
ଝଡ଼ ମୁହଁକୁ ପିଠି କରି
କେମିତି ଜୀଇଁବାକୁ ହୁଏ ??

କେତେ ମାଇଲ୍ ଦୂରତାରେ
କ୍ଷେତ, ବଣ, ନଈ
କେତେ ଫୁଟ୍ ଉଚ୍ଚତାରେ
ସୁଉଚ୍ଚ ପାହାଡ଼ !!

ନୂଆ ନୀଡ଼ରେ ତା`
ସାଥି ସହ କିଚିରି ମିଚିରି
ହଳେ ପକ୍ଷୀ ଶାବକ

ଖଣ୍ଡି ଉଡ଼ା ଦେଇ
ଆକାଶକୁ ଉଡ଼ିଗଲା ବେଳେ
ଆକଟ ଛଳରେ କହିପାରେ ନାହିଁ
ଦିଗନ୍ତ ବିସ୍ତାରି ଆକାଶଟା
କେତେ ଉଚ୍ଚ, କେତେ ଅପହଞ୍ଚ !!

ଗୋଟେ ପୃଥିବୀ ତ ଛାଡ଼
ଉଡାଣ ଖୋର୍ ପକ୍ଷୀ ପାଇଁ
କାଳ କାଳ ନିଅଣ୍ଟ ପଡ଼େ
ଚଉଦ ବ୍ରହ୍ମାଣ୍ଡ !!!!!!

ଦେଖ,
ଏଇଠି କୋଉଠି
ନୀରବରେ ନିର୍ବିକାରରେ
ମାଟିରେ ମିଶୁଛି ମୋ ଦେହ

କିଏ କହୁଛି ମୋତେ-

ତୁମେ ଯୁଦ୍ଧର ଡାକରା ଦେଉଛ ତ ?
ଟିକେ ରହିଯାଅ,
କିଛିକ୍ଷଣ ପାଇଁ
ଏ ଭୋକିଲା ମାଟିରେ
ଚିତ୍ରାୟିତ ହେଉ
ଅନ୍ନର ପରାଜୟ......
ଅଟକିଯାଉ ରଥଚକ
ଭୋକର ଦଲ୍ ଦଲ୍ ରେ,

ଅଧର୍ଯ୍ୟ ହେଇପାରିବା ବି
ଶିଖିନିଅ ତୁମେ,

ଶିଖିନିଅ କେଇ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତ ପାଇଁ
ମନ୍ତ୍ର ଭୁଲି ପାରିବାର
ଅମୂର୍ତ୍ତ କୈାଶଳ.....!!

ଏଥର ଉଠିଆସ ନିଜ ମୃତ୍ୟୁରୁ
ଜନ୍ମକୁ ଫୋପାଡିଦେଇ ଆସ
ଗୋଟିଏ ଭୋକିଲା ଦେହ ପରି
ଶସ୍ୟ କ୍ଷେତ ଧାରରେ.....!!

ବିବ୍ରତ ମୁଁ-
ସବୁ ଧୂଳିକଣାରେ
ଟୁକୁଡା ଟୁକୁଡା ମୁହଁ ମୋର

କିଏ ଗଢୁଛି ମୋତେ
ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତ ପରେ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତ ?

ପୁରୁଣା କ୍ୟାଲେଣ୍ଡର ଭଳି
କୋଉଠି ହୁଏତ ଟଙ୍ଗା ହେଉଛି ମୁଁ
ଗଚ୍ଛିତ ରହୁଛି ମୋର
ରଦ୍ଦି ନିଶ୍ୱାସ..

ନିଆଁରେ ନଈରେ
ଧର୍ମରେ ଧ୍ୱନୀରେ
ଚିତ୍କାରରେ ବିକାରରେ
ଲହପି ପଡୁଛି
ଯୁଗ ଯୁଗରୁ ବିସର୍ଜିତ ମୋ ଦେହ

ତଥାପି ରହିଯାଉଛି ତୃଟି
ଭୋକରେ ଭରିଯାଉଛି
ଶୂନ୍ୟସ୍ଥାନ....

କେହି ଯେମିତି
ଗୋଲ ଗୋଲ ଦିଗ୍ବଳୟକୁ ଗୁନ୍ଥି
ଓଟାରି ଆଣିବାକୁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ
ପାଚିଲା କମଳା ପରି
ସକାଳର କଅଁଳ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟ

ତଥାପି,
ଭୋକ କବଳିତ ମୋ ଆଁ`ରେ
ତୁମକୁ ଦିଶିଲା ବ୍ରହ୍ମାଣ୍ଡ

ମୋର ଦୋଷ କଣ ମା`
ଯଦି
ମୋତେ ବାରମ୍ବାର ଡାକେ
ମାଟି ରଂଗର ଭୋକ.........!!

ସମଗ୍ର ଆୟୁଷ୍କାଳର
ସଞ୍ଚିତ ଭଲ ପାଇବା ନେଇ
ପହଞ୍ଚି ଥିଲ ହଠାତ୍
ସବୁ ସ୍ମୃତିର ସଞ୍ଚରଣକୁ
ଅନ୍ତ କରି ଫେରିଗଲ
ଗୋଟିଏ ଜନ୍ମର ଇତିହାସରୁ
ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାହୃତ ହୋଇ।
ଆସି ନଥିଲେ ହୁଏତ କବିତାଟି
ଶେଷ ପାଦ ଆଗରୁ ସରି ଯାଇଥାନ୍ତା
ସରିବ ସରିବ ହୋଇ।
ନ ଆସିଥିଲେ
ଅଭିମାନର ପାଉଁଶ ଉପରେ
ଅପେକ୍ଷି ରହିଥାନ୍ତି
ଲିଭି ଯାଇଥିବା ଧୂପର
ଅବଶିଷ୍ଟ କାଠିଟିଏ ହୋଇ।

मुद्दत बाद जो याद किया हमें
यूँ लगा डूबते को सहारा दिया तुमने
कभी सोचो कैसे गुजारे लम्हे तेरे बिना
तेरे बिना भी तेरे साथ जिया हमने।
¬¬¬
हवा के झोंके के संग आते और पोर-पोर उतर जाते
सदियों बीत गये तुम्हारी ख़ुशबू को महसूस किए
वक्त के साथ हवाओं का भी रुख़ बदल दिया तुमने
क्या जानो एक-एक पल बिन तुम्हारे कैसे गुजारी हमने।

ख़फ़ा हैं हम तुमसे भी संगदिल और ख़ुदा से भी
सिद्दत से इश्क किया, इश्क को खुदा माना हमने
फिर हमसे हमारे ख़ुदा को ही गुमनाम किया तुमने
क्या जानो एक-एक पल बिन तुम्हारे कैसे गुजारी हमने।

करवट लेते - लेते गुज़रती हैं मेरी हर रात
बिस्तर पर तन्हाईयां है और है तुम्हारी बात
मोहब्बत में न जाने कौन सी सजा दी है तुमने
की बहते अश्कों में भी तुम्हें देखा है हमने।

फिर चलो उस नीड़ में
जो सुकून की चादर ओढे हो
नर्म बिस्तर हँसी खुशी का
और रिश्तों की तसल्ली समेटे हो
पर घोसलें अब एकाकी हैं
रिश्ते अब बेमानी हैं
सबका अपना जीवन है
जो ख़ुद को खुद में समेटे हैं
एक ही घर में
हज़ारों चाहरदीवारियाँ हैं
हर इंसान मैं का लबादा ओढ़े है
कुढ़ता है, गर्मी से जलता है
चिड़चिडेपन की खुजली से परेशान है
पर फिर भी उस पैबन्द लबादे से बेहिंतया प्यार है
खुद को खुदा समझता है
पर मन ही मन खुदा से डरता है
बाहर से बेबाक , बेख़ौफ़
पर अंदर से डरा , बेजार है
सबके अपने अपने देशी विदेशी इलाज हैं
पर फिर भी लाचार है
सबके अपने जीने के अकडू नुस्खे हैं
बहुत ही कैद है हर शख्स
अपने बनाये अहम के बाड़ों में
पर बनता बहुत आज़ाद ख़याल है
ये सुकड़ी मुकडी ख्यालो के पोथियों में
दिमाग खपाता आदम जात
प्यार और हमदर्दी का भूखा तो बहुत है
पर फिर भी अकड़ की गुफा में बैठा
बहुत ही अकेला , बीमार और गमजदा है।

Where did those days go?
TIME - flew like a river
In it we went with the flow
Reflecting our moments like a mirror.

Days of sunshine and laughter
Blessed us with all fruits
Did not stay the same forever,
Calmness and patience found its routes.

Life came with all its twists and turns
Closed ones` journey to the other end
Gave us blows and burns
With it wisdom embraced us at every bend.

We pray to the Almighty
To keep us safe and sound
He is the One so mighty,
In Him the safest abode we found.

He is our guiding light
Protecting us in every form
He is there to make our lives bright
Helping us go through every storm.

At noon, where light stretches long,
I search for my shadow, elusive in the blaze.
The sun, relentless, denies me shade,
leaving me alone with the ground`s glare.

On asphalt streets, heat ripples,
waves distorting the space I should occupy.
Beneath the peepal`s whispering leaves,
even there, no dark twin follows.

In mirrors, I seek a trace,
but they mock me with hollow reflections.
The grass, seared yellow, offers no cover,
no hint of the familiar silhouette.

I wander, tracing steps in circles,
as if the sun itself consumes my presence.
Ghosts of yesterday linger in memory,
a fleeting glimpse of what once was.

If I am shadowless, who am I?
The earth turns, pulling light with it,
while I remain, a sunlit wanderer,
searching for the lost part of my being.

Evening will come, soft and forgiving,
and maybe then, in twilight`s embrace,
I`ll find my shadow again,
and know myself whole once more.

There is a skeleton of a serpent
Covering itself with an ant-hill.
Inside are many small holes
in which ants are humming silently.
Slough, grains, tiny insects:
All are shining in the darkness of the skeleton.
In the mouth of an ant
Clusters of stars emerge.
Ant-hills melt down to its every crack.
In the swirl of sands, under the refuge of the skeleton,
the swarms of ants disapear.
In everybody`s mouth
the grains shine by the rays
Luminous, Luminous!

A black veil frequently engulfs us
aeon after aeon, as pods are captive
inside the hull,as albumen-yolks are
confined within the sophisticated shell.
light always intrudes inside the caliginous
sphere, excellent! so indigenous, so true.

O is the circle,inside it,lives are struggling
in a criterion complex way.The debutant
creation started from the mother`s womb
to expose themselves with delighted petals,
as the truth stepped out in the true illustration.

Enormous astounding features depict
in our retina, and churn us with euphoric
zeal.It plunges us into a massive colored deluge
that encircles us with vibrant cyan,
which always kisses us so affectionately.

In the physique`s core, darkness mingles
into dark, but outer chilly breeze makes us
electrify. That impulse urges us to break
through the cranium to cerebrum and become
familiar with the effervescent world.

green to golden apple, golden orange,
yellow to golden sphere--
all are buoying on the coloured waves
in our yellowish retina,
that trait our life, aeon after aeon.

The telephone lines that carried your voice,
Are now nesting ground for tailor and weaver birds,
All my thrills of being on the other end beyond my choice,
Now trills of their songs getting drowned with engines frightening the herds!

All the cables that infiltrate the space of earth,
Encroaching upon the privacy of tiny creatures in the soil,
That brought your laughter to my ears renewing my birth,
Now entrenched in invisible fields afar, in a circular coil.

All the decades of words that chiseled themselves to articulate,
As conversations volleying love at times inexpressible,
Tense like taut elastic bands that snap at our silence opiate,
Waking us from a reverie of our drunkenness with each other in a fable!

It doesn`t really matter as our lines are duly embedded,
Beyond the telephone lines and cables under oceans,
We have verbalized having lived promises that superseded,
Our words the very witnesses of thoughts sedimented through life`s decantations.

And conversations are now silent moments of our hands feeling each others` pulse.. Till time stops in another dimension..

Someday If I go away from you
Donot blame me
Rather regret your self
For not being able to
Keep me with you.
If I never come back again
Then also donot blame me
But blame your self
For not being able to
Bring me back.
Our life is like that
We donot know
Who will come
Who will go away from our life
But the past days
Remain as a sweet memory in every one`s heart.

You all caught me wrong.
I have not yet told you
about this pain.
It`s too deep than the sea.
You deceive yourself by my wily smile.

It is the messy trap
to cover the scary pit
deep inside my heart

You have not seen
the grave damages of my body.
You can see the imposing pics
that I intently show you all.

You have not seen the pain
that every time slithers into my veins
Knowingly I bury them
in the deep dark silent regions

You have not seen the anger
boiling inside my mind
As I manage to mould them into my laughter

You all are not acquainted with my pain
that is blowing like a hurricane
`whirling around` to
shatter the opposition!

Martha had high hopes
Grand dreams and tall ambitions.
To touch the clouds
To sail on yachts.
To roam around in Venice
To dine with the celebrities
To buy entire supermarkets
To study in Oxford
To ride in lavish cars
To drink the richest wine
To play an electric guitar
To have the most fruitful garden
To wear the latest clothes
To be the talk of the town
To smell like the richest woman
To purchase fancy flowers
To have a whole library
To wear the costliest diamonds
To own a mansion and
To eat exotic dishes.

But the more she tried to
Sail on a luxury cruise,
Fate intervened to show
That hers was a paperboat.

source_fields.captured_title: The mystery of the missing tomato
source_fields.body_html:
A tomato was lost in the International Space Station.
A part of an experiment of air and water grown techniques in plants.
Frank Rubio the astronaut was blamed.
Being in the longest single spaceflight was his claim to fame.
An important scientific research sample was missing.
NASA was desperate to find it out.
Rubio was proud to harvest the first tomato in space.
But it was also his cause of disgrace.
A very special tomato disappeared.
Rubio searched and searched in the 365 feet long space station.
But the precious tomato could not be found.
The one- of- a kind tomato was not around.
At last another astronaut found the tomato.
Jasmin Moghbeli cleared the name of Rubio.
So the tomato was not eaten by him.
It`s a true story although a sci-fi story it might seem.

source_fields.captured_title: ମୁଁ ଯେତିକି ଭୋଗୁଛି ତୋ ଭାଗରେ ତା ଠାରୁ କମ୍ ପଡୁ ଖରା
source_fields.body_html:
ଖବର ଆସିଛି
ତୋ ସହରର ତାପମାତ୍ରା
ଗତ କାଲିଠାରୁ ଅଢେଇ ଡିଗ୍ରୀ କମ୍ ଅଛି
ଯାହା ହେଉ ,ମୋ ପ୍ରାର୍ଥନା ଠାକୁର ଶୁଣିଛି.

ଆମ ସାନ ସହରଟିର ନାମ
ବାରମ୍ବାର ଲେଖା ହେଉଚି ଟିଭି ପରଦାରେ
ନାଲି ହରଫରେ।

ସଂଜ ହେବା ଆଗରୁ ,ପାଉଁଶ
ସବୁ , ମଲ୍ଲିକଢ଼
କୃଷ୍ଣଚୁଡ଼ା ଗଛ ତଳେ ଗଦା ଗଦା
ଲୋଚାକୋଚା ଦରଫୁଟା ଫୁଲ
ଇଏ କିଛି ବିରହୀ ଯକ୍ଷର ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା ନୁହେଁ
ଆମର ଏଠି ସତସତିକା
ଗଛର ଚେରରୁ ଧୂଆଁ ଉଠୁଚି .

ବାଲ୍ କୌନିରେ ପାଣି ରଖିଥିଲା ମାଆ
ମାଟି ପାତ୍ରରେ
ଅଥଚ ଆଜିବି ଆସିଲେ ନାହିଁ ସେମାନେ ,
ପାଞ୍ଚ ଦିନର ଅପେକ୍ଷା ପରେ
ବାପାଙ୍କର ଆଶଙ୍କା
ହୁଏତ ସେମାନେ ପହଞ୍ଚି ଗଲେଣି
ଏଠାକୁ ଆଉ ଫେରି ନ ପାରିବାର ଦୂରତାରେ।

ଆହା,ସେହି ଚଢ଼େଇ ପନ୍ଝା
ତୋ ବାଲ୍ କୌନିରେ ପାଣି ପିଉଥାନ୍ତେ କି
ଆଜି ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାରେ ।

ଜାଣୁ,ନିଦ ନ ଥିବା ରାତି ମଝିରେ
ଗତ କାଲି
ମୁହାଁ ମୁହିଁ ହେଇଗଲି,ଗୋଟେ ମଧ୍ୟାହ୍ନର
ନଈ ମଝିରେ ବାଲି ଖୋଳୁଥିଲା
ଝାଳ ଲଟପଟ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟ
ନିଜର ବିମ୍ବ ଟିକୁ ସେଇଠୀ କୋଉଠି ହଜେଇ ଦେଇଛି
ସେ ଲିଭିଗଲା ପରେ ଜାଣିଲି
ବହୁତ୍ ଦିନରୁ ମୋର ଅନାମିକାରେ
ଗୋଟେ ଦରପୋଡ଼ା ସ୍ବପ୍ନ କୁ
ମୁଁ ମୁଦି କରି ପିନ୍ଧିଚି.

ଅଜାଡ଼ି ହେଇ ପଡ଼ୁଚି ମାଳମାଳ ତାତିଲା ଢେଉ.

ଭୟ ଲାଗୁଚି ଯେ
ତୁ ଯଦି ଚାଲି ଚାଲି ରାସ୍ତା ପାରି ହେଇ ଯାଉ
ମୋ ସାମ୍ନାରେ
ତଥାପି ବି
ତତେ ଚିହ୍ନି ପାରିବି ବୋଲି କହି ପାରୁନି
ଏପ୍ରିଲର ଆଲୁଅ
ସକାଳ ହେବା ଆଗରୁ
ଅନ୍ଧାର ଭରି ଦେଉଚି ମୋ ଆଖିରେ
ମୁଁ ମିଛରେ ମିଛରେ ଖୁସି ହେଉଚି
ଠିଆ ହେଇଚି ବୋଲି
ତୁ ଏଠୁ ଚାଲିଯିବା ଦିନ ଠାରୁ
ତୋ ସହରର ଟ୍ରାଫିକ ଛକରେ।

ଏବେ କାଳରାତ୍ରିର ଅବସାନ ।
ତଥାପି ଆକାଶରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ତାରା ଖୁବ ଏକଲା
ଆକାଶଗଙ୍ଗାରୁ ମୁହଁ ଫେରାଇ ସେ ଗଢ଼ିନେଲା
ନିଜର ଏକ ଅଲଗା ବ୍ରହ୍ମାଣ୍ଡ ।
ଆହା..!
ତାରା କଣ ଜାଣିଥିଲା ?
ଦିନେ ଉଲକା ପରି ନିଃଶେଷ ହୋଇ
ପୃଥିବୀରେ ପତିତ ହେବା
ତା` କପାଳରେ ଲେଖାଥିଲା ?

ହଠାତ ବିରାମ ଚିହ୍ନ ପାଲଟୁଥିବା ସେ ଅବଶେଷକୁ ମୁଁ ପଚାରେ
ଦୁଇ ନିଟୋଳ ଓଠ ଖୋଲି ଦମ୍ଭିଲାପଣରେ ସେ ଉତ୍ତର ବାଢେ
ସବୁକିଛି ପରିସମାପ୍ତି ପରେ ମଧ୍ୟ
ମୁଁ ତ ସେଇ
ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣଚ୍ଛେଦ ପରର ଆଶାୟୀ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ସୂଚକଟିଏ

ସେ ଦିନ ସବୁ ତ
ଏମିତି ନଥିଲା ଲୋ ବୋଉ
ତୁ ମୋ ମଥା ଉପରେ
ହାତ ରଖୁରଖୁ
ନିଦ ମାଉସୀର ଲମ୍ବା ପଣତ ଭିତରେ
ଯେଉଁ ଅନ୍ଧାର ତକ ମୁଁ ସାଉଁଟି ଆଣୁଥିଲି ସକାଳ ଯାଏଁ
ସେଠି ଥିଲା ତାରା,ଜହ୍ନ
ଆଉ କାମିନୀ ଫୁଲ ମାନଙ୍କ ମହକ।।

ଏବେ ଏତେ ଅନ୍ଧାର ଯେ
ମୁଁ ବାରବାର ଝୁଣ୍ଟିବା ପରେ
ଅବଶ ଲାଗେ ସତ
ହେଲେ ଅନ୍ଧାର ଭିତରେ
ନିଦ ମାଉସୀର ପଣତ ଯେ
ଉଡିଉଡି ଯାଉଥାଏ କାହିଁ କେତେ ଦୂରକୁ।
ମୁଁ ଧାଉଁଥାଏ ତା ପଛରେ
ବିନା ଜହ୍ନ ଆଲୁଅରେ,
ଫୁଲର ବାସ ନୁହଁ
ଗୋଟେ ଆଇଁଷିଣିଆ ଗନ୍ଧରେ
ଅଣନିଃଶ୍ଵାସୀ ହୋଇ ପଡିବା ବେଳେ
ହଠାତ ମୁଁ ଦର୍ପଣକୁ ଚାହିଁ ଚମକି ଉଠେ
ମୋ ସାରା ଦେହରୁ ଖାଲି ରକ୍ତ ଝରୁଥାଏ।।

ତୁ ଜାଣୁନା ବୋଉ
ମୁଁ ଏବେଏବେ ଖୋଜିହୁଏ
ଗୋଟେ କୃତ୍ରିମ ଅନ୍ଧାରକୁ
ହଜି ଯାଇଥିବା ନିଦ ମାଉସୀର ପଣତକୁ
ଡ୍ରୟାର ଭର୍ତି ଏଇ ନିଦ ବଟିକା ଭିତରେ।
ତଥାପି ଏ ନିଦ ବଟିକା ମାନେ
ଭିଡି ନିଅନ୍ତି ମୋତେ ଯେବେ
ଗୋଟେ ଗହ୍ୱର ଭିତରକୁ
ସେଇଠି ତୋ ପରି କେହି ଜଣେ ଥାଏ କି!
ସବୁତକ ବଟିକା ଛଡେଇ ନେଇ
ଫୋଫାଡ଼ିଦିଏ ଡଷ୍ଟବିନ୍ କୁ
ଆଉ ଧକ୍କା ମାରି ବାହାର କରିଦିଏ
ମୋତେ ଏ ଗହ୍ୱର ଭିତରୁ!

I stole a quick glance at her,
She looked soft and somber.
Painful tears found their way,
down her weathered cheeks running away.

Suddenly a wide grin
appeared on her face,
She seemed reminiscing
that reduced her ache.

The moon showed off its full splendour,
In that light I could perfectly spot her.

She was preoccupied
thinking of her past,
she only had a scant attention
to me till the last.

There wasn`t any bonding,
there wasn`t any barrier
Don`t know why
my heart melted for her?

To me her emotions were beyond comprehension,
I could see, I could feel but couldn`t mention...

From tomorrow the daily newspaper

My mother used to read regularly

Shall be stopped.

The diapers and bedspreads purchased online

in bulk, shall be returned.

The list of medicenes requisitioned from the chemist

Shall not be sent this month.

The dedicated chair for my mother at the dinning table

Shall fall vacant henceforth.

The wheel chair made ready

for my mother`s limited movement

is folded, stacked on the chaja

as it will never take off.

The physiotherapist shall stop visiting our house

The cheques meant for withdrawal

From my mother`s pension account shall be stale.

The current news on the death my mother

will come out fresh.

The morning sun peeping through the window

Of the room where my mother had lain

Shall stop as the window is not opened.

From morning till we go to bed

Manything would be as usual

But in the morning tea and

In the preparation of lunch

Deliberately some portion

shall remain as leftovers.

Some of my friends shall ask regarding her

And they will express their wonder;

How she without any ailment of old age

Suddenly had passed away

Did she not have the desire to live any more ?
Gradually the time will pass away

And the time we had kept for our mother

Shall no more engage us.

Noboby need to attend her interest to tell

All the stories she has stored for us

By reluctantly listening to them.

We would only hear some sounds

as resounds of her voice in a vacant place

which would be soon forgotten.

Now all other things going on in a routine way

Shall go on without our mother.

When the sinking days of wintry twilights,
Metamorphose into a black curtain,
Jatinga is offered on her platter a vapoury spread.

Swirling fog hang heavy,
Lurking and beckoning you with thick lashes,
The cold chill touches you with a gentle caress,
It offers a feast to the eyes,
The eerie silence and white curls ,
Produces a mysterious sight before the iris.

The green canopy and the Blue hills reverberates a echo ,
As nature basks in exuberance.
The luscious thrill of foggy spells are a savoury spread with sketches of fairy tale sights.

The winding road takes you either uphill or downhill,
Brushing you with wet,slippery strokes
Against your skin,
Particularly your countenance.

The cloud capped hills
Are dressed with cottony fluffs,
And you can find yourself in the lap of cumulus.
White blankets dresses the peaks
And fly slowly.

When you talk of the hills calling,
Barialas the glorified picture is etched in our minds,
Yes,theBarial of Jatinga,
The Barial of DimaHasao,
Whose loving embrace you will cherish.

The serpentine road of Jatinga,
The blurry, virgin fog of Jatinga,
The yonder forest of Jatinga,
Which soaks you in the petals of enthralling serenity,
Erasing the mad rush of time count.

The mellifluous streams drenches you with its ecstatic sprinklers,
The swishing trees emanates whispers , you try to decipher,
Jatinga thus sits blissfully in the throne ,
Of one of the pages of Haflong`s story book,
Showering basketful of tranquility as you approach it`s door.

Time has effaced your face
Long back:
Your comely features waned
Under the sneering sun_
A pallid cluster of
Draught-bitten blooms.
Wildering sum, once,
Girdled your tender form,
You twirled your pen,
Long hence:
You aspired to figure out
The answer.
The flimsy rill of meaning
Ceased its flow.
Then,
You withered away.
On my graceless frame,
Your ebbing pain lingered.
In fear,
I retreated to a dingy shade.
I discarded my pen.
My unkempt notebook yellowed
With an injured heart.
Thus, life continues to remain
An unfathomed sum.

Deaths and the Accountant
An insidious spark of malefic delight
Lo, you could ignite the pyre of light!
Your stern frame had donned
Its dark, longish garb,
Once more:
A transient spell of twisted fun

Those eyes savoured
Handfuls of ashes.
Those fingers wielded
Their numeric crafts
On your precious ledger
Of profit and loss.
A wreckful gust in pride engrossed
And , the last lot of leaves is lost!
Green lives writhe
On the sweltering dust.
Your pen scribbles
On the timeless record
Of profit and loss
Once more:
Your dark, longish garb
Flashes the designs
Of mercantile art.
Ah! You have amassed across ages
The burnt out remanants of lives in pages
Of curated balance sheets:
In the fold of surreptitious sums
Numbers are being caged
Ad continuum.

My breaths do not know your love for me,
digging through the walls of emptiness,
I place my eyes in the gliding distance,
the veins of darkness carve out
my route to the last wall.
Layers of my presence dry slowly
crumbling into the sundried flavors
of the passing months,
paddy fields dance ripened,
drowned in overwhelming monsoon.
Memories wait uprooted,
secrets smile at the sun,
upset nests find a way
out of this flooded freedom.
Hatching space,
forgotten clumsiness under hygiene,
a red ribbon bow ties up my womb
presenting the oldest town of ruins.

Rising from its own ashes,
It lives till eternity.
A living spirit,
Striving to create `the Land of the leal`,
It pushes people to be the ultimate conqueror,
Having vision more than sight,
It adores all but connects with none.
Being blessed with a peculiar sense of seeing the naked truth,

Emerging victorious,

ପଣତରେ ବନ୍ଧା ପ୍ରେମକୁ
ବିଶ୍ଵାସର ଭୂଇଁରେ ପୋତିଲି
ଏ ମେଘ ଭାରି ମିଛେଇ !
ଢ଼ାଳିଲି ଆଞ୍ଜୁଳେ ଆବେଗ ଲୁହ ରକ୍ତ
ପ୍ରେମ ଗଜୁରି ହେବ କି ମୋ` ଜିଇଁବାର ଗୀତ ?

ଜଞ୍ଜାଳମୟ ପୃଥିବୀକୁ ଫେରାଏ ପାଦ
ତେଲ ଲୁଣରେ ଜୁଆଏ ଜୀବନ
ସତରେ ଅନ୍ଧାରର ଆରପାଖ କେଡ଼େ ବିକଳାଙ୍ଗ ମ !

କୋଉ ମହକିଲି
ନା ଜୀବନକୁ ନେଇ ଗୁନ୍ଥି ପାରିଲି ମଲ୍ଲୀର ମାଳ
ଜୀବନ ତ ଜୀବନ ନୁହେଁ
ନିଆଁଲଗା ଗୋଟେ ନିର୍ମମ ଖରାବେଳ !

ଜୀବନ ଜୀବନରେ ଏ ଜୀବନ
ଦେ` ରେ ମୋ` ନିଃଶ୍ୱାସରେ ମୁଠେ ନିର୍ମଳ ପବନ ।

ଏ ଜୀବନକୁ ଭାଗ ଭାଗ କରୁ କରୁ
ସରିଯାଏ ମୁଁ
ସରିଯାଏ ମୁଁ !!

ତୀଖପାହାଡଉପରୁଚାହିଁଦେଖେ
ହାଲ୍କାହାଲ୍କାକିରଣରେଭିଜାଭିଜା
ବାଦାମିରଂଗରମାଟିରଉଜ୍ବଳମୁହଁ

ମୋଭିତରେଫୁଲ, ଗଛ, ମାଟିରଗଂଧ
ଅଛିଆକାଶରଖୋଲାମେଲାଭାବ,
ରତରତସଂଜବେଳରଗୋଲାପୀମୁହଁ।
ଅଛିପୁଣିଦିନମାନଂକୁଶେଷବସ୍ରେ
ବସେଇହାତହଲାଇଫେରିବାରଅଭ୍ୟାସ
ରାତିଂକୁମିଳେଇଯିବାଆଗରୁଚୁମିବାରଆଦତ୍।

ମୋଭିତରେଅଜସ୍ରଲୁହଂକଉଷ୍ନପ୍ରସ୍ରବଣ,
ବର୍ଷାରଛଳଛଳଆଖି, ନିର୍ଜନନଦୀଘାଟରେ
ଉଦାସୀନୌକାରଏକେଲାପଣ, ହତାଶପ୍ରେମିକ
ପରିଅନ୍ୟମନଶ୍କଘୁରୁଥିବାପବନରଛାଇ, ସବୁକିଛି
ଯୋଡିଯାଡିଦବାପରେବିଅକୁଳାଣଅସହାୟଭାବ।

ରଂଗସବୁଂକୁଫେଣ୍ଟିଦେଲେ
ସଫେଦନିର୍ଯ୍ୟାସରେପହଂଚିଯାଏ
ରଂଗ, ରୂପଓଗଂଧ।
ସଫେଦବରଫ, ବଗପକ୍ଷୀରଡେଣା।
ସୁପ୍ତଶାମୁକାରସ୍ଥିରପୃଷ୍ଠଦେଶ
ମୃତ୍ୟୁରଶୀତଳସ୍ପର୍ଶ।

ଉଠି ଆସୁ ଥିବା ଆମ୍ବିଳା ହାକୁଟି
ବତୁରାଇ ଦିଏ
ଅକୁହା କଥାକୁ
ଅଖାଡୁଆ ନିଶ୍ଵାସ
ସୁବିଧା ବାଟ ଦେଇ ଆସେ
ପୁଳା ପବନ ଭିତରେ ଥିଲେ ବି
ବାହାରେ କିଛି ଟା
ଗଣତି ରେ ଗଣି ନିଏ
ଅଗଣିତ ଜାଣିଲେ ବି
ସମୟ କୁ ବୁଣି ଦେବି ସେଥିରେ କିଛି
ବାସି କଥା ସବୁ ସଜାଡି ରଖିଚି କହିବାକୁ
ଶୁଣୁ ଥିବା ବହଳିଆ ଶବ୍ଦକୁ
ଅଜାଡ଼ି ଦେବି କାହା ଆଗରେ
କହି ଦେଇ ଶସ୍ତା କରି
ଶାସ୍ତି ଦେବି କି ନିଜକୁ?
ପ୍ରଶ୍ନର ପୋଷାକ ପିନ୍ଧିଲେ ବି
ଦେହ ର ଚମଡ଼ା ବାହାରି ଆସେ ବାହାରକୁ
ଯାହା ନ ଲୁଚେଇଲେ ବି ଦେଖା ଯାଏ ନି
ଅଲୁଚା ଅକୁହା ହୁଏ,
ଅଦେଖା କୁ ଦେଖି ଦେଲେ ବି
କାଲି ଟା ବେଶି ଜୀବନ୍ତ ଲାଗେ
ସମୟ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ସମୟ କିଛି ଲାଗେ
ବିଗତ ହଉ କି ଆଗତ
ଆଜି ଟା ସଫେଦ ଚାଦର ଭିତର ର ଶବ
ସତେଜ ଲାଗେ କେବଳ
କେବଳ ଆଜି ବୋଲି
କେବଳ ଏବେ ବୋଲି।

ସେ କାଳେ
ତାରାମାନଙ୍କୁ ଅଧରାତିରେ ଛାତକୁ ଡାକି
ମନ ଖୋଲି ଗପେ
ଅନ୍ଧାର ସହ ସେ ସଙ୍ଗାତ ବସେ
ଆକାଶକୁ ବାରହାତର ଶାଢ଼ୀଟିଏ
କରି ନିତି ନିତି ପିନ୍ଧେ
ବହଳେ କୋହକୁ କଜଳ କରି ତା ଆଖିରେ ନାଏ
ବିନା କାରଣରେ କେବେ ଖୁବ୍ ହସେ
ପୁଣି କେବେ କାରଣ ନଥାଇ ସାରାରାତି କାନ୍ଦେ
କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଝିଅ ଠିକ୍ ଏମିତି ହିଁ ଦିଶେ।

କସୁଥିବା ମସଲାରେ
ନିଜ ପ୍ରତିବିମ୍ବ ଆଙ୍କେ
ଧୁଆଁର ଧାସରେ ପୁଣି
ଭବିଷ୍ୟତ ଲେଖେ
ପୂଜାଘରେ ଫୁଲ ଥୋଇ
ଶବ୍ଦଙ୍କୁ ସେ ଗୁନ୍ଥେ
ସ୍କାଇଲାଇଟ୍ ଆଲୁଅରେ
ତା ନିଜ ଆତ୍ମାକୁ ସେ ଖୋଜେ
କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଝିଅ ନିଜ ପାଖେ
ବାର୍ ବାର୍ ହଜେ।

ଛଦ୍ମବେଶୀ ନୁହେଁ ସିଏ କଳାକାର ନୁହେଁ
ସବୁ ଦେଖି ନ ଦେଖିବାର ମିଛ ଅଭିନୟ କରେ
ଥରେ କି ଦୁଇ ଥର ନୁହେଁ କବିଟିଏ ଅହରହ ମରେ
ଜୀଵନ ଜଞ୍ଜାଳକୁ ନେଇ ଖୁବ୍ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଆଣେ
କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଝିଅ ସବୁ ଜାଣିପାରେ।

ସାଥୀ ଠୁ ଅଧିକ ସେ ଶବ୍ଦ ପାଖେ ଥାଏ
କେବେ ତାକୁ ପ୍ରେମିକ ତ କେବେ ପ୍ରଭୁ ଭାବେ
ସ୍ବପ୍ନକୁ ନିଃଶ୍ୱାସ କରି ବଞ୍ଚି ରହିଥାଏ
ସ୍ବପ୍ନ ସହ ହସେ ପୁଣି ସ୍ବପ୍ନ ସହ ରୁଷେ
କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଝିଅ ଏମିତି ହି ଦିଶେ।

କଳା ରଂଗର ବାଦଲ କେବେ ତା ନାଁ ଧରି ଡାକେ
ଅନ୍ଧାର ବି କେବେକେବେ ତା ପ୍ରତିଛବି ଆଙ୍କେ
ହାଟରେ ଘାଟରେ ତାର ବାଃ ବାଃ ହୁଏ
ନିଜ ଛାତ ତଳେ ତାର ତିରସ୍କାର ହୁଏ
କେବେ କବିତା କୁ ନେଇ ପୁଣି କେବେ
ଚରିତ୍ରର ନୂଆ ଆଖ୍ୟା ଦିଆଯାଏ
କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଝିଅ ଏମିତି ହିଁ ଭୋଗେ।

କଥା କମ୍ କହେ ସିଏ ବେଶୀ ଭାବୁଥାଏ
ମିଛ ପ୍ରଶଂସାରେ କେବେ ପୁଣି ଭାରି ଖୁସୀ ହୁଏ
ଭାବକୁ କରିଣ ହାର ସେ ନିତି ପିନ୍ଧୁଥାଏ
ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି କହିଲେ ତ ସେ ତାକୁ ଭାବୁଥାଏ
କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଝିଅ ଏମିତି ହିଁ ଥାଏ।

ପର ଦୁଃଖେ ଦୁଃଖୀ ସିଏ ନିଜ କଥା ଭାବେନା
ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ଦେଖିଲେ ସିଏ ମୋଟେ ସହି ପାରେନା
ନିଯଠୁ ଅଧିକା ସିଏ ଭାବନା ସହ ରହେ
ତା ଜୀବନ କହିଲେ ତ ଭାବନା ହିଁ ଥାଏ
କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଝିଅ କାଳେ ଗୋଟାପଣ ଭୋଳି ହେଇଥାଏ।

ଅନୁଶାସନ ଭିତରେ ତା ଶ୍ୱାସରୁଦ୍ଧ ହୁଏ
ଧରା ବନ୍ଧା ଜୀବନକୁ ଖୁବ୍ ନିନ୍ଦା କରେ
ଈଶ୍ୱରକୁ ମଣିଷ କେବେ ପୁଣି ମଣିଷକୁ ଈଶ୍ୱର ସେ ଭାବେ
ନିଜ ମନ ଇଲାକାରେ ସିଏ ଆଧିପତ୍ୟ କରେ
କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଝିଅ ଠିକ୍ ତା ପରି ବଞ୍ଚେ
କବିତାକୁ ଭୋଗେ ସିଏ କବିତାକୁ ଭାବେ
କବିତା ଲେଖୁଥିବା ଝିଅ ଠିକ୍ ତା ପରି ବଞ୍ଚେ।

प्रेम को प्रतिपल सींचना
स्त्री की विशेषता है
प्रत्येक अनसुलझे
समस्याओं के धागों को
आहिस्ता आहिस्ता सुलझाना
उसकी फ़ितरत है।।
वो रंग भरी गुलाबी हसरतों को
दरकिनार कर कंटीले रास्तों पर
खुशीखुशी चल देती है
क्योंकि इससे उसके परिवार को
एक अच्छा स्टेटस मिलता है
वो विसंगतियों को पार करती है
और संगति करने योग्य वातावरण
पोषित करती है।
जब कि जानती है अंत में
सभी को दूर जाना है।
वो वैरागी है माया के भेष में
एक सन्यासी है कर्म की पृष्ठभूमि पर
एक ज्वलंत उद्गार है
कोमल शब्दों के लोच का।
मांसल देह में
छिपा एक लौह जज्बात है।
स्त्री है जिसकी ई की मात्रा पर
ही कई भार ,कई विश्वासघात हैं
फिर भी वो इस मात्रा को
बखूबी खींचती है
सलीके से
कोमलता से
और दार्शनिकता से।

रात चलती रही, नींद आई नहीं,
ख़्वाब से भी मुहब्बत निभा ना सके।
तुमसे मिलने की दिल में तलब तो जगी,
तुमसे मिलने मगर फिर भी आ ना सके।

शाम खिड़की से तुमको था देखा मगर,
तुम जो पलटे, तो नजरें ये झुक सी गई।
यूं तो दिल मेरा धड़का किया तुमसे पर,
देख कर तुमको धड़कन ये रूक सी गई।
जो नज़र ही न मिल पाई, क्या फायदा,
प्यार आंखों में तुमको दिखा ना सके।

तुमको जीते रहे, तुमपे मरते रहे,
धीरे धीरे तुम्हीं में उतरते रहे।
मेरे दिल की अंधेरी सी बस्ती में फिर,
कुछ दीए नाम के तेरे जलते रहे।
बात निकलेगी होगी कयामत सनम,
बात होंठों में फिर भी दबा न सके।

महुआ की छांव में, चांदनी के तले,
तुमसे मिलने का वादा हुआ था कभी।
एक पल में, मेरे मन को शबनम ने और,
साथ ज्योति ने मिलकर छुआ था कभी।
बाट में तेरी पलकें बिछाई मगर,
अपनी राहों से काटें हटा न सके।

रूप मैं हूं तो तुम हो नज़र प्रेम की,
बिन तुम्हारे मैं होकर भी कुछ भी नहीं।
तुम मेरे शाम हो, मैं हूं जोगन प्रिय,
तुम मेरे सब हो, मैं तेरी कुछ भी नहीं।
अरसों बरसों की ये दूरियां हैं अचल,
चाहकर भी ये दूरी मिटा ना सके।
तुमसे मिलने की दिल में तलब तो जगी,
तुमसे मिलने मगर फिर भी आ ना सके।

source_fields.captured_author: Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा
source_fields.body_html:
पहले यह दिल मेरा ही था,
हम बस मन की सुनते रहे|
जब से तुम आ गए हो सखे,
ख्वाब सुनहरे बुनते रहे|

मैं अब तेरी तू मेरा है,
और भला हमें क्या करना|
पाकर तुझे मन नहीं भरता
तुझको तुझसे चुनते रहे|

आँखों में पल पल पलते हो,
नजर कोई लगाएगा क्या?
ये अंजन तुझ पर वार दिये ,
तुझे नैन में गुनते रहे|

बंद पलक करके जब देखे
छवि तेरी ही निराली थी|
तुम बस यूँ ही कहते रहना
हम बस तुझको सुनते रहे|

जब तक मुझको तुम न मिले थे
सुना सा दिल का आँगन था|
अब मन मेरा उपवन सा है,
फूल से हम निखरते रहे।

मुझ पर तेरा रंग चढ़ा यों
श्यामल तन मन हो गया,
गौर वर्ण भाये ना हमको
श्याम रंग मे रंगते रहे।

In a blink of an eye
A dove flies out of his pockets.
In just microseconds
Live bodies are split bloodless .
Playing cards turn into roses
More and more magic he discloses.

Chained boxes and iron chests
Pricked with swords and axes
Inside people still safe and
In the hall resound applauses.
The magician utters some spells
and Shows tricks without causes.

I wish to gain all his power
To learn all spells and tricks
and say Abracadabra to vanish
And then observe people
Who is my friend, who an enemy,
And see myself astonished.

I want the magic wand to confer
Peace on all war prone zones.
To teach unity to all the distant
Families, friends and couples.
Then convert all guile, avarice,
and Doubts into bubbles.

I can then change weapons into
Books and flower bouquets.
And turn guns into pens
and bombs into buffets .
I will change abuses into good
Wishes and rage prohibited.

I will then conquer the blues
Of evils and triumph over
insanity and inhumanity and
Make the world a four leaf Clover.
I`ll Burst the balloon of racism
and Bring all colours closer .

True love, I say, is a messed-up form
An intersection between flesh, rhythm and melody.
Moments of becoming, then unbecoming
Overdosed love letters and a hundred pre-deaths
Translated as rhythmic reminders
of the best of you, the best of me, both of us
floating in our torrid sea, learning the art
of bleeding, learning to be free in the art of estrangement.
A true and free verse, I say, is a messed-up love story
An explosion of failed rhymes soaked in disorderly brine
A lover, a dancer, a king or queen of bitterness and dark melody,
striving to write stories of raging silence, the revolution of dying.
A dreamer of an embryo, swimming in the motherly belly of memories
and pain, a jazz singer entrapped in displaced music, notes flowing
Music of wounded souls, wet, amorous bodies of staggering words
drenched in the dark rain, when it rains sometimes,
In the badlands of lethal poetry.
True love meets free verse, sonnet and the river poems of Sufi poets.
They talk about torrents and explosions, wronged births of poetry Gods
and divas, and dive in the cosmic water-bodies of soulful melancholy.
Free verse, the petrichor of rhymes are reborn in the nakedness of despair.

source_fields.body_html:
बिखरती है सुगंध मुझ से है रंग चहुँओर
मैं एक तत्व रंग बिन मात्र अनुभव
मुझ पर कोई रंग न चढ़ता
मुझ से रंग है निखरता
मैं हूँ धरा अम्बर कण कण में
न बांध सकोगे मुझे आलिंगन में
न त्याग सकोगे मुझे शरीर से
मैं हर छोटी बड़ी हल्की गहरी सांस में
मुझ से ही प्रकृति की दिव्य ध्वनि की परिभाषा है
मुझ से ही तरंग अप्रकाशित भावों का है
मैं बिन-रंग नहीं, रंग-बिन हूँ
मैं अदृश्य कड़ी सारे तत्व से जुड़ी
मुझसे ही उड़ता है गुलाल
लहराता है आँचल रंग बसंती
बिखरती है सुगंध मुझसे है रंग चहुँ और
में एक तत्व रंग बिन मात्र अनुभव ।

फिर भी करीब हो तुम ।
दिल के आशियाना का
अहम हिस्सा हो तुम ।।

इश्क हमारा बेहिसाब हो तुम
इश्क के नशे की शराब हो तुम।।

इश्क होगा तुम्हें भी कभी हमसे
खुदा करे!!
हमारे इश्क में डूब जाओगे तुम ।।

इस नाचीज़ को कभी
याद कर लेना ,
निगाहें टिकी रहती हैं तेरे दीदार के वास्ते ।।
कभी सपनों में आके हमे छू लेना।।

जिंदगी जिंदादिली का नाम है
खुलकर कभी मुस्कुरा भी लो,
गम तो हजारों हैं जीवन में
अपनी मुस्कुराहट में इसे छुपा भी लो ।

मुस्कुराते चेहरों की अपनी
एक अलग परिभाषा होती है
यह गम के कीचड़ में भी
खुशी के फूल खिला देती है ।

मुस्कुराते चेहरे सामने वालों की
दिलों में समा जाता है
ना बनने वाले कामों को भी
चुटकी में बना जाता है ।

छोटी सी मुस्कुराहट
बड़ी अनमोल होती है
सफलता दिलाने में इसकी
अहम रोल होती है।

आपकी मुस्कान आपके
अंतर्मन को दर्शाता है
सामने वालों पर अमिट
छाप छोड़ जाता है ।

इसलिए मुस्कुराने में
कोई कंजूसी ना करो
भगवान का दिया मुफ्त उपहार है ,
जी भरकर इसका प्रयोग करो ।

इसलिए कहता हूं
जिंदगी जिंदादिली का नाम है
खुलकर कभी मुस्कुरा भी लो
गम तो हजारों हैं जीवन में
अपने मुस्कुराहट में से छिपा भी लो ।

हवा सर्दी की
कँपकपाती है,
हवा गर्मी की
अकुलाती है,
हवा बसंत की
सुलगाती है,
प्रियतम की
मधुर याद दिलाती है।

हवा अक्सर
रूख बदलती है,
कभी पुरब,कभी
पश्चिम से चलती है,
हवा गर अनुकूल
हो जाती है,
जिंदगी काँटों से
फूल हो जाती है।

हवा बिना भेद-भाव
चलती है,
हर एक की
साँसें बनतीं हैं,
हवा जिनकी
चलती है,
दूनिया उनके कदमों
पे झुकती है।

source_fields.captured_title: My love within a Golden Frame
source_fields.body_html:
Slowly, the palette of Life
Has begun to fade ,
What I hold dear ,
Nestled in the depths of my heart ,
I`ve cradled with utmost care .

Occasionally, Unknowingly,
If unfurls transforming into a
vast canvas.
Resembling the expanse of the sky .
Within it , like colourful patterns ,
resides affection,
A Cosmos of planets and stars !

I enfold this canvas once again.
But can love ever be confined ?

They shimmer with an eternal rhythm,
Resembling the celestial canvas of night.
Capsuled within a golden frame ,
In the image of my beloved,
Clad in a black coat and red tie ,
Wearing a smile that graces his face .

Where love takes the from of Butterflies.
The boundaries of my affection.,
Break free from the confines
Of the golden Frame.
Galloping away like warhorses,
With reins being tugged and whipped.

It takes considerable effort to pacify.
To rein in the untamed spirit ,
Yet , persistently,
I confine love within its bounds,
like Parrot in a cage.
Clipping the wings,
restricting there flight .

No principles, no discipline
except his honesty, never steady
except standing by his words
like trees in the wild, grateful to soil.
Restless, impatient filled with a spirit
to go out, carve the world to shape,
lying splintered, orphaned, uncared for,
unhoned stones, swamped mud.
Any food, any drink, hair held in a napkin,
the wind around ankles and a heart
fathomless, hands empty after
giving away all, even the last copper.
Would there be a meal the next day?
Would his bed be quilted or bare floor?
Would he sleep, even have time to doze?
A temple, durgah, church, or a burial yard?
We find in him our living God, he
honing men out of us, born as beasts, devils;
begged for food, no complains, no guilt;
our unassuming Lord of small things.
Squatting on bare floor of his crumbling home
he rolls cotton wicks for his earthen lamps
when not grand-planning for his universe, perhaps,
the unassuming arbiter, the silent saviour.
Not a gold coin, no shining diamond,
rather a small coin much thumbed,
frequent and transient passing from one
to another facilitating comfort, peace.
No bright star, no spiraling nebula, for
what use being light years away, he is
the next door friend, a rice plate giving
a square meal, reed mat for a tired body.
(A tribute to Sai of Shirdi)

We built the empire,
Mixing blood and dust
Propping the pillars of stones
With bent and broken bones.
The empire stank of sweat
In the heat of summer,
While piles of flesh lay
Rotting in barren fields.
Hands were too tired
To wave away
The bothersome flies,
Alighting on dead eyes.
The rains came bringing
The showers of blood,
Casting down the stones,
Laying bare the bones
And the blood flowed streaming,

Ribbons of red,
In the grey of the dust.
Winter came and went;
Spring found us
A pile of bones lying

In the dust with
The bent and broken bones.
We lay in the barren fields,
Watering the parched earth
With blood and sweat,
Stripping the flesh from
Our broken bones,
Leaving it to rot
In the grimy dust,
Watching the flies
Hover and settle
On our dead eyes.

The day ends flickering at my fingertips,
I sew the gold-dust to my eyelids,
they close down.

Far away... In a dream...

The moon might be peeping through
the neatly combed leaves of the coconut tree.
The vast mirror of the flooding river
might be drenching the shores,
the clouds might be sailing,
breaking through their anchorage,
stars and fishes might be at play
on the same ghat,
breaking through the snares of the world.

On my closed eye-lids
dance a prayer,
a note of Ahir Bhairav strikes
the gong of my soul.
I diffuse in the dew-drops of bliss.

My poems often wander in the womb
Like a baby searching for her exit numb
Opened my eyes first to the Visible God,
A presence so divine,
A love that`s tangible, and all the time.
A Divine dialect ,a sacred abode
Why do we learn our mother tongue before any other?
Cause the first voice that we hear is that of a mother.
I carry an ocean inside my heart
No metaphors can pour it out right
Words will not do justice describing her worth.
Do we stop loving the ocean after we leave the beach?
She`s the ultimate truth this vast universe preach.
Keeping each beat steady through the rhythm of life
She turns chaos into beautiful magic
Where healing and bliss play ultimate logic
Learned from her that forgiveness is a blessing
She`s the fragrance after the rain caressing..
She`s blood, audacious strength, and bonfire,
The fierce love that teaches resilience rare,
I wish and pray she never grows old
She`s moulded with a heart of pure gold.
She`s that all in one, omnipotent force
Everything that`s visible and invisible at source,
The universal power that meets you in the womb,
She`s my medicine, my elixir my prayer
A trillion roses endlessly flying in the air.
As I scroll through the gallery of memories
I realize how difficult it is to be a mother, sans worries
Can`t afford to lose a priceless gift
So never ever try to make a rift
She`s the answers to my questions
She is the travelogue of life lessons.

She loved some one else
To see if that would
Make her to love you less.
Oh yes , it helped
To remind her poor soul
How much she loved you even more.
He said it was childhood
Long years and life goes on,
For her , time has never moved
From the moment she knew him.
The scar is still so fresh
As if she fell just a day ago
In love with his beautiful heart
Yet oblivious of state her`s was.
She tried not talking to your shadow
In stealth of nights , in solitude
Yet he happened to irk her soul
Cos he said he loved her no more.
Oh yes, it is for good
That he let the word out,
Now even the shadow is gone
Leaving behind unknown trails.
He says it was madness
Then she still suffers from it,
In awake world , she pretends to move on
In the other , she still speaks to his heart .
And yes, do not worry at all
She don`t ask for equal reaction for love,
Cos it no more needs him in it;
Love is now independent , floating feeling.
Thoughts now wander in search of him
Finding him no where near
They weave new poems about him
That is the best way to keep him around.

source_fields.captured_title: He Too Be Called A Poet
source_fields.body_html:
A poet ever searches delights from life`s every twist and turn
As soon as his poetic journey begins with the rising sun
He often flies with the butterflies into the sky by his poetic strain
But for a drop of nectar from wild flowers he too forgets his pain

And on sheets of paper he builds his juicy honey comb
And stores there his sweet honey always, and for life long
He is the man who with the strength of his imagination
Dives deep into the ocean to find gems for his poetic passion

But unlike him a true poet does exist between you and me
Who ever nourishes a big feel-heart and perceiving eye
Whose broad encompassing mind finds delight in between the lines
And pirouettes with the emotion of the poet in his own styles

He may never write poetry in his life still he be truly called a poet
Since he preserves beauty in his heart and finds delight in every art.

Did the sun rise today ?
Perhaps it did on the East as usual
In that distant horizon of the Silver city
Perhaps its rays were scattered as usual
On all and sundry
On everything that lay beneath
In and outside the city
On Roads and Rivers
On sands and cements
On roof-tops and pavements!
Yet why I did not feel its warmth ?
Its ever enveloping presence ?
The sky was clear and blue
In that the Sun swam with its radiant glue !

But then why the warmth was not felt
As if it was as good as the Sun hidden in smokes
Making the otherwise sunny day a dull day
Making the soul suffer a void
Making it feel as if something was missing?
Something precious !
Missing in the air, missing on the soil , missing in the river
Missing the air , missing the river
The sunlit day was felt as a sun-less day
Did the sun come over the silver city
Or it moved towards the rose city
I curse that magician who stole sun.

My mornings have a taste of
plums from Ranikhet
Aha Pullum – the children
toss and twang.
On the streets of Almora
I would buy them in kilos
and distribute to
my friends in town.
Red and juicy, at times sour
they ended up as jam
in my mother`s kitchen.
Often the colours trail
a mark on my kurta.
I know you have just had plums
You sniff and disapprove.
Pullums and not plums, my heart
fusses. I do not look at you.
I guess you have noticed
my fist hides a few and
the juice is trickling down.

When People stop listening
Crocuses bloom.
The eyelids drop
unable to bear
a single note of diffidence.
The sun is soft
this mid-summer May
as ashes bring
bodies home.
And we put them on
our tinted glasses
revealing little or nothing
woes on hold.
Aconites shrill.
The earbuds wilt
words deflate
and all is still.

source_fields.captured_title: Gray is not the Warmest Colour
source_fields.body_html:
Grey sky—
Monsoon dusk—
The dull sunlight is yet to fade.
And yet it is not luminous,
Soft beams linger on,
Like the memories of a lost lover,
Remembered and forgotten—
In the mind`s abyss.

Vestiges of people,
Silhouettes sans substance,
The passing off and a faint presence,
Warmth turning to nonchalance.
Rivers of the past—
Blurred visions—
Melt into the chiaroscuro of the horizon.

When the sunlight walks through the windows and plays on my bed.........
Either the moonlight silently plays on my face....
I feel your touch even though I am in deep sleep.
Whenever it rains in the weather, I get drenche..,......
The melodious song of each raindrop on the leaves.....
And the torrent of rain sitting on the side of the road-----
I will make a paper boat for u .I write some memories and let them flow.
There is no such beautiful moment where you are not there......
And there will never be a tear that doesn`t remember you.....
The reality is that you are there in every moment of my life.
I thought I would like the cool life.....
And I will live a happy life even without you...
But as the years go by, I feel like missing you.
you never said you would love me.....
And I also never said that I love you....
But there was definitely love between us.

The three stumps of wood — the floating hope of
humankind on a rising sea.
Above, the vultures hover awaiting to feed on the
Carcass of human pride
The mangroves tremble, the fir and spruce
exchanging condolence
though entwined by fate to lead
each other to obliteration
My poem `A Noah`s Ark`
a refuge for he who offers his prostrated
obeisance to the left out green
***
The lost faith in the `world personified`
Or the Last faith in the Vedic prayer which sermons
to take shelter in the `Daru`
A thought torn and split apart
As like one who clings to the horizon either
immersed into darkness or fished out to light
As like someone deciding
Either to run into the popping crease
and defend the stumps
Or to run away and be stumped out
Eventually, the apprehensive mirror reflects
Either to recover what is lost
or to have believe in what would last.

To believe in thy white — thou phenomenal
Universe To have faith in thy black — thou the
Emptiness

To rely on thy red — thou garlanded
Passion
Wearing a brown of green, beholding
creativity — I preserve my
eagerness in your blue
Show me, guide me, make me
a primitive tribal to worship thou with trust
Lead me my wood thee `Saviour
of the fallen souls`
We too resolve to preserve thy eternity
and remove the loom what haunts the men
The Nero of the newfangled world
the father to Nino
who has been groomed to be
the Frankenstein
now discovers his descendant
to lead a mutiny against the
progenitor himself
The walls of Apollo crumble
the divine tragic justice befalls
on the mortals who were too
ambitious to be the Titans
Poseidon rising...
With no Leonidas left to desist
Nino at the Gates of Hell.

Only idolising the wood so indestructible
can one attain supremacy
Only comprehending the rotation of the discus
emphasising the change of time can
one help the mind

to cleave apart from matter
He who has no material hands and
feet but transcendental senses
He who stands on oblivion
He whose round eyes enlighten the
Stygian pitch dark
He who animates the deep rooting,
The climbing of airy stairs to embrace the sunlight
The spreading of boughs to offer shade
The bestowing of the boon of fruit
and flowers — all by thyself.
Inspires Mankind to be selfless
So that the wood may `pahandi`
to leave its rootfall everywhere
***
The white silvery salt of the
crawling desert,
now exhales the heat
Hunger and thirst hand in hand,
crawl below the sandy dunes to
be carried everywhere

Holocaust in the womb of greed
awaits the ice to melt
And famine whispers,
Land, land everywhere, with no
Green to see
Like the pagodas of Herod, the
temples will collapse with faith
being fake,
The church will be ruined,

with no confessions to make
and the mosque will have no one
to say `for God`s sake``
All these happen when we live
just to take...
***
Every time I ascend the twenty-two
stairs, singing the song of the
holy hermit,
I rediscover the divine — how man
mingles with nature
and awaits the Day
when cataclysm will reunite
all the religions in the
citadel of wood
To taste the forgotten fruit of spiritual
Food,
which will be born out from thou
O` stumps of wood.

My Lord that day this poet
will repose peacefully underneath
the holy shroud of your hood.
***
Destiny`s destiny in Man`s hand
The past slipping into the Seaman`s Land
The future will sprout from the
barren sand.
They will flee from the lands of fire,
They will march in fear from where

burns the pyre,
will be led by Moses of their time
will follow the far away ringing
of chime
To Babylon where the woods are
still dark and deep.
A gleeful haven for the innocent
sheep
To the land of midnight sun and lark
where the colours breakfast by nibbling
the dark.
Men queue at the brim of green for recluse
to return the wild the `stumps of wood`
A safe haven for sure and not
to lose
The final restoration of the last faith — an offspring of
My mood…

Hands around shoulders to keep,
But no shoulder to rest on and weep,
The lights around so blinding bright,
How strange is it that I struggle for sight!

The world was green, the world is blue,
Time arrived but swiftly flew,
What beyond those mountains lay,
Curious perhaps, I lost my day.

Was this road worth the tread ?
How much along, to rest I laid?
Did I find what I set out to fetch?
And that I found, was that my match?

I look back at the trodden path,
Those worn out patches, the trampled grass,
And then I see my footsteps fresh,
Shimmering down the path in a mesh.

The walk is mine, I have travelled alone,
The peak I scale or the dale be my home,
If another traveller looks for way,
My footsteps would dazzle, not let him sway.

With that I leave to scale the slant,
To face the rocks ominous chant,
Look, mark up there for the flag I post,
Remember my journey, I return or I not.

If you remember freedom
There will always be a way
to break the walls between us
You will have invisible wings
to cross the borders that divide us
You will feel the whipping winds
that do not decide where
to strike and at whom
The fire in your heart will ignite
minds that will be unbiased

If you remember freedom
You know what it is to smile
A smile that accentuates the eyes
and precedes a carefree laughter
You know the song of a free land
that escapes beyond the sky

To be free is to speak without fear
To live without disguise
To be able to love and be loved
without being questioned or judged

To remember freedom is to
reminisce spring in winter
To wait for the sun in darkness
If you remember freedom
you will always be free

They may enslave your body but
the mind can never be held captive
It will break free from all the hurdles
that are thrust upon it
You just need to remember freedom
and speak what it is to be free

You perched on the
Stony clusters alongside
The pavement stretch,
There the warm billows
Roll and peck the shore.
Migrated from faraway
You were in the quest of life,
Yet you lent me a feather
To ease my flight beyond
The horizon of light and shadow.
Molded my wings with hope
To endure the trial of tempest,
Gifted me a reason to weave stories
To be translated solely by the waves.
