source_fields.captured_title: तुम्हारे बाप का घर नहीं है
source_fields.body_html:
घर की इज्जत घर की दीवारों से नहीं
हम स्त्रियों की त्वचा से चिपकी रही
हमारे तेज बोलने से झड़ जाती थोडी़
थोडी़ उखड़ जाती हमारे खुल के हंस जाने पर

हमने देखा तक नहीं गंदी नजर से देखने वाले की तरफ
हमारी त्वचा पर लिपटी इज्जत सब समझ जाती
और गिर जाती थोडी़ सी

हमें छेड़ने वाले लोग गुनाहगार नहीं थे
नाहीं हमको छूने की कोशिश करने वाले हाथ लिजलिजे
हमारा पीछा करने वाले पैर पापी नहीं थे
हम ही दोषी थे
हम रख नहीं पाये अपनी इज्जत का ख्याल

हमें डांट पडी़
हमें मार पडी़
हमें दी गईं भिन्न -भिन्न उपाधियां
जो बनकर कुल्हाड़ी छांटती रही हमारा हदय

हम कभी भी अकेले नहीं होते
हमारी त्वचा पर लिपटी इस इज्जत में उग आतीं
असंख्य आंखें
जिनके मुंह थे और थे बडे़ बडे़ हाथ
हमारी जरा भर गलती पर काट सकते थे गला
गाढ़ सकते थे धरती में

मैं अनेक पुरूषों से मिली
मैंने खूब तलाशा
उनके तन पर केवल त्वचा थी
इज्जत नहीं थी
इज्जत को वे रखते थे अपने जूते की नोक पर

आजादी को उडा़ते सिगरेट के धुएं में
मनमानियों को पहनते अपनी टाई बना
वे कुछ भी कह सकते थे
वे कुछ भी कर सकते थे
इज्जत की आंखें फोड़ देने के लिए उनका पुरूष होना काफी था

उनके लिए हम तीन मांस के टुकडों के अलावा
कुछ न थे
हमारे लिए हम उनकी तरह मामूली इंसान

हमारे अपने पुरूष ने जब - जब धड़ल्ले से कहा -
तुम्हारे बाप का घर नहीं है
तुम्हारी मनमानी नहीं चलेगी यहां

तब - तब हम खडे़ रह गये ठगे से
हमें याद आये पिता और वो घर
जिसके लिए हम पराये थे जन्म से

पीडा़ और क्रोध से हम चीखे -
जब कोई घर हमारा है नहीं तो ये किसकी इज्जत है
जो चिपकी है हमारी त्वचा से
बह रही है हमारी नसों में
पहुंच गई है हमारे मस्तिष्क तक
न जीने दे रही है न ही मरने |

source_fields.captured_title: सबसे आगे बढ़ते रहना, अच्छी बात है।
source_fields.body_html:
सबसे आगे बढ़ते रहना,
अच्छी बात है।
पर इतना भी आगे
ना निकल जाएं कि
जब मुड़कर देखें तो
केवल शुन्य दिखाई दे।

जीत चाहे कितनी भी
बड़ी क्यों ना हो?
जश्न में अपने संग ना हो,
तो फीका ही रहता है।
तमाम अच्छी बातें सिर्फ
समझाने के लिए नहीं,
कुछ समझनें के लिए
भी होते हैं।

कांटों की चुभन तो
छन भर पीड़ा देती है ,पर
शब्दों की चुभन
उम्र भर टीस देती है।
इसलिए अपनी वाणी में
सरलता मधुरता और
शालीनता बनाए रखें।

जख्म ऐसा कोई नहीं,
जो भर ना सके।
नासूर तो उसे कुरेद कुरेद कर
बना दिया जाता है।

आप किसी से कुछ मांगों,
या ना मांगों,देने बाले
और कुछ नहीं तो,
बद्दुआ तो देगें ही देंगें।

आपके गम में आपके आंसू
पोंछ ने बाले में कुछ लोग
ऐसे भी होते हैं ,
जिन्हें यह डर भी खाए जाता है,
कि कल को कहीं ये
सुखी ना हो जाए।

चलो थोड़ा हट कर
बात करते हैं।

अक्सर देखा गया है कि
इस दुनियां में सच्चा प्यार
उसी को नसीब होता है,
जिन्हें प्यार की कोई कदर नहीं।

अक्सर ऐसा होता है कि
हम उन्हीं से कुछ नहीं कह पाते,
जिनसे बहुत कुछ कहना चाहते हैं।

ये कहना पूरी तरह से
बिल्कुल ही असत्य नहीं
कही जा सकती कि
हमारा दिल हमारी आंखों
जो कहना चाहती है,
लबों पे उसके विपरीत
बातें होती है।

अगर जीवन में कुछ छोड़ने के केबल एक और एक ही अफसर मिले,
तो बिना सोचे-समझे ईर्ष्या
करना छोड़ दें।
जीवन से आधे दुख यूंही चले जाएंगे।

Heart carries
A sea every moment
Two rivers `re on the eyes
Silence is in her depth
Furore wave of sea has
A mischievous dream of
Losing in sky too.

Tell me
Who peeps in
The bosom of the Sea! Being a ruddy shelduck
It `s flowing constantly
For thousand years.

The lips buzz a
Meaningless song,
Pains decorates silently,
Two rivers flows in the eyes,
Lose rythum of life ,
A dust particle leads the path
The heart carries a river.

Adorning a fiery dress She leaves;
Putting to sleep all mankind,birds and leaves.
She is gentle,majestic and exudes radiant light;
She is the joyful, sad, enchanting twilight.
She enters the Golden Pool of Silvery waves
To reach her abode of pearls that oyster saves.
High above a solitary bird bids farewell
To the elms swaying as if in a dance of farewell.
Night crowds around like a velvet blanket.
Shrouding the bright waters in a black net.
But still one Amber sparkles
Lingering, to stay with the world in which it revels!!
Far away a bell chimes
Infusing a sense of infinite calm.
Voices of Lord`s praise sung in rhymes
Arise from the Earth around, reaching Heaven through this calm!.
Another day has ended with all it`s swords and songs.
Yet for some delight or consolation one longs.
Many a dreams seem to have been buried
In the toil for fulfilling basic need.
Yet, one awaits the rejuvenating dawn
When we can sail the Ocean of Life like a swan.
The dawn that gives priceless hope;
Hope, that Despair will not throttle like a gnarled rope.
That,a soul, in alleys of Lonliness and Tears need not grope!!

My sadness has crossed the paths of infinity.
At last it has touched your feet, a summation of happiness and mirth.
Since days,I have shed tears boundlessly,
I have not known why it has been flowing relentlessly-
Today, I have woven a string of my tear drops, to garland you, O my Lord.
Your Northern Star has beckoned me in evading darkness.
I have never reasoned the sadness that I have borne all the while
I was still in quietness.
Today, after ages, at your touch, my sadness has become a string of the lute that plays for you.

Embrace solitude in grace during crunch time
it develops a friendship and later a partner in name
to rise and shine on a stage called life.

Embrace solitude at the first hint of vacant time
it ignites a burning fire of desire to battle struggle
and rise to the challenge in fulsome pride.

In solitude aspiration frame expression in colours
in solitude the pages of book spill secrets
in solitude fragrance of love is limitless
in solitude poetic lyrics blaze alive in words
in solitude humanity bridge the empty spaces
in solitude the world of ideas spread in degrees
in solitude grief triggers constructive messages

Solitude is a timeless treasure of the universe
that stands as a stark reminder to the human race
to observe life as a small part of puzzle
and be open to change in a friendly gesture.

Solitude sings a different tune in the history of human existence
at the push of a button rotates the axle of conscience
from womb to tomb in this global gate.

Embrace solitude in grace to invite the divine
Choose to believe that solitude is a blessing in disguise.

Anger, anger, go away
You burn in your own way
You live in a house of hatred
In every eye, I find fear
you are not sacred

You can`t be diagnosed
with a problem
You are not a solution
In fact, you are the cause
of all mental pollution

You are an impolite interpreter
You are a mind destroyer
You are a burning cigar
Who spoils beauty
leaving behind a scar
You are, at times a reason for
catastrophic effects like war

You mislead and stray and stray
You set fires upon fires
never apologizing to your prey

Hey anger, you need no permission
when you get out of control
There is no limitation
You are such a devious one
So retire already and be done!

You are a marvel to me,
a stunning piece of poetry,
written by moving finger
on a sheet of soft golden paper
brought from Lei - Yang ,
by the sailor from Byzantine
who by chance,
anchored himself
to the black obsidian
with his glance on the coastline
of my fantasy.
I feel full import of your essence
that helps me appreciate your grace.
I wonder why the texture
of your plump words,
resists critical scrutiny?
Is it that delicate and fragile
that you apprehend
It will lose its sheen
with a single stroke of an analytic pen?

I lie awake in my mother`s womb,
Worried for my safety and hers.
If I`m born, I`ll be shown my tomb,
A girl is not what my family prefers.

But I wish to live, to laugh and feel
Please don`t take away my right!
Can I at least get a chance to appeal?
Don`t murder me when I can`t fight.

I`ll accomplish what your sons promise to be,
I`ll be there for you when you`re old,
I`ll study hard and earn good money,
For my achievements you`ll be extolled.

The world is fighting for women`s rights,
But they`ll never know me and me them.
An endangered species, my faultless plight,
And it`s me society continues to condemn!

Every time I shut the door
I leave a window open
Inwardly I still hope
This time something might happen

Although, I know from the start
That it`s going to end soon
Thick black clouds scattered around
I`m searching for my glorious moon

A small part of me still thinks
Things might go different this time
It raises the anxiety and anguish in me
Tormenting me like the first time

If it`s love, it needs to be spontaneous
I can`t be someone else to impress
You keep saying, ;You`re a lot to handle ;
I say, ;Then go find someone less ;

An argument that has no end
But we always end it abruptly
We end up yelling at each other
Though we start talking softly

We throw things, we cry, we leave
We swear off each other`s company
Next moment we yearn to come back
This is our love`s despairing irony

I rebuked myself, No! Not this time ;
This time I won`t let it happen
Again I shut the door tightly
But I leave a window still open...

She wakes at the crack of dawn
Her sleep deprived eyes looks momentarily disoriented
Through the gloam she tries to focus.

She goes about her morning duties
Harsh tones and routine words greet her
As the city nudges itself into wakefulness
Her childish eyes watch `others` in uniform going to school.

Her agile mind asks,;Is school like Aanganvaadis?;
A sigh escapes she would never know
A rude prod pokes into her thin frame
It doesn`t hurt her anymore.

Quickly she picks up the white `mogras`
Her mother has taught her how to weave them
`Venis` interspread with tiny rose buds
They are for the ladies who hurry to their respective jobs.

Traffic builds up
with armful of `gajras` and her youngest sibling straddling her
She waits for the signal to change to red
Then she weaves across the cars to sell her freshly made adornments.

Traffic moves and accelerates
She waits patiently for her situation to change
Her large honey brown eyes has a recurrent dream
Would she be able to achieve it?

She has dared to dream
An impossible dream
The Sun shines harshly upon her
Beads of sweat trickles down her frail body.

Raucous sound envelopes her
Her cracked heels gathers dust
On a half empty stomach
Her hope clings to her.

Days pass years pass they grow on her
Now she is a replica of her prematurely wizened mother
Her rough tone rings through
As she plies her stuff.

Grey undertones blanket grey pavements
Dreams have died a natural death
Dawn and dusk blend as one monotone.

The tides in anguish,
The seething fire in her womb,
The ice clad mountains ,
Alive she breathes in a frozen tomb,
Her soft rosy petals blooming,
Braving the thorns with grit,
Undulations a plenty,
Fluid as water and gracefully fit,
Ever in a dance her cadence is sheer beauty,
Internalize her energy peacefully,
For duality is her game,
The demon, the monster, the angel,
Soaked in every soul`s name,
The good , the bad and the ugly,
She nurtures them all with panache,
Some with gruel, some with broth,
Some with porridge and some with ganache,
But feed she will from her womb fecund,
With that sweet fire called earthiness,
With loving arms in an embrace, perennial nectar in a bund,
Call her woman, call her lady,
Call her your girl and beloved,
Along with her you will spin if only you are ready,
And feel how you brim with an inexplicable feeling blessed.

When it all reflects in little things,
Daisies, violets, mould and shrooms,
Mist, tsunamis, hurricanes and dooms,
It`s thoughts that have gone into her lap,
As she sprawls in an expanding map,
Hold on to her tight
Just love her with all your might.

The turquoise waves
Brushed me again
With a thousand kiss!
On a sunbathed morning
You make me feel your silent touch
From the sunken depth of time.
You rest in peace
Deep within me
Like the deep blue sea...
As the briny winds embrace me
I can feel your tender love
Waiting alone by the shore.
With hands stretched at you
My heart yearns for you
Why do you go back?
The world sees a smiling face
But only the golden sands
Know the bleeding me
Torn apart in your grief.
I come back with an injured soul
And empty hands.
Everytime!

Her once beautiful frame
looked more of a useless piece of furniture now...
from the spinster`s demeanour emanated
a dull odour that seemed obnoxious at times ...toiling from dawn to dusk
her complacent resignation to her fate
seemed miserably irremediable at times...
a fortuitous encounter made all the difference !!
their fingers touched
over the steaming volcano ...
the juvenescent spinster
allowed the greenary all around to eye her with envy ...!

ଦେଶ ବୋଇଲେ ଆଉ କ’ଣ କି?
ସ୍ପଦ୍ର୍ଧା, ସାହସ, ସ୍ବାଭିମାନର ପରିସୀମା ଭିତରେ
ମଥାଟେକି ଉଭା ହୋଇଥିବା ଗୋଟିଏ ଜାତିର ଅସ୍ମିତା...।
ହଁ, ସେ ଭଲକରି ଜାଣିଥିଲେ ଏ କଥା...।
ସେଇଥିପାଇଁ ତ ଭାଙ୍ଗିପଡୁଥିବା ମେରୁଦଣ୍ଡରେ
ତଡ଼ିତ ଖେଳାଇବା କଣ୍ଠରେ କହୁଥିଲେ...
“ମତେ ତୁମେ ରକ୍ତ ଦିଅ ମୁଁ ତୁମକୁ ଦେବି ସ୍ବାଧୀନତା।”
ସେ ଦିନର ସେ ମଣିଷମାନଙ୍କର ରକ୍ତରେ
କେଉଁ ଦୂରନ୍ତ ପ୍ଲାବନ ଥିଲା କେଜାଣି!!
କେହି ସ୍ବରାଜ୍ୟ ପଥରେ ଥିବା ଗାଡ଼ମାନଙ୍କୁ, ପୋତୁଥିଲେ
ଆପଣା ମାଂସ ଆଉ ହାଡ଼ରେ।
କେହି, ସ୍ବାର୍ଥର ସାରଥୀକୁ ବହିଷ୍କାର କରୁଥିଲେ
ଜାତିର ନନ୍ଦିଘୋଷରୁ।
କାହାର ‘କର ଅବା ମର’ ହୁଙ୍କାରରେ
ନିମିଷକେ ଅସମ୍ଭାଳ, ଉତ୍ତାଳ
ଆକୁମାରୀ ହିମାଚଳ।
ଦେଶ ବୋଇଲେ ଆଉ କ’ଣ କି?
ଏଇ କେଇଟି ଅନତି କ୍ରମଣୀୟ ପରିଚୟର
କାଳାନ୍ତକ କଲ୍ଲୋଳ...।
କେବେ କେବେ କେଉଁ ଅଲୋଡ଼ା ସ୍ବପ୍ନ ଭିତରେ
ଓହ୍ଲେଇ ପଡ଼ନ୍ତି ଏଇ କେତୋଟି ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ବଳ ନକ୍ଷତ୍ର।
ଯଶ, ଅର୍ଥ, କ୍ଷମତା, ବିଳାସର
ଅପରିଚ୍ଛନ୍ନ ଉଚ୍ଚାଭିଳାଷରୁ
ମୁକ୍ତ କରି, ମଣିଷକୁ
ଦେବାକୁ ଇଚ୍ଛା କରନ୍ତି ବିଶୁଦ୍ଧ ମାନବିକତା।
ଲଢ଼େଇ କରି ଛଡ଼େଇ ଆଣିବାକୁ
ଶିଖାନ୍ତି, ସମଗ୍ର ବିଶ୍ବକୁ
ଧ୍ବଂସ, ସର୍ବନାଶ ମୁହଁରୁ...।
ସ୍ବପ୍ନ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଯାଏ... ଚୁପ୍ଚାପ୍ ଫେରି ଯାଉ ଯାଉ
ପୁନଶ୍ଚ ମହାଶୂନ୍ୟକୁ, ସେମାନେ ଦେଖନ୍ତି...
େଯ ଏକ ସୁସଜ୍ଜିତ ମଞ୍ଚରେ କିଛି ଶବ୍ଦର ସୌଦାଗର
ଆଉ କିଛି ବି କରି ନପାରି
ଭୋଗୁଛନ୍ତି, କେବଳ ସ୍ମୃତିଚାରଣର
ଦାରୁଣ ଅସହାୟତା...।

ଯେତେବେଳେ ଧଉଳି ଯାଏ
ବୁଦ୍ଧ ସବୁବେଳେ ଶୋଇଥାନ୍ତି ।
ବାହାରେ କିଛି ବାଦାମ୍ ବିକାଳି
କିଛି ଫଟୋଗ୍ରାଫର, କିଛି ପର୍ଯ୍ଯଟକ
କିଛି ଦେଶୀ ମାଂକଡ
ଏମାନଂକ କୋଳାହଳ ଭିତରେ ବି
ଭାଂଗେନା ବୁଦ୍ଧଦେବଂକ ପହଡ ।
ରକ୍ତ ଜୁଡୁବୁଡୁ ମାଟିର କାକୁସ୍ଥ ଚିତ୍କାରରେ
ଚଣ୍ଡାଶୋକ ପାଲଟି ଯାଏ ଧର୍ମାଶୋକ
ରକ୍ତନଦୀ ପୁଣି ପାଲଟେ ଦୟାନଦୀ
ଇତିହାସରେ ଯୋଡାହୁଏ ପୁଣି ଏକ ନୂଆ ଫର୍ଦ
କୂଳରେ ଗଢା ହୁଏ ଶାନ୍ତିସ୍ତୁପ
ମୁକ ସାକ୍ଷୀ ସାଜେ
ସବୁବେଳେ ଧଉଳି ପାହାଡ ।
ଧଉଳି ଅପେକ୍ଷା ତା`ର ରାସ୍ତା
ମତେ ବେଶୀ ଡାକେ ହାତ ଠାରି
କିଏ ସବୁ ଯାଇଛନ୍ତି ପରିବ୍ରାଜକ
ସେ ରାସ୍ତାରେ
ଫେରି ନାହାନ୍ତି, ମତେ ଜଣା ନାହିଁ
ମୋର ବୁଦ୍ଧ ହେବାର ନାହିଁ
ଏ ସଂସାର ହିଁ ଥାଉ
ମୋର ଚରାଭୂଇଁ ହୋଇ ।
ବୁଦ୍ଧଂକୁ ମୋର କିଛି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ
ପଚାରିବାର ଅଛି
ସେ ଲାଗି ଧଉଳି ମୁଁ ବାରଂବାର ଯାଏ
ଆଉ ଫେରେ
ଯଦିଓ ମୁଁ ଜାଣେ
ବୁଦ୍ଧ ଆଉ କେବେ ଉଠିବେନି
କିଂବା ହୁଏତ ଉଠିବେ
ସାରା ପୃଥିବୀ ଶୋଇଗଲା ପରେ ।

तू मंज़िलों का हमें क्यूं पता नहीं देता
है राहबर तो क्यूं रस्ता दिखा नहीं देता।

कभी-कभी तो ख़ुदा भी कठोर है इतना
वो दर्द देता है लेकिन दवा नहीं देता।

मैं उसका द्वार कभी जब भी खटखटाती हूं
दया दिखाता है पर आसरा नहीं देता।

अगर न होता मुसव्विर बड़ा खु़दा मेरा
फलक पे चांद-सितारे सजा नहीं देता।

भटक गया वो राह में तो फर्ज है तेरा
तू उसको राह सही क्यों दिखा नहीं देता।

वो जब भी मिलता है तो अपने घर बुलाता है
मगर कभी भी वो अपना पता नहीं देता।

तू सहता जाता है क्यूं उसकी बेतुकी बातें
पलट के तू भी उसे क्यों सुना नहीं देता।

न जाने कौन आस्तीं का सांप हो जाए
समय ये आज का इसका पता नहीं देता।

सभी सयाने हैं सुनता है कौन अब किसकी
मैं अब किसी को कोई मशविरा नहीं देता।

अगर न होता `किरण` वो अज़ीम जादूगर
यूं चांद बदली से ढककर छिपा नहीं देता।

आँकड़े चलते ही रहते हैं
अनगिनत बातों के
मसलन जनसंख्या,
जीवन मरण का हिसाब किताब
वैज्ञानिक और व्यवसाय के तथ्य
गिनती के पार शायद कुछ नहीं
हम भी इन्हीं गिनतियों का हिस्सा हैं
कहीं न कहीं इनमें ही
शामिल होना पड़ता है
ताउम्र रजिस्टरों और कंप्यूटर के
स्क्रीन्स पर सिर्फ और सिर्फ
क्रमबद्ध लोगों के नाम
उनके अंग्रेज़ी की वर्णमाला के
हिसाब से......
आदमी के नाम को
लिख दिया जाता है
आदमी थक जाता है
बिलों को भरते भरते
कितना कमाए
कितना खाये!
पर संतुष्टि ही नहीं मिलती
एक चक्र है
आजीवन इसी में चलना है
इन्ही आँकड़ो से गुज़रना
पहले जन्म प्रमाण पत्र
अंततः मृत्यु प्रमाण पत्र
और बीच में न जाने कितने
आंकड़ों का सच!!

कुछ सात समुंदर पार से,
कुछ सड़क किनारे ठेलों से;
सामान अनोखे लायी हूँ
दुकानों से कुछ मेलों से l

बोरी भरकर ले आई मैं ,
सपने बचपन की पलकों से,
और ले आई कुछ ग्राम अँधेरे ,
मैं घनी रात की अलकों से l

कुछ लीटर पानी ले आई ,
मैं सावन वाली बारिश से l
और पर दो ठो ले आई मैं ;
परियों से बड़ी सिफ़ारिश से l

बड़े जतन से किलोवाट कुछ ,
सूरज की गरमी लायी हूं ,
और मांगकर हरे पात से ;
शबनम की नरमी लायी हूं l

एक पाओ तारे भी लायी ,
वो सबसे मेहंगा सौदा था l
आसमान के सर्राफ़े में उसका ,
हीरों जैसा ओहदा था l

तारों के संग कुछ नील गगन भी ;
फ़्री ऑफर में आया था l
ये आसमान का टुकड़ा मुझको,
बहुत अधिक ही भाया था l

राह चलते जब पड़ा समुंदर ,
एक मुट्ठी भर ली रेत ;
और गुज़री जब एक गांव से,
एक बालिश्त ले आयी खेत l

फिर एक नज़र देखा थैले को ,
कुछ जगह अभी भी खाली थी ,
इक कोने में बीज भरे ;
कुछ हरी घास भी डाली थी l

मैने घर ले जाकर ये कुदरत के टुकड़े
बड़े प्रेम से छांटें थे ;
कुछ रखे अपने घर पर ,
कुछ आस पास में बाटें थे l

फूलों से जो रंग मांगकर,
लायी थी मैं किश्तों में l
रंग रुमानी और चटख भरे थे ,
हर नाते हर रिश्तों में l

कुछ आशा और मुस्कान को मैंने,
होम डिलीवरी पर मंगवाया है,
है दरवाजे पर दस्तक शायद,
पार्सल मेरा आया है पार्सल मेरा आया l

विचारों की उड़ान हमेशा चलती रहे, मन की गहराईयों में बहती रहे। आकाश की सीमाएँ पार करती रहे, सोच की बांहों में भरी रहे।
विचारों की उड़ान देश-विदेश की यात्रा है, संगीत की स्वर में बजती रहे। विचारधारा के बादलों को छिड़कती है, सृजन की आग में जलती रहे।
विचारों की उड़ान विचार के पंख है, हर संदेश को दूर-दूर तक ले जाती है। मन की उत्साह की चमक को बहती है, नई सोच को प्रगाढ़ता से पहचानती है।
विचारों की उड़ान दरिया को पार करे, विपदाओं के तूफ़ानों में भी टिकी रहे। ज्ञान की धारा में बहती रहे, संघर्षों के पहाड़ों को छिद्र बनाती रहे।
विचारों की उड़ान दृष्टि को उच्चाईयों तक ले जाती है, अविचलित मन की स्वतंत्रता बनाती है। विचार की गाथा हर किसी को सुनाती है, विचारों की उड़ान, नए सपनों को सजाती है।

बेटी पढ़ाओ बेटी बचाओ
लेकिन पढ़ी हुई बेटियां सुहाती कहाँ है ?
पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियां पिता के कंधे का बोझ और बढ़ा देती हैं ,
पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियां माँ के सहकर्मियों की भृकुटियाँ तना जाती हैं ,
पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियां अपनी ही मौसी ,बुआ ,चाची को पराया कर जाती हैं ,
पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियां पड़ोसियों के बेटों को परेशान करती हैं ,
पढ़ती बेटियां रात आठ बजे के बाद घर आये तो मोहल्ले में गंध फैलाती हैं ,
पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियां अपाला, गार्गी, अरुणा,सरोजिनी , सुषमा,
विजयलक्ष्मी की कल्पना साकार भी कर लें ,
लेकिन माँ ,पिता के मन को चैन का आकार नही दे पातीं।
पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियां अगर हिंसा का विरोध करें तो अपराध है ,
पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियां अगर क्लेश की मंशा भाप जाएं तो पाप है ,
पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियां अति भावुकता में गदर कर जाती हैं ,
पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियां ही जीवन मे सांस के लिए सिंगल मदर (कुछ) बन जाती हैं ,
और फिर सिंगल मदर बनी पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियां अगर सुबह बालकनी में दिख जाएं तो दिन बर्बाद हो जाता है ,
पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियों का छत पर टहलना निषेध है ,
पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियां पृथ्वी ग्रह के आकाश का टिमटिमाता तारा हैं ,
पढ़ती बढ़ती बेटियां लाडो नही होती ,
बस कहीं अपनों से लाड़ के लिए लड़ रही होती है।

source_fields.captured_title: MY SISTER AND I COMB A DOLL`S HAIR
source_fields.body_html:
We named her Starina, after a favorite
movie character.
Dressed in a glittering skirt and turquoise top, she smiled at us,
and her teeth were perfect pearls. Her long hair was a hot pink hue.

We took turns to run the tiny comb
through her rosy strands,
braiding them together with satin ribbons.
Nobody spoke a word.
She could`ve enjoyed the attention
had she been human,
but she wasn`t; she remained an enigma, her cerulean eyes open,
her lips frosted, her skin dusky:
I supposed she was surprised ;
(just as you are, just as the world is)
that two childless middle-aged women
would play with a doll.

Surrounded by gloom, still you are bright,
O` you are a queen of beauty dear night,
Floating all alone in an ocean of solitude,
You sing a song without any flute.

Twinkling stars and glimmering moon in the sky,
In your laps, they swing with joy so high,
Enlightening whole world shining every corner,
O` night, some magical wand you surely harbor.

Bats and owls enjoy your silence,
Creatures, mosquitoes and kites whisper and dance,
Glittering fireflies humming here and there,
Blooming jasmines smile everywhere.

O` in your veil, dreams come and go,
A magical spell to the lives they throw,
TV shows, movies, late night parties,
Somewhere a whisper of students` book`s pages.

Melody of love sung by the lovers,
Soothing lullabies chanted by the mothers,
O` night, your silent whispers are awesome,
Listening to which every heart blossoms.

1.
bus arrival
she steps out
of the puddle

2.
settling dusk
the tea-seller unseals
his milk packet

3.
gleaming sickle
a bard enters
the jute field

4.
deepening twilight ...
another honeycomb slice
into the bucket

5.
night street sky —
a boy spins the dough
on his fingertip

6.
two salmon
in his lave net
sunset song
7.
monsoon garden tour —
one among the group
loads his catapult

8.
the weight
of a raindrop
ant swarm

9.
Koel song
the tea-plucker adjusts
her sling bag

10.
another mound
the stink bug climbs
grandpa`s kneecap

All seemed in place
She had the solace
The sun rose and set on time
The church bells did chime
And one day she discovered...
It wasn`t just as peaceful as it seems
There was chaos within each soul
As the sun set, many were laid to rest
When the sun did rise, many were not alive,
In her vale, some floras blossomed
But some were pale
Whence she panned across the horizon
She grasped the reason
An unyielding storm had robbed the vale
Nipping the buds, unleashing its horror
The vale shuddered with this terror
Uprooted trees lay face down
The listless branches silently wailed
She was numb as she empathized
Was it the dejavu of her plight?
Ripped off her modesty,
Blamed for her tragedy
Her life and her vale were a cocktail of seasons

Autumn would follow spring
She and many others would travel through umpteen life`s swings!

Gratitude the word
I seek
People change during the spring
They fell in love with each other
They fell in love with themselves

Sun,
My face you touch
As a great protector
I feel the power of the heat

The world will change one day
When the people become
Generous as the Sun

On this day the burden of fifty-eight years
Of boons , blood , flesh , the marrow and hair , tears
Passion , anger , indifference , love
Thoughts , consciousness regard , insult .
This body bends down , the warmth of the body lessens
The different stories of life
She has seen life in delicate dreams
The half seen dream has ruined suddenly in mid night
Some dreams fall like tears on a pillow
The dreams has something beautiful
Something unlovely and too
The reality`s some coloured , some black and white drawings
What does the body do when burden on body increases
She tells the morning light to lessen the burden
She did not sleep last night
She was suffocated due to asthma and cold
She pleads to the Lord to keep the day calm and gentle
For the last eight months she has been enduring
The private grief of loss that burns down everything

The burden of her body
Slowly makes her lonely -
Friendless and sad cheerless .

भर उठती पीड़ा से
सोचती हर लूं इनकी सारी पीड़ा
देखूं इन्हें बस हंसते गाते

जब जब खड़ी होती ईश्वर के समक्ष
हाथ जोड़ जपती -

ॐ सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः
सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः
सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यन्तु
मा कश्चित् दुःख भाग्भवेत्

सोचती ईश्वर सुन रहे हैं मेरे मन की बात
अब संसार सुखमय हो जायेगा
मैं देखूंगी सबको मुस्कुराते ।

तृषा! मरुस्थल होती प्रकृति की,
कला की खंडित कृति की।
तृषा! पल-पल सिसकती,
बंजर हुई आकुल धरा की।
यह तृषा है!

कितने हृदय में अवसाद लिए,
निरंतर अनगिनत बोझ लिए।
नित नए विकल आकार धारण किए,
झोंकती हर देह अग्नि में अतृप्त क्षुधा लिए।
यह तृषा है!

विस्तृत महाक्षेत्र है चहुँओर इसका,
चक्रव्यूह मस्तिष्क, हृदय रण-क्षेत्र इसका।
रक्त-धमनियों और शिराओं में विस्तार इसका,
राजसी या रंक हर मन पर अधिकार इसका।
यह तृषा है!

इसके क्षणिक उन्माद से कभी डूबा किनारा,
इसी के सोपान से मिलता विश्व सारा।
अतृप्त विचरती इस लोक में परिपूर्णता को,
स्वप्नों को संपूर्ण करती, चिरकालिक अनंत धारा।
यह तृषा है…

source_fields.captured_title: हर एक सूर्यास्त की सुबह होगी
source_fields.body_html:
हर वो सपने जो टूट के बिखरने लगे हों
तो एक नया ख़्वाब जन्म लेगा
हर एक वो दरवाजा जो बंद हो गया है
एक नया द्वार खुल जाएगा
हर एक अंत की एक नई शुरूआत होगी
हर बीता हुआ लम्हा, एक नई सौगात होगा
हर एक दौर का एक नया अंजाम होगा
कुछ भी यन्हा ऐसा नहीं, जो विलुप्त हो गया
मिलती रहेगी हर एक चीज़ रुप बदल।।

As of sudden, my eyes got wet,
When I saw three little sparrows on my front window rack,
They are using their wings for informing me,
That I`m back. ""!

Why you have become so pessimistic about the false visions!
You should have to keep your faith in my unions,
We are not alone!
That`s why we have a lot of our potential boons.

And like you all my playmates,
Always used to pray for ourselves,
All of your pure love is ever with all of us,
So because of your divine devotional affections,
We all are in very safe zones.

I have been always praying to Lord for you my dear birds,
By the grace of God,
All of you will always be safe and secured,
This one is only the gift I have for you,
And hope all of you always will be stable and cheerful.

A moment dropped from the basket of time
And went to pay its many debts
Life quietly awaited it
Pain needed to be healed
Hearts needed to be joined
Duty cried for fulfillment
A smile no time to spread
Desire danced on darkened streets
Work tired, sat around
Honour, Duty dueled away
Relations just fell apart
The moment picked those heartstrings up
No music came no love sang
I went to look for the fallen moment
And found an entire saga of Faith
The Moment lost forever.

Distilled to live through blank breaths
aged until perfect, in casks of death,
treasured poison turns into elixir,
melancholy brews the salt of rain.

Dying is just a regular habit of life,
living is kept sealed as firewater
in a glass bottle kept away from sun.
Fulfilled grief bubbles in poured fun.

A smile wrought with a hidden sigh
yearns through ages of forgetting lies,
an immense pain grinding the stars,
sells naked nights at a sky high price.

Memories sip the aroma of old pain,
whore lips shape the crescent moon,
the wet mind soaks into the pillow,
ice cubes drown drunk babbles soon.

Golden solitude, poured on the rocks
intoxicates curtains and door locks;
when death gets sold at any price,
an uncertain life, who`ll borrow twice?

Selling leftover care, death earns life,
stray love licks careless dreams,spilt;
late moment runs gasping after time,
stares blank at the empty railway line.

Wheeled wagons of enslaved time
leave the platform clanking in rhyme,
learnt multiplication tables repeat
in a harmony everytime like a chime.

The white chest pocket retains
the smudged marks of vintage wine,
aborted pain bears a washable name,
that outlives the aroma of dry stains.

We are endowed with eyes not just for
viewing the world but also for
turning dreams into swings and rocking them.
Eyes should become shepherds
to graze the time that cannot become
a single teardrop even after burning many candles.
We should wander freely like antelopes
in the world which is akin to a thick jungle.

After judging the current moment like this,
I bring a strange illusion stored in an astral casket
as if my antique dreams are sprouting!
As if some ancient goddess, discerning the secret lingo,
scooped them and offered me sugar candies.
I convert the dreams of the past
to a swing again and rock them.
Realise that the dream-oozing eyes
are man`s true coronets;
the visible crowns are useless carvings.

After listening to the bells of the shrine
in the brittle sunshine of the morn,
I glide like waves from myself to my interior.
Appear as if jumping from one branch to another.
Time changes, so do the scenes.
The witness of eyes rocks me again.

Origin (Telugu): Raghu Seshabhattar
Translation: Elanaaga

Shining as moon and her lone journey
Delight in loneliness and tears
Not like the crowd
So I make my statue myself
The determination of life itself
The life of struggle
Light in ladder by myself
Myself guide and heart of kindness
Giving light to others in darkness
The shining bond of light
The words carve my statue
The hands type my words
Creating the strong statue
Never fallen behind
My journey of loneliness
Like alienated moon herself.
Shining in universe as art of words
Dignified by light of words
Making figure of my ethics
Life in darkness seeks brightness
Alone I am able to light myself.
Morning of words in light
Hiding behind the dark side
Making statue of my art
Giving priority to my insanity of ideas
Ethical garland of words
Around statue of myself, to the light of earth
Being goddess of universe.
Untouched by people, unused by fake
Words make the statue of myself.

Rambling through the Botanic Gardens
On a mellow Wellington day,
Hand-in-hand with 4 year old,
Inquisitive, granddaughter…
I see the world through her eyes.

We hear the cicadas buzzing hum.
She crouches down to a leaf,
And lifts a cicada onto her hand.
She proudly shows me each part,
While I wonder at her awe.

Skipping along paths happily,
Pockets full of treasures found,
We stop at the duck pond
And quack back at the ducks,
Before we sit and lick ice-creams.

“We’re having a day off,” she says
“Look at the stampede of birds,”
She points at birds chasing crumbs.
Relishing her discovery of words,
I want the joy of being a child again.

Flower petals, long forgotten, between pages old
The withered face brightened up, dubious memory unsold
Paise five, a lozenge bribe, conscripted in the battle royal
Sister;s love, a high ransom, runs the child fast
The irresponsible words, the letters, the yellow ashes of teenager;s fervour
Brother;s cries, mother;s cares, call of love, encrypted in tears
Monsoon cloud dampens the mood, jasmine atones
Her piety, her prayers
Ascetic life stupendous
Floating in the bowl, Najifa;s soul, loving barriers far and near
Sitting on the chair, writhing muscles hear
Jasmine, a converted rose.

source_fields.captured_title: The pain of an empty Heart
source_fields.body_html:
The red blood of my heart
Hed long turned into rocks of pain ,
Those rocks of pain in my heart
are too heavy to carry .
A shattered glass house in chest ,
Mental anguish , life`s turmoil ,
The agonizing cry of the heart `s chamber .
A trembling , entangled knot .
Thus , hidden within the deep abyss ,
It weaves through the web of sorrow .
An empty heart today ,
Sighing breaths ,sighing mind , sighing body .
The echo of sorrow resonates in the heart`s depths .
A peculiar agony in this sigh .
The pulsation of the heart grows silent and
fades away .
I become still ,
In the emptiness of the heart ,
it creates the sigh .
Those shattered fragments .
Transform into scattered syllables ,
Merging into the rhythm of my experience .
Each ripple of poetry
Forms a necklace of words.
In the garland of waves .
My soul finds its expression .
The inspiration to survive .

Life,
if not easy....
it is not that difficult..
the attitude makes it a cult

some learning
some unlearning
some rejection
some acceptance
a reflection
with the flow

life,
is a brook
with debris
some in the depth
some with flow
some leaving behind
makes it flow...

a brook..
a river...
flows, never looking back
only forward
to reach its destination
the sea.

source_fields.captured_author: Asish Kumar Mishra/ ଆଶିଷ କୁମାର ମିଶ୍ର
source_fields.body_html:
ଭ୍ରମର କି ବୁଝେ କେବେ
ଦେହ ଓ ଦରଜ
ଜାଣିଜାଣି ଫୁଲ ସିନା
ବିଶ୍ବାସରେ ଦୁଃଖ ଯାକ ସହେ

ଯେଉଁ ଫୁଲ ପ୍ରୀତି କରି
ଦୁଃଖ ରଖିନାହିଁ
ତା ବାସ୍ନାରେ
ଅରଣ୍ୟକୁ ସୁଖ ଘାରେନାହିଁ

ଯେଉଁ ଫୁଲ ଖୋଜେନାହିଁ
ଯାତନାର ଡାଳ
ଝଡିଯାଏ ତା ପାଖୁଡା
ଡେମ୍ଫ ଛିଡେ ନାହିଁ !

ଶୋକ ଗୀତ ଶୁଣିଶୁଣି
ଜିଉଁଥାଏ ଯେଉଁ ଫୁଲ
ପବନ ତା ନିଶ୍ବାସରୁ
ଯାଏ ନାହିଁ ଫେରି

ଜାଣିଜାଣି ତମେ ମତେ
ଦେଉଥିବ ଦୁଃଖ
ସରିଯିବି ସରିଯିବି
ଦୁଃଖ ଗଲେ ସରି !

ପାପୁଲିର ଭାଗ୍ଯରେଖା ମୋର ବୋଲି
ଯେଉଁଦିନୁ ଦାବିକରି ବସ
ସେଇଦିନୁ ଜୀବନ ଜିଇବାର
ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟତା ଆଉ କିଛି ଥାଏ କି ??

ତମ ଛାତିତଳ ସଂଗୋପିତ ଇଚ୍ଛା ଯେବେ
କଡ ଲେଉଟାଏ ବେଳ ଅବେଳରେ
ସତ୍ଯର ଉପକ୍ରମରେ ଅସତ୍ୟ ବି
ପାଷାଣ ପାଲଟିଯାଏ ଅନାୟାସରେ ।

ଯାବତୀୟ ଦୁଃଖକୁ ତଥାସ୍ତୁ କହି
ମଲା ସ୍ବପ୍ନର ମାଟି ନେଇ ତୁମେ
ଗଢିପାର ନିଜ ମନ ମୁତାବକ
ଜମା ଶବ୍ଦ ତୋଳୁନଥିବା ଈଶ୍ବରୀଟେ ।

ଏକ ସ୍ରୋତହୀନ ନଈ ଆଖିର
ନିଭୃତ ଡୋଳାରେ ସାଇତା ନୀରବତା
ବନ୍ଦ ଲଫାପାର ଚିଠିପରି ଅପଢା ହୋଇ
ରହିଥାଏ ଅନ୍ତିମ ଯାତ୍ରା ଯାଏ ସିନା
ତମ ସଂଯୋଜିତ ଶବ୍ଦପୁଞ୍ଜ ଫିଟାଇ ପାରେନା
ଜୀବନ ବେଦର ସେ ନିଗୂଢ ରହସ୍ଯ ।

ଏବେ କୁହ ତୁମେ ,
ସ୍ବପ୍ନର ବୀଜଟିଏ ଗଜୁରିବ ବୋଲି
ମୁଣ୍ଡା ମୁଣ୍ଡା ଶୁଖିଲା ମାଟିରେ
ନିରୁତା ପ୍ରେମର ଜଳ ସିଞ୍ଚି
ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରିବି କିପରି ?

ଯେଉଁ ଅତିଥିମାନେ ଆସିଥିଲେ
ମୋର ବାହାଘରକୁ ଗତ ସଂଧ୍ୟାରେ
ସୁପ୍ରଭାତ କହିବାକୁ ଗଲା ବେଳେ
ସେମାନେ ଡେଇଁ ସାରିଥିଲେ ଗାଆଁର ସୀମାଂତ

ପତ୍ନୀଂକ ପ୍ରଥମ ଗର୍ଭ କଷ୍ଟରେ
ସାରା ସକାଳ ମୁଁ ବ୍ୟସ୍ତ ବିବ୍ରତ
ଏଂତୁଡିରୁ ନାଭିନାଡ ଛିଣ୍ଡାଇ
ଝିଅ ଦଉଡି ଆସିଲା ମୋର କୋଳକୁ
କହିଲା, ବାପା, ତମର କପାଳରେ
ଏ ତିଳଚିହ୍ନ ତ ନଥିଲା ମୋର ଜନ୍ମବେଳେ

ସଂଜ ନେଇ ଆସିଲା
ଶତାୟୂ ପିତାଂକ ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ସଂବାଦ
ପୂଜାରେ ଆସିପାରେ କହି
ସାନପୁଅ ସେତେବେଳେ
ସପରିବାର ଉଠି ସାରିଥିଲା ଟ୍ରେନରେ

ଫୁଲକୁଣ୍ଡରେ ପାଣି ଢାଳି
ଆଖି ଉଠାଇଲା ବେଳକୁ
ମୋର ଦେହରୁ ବିଚ୍ଛିନ୍ନ ମୋର ଛାଇ
ଘର କଂପୁଥାଏ
ଅନାଗତ ଆଗଂତୁକ ମାନଂକ
ହସ ଓ କାନ୍ଦରେ

କେତେ ସଅଳ ଓ ସହଜରେ
ମୁଁ ପାରି ହୋଇଯାଏ ଖେଳ ପଡିଆ
ମହୁଲ ବଣ ଓ ଶ୍ରାବଣର ନଦୀ
ବାଘ ଗୁଂଫା ଓ ମରୁଭୂମି,
ପରିଚିତ ଶବ ମାନଂକୁ
ପଥର ପରି ଗଡାଇ ଦିଏ ରାସ୍ତା ତଳକୁ
ମନ୍ତ୍ର ପରି ପକ୍ଷୀ ମାନଂକୁ ଉଡାଇ ଦିଏ
ଅରଣ୍ୟ ମୁହାଁ ଓ ଘୋଷଣା କରିଦିଏ
ଯେ ଏ ଦେହ ଖଣ୍ଡିକ ବି ଆଉ ମୋର ନୁହେଁ

କେତେ ଶୀଘ୍ର ସରିଯାଏ ସବୁ ସତରେ
ପାଦ ବଢାଇ ଦେଲେ ସରିଯାଏ ରାସ୍ତା
ଆଖି ଖୋଲିଦେଲେ ସରିଯାଏ ଦୃଶ୍ୟ
ହାତ ବଢାଇ ଦେଲେ ସରିଯାଏ ସ୍ବପ୍ନ

ତଥାପି କଣ ସବୁ ଜାଣିହେଲା
କେତେବେଳେ କଅଣ ଘଟିଗଲା
ଶୋଇଥିବା ବେଳେ ଘରେ ଓ ବାହାରେ

ସତେକଣ ସବୁକିଛି ମୋର ଜାଣିବାର ଥିଲା
ଶୁଣିବାର ଥିଲା ରାତି ଅଧରେ
ଅଜ୍ଞାତ ଲୋକଂକର ଡାକ
ଟିପି ରଖିବାର ଥିଲା କାହାର କେତେ ଆୟୂଷ
ମଣିଷ ଓ ଅସରପାଂକ ଜନ୍ମ ମୃତୁ ହାର,
ତାକୁ ଅଲବତ୍ ପିଛା କରିବାର ଥିଲା
ଯିଏ ମୋର କବାଟରେ ସମନର ନୋଟିସ୍ ମାରି
ଖସିଗଲା ଅଂଧାରରେ

ସତେ କଣ ମୋର ବଂଚିବାର ଥିଲା
ଆୟୂଷ ବାହାରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ଏକ
ଅଜଣା ଆୟୂଷ !

source_fields.captured_author: Prasanna Kumar Swain / ପ୍ରସନ୍ନ କୁମାର ସ୍ଵାଇଁ
source_fields.body_html:
ମୁଁ ଆଜିଯାଏ ସେଇ କୌତୁହଳ ମାନଙ୍କୁ
ପିଠିରେ ବୋହି ଚାଲିଛି

ଏଇ ଯେମିତି
ନାରୀକୁ କିଏ ଆଙ୍କିଲା ପୃଥିବୀଟେ କରି
ପ୍ରେମିକକୁ ଦେଲା ଉତ୍ତପ୍ତ ଅଗ୍ନିରେ 
ଝାମୁଯାତ୍ରା ଦଣ୍ଡ?

ଗପ ଭିତରେ ଭରିଲା
କୋଟି କଳ୍ପନାର ରାଗ ଅନୁରାଗ
ଜୀବନ ଭିତରେ ଏତେ ଛନ୍ଦ ଓ କପଟ
କବିତା ଦେହକୁ ଗଢିଲା ଲହୁଣୀ ପରିକା
ଚଲା ବାଟରେ ଏତେ ରୁକ୍ଷ ପ୍ରତାରଣା?

କେମିତି ବୋଉମାନେ
ଚୁଲି ଜାଳୁ ଜାଳୁ
ଜାଳି ଦିଅନ୍ତି ନିଜର ଗୋଡ଼ଯେ
ବାପlମାନେ କ୍ରମେ କ୍ରମେ ପାଲଟନ୍ତି କୂର୍ମ
ଏକଥା ଆଜିଯାଏ ମୁଁ ଜାଣି ପାରିଲିନି।

ମୋର ପ୍ରକାଶିତ ବହି,
କୈଶୋରର ପୁରୁଣା ଅକ୍ଷର
କବିତା ଆସରରୁ କିଛି ତାଳି କୁ ନେଇ
ତୃପ୍ତିର ନିଃଶ୍ୱାସ ନେଉଥିବା ବେଳେ
ମୁଁ ଏଯାଏ ବୁଝି ପାରିଲିନି

କୋଉଟା ଜୀବନ ପାଇଁ ଭାରି ଦରକାର
ଚୋରା ଚାଇତାଳି ନା ଚାଷ ଜମି ମାଟି ସମତୁଲ?

ମୁଁ ଏଯାଏ ଜାଣି ପାରିଲିନି
ସବୁ ନଈତ ସମୁଦ୍ରକୁ ଧାଉଁଥାନ୍ତି
ଆଉ ବହିଲା ବେଳେ
ଟେରୀ ଝିଅଙ୍କ ପରି ଆକାଶକୁ ଚାହିଁଥାନ୍ତି କାଇଁ?

ପବନକୁ କିଏ ଦେଲା ଏତେ ଅଧିକାର
ଇଚ୍ଛାଧୀନ ସମ୍ରାଟଙ୍କ ଅବାଧ ପ୍ରବେଶ ପ୍ରସ୍ଥାନ ?
ଅଥଚ କେହି ତାକୁ ଦେଖି ପାରିଲେନି
ଚର୍ମ ଚକ୍ଷୁରେ କେମିତି ?

ସତରେ ମୁଁ ଏଯାଏଁ ଜାଣି ପାରିଲିନି
ଫୁଲଠୁ ବି ବାସେ ମଣିଷ ମାନଙ୍କ 
ଏ ଚର୍ମଦେହ କେମିତି
ପେଟମାନଙ୍କ ଠାରୁ କିଏ ବଢ଼େଇ ଦେଲା 
ଭୋକ ମାନଙ୍କ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ?

ମୁଁ ଧନ୍ଦି ଚକଟି ହୁଏ
କିଏ ରଖିଲା
ସାପ ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ ମଣି
ଗର୍ଭ ଭିତରେ ଖଣି
କିଏ ଝାଳକୁ କଲା ଏତେ ଝଲମଲ
ଶୃଙ୍ଗାରରେ ସହସ୍ର ପରାଜୟ
ଅନ୍ଧାରକୁ କଲା ଅବିଶ୍ୱାସୀ
ଆଲୁଅକୁ ଦେଲା ପକ୍ଷୀଙ୍କ କାକଳି
ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ସନ୍ଦେହ
ଓ ସତ୍ୟର ମାନଚିତ୍ରକୁ 
ମିଛର ଅକ୍ଷାଂଶ ଦ୍ରାଘିମା ?

ସତରେ ମୁଁ ଏ ଯାଏଁ ଜାଣି ପାରିଲିନି
କିଏ ବଡ଼
ଘୁର୍ଣ୍ଣିର ଘୁଙ୍ଗୁର
ନା
ଶୀତଳ ହସ୍ତାକ୍ଷର ପହିଲି ମେଘର ?

କିଏ ଆପଣାର
ପତ୍ନୀ ନା ପ୍ରେମିକା
ପ୍ରାରବ୍ଧ ନା କ୍ରିୟମଣ
ସ୍ବପ୍ନ ନା ଜାଗରଣ
ମାୟା ନା ମୋକ୍ଷ
ଲକ୍ଷେ ତାରା ନା ଗୋଟେ ଜହ୍ନରାତି
କଦମ୍ବ ନା କବର ?

କିଏ ମୋତେ ବେଶି ଦୁଃଖ ଦିଏ
ପ୍ରାଣ ନା ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା
ପ୍ରେମ ନା ପ୍ରତୀକ୍ଷା
ଅଶ୍ରୁ ନା ଉର୍ମି
ସନ୍ୟାସ ନା ସାନ୍ନିଧ୍ୟ?

ଛାଡ଼ ମୁଁ କୋଉ ଜାଣି ପାରିଲିକି
ସତରେ କେମିତି ଲେଖାଯାଏ
କବିତା ଯେ
କେମିତି କହି ପାରିଥାନ୍ତି 
ମୁଁ ଯାହା ସତରେ ଚାହୁଁଛି
କିଏ ସତ୍ୟ
ଜୀବନ ଗଛର ଡେମ୍ଫ
ନା
ମରଣ ଫୁଲର ମହକ ?

ଚିରକାଳତ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଘେରରେ ପ୍ରସନ୍ନ।

ଯେଉଁ ଦଲକାଏ ପବନ
ମହୁଲବଣରୁ ଭାସିଆସେ
ସେଥିରେ ମିଶିଥାଏ
ଗୋଟେ ଧାଙ୍ଗିଡୀର
ଅବୁଝା ଗୀତ ।
ଯେଉଁ ଜହ୍ନ ଆକାଶରେ ହସେ
ସେଦିନ ସଂଜରେ କେହି ଜଣେ
ଏତେ ଆନମନା କରେ ଯେ,
ଲେଖିବାକୁ ଇଚ୍ଛା ହୁଏ
ଗୋଟେ ଲୁହର କବିତା ।

ଯେଉଁ ଅଦିନ ବର୍ଷାରେ
ଭିଜି ଭିଜି ସେ ଆସେ
ମୁଁ ଦେଖୁ ଦେଖୁ
ସେ ନିଜକୁ ଶୁଖେଇଦିଏ
ଅଂଧାରର ଆଲିଙ୍ଗନରେ।
ଯେଉଁ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ ଟିକକ
ସେ ଆଖିରେ ବୋଳିଦେଇ ଯାଏ
ସେ ରାତିରେ ଶବ୍ଦ ସବୁ
ଆଉ ଧରାପଡନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ ହାତରେ।

ତଥାପି ସେ ଭାବନାର ନଈକୂଳେ
ବିଶ୍ୱାସର ବନିଶୀ ଧରି
ତାକୁ ଜଗି ବସିବାକୁ ହୁଏ
ଦିନ ପରେ ଦିନ
ସେ କିନ୍ତୁ ଆସେ
ପୁଣି ଆସେ ନାହିଁ
ଆସିଲେ ସେ କାଳେ ଲୁଚି ଲୁଚି
ଭାସିଯାଏ ନଈର ସୁଅରେ ।।

source_fields.captured_author: Binaya Kumar Mohanty / ବିନୟ କୁମାର ମହାନ୍ତି
source_fields.body_html:
ଆକାଶମୁହାଁ ଗୁଡ଼ିର ନଟେଇ ଛିଣ୍ଡିଯିବା ଦେଖିଚି,
ଦେଖିଚି ବି
ରାବଣର ଯୋଗୀ ବେଶ।

ଯାହା ଦେଖିପାରିନି ଏଯାଏଁ
ବୋଧହୁଏ ଗୋଟେ ଅନାଥ ଖପୁରୀର ଅବଶିଷ୍ଟ ଭବିଷ୍ୟତ
ଯାହା ଏବେ ବି ସଂଶୟ।

ମୁଁ କାଲିର ସକାଳ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରିବାକୁ ଥିବି କି ନା,
ମୋର ଅପୂର୍ଣ ଅଭିଳାଷ ମାନଙ୍କ ଅଭିଷେକୋତ୍ସବକୁ
ମୋତେ ଡକା ପଡିବ କି ନା,
ମୁଁ କି ଜାଣେ!

ମୋ କାନରେ ଏବେ ବାଜୁଚି
ଗୋଟେ ରଣଭୂମିର
କର୍କଶ ଦୁନ୍ଦୁଭି,
ମୋତେ ଦିଶୁଛି ପ୍ରେମିକମାନେ ସାଞ୍ଜୁ ଶିରସ୍ତ୍ରାଣ ପିନ୍ଧି ଯୁଦ୍ଧପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହେଉଥିବାର
ଅଦ୍ଭୁତ ଦୃଶ୍ୟ।

ଭବିଷ୍ୟତ ନଥିବା ଗୋଟେ ସିଂହାସନର ମାଲିକାନା ପାଇଁ ମସୁଧା ମାନଙ୍କ ମାତାଲ୍ ପଣ
ଏବେ ଜଳ ଜଳ।

ପୂର୍ବରାତିର ଶାନ୍ତି ଚୁକ୍ତି
ଫସର ଫାଟିଚି,
ବୟସ୍କ ମାନଙ୍କର ବଡପଣ
ଉଲଗ୍ନ ହୋଇସାରିଛି
ଦାଣ୍ଡ ଘାଟରେ।

ମୁଁ ଏବେ ମୋ ନାଁ କୁ ନେଇ
କ`ଣ କରିବି!

ଏ ପରିଚୟକୁ ନେଇ କୋଉ ହାଟର ସଉଦା କରିବି,
କୋଉ ବଗିଚାର ଫୁଲକୁ ନେଇ
ମାଳା ଗୁନ୍ଥିବି!

ତୁମେ ପାରୁଚ ତ ଫେରେଇ ନିଅ
ନଈକୁ ନିଜ ବାଟକୁ ,
ନିଆଁକୁ ନିଜ ଭାବରେ ଜଳିବାକୁ ଦିଅ।

ଚୁଲିକୁ ଯାଉ ତୁମ ବଡପଣ,
ଇତିହାସ ସାକ୍ଷୀ ଥାଉ।

(ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ଲେଖକ ଏବଂ ଚିନ୍ତାନାୟକ କିଶନ ପଟ୍ଟନାୟକଙ୍କୁ ସମର୍ପିତ)

ମୁଁ କ`ଣ ଏପରି ଏକ
କବିତା ଲେଖି ପାରିବି
ଯାହା ମୋ ରାଜ୍ୟର
ସାଧାରଣ ଲୋକଙ୍କ
କାମରେ ଆସିବ

ସେ କବିତା
ମୋ ଭାଷା ସପକ୍ଷରେ ରହି
ମୋ ଭାଷାଭାଷୀମାନଙ୍କୁ
ଏକ ଅର୍ଥ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିପାରିବ
ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଜୀବନକୁ
ଅର୍ଥମୟ କରିଦେବ
ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ସମାନ ଅର୍ଥ ନହେଲା ନାହିଁ
ସଭିଙ୍କୁ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛଳ କରିଦେଇପାରିବ

ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ଏମିତି ଏକ
ଅର୍ଥନୈତିକ ସୋପାନକୁ ନେଇଯିବ
ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ହା - ହୁତାଶମୟ
ଜୀବନ ନଥିବ
ବା ଜୀବନର ଦୁର୍ବିସହପଣ ନଥିବ

ମୋ କବିତା
ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ କ`ଣ ଏକ
ନୂଆ ବିକଳ୍ପଟିଏ ଦେଇପାରିବ
ବିକଳ୍ପଟିଏ ରହିଥିବାର
ରାସ୍ତାଟିକୁ ଦେଖାଇ ଦେଇପାରିବ
ଏକ ନୂଆ ରାସ୍ତାର
ସମ୍ଭାବନା ଦେଖାଇ ଦେବାର ଅର୍ଥ
ସୁନ୍ଦର ସ୍ୱପ୍ନଟିଏର ନିର୍ମାଣ କରିବା
ମୋ କବିତା କ`ଣ
ସୁନ୍ଦର ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିପାରିବ

ଏହି ଭୟଙ୍କର ସମୟରେ
ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ ବି ଅନେକ କିଛି
କୁନି ଛୁଆର
କୁଆଁ ରବରେ
ପରିବାରଟିଏ ନୂଆ ଉତ୍ସାହରେ
ଆନମନା ହେଲା ପରି
ମୋ କବିତା କ`ଣ
କୁଆଁ ରବ ହୋଇ
ଏଠି ଖୁସିର ପରିବେଶଟିଏ
ନିର୍ମାଣ କରିପାରିବ ।

(୨)

ମୋ କବିତା କ`ଣ
କୃଷିଜୀବୀଙ୍କୁ କୃଷିର
ନୂଆ ମାର୍ଗ ଦେଖାଇପାରିବ
ସେ କ`ଣ
ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ପୁଣି ଥରେ
କ୍ଷେତ ଆଡ଼କୁ
ମୁହାଁଇ ନେଇ ପାରିବ
ଆଉ ସବୁଜ ଲହଲହ
ଶସ୍ୟ ଶ୍ୟାମଳା କ୍ଷେତ ଦେଖାଇ
ତାଙ୍କ ମୁହଁରେ
ହସ ଭରି ଦେଇପାରିବ

ମୋ କବିତା କ`ଣ
କ୍ଷେତର ସବୁଜିମାକୁ ନେଇ
କୃଷକମାନଙ୍କ ଘର ଓ ଖମାରକୁ
ସବୁଜ ରଙ୍ଗରେ ରଙ୍ଗୀନ କରିଦେଇପାରିବ

ମୋ କବିତା କ`ଣ
ବନବାସୀଙ୍କୁ ତାଙ୍କ ବଣ
ଫେରାଇ ଦେଇପାରିବ
ତାଙ୍କୁ କ`ଣ ସେ
ହେ ଜଙ୍ଗଲର ଅଧିବାସୀ
ନିଅ, ନିଅ ତୁମ ଜଙ୍ଗଲ
ନିଅ ନଦୀ
ନିଅ ଜମି
ନିଅ ସବୁଜତା,
ସରଳତା ନିଅ
ଓ ସ୍ୱଚ୍ଛ ରୁହ, ହୁଅ
କହି ଦେଇପାରିବ

ମୋ କବିତା କ`ଣ
କମ୍ପାନୀମାନଙ୍କ ଲୋଭ ସମ୍ମୁଖରେ
ଏକ ଭୀଷଣ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧ ହୋଇ
ଠିଆ ହୋଇ ପାରିବ
ଲଢି ପାରିବ
ଲଢି ବିଜୟୀ ହେବ

ମୋ କବିତା କ`ଣ
ପ୍ରକୃତିକୁ ପରାଜିତ କରିବାକୁ
ଚାଲୁ ରହିଥିବା ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ବିରୁଦ୍ଧରେ
ଏକ ଆହ୍ୱାନ ହୋଇ
ଉଭା ହୋଇ ପାରିବ

The declining age first tastes like honey, yet its instant fermenting sweat, the constant human struggle,
the cramped and inflexible exercise of power
squeezes stinking secretion through
the pore billions of Earth`s skins.

The degenerate species are dying out. The Savior
is climbing on the lustfully gaping chimney of the caves
towards our Earth mother`s womb.
The universe: an umbrella.
Successive events: sewing machine.
The creative intention: dissection table.
What it`ll find is Cybele`s frog-headed, rotten fetuses,
their tales are arrowhead claws
(We lifted the processes
of the dead world to the vegetative level,
and indeed, fat homunculus
jumped out of the alchemist`s cauldron,
but at a lower quality,
as its creator.)

The offspring are our caricatures!
The offspring are our caricatures! p>

The eternal mystery is research, experiment,
when Aethyr collapses into a magical orgasm,
and explodes.

The remains are a cooled off, lifeless cosmic spider web,
what for a moment, the charlatan
enchanted to live.

 

(Translated by Gabor Gyukics)

I know how they have been acting out
some role from an ancient time—

long, episodic, their fate
rising and falling with the seasons,

their words at times reduced
to a bare, granular trickle of emptiness,

hushed to the silence of all time,
or at other times, raised to the insanity

of space, rushing towards the end.
They are what we could not be, can never be—

looking far and distant, always,
their hearts beating

to the pulse and body of the earth
in slavish imitation of a script

that we can hardly follow.
There is only a mute gesture of invitation,

intimate as life, of death, unaware of our
smaller commitments toward our

children and ourselves, beckoning us
to participate in their predestined games.

I don`t dream anymore
I sleep to forget
I stand in front of a mirror
To find myself

My true self
I hide my feelings in a jar of dead leaves
That gives me courage to let go

Alone in a world of dilemmas
I wait and wait with lots of patience
I have succeeded to find my foes
In solitude of my changing time

A sublime phenomenon
Present is painful
Who am I to forgive

My success
that I understood
We come alone
We exit in silence

An unknown vastness of dignity
Where sparkling stars
greet with open arms...

Never ever cry for me
I will return as a yellow butterfly

She has laid herself by the darkness thinking,
`How far pungent the odour of blood can be!`
The wall has reached her forehead,
her eyes- won`t they be able to catch a glimpse of the sky?
Would they flow and flow forward?
Be engrossed in the sound of blast?
The flowers must be in bloom somewhere,
she thinks-
The birds chirp.
The timid girls sing.
The heart lives in innocence,
while this world proceeds inchmeal
transforming itself into Afghanistan.

Translated by Shyamashri Ray Karmakar

The definition of happiness
Keeps changing with time

A child finds happiness
In flying a colourful kite
Or watching an insect totter
Or seeing a bird fly in the sky
Or even getting dirty
In the muddy pool of water

The requirements of life
Keep increasing and expanding
As one grows up
And the meaning of happiness
Also gets modified
The little things
Which he so enjoyed as a kid
Seem so miniscule
The things that give him pleasure now
Are different-
Money
Fame
Social status
Number of cars which one owns
Number of apartments
Oh! The list is endless!

But as one keeps ageing further
The truth dawns upon the man
The worldly things do not matter at all
For
Everything shall go to dust...
And the definition of happiness
Alters once again....

ଏକ ପାର୍ଶ୍ବରେ ବୁଦାବୁଦା ଗହଳିଆ ଚିହ୍ନାଚିହ୍ନା ଗଛସବୁ,
ଏକ ପାର୍ଶ୍ବରେ ଏକଦମ୍ ଅଜଣା ଓ ଭୟ ସଂଚାର କରୁଥିବା ନଈର ସ୍ରୋତ,
ଏକ ପାର୍ଶ୍ବରେ ହଳଦୀ ଗୁରୁଗୁରୁ ମେଞ୍ଚେ ଚଢେଇ ଓ ଶସ୍ୟଭରା ଶ୍ୟାମଳ କ୍ଷେତ,
ମନ୍ଦିରରେ ପ୍ରେମିକ ଭଳି ଗୁଡାଏ ଈଶ୍ୱରଙ୍କ ମୂର୍ତ୍ତି,

ସ୍ତନପାନ ପରେ ଶୋଇ ପଡିଥିବା ମୋର ଶିଶୁମାନଙ୍କ କପାଳରେ ଚୁମା ଦେଲି,

ସେମାନଙ୍କ କୁନିକୁନି ନରମ ପାଦ ପାଇଁ ମସୃଣ ଓ ଫର୍ଚ୍ଚା ରାସ୍ତା ତିଆରିଲି ।

ସେଦିନ ଢଙ୍କା ହେଇଥିବା ଜହ୍ନରାତି ଥିଲା ସବୁଠି,
ସେଦିନ ସ୍ଥିର କଲି ଇତିହାସ ମତେ ବାରମ୍ବାର ପ୍ରେମଗ୍ରସ୍ତ କରୁଥିବା ଏକ କୁହୁକ,
ସେଦିନ ମୁଁ କୁହୁଳିଲି ଓ କୁହୁଳିଲି ମାତ୍ର ।

ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଦିନରେ ଫେରାର୍ ଥିଲି ମୋ ଠିକଣାରୁ,

ମୁଁ ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣୁ ହେଉଥିଲି କାହାକୁ ଶୁଭୁ ନଥିବା ସ୍ୱରରେ,

Lucid words cloud
Prisms of versed contradiction
Wobbled into poetic impotence

Looked around
Scarce dollops of insanity
Creeps of webbed catastrophe
Deformed slings strip in shame

That lost hunch
Intuitive notions wake in delight
Silent screams hammer in delight
Tired breath and its cursed culpability

Through your answered denials
My arrogant faith slogs to believe

Do you see the future?
Please tell me yours,
ten years from now.

Don`t tell me about mine.
I don`t want to know.
I am happy with the sudden turn

of the river here.
I am happy with the unkempt room
and the old, injured mirror

Green leaves play
hide and seek with me
and turn brown, in front

The earth is young,
so are we. Don`t tie us
with the lure of the future

and mathematical steps.
Let the future be dark
I`ll invoke colors to illuminate.

© Aneek Chatterjee

I do not know how many gates or walls each city has,
but I am sure they exist, invisible to the naked eye.
So some cities smell of apartheid and closure,
some of salt-spray and dried fish,
still others of camphor and sandal wood.

There are other kind of cities too-
where midnight crosses sand dunes
to reflect black shadows on walls.
Cities halted by time.
Cities where solitude patrols on horse- back.
Cities extravagant with sunlight.

Yet there is a city different…
Where autumn evening wipes a mirror
to reflect a lotus.
A city of misty mountain blue.
A city hovering over closed eyelids.

In the depressing fold of Time
Man has to remain in mind`s long hibernation
Engulfed in foggy blankets
With apathetic torpor
Despite the frequent trepidation
Of the half-dead earth.

He waits and waits till the death of dark nights
When the rays win over the smog
Day opens its big eyes--
The ball of fire
Rolling in the stooping sky
From the dark dusk to the bright dawn.

In the refreshing fold of Life
Man feels delighted, rejuvenated from within
Following the footprints of the light
Picking up the glowing meaning
From all dark moments,
Scattered in hazy maizes, wrought by Time.

Glossy foundation blended with a fine touch
The compact should not be too much
Concealers hide all the flaws
While applying highlighter you should know when to pause
Blushing on the high cheekbones
Each step and stroke tone on tone
With arched eyebrows and the coloured eyelids
A touch of a mascara is all you need
The Kohl laden eyes set on fire
The perfect winged eyeliner stroke is all you desire
Don`t forget to tint your lips
A spray of perfume is the last tip

Mastering the art of make-up
Is not at all easy, but is real tough
But then the ageing lines and crows-feet near the eyes
Leads you to realise
It`s better to wear make-up as a mask
Because showing your real face is a difficult task
In a society where hypocrisy is the new trend
Make-up comes as a true friend
People pat your back and will say age with grace
But it`s again they, who will beauty shame and create mess
So philosophically be proud of your flaws and scars
Lastly wear your make-up and shine as a star

Then you asked me, why do I shine so bright?
I said, my love, because I amyour agenda of the light!

Then you pondered, how can my love be such a delight!
I said calmly, because love, at once, is opaque and clear daylight.

You brooded, `how can someone, how can someone
be a lover of your poise, your repute!!`

I said,Samudra Manthan, the churning of the ocean, was accomplished to extract
the Amrit, celestial nectar, where the Devas and the Danavastook part.

In a tug of war challenged to roil the elixir from the ocean
bed to attain immortality and eternal life beyond bereavement.

The medieval Hindu Theology encompasses this legend
that the Devas were carrying the amṛitaway from the Asuras, adamant.

Drops of nectar fell at four places on the Earth--Haridwar, Prayaga (Prayagraj),
Trimbak (Nashik), and Ujjain, in their divine right.

In the churning of the ocean delightful treasures,the architypes
for their earthly and heavenly complements were brought.

Oceanic depths broughtChandra, the moon,Parijata, the tree fragrant,
the four-tusked elephant Airavata, Lord Indra`s mount.

Amid all that glory and glee of me, your Lakshmi, you churned our fate,
using Mount Meru as the rod and Vasuki as rope, the king of the serpent.

You became Lord Shiva, you chose to devour the poison, you drank it.
In my `manthan`, you elected glory for me and for yourself, venom was kept.

Nandini`s conjecture--love churned me, this love was my `manthan`.
Love took me out of the darkness of coalfields, like a granite.

My adorable, love is ember, love granite, love murky pebble,love-- a stone bright.
Love devotion, love renunciation, love merger, love—a prayer from the heart.

The most refreshing source of positive energy
born from the womb of imagination,
God has ever been a mystery.
Some see the force as abstract,
for some it incarnates from time to time since ages.
My God not flesh and blood is a poetic image.
My God is a poetic image, the confluence
of contemplations, dreams and perceptions,
wherein all come, feel full, meet and merge.

My God is a poetic image, rather a whole poem in itself
with all its cosmic connotations, transcendental,
beyond the confines of a cage, the priestly hedge.

Everything visible and invisible,
my God is my day, my God is my night
and all that is envisioned
in the enlightening embers of twilight
from beginning to the end and all possible beginnings.
The entire cosmos is there in the eyes of my Lord,
everything we come across:
the crescent moon and the cross,
the calmness of the ocean in meditation,
the purgatorial fire, storm,
restlessness and pangs of the creative process,
Kaal Chakra and Karma,
the sense sublime of the compassionate mind
and all that we love to find where there is Raj Dharma.

This amazing poetic image,
The God of the woods and wonder,
in its unifying whole uplifts the soul,
the soul intensely passionate and humble,
and makes everything beautiful,
binding us together in its love and divine splendor.

Smitten by living
Drowned in experience
I was heedless
Till a moment fraught
Taught me
the lesson of mortality
Not morbid but prescient.

I finally opened
The Bhagvad Gita of life
Learnt that birth is
But a preparation of death
It is only this
Now and here,
That is ephemeral and eternal.

Oh dearly beloved
Architect of blood
And filial tenderness
Oh soul of my being
Haven of care
Oh fount of wisdom
And cherished smile
Warm armed
Lotus palmed
Deer eyed

The heart of attachment
Was extinguished in a moment
And in that moment
The essence of love
Became the dust of detachment
Obliterated except in the endless mind

Eyes, ears, arms, tears
Seek revalidation
And I`m left with the trophy
Of a framed photo
And the goodbye
Of two charred feet.

Let us go to eat out today

A white cool wind is blowing
Let us go to eat out today
Let us bring back
our missing selves today
Let those two old hands of ours
clasp each other today
A white cool wind 1s blowing
Let us go to eat out today
Let our shadows
chat at the dining table today
and let us watch them closely
The shadows can’t tell a hie
as they have no tongue to speak
Silence is their speech
Let us listen to them today
A chilly white wind is blowing
Let us go to dine out today
at the hotel called Death

The Curve

All the beautiful curves

of this world are dangerous
Come, let us alight

at this seductive, dangerous curve
Look!

From this curve

one feels like taking entire world
into an embrace

From this curve

one feels like plunging down

to the green

Is this curve

dangerous

just because it is beautiful?

Or beautiful

because it is dangerous?

All the beautiful

and dangerous curves of this world
return us to our homes

Come,

let us return home

Tell me, sweetheart,

which way is your home?

God sends us to this world as a mother sends her children to school
On entering this world we mischievously start flouting the rules
Not heeding the warnings we start playing with fire
Our bodies become storehouses of insatiable desire
We start playing foul in the World` s playground 
We listen to the noises around by silencing the inner sound
We proudly disrespect all the rules of the school
No wonder a mortal  enters  this world  as a  " Wise Ignorant" but goes back as a " "knowledgeable fool"
Don`t forget that every mother back  at home lovingly waits for her child
The Creator too waits for the souls with a sense of pride
Happily you will go home after all the playing and running
If your Uniform is Stain- free at the   time of Homecoming.

A strong urge knocks
Quite often, naturally
Should be quenched philsophically
As our journey is all about
Beauty and depth,
Within that, wears a sheen, forever
Every challange is designed
To chisel away at all
That`s brittle in order to sculpt
A fabulous masterpiece
In the intrinsic you....!
Incredible wisdom blossoms
As one discovers own unique mission,
Begin uncovering, true ability
Introspect completely
It`s not about, what you wish,
It`s merely about, who you are i
Mark your persona
Let`s put more efforts to mine
The beautiful, glittering jewels within...!
Fair statement...
Determination without directions, is illusive.....

Aroma of coffee seeps in
An "Ocean of fantasy" engulfs
Boney M seduces in flashes sepia
I tap my feet keeping time with time,
The rhythm switches to a fast number
Galloping with world outside the glass door
My languid mind loses track.
Inside here it is cold and soporific
Only the aroma, flitting rhythms,
Clink of exit and entrance register
"He should be here by now" I tell myself--
The wait tells on my spine
Weighs upon frayed senses,
I shelter my words in sundown script
"Tell him I came"
I rise to quit.

It is always in the sea of memories
Where I keep afloat
And it is the time slot
Which brings back
Events happened in the past.

I wonder about the times to come
Living in a house,
Of liquid material,
The paste of the Past,
My memories sweet

Whenever alone, I slink back
Into the cosy lap
And how
Crying aloud
They call me back.

How alive they are!
Past, you are not described properly.
Thou art past continuous
Flowing through the present
Into the future.

Trains have systems which show
Which cities and stations
They have passed
Unlike our minds,
Who carry along the stations left behind.

Very few are the moments
Which drag me
From the pool of the past,
And see me ramp walk
In a swim suit

After ambling about all day,
As dogs to their kennel retire
So doth I fling back
To the chawls
Where those shadows abide.

Grandpa died last night.
Soon after his departure
Grandma crushed her glass bangles
on a piece of stone
Then, she dropped back into a deep silence.

The vermilion mark on the parting
of her hair was gone,
The alta on her feet became wet with tears as blood,
The broken bangles showed
the drab and desolate picture of home.

I explained to grandma: How, once
ripe, the cucumber falls off its twig
on its own,
How the migratory birds fly back home
from Chilila at the end of winter.

It`s not true that grandma does not know all about this.
Yet, she had never felt the agony of separation herself anytime before,
She had never measured out the depth of wounds beneath her heart,
She felt like burning on the pyre here
when grandpa`s body went aflame over there.

Grandpa is no more.
Grandma`s blood has turned into water,
Her heart lies scattered in splinters
like the intricate entrails of a rotten calf on the road,
Her hands and feet get stuck up
in the deadly hole of a snake.

Grandma understands everything,
yet nothing;
She continues to ask: Why
Grandpa was here yesterday,
and why he does not exist today!!!

O impartiality!
You are a rare bird as a red crow.
Also, queer laughter flung by a hyena
hidden in an impenetrable jungle
not seen by anybody.
I dream of embracing you,
but even stumbling upon doesn`t occur!
Has your meekness gone up in flames?

I retired into seclusion
as I couldn`t see you for long.
Heading toward self-effacement,
entangled in the sharp fangs of torment
I am getting wounded every day.

Probity is your pet sister;
She, too, was banished from society.
Like you, concealed she has been for a long.
Is she also less merciful?
Coax her; convince her
to come out in public.
I wish to uncloak my fondness for her
only in front of her.

If both of you walk here in tandem,
this planet would be in fine fettle;
the topsy-turvy world
is awaiting your arrival eagerly.
***

Bed of thorns
Castle of love
The scenes were planning big,
The dream sequences
The set up on spring`s valley
Strokes played
Ethereal  orchestra in mind.

The reflections danced on canvas
Images had to get mended
Sometimes somewhere,
The expirations are time bound
Of animate or inanimate.

And there
Stubborn brush didn`t march on
Uncanny pallet turned face down
Coagulated rebel colours,
Had to fall a green leaf
Below the red flower
Tree  to be kind
To hold them in place
The picture to look contented
That`s the wish
Everyone`s everywhere.

From some corner of the castle
Anxious musings suddenly yelled
A punch on the bough
Caused by distracted brush
Deformed a tree
On the bank of river
Splashing waves high and low
White and blue strokes
over taking one another
Light shade got darker
And dark lighter
Session had to stop there.

The incompleteness
Completed the impression,
Started walking
On bed of gravels
The  caressing strokes
Abstract and unreal
To the castle of love and admire.
—————
Rashmi Mohapatra
Mumbai

Today I woke up to a pastel hued morning.
Had a platter of maple dreams for breakfast!
The sunrays stealing its way through the vertical louvres of the window blinds
Strobed around my room.
The sequins off my dress scattered on the floor
reminded me of our clandestine tryst last night.
The mosaic verses and the innocuous times.
The sudden crescendo of happy hysteria amidst our prosaic lives.
That made me compose haptics poesy
that I could prod on a sombre noon.
The roaring gush of wind shook me up from my ictus.
The concerto of the drizzle broke my slumber and plunged me into the abyss of reality.
I tumbled headlong.
My body heavy like the tectonic plates
awaited a seismic release.
The rhetoric of grief gradually gnawed at my maple dreams.
Am I still your Innamorato?
I will try to sleep again.
For my dreams are a safer place.

The papaya tree in a backyard of a
House amidst so many houses
Is overloaded with fruit ripe
And alluring and mouth watering
A monkey`s eyes fell on the green tree
The monkey in a moment 
Signalled to the other monkey`s in a herd
Which are in search of food
The monkey which first arrived
Jumped on the tree and started
Eating the golden fruit
The inmates of the house 
Started attacking the monkey with sticks
They have been waiting the fruit to ripe
For so many days eagerly
But alas! See what happens in moment
If the monkeys had found  fruit
In the the forest surrounding.
If the monkeys found trees
On the surrounding hills with sufficient
Trees with fruit to eat
If the the monkeys found streams
Flowing with water to drink from
The monkeys would not have ventured 
Into human habitations.
Just because of human intervention
In to their territory by destroying trees
And hills,and destroying streams
The animals venture in to
Human habitations in villages and towns.
@ParashuramRao Gande

source_fields.captured_title: THE OMINOUS AGENDA OF A NIGHT
source_fields.body_html:
honking cars of dreary night
going into deep slumber
sterile faces of the smoky city
passions prisoned in the cage of the skeleton
heads are peeled off like hot potatoes
the sizzling body of the platform
cools down like the last locomotive
whole day a city dies  in the oxymoron
to be alive the next day
sweating of  the pedestrians here or there
the naked mad woman sleeps under railway bridge
here the road weaves and
manufactures the seasons
artificial smiles pour from the lips of the mannequin
arduous journey of the unknown footsteps
gnawed by intrigues
dense is the darkness
denser are the signatures of the gypsies
each alphabet is a syntax under the sky
like a polar star
who can compose the melody?
the virgin eyes will be red soon
who can compose love?
opium sellers are moving around
lust is burning in the metropolitan city
in the moment of delirium
the mad woman is pregnant now
shivering in cold
perhaps someone has raped the
the black city…… !!

Putting on clothes,
Who had a good slumber for like a year,
Handing down muffs,
To my hella cold ears.
A cold rosiness passes down my cheek,
To my lip making them dry,
As I watch birds in the open air fly,
I hear the jammed snowy doors creak.
I stare about,
Through my rimy window,
Asking the balmy earth its whereabouts,
Really foggy it does become when my mouth, I blow.
Rolling in my blanket indolently,
Doing nothing but just pitying me,
`Why do I always have to work?
I ask myself resentfully.
Natheless winter fills my face with glee.
I gaze at the sun,
Setting down so early,
Follows it the serene moon,
Radiating so gaily.

 

I step down into the streets,
Amidst the snow and the flowers,
I stand still,
Sniffing the scent of the ice bits,
The divine vibes of winter I feel.

I walk forth,
Joining my mates for the Christmas Eve,
Inside the shack, around the tree,
I feel the warmth,
As a smile on my face the cold winds weave.
It`s so tranquil,
Nothing could make me happier,
As I stand here,
Relishing the cuddles of winter.

मेरे कपड़ों को चीरते हुए
जिस्म से खून रिसाते हुए
बेपरवाह से दबंगई से हँसते हैं

हालांकि दुनिया की नज़र में
कम से कम में गुजारा करते हैं।
रेतीली आँधी को पीते हैं
फिर भी रेत को सहते सहते 
वो रेतीली रेत से कसकसे हो गए हैं शायद!

उसके तीखे कण आँखों में चुभते हैं।
खैर कैक्टस किसी किसी को
खूबसूरत भी लगते हैं
जो रहते हैं बड़ी इमारतों की कैद में
जिंदगी से दूर
परेशानियों के जंगलों से बहुत दूर।

क्या नज़्म लिखूँ तुमपर?
तुम तो खुद ही एक खूबसूरत नज़्म हो!

वाचते ही तुमको
कोई तरन्नुम सा बहने लगता है हवाओं में,
मैं बन जाती हूँ कोई कोयल
और लहराने लगती हूँ फजाओं में,
मैं रूप ले लेती हूँ पपीहे का
और मैं नगमा गुनगुनाने लगती हूँ,
मैं बन जाती हूँ नीली मोरनी
और पंख खोल झूमने-गाने लगती हूँ!

क्या नज़्म लिखूँ तुमपर?
तुम तो खुद ही एक खूबसूरत नज़्म हो!

पन्ने पर पन्ने भरते ही जाते हैं
तुम्हारी तारीफ़ें बयान करने में-
अल्फ़ाज़ की कमी खलती है
कितना कुछ है कहने को,
कितना कम कह पाती हूँ!
सोच रही हूँ कोई किताब ही लिख दूँ तुमपर
नज़मों से भरी हुई,
तुमसे भरी हुई!

क्या नज़्म लिखूँ तुमपर?
तुम तो खुद ही एक खूबसूरत नज़्म हो!

रात में महताब की तरह
अपनी ज़रीं सी रौशनी फैलाती हो,
कभी-कभी मुझसे मिलने
मेरे दिल की नदिया में भी आती हो
छाप अपनी छोड़ जाती हो-
और जब इस नदिया में तुम होती हो ना
कोई आवाज़ भी नहीं होती
बस तुम ही तुम नज़र आती हो!

क्या नज़्म लिखूँ तुमपर?
तुम तो खुद ही एक खूबसूरत नज़्म हो!

अभी तो बिल्कुल नजदीक हो
पर जाना ही होगा तुमको दूर
दिल के हर कोने में
छाया रहेगा तुम्हारा ही नूर
जब भी कोई आवाज़ होगी
एहसास सा होगा तुम कहीं पास हो जरूर,
पर जब तुम न होगी पास
रहेगा मुझे मेरी इन नज़मों पर गुरूर!

क्या नज़्म लिखूँ तुमपर?
तुम तो खुद ही एक खूबसूरत नज़्म हो!

Distance between you and me
has been muffled in silences
Silences that words fail to capture
as live fish slipping out of hands
under water
Only the pierce of a metal hook
can ensnare it...
But the hook has become elusive ...
Nothing seems to frame the vapour
emanating from seamless seas
that flow between our banks
illusory like the ever-receding horizon
The cool balm of the skies
that forms tears from air
tears that gather to wash away droughts
birth life in seeds and saplings
is missing ....
Instead, there is the heat of the dry desert....
Words cannot enter this forbidden land
so, silence blows with the wind
over the arid desert
shifting shapes of sand dunes...
creating mystery...
will the oasis meet the ocean?

source_fields.captured_title: I WILL FIGHT BUT NOT QUIT
source_fields.body_html:
O’ every moment I fight with my hurdles,
I am a woman who wishes to cross obstacles,
I know, I am surrounded by problems,
Yet I believe in burying them in the ground.

I do not bother about any storm coming,
I will keep on walking and moving,
Igniting my courage and strength within,
I will fight and I believe to win.

Yes, I know I am all alone in my life,
Yet I will keep on struggling for strife,
I won’t shed my tears anymore,
Life is a challenge and I will adore.

I do not get afraid of the thorny paths now,
Even in failure, I say O’ wow,
I learn from my failures and move on,
I am a woman who fights with special weapons.

Come on, O’ life, bring to me hurdles,
I too promise that I won’t quit and will bring miracles,
I am fighting and will fight till the end,
For me, my inner strength is my best friend.

A makeup artist
Knows what is beauty,
Only when he understands
The difference between
Beauty tools and a real face.
What to use for beauty,
Tools or a real face?
Or some essence of universality,
Or a peeping soul.
Soul is always
An easy license
Of measureless
Search for depth.
Art of beauty needs a display;
Appreciation is only the aftermath.
Experimentation
Is a true sign of affection.
Learners defeat
The learned ones
And creation sprouts
Like a fountain of new generation.

©️Sushant Thapa
Biratnagar, Nepal

Scars dotted visible invisible
Its profound imprints invincible
Its blemish, speckles seeable and discernible
Its far reaching consequence, a glutton unimaginable

Scars deep set deep skin
Bleeding wound, bled heart akin
A gift of scar by kith and kin
Loving deep discreet clan is not sin

Scar in flesh, bruised inside skin conciliate
Wounded by heart can’t reconcillate

Haunted throughout as awful fate
Cut a sorry and ugly figure, in desolate state

Biting criticism, harsh remarks, stingy tongue
Slit heart, pierced stature as scorpion stung
Unstringing string of love’s beads unstrung
Mind and body writhe and wrung

Quite a few, sacrifice an altar of honour killing
Their love for honour more than blood spilling
The scars given their daughter more than killing
Incessant flow bleeding almost alive killing

We, you and I
Float on the fluff of a cloud
And the drop of the rain
And the wings of the birds

Your heart sings a song
Which reaches me through
A gentle breeze
That settles on my cheeks

And We , you and I
Remain blissfully together
Bound by everyday heaven
That one finds all around us

Our heaven
The one that we built together
As our souls embraced
And then blew it to the winds

Knowing that heavenly bliss
Can never ever be tied
And bound and confined to
The pettiness of mundane worldliness

It is in the freedom of togetherness
That You remain
Blissfully mine
And I blissfully yours

When I walk in your street
I try to revisit the past memories,
Still alive-
In the fringes of the stoned pathways,
In the cracks of the broken walls,
On the cutlery of the baker’s deli,
In the fragrance of the florist’s boutique,
On the edges of that wooden bench,
In all those places,
Where we coexisted,
Celebrating our togetherness,
And vouching a forever.

Alas! Surreal it is,
To the outer world,
Only my soul can feel its existence,
But,
For how long?
Is a question that baffles me,
And as I close my eyes,
I feel you everywhere,
Relive those past memories,
And head towards my abode,
Alone but not lonely.

The little abode
of sticks and straw,
In the parlor of a dry desert land,
was home to me and my own.

It stands today,
shell-shocked;
with the blood
of my babies,
splattered across!

The pomegranate trees
stand charred,
and the fruits are quashed
in terror.
Nothing but the signature
of an inane game --
they call `war`.

My breath wanders like a spirit,
embalming the swelling corpses,
that have no names.
No faces left.

With every fall,
vultures whisper
of a feast,
they know they cannot digest.
The cry of Mother Earth rises,
but there`s no one to hear her groan.
And humanity remains silent.

Let`s make room for a better future
By letting go off things of the past.
It is not easy to let go either
But holding onto things unpleasant,
Only makes us heavy.

It`s like carrying a baggage of regrets
Or love that turned bitter or mistakes done
It maybe seperation, anger, loss, betrayal
Or anything that hurts our heart and soul.
It`s a war between holding on and letting go.

The load we carry brings us down
And the more we hold onto it
The more sad we become that drains out our energy.
Let`s learn to let things go
And not get stuck on our yesterdays.

Instead, embrace what today has to give us
Let us have a steady sobriety
And not let things fester in our minds.
Letting go releases our tension and heaviness
That makes room in our hearts and love ourselves more.

Walking amidst the remains of Serdica
An age passes by quietly, almost
Till absolute order descends over extreme chaos
Time freezes or not hard to say
But Athena comes riding ;
Her chariot, patrolling her ;territory
Spinning and weaving threads of peace
And just as the cuckoon, readies to rest ;
Ares`s arrows pierce;the warmth
And once the glass breaks ;
It just breaks and breaks !;
Mars joins too! Time is not;
A fresco but a melting pot
Roman legions stand guard;
Not even Cleopatra can;diffuse the stand off!;
Aphrodite and Venus;
Nymphs and goddesses try together!;
But once begun, the war is a brutal sport !;
And not just for athletes!
Generals and Colonels, Marshals and Captains;
On horses and on foot, Survey the land;
And the map! Oh! Weapons and weapons;
Escalate the war ! But have you seen;
Paintings depicting the end? Retreating armies;
Death around, the stench;of blood!;
Peace treaties;are brutal too!
But look;there glimmers an ancient;
Agreement, in stones ! Age old writing;
On stone columns, 30 years peace contract;
Between kingdoms of;Bulgaria and Byzantine !;
Dear Athena, Call Apollo ! This world;
Needs healing! Spinning;around! Looking for time!;
There isn`t any! The metro `s here! Before you board;
Strech your arms and hold !;
Athena`s gone but she is;here!
Sveta Sofia still smiles ! A bird in hand !
Turn around, embrace;the glory and beauty of life!;
The train leaves but come again to Serdica
And post;peace letters to all you can!

An active, adorable and accountable,
What not, she`s an epitome of being humble;
Going through all the difficulties,
She brings comfort to the families.

Behind every man, there`s a woman;
She serves as a servant with pain
How smart she`s, she never unfolds it
Unless she reaches to the final breath.

Oh god! She is available everywhere
Office, home and for kids so dear,
Never complains of whom she is
And where she`s; rather lives in bliss.

To the world, she is a fierce lioness;
To her kids, a cushion of happiness
To the world, she is a roaring dragon
To her husband, the source of joy and fun.

With winsome heart and soul
She lives for her kids and her man`s goal,
Never hurt her at any case of life
As she`s the heavenly god alive.

There is a gentle stream outside
No currents
No whirlpool
Nothing will rock your boat tonight
Does that comfort you?

Sail along
Feel your heartbeat
Somewhere else
Inside a lover`s safe place
But you need a lover to love, for that

;

Everyone smiles
The same way
It hurts
How they all hide the same aches

Even if it matches the shades of the skies
Find a little storm somewhere
Find turbulent weather
To cure you

I hear the thousand waves
crashing on the sand
all night
windswept leaves
incessant susurration
iridescent dreams of the earth
swept and buried into
the heart of darkness
I see the skeletons of poor souls
laying on the sand
weeping,
sighing
wallowing
in the darkness

I see the pain
Feel the wound...
the storm
the burning ember in your heart

I know what it means
to be in pain
I know what it means
to die a thousand deaths
and wake up to the same world
over and over and over again...

I see your heart
the endless emptiness
I feel
the warmth of your tear
I hear
your raw words
wrapped and then unwrapped
in rhythmic art of poesy

I see ashes of broken dreams
floating
in the air
falling down
on the surface of
the ocean deep and dark

I see your deer eyes
quest for the ashes
quest for a new life
to reborn like the mythical bird

but the ashes won`t always
make you Phoneix
sometimes it`ll be the old you
the broken you
who will have to
curve the path through hell..
to keep on living.

Soldier, doctor, surgeon, banker or a painter,
I can be found everywhere,
For my skill,for being a hard worker.
And yes,there, my hands, my eyes and my brain all work together.

The places I have secured for my establishment,
I established my nation too with my every cent.

My energy, my effort and my intention,
I arranged them to better my nation.
Since the past ages I have seeded my contribution;
Sometimes for family, sometimes for the whole nation.

The agitated earth I make it gentle and soft;
I came down as cool drops to save the heart from draught,
I make the home fit to live, fit to continue the creation,
With or sometimes without anyone`s respect or admiration.

Every minute I showed my courage to hold my chair,
To rule or to make someone rule with my passion and care.

Creator I am, protector I am.
When mess broke out; chaos broke out;
Warrior I am.

The games we play to our utter dismay
In our greed for power and for fame
Leading ourselves astray, in life today
We play the Jenga game.
Our globe, she spins and pays for our sins
By those that are crooked and corrupt
Without a single thought, we take our shot
The balance of nature we disrupt.

Crippling our flora and disrupting our fauna
Polluting our oceans and seas
Thru war we reshape, flatten our landscape
And slowly we`re losing our peace.
The risks we take, put Earthly life at stake
We have only ourselves to blame
Every gamble we make, the rules we break
Whilst we play the Jenga game.

Our Earth, she crumbles as man he fumbles
Her warm green blanket he replaces
With cold cemented jungles, she rumbles and stumbles
It is a stark future that she faces.
We need to dive deep, our earth to keep
Yet we tilt the balance, ain`t that a shame
Nothing stays the same in progress`s name
We continue to play the Jenga game.

*Jenga is a game where players take turns removing one block at a time from a tower constructed of 54 blocks. Each block removed is then placed on top of the tower, creating a progressively more unstable structure.

I can wait for you
Secretly behind shadows,
A fresh wind may
Tell me in a whisper
The message of your arrival.
Blue sky may watch
With envious eyes,
An intimate silhouette`ll reflect
In the smiles of green.

I may recite a poem
In noon too for you,
Putting eye to eye on you
I can tell a tale of
Witching hour.
In deep and dense darkness of might
Two fireflies are on a boat
Embracing the vast sea.

I`ll wait
Being a handful of dust,
Mixing with a crazy wind,
I`ll wait for you
Secretly behind the lotus petals
Being an anxious sunshine.

ମୋ ଭିତରେ ଯୋଉ ଚିତ୍ରଟି
ଶାଗୁଆ ସକାଳଟିଏ
ତୋଳି ଆଣୁଥିଲା/
ତାକୁ ଦେଖିବାଟା ଗୋଟେ
ଅପରାଧ ହିଁ ଥିଲା।

ଯେଉଁ ମଉନ ଆଶାକୁ ନେଇ
ଲଟୁ ପରିକା ଘୂରି ବୁଲିଲି,
ସେଥିରେ କିଛି ବୁଝିବାର ନ ଥିଲା,
ନିଜ ପ୍ରତିଛବି ଦେଖି ନିଜକୁ ସେ ଡରୁଥିଲା।

ଖସୁଥିବା ବାଲିଚରରେ
ଦୁଃଖର ଏକ ପାହାଡ଼
ଠିଆ ହୋଇ ଯାଉଛି ଓ
ତୁମ ଛିଟିକି ପଡ଼ିଥିବା
ବେଶ୍ ପୁରୁଣା
ପ୍ରତିଶୃତି ସବୁକୁ ଦୋହରାଉଚି।

ସାଙ୍ଗ ହୋଇ ଯିଏ
ବାଟ କଢାଇ ନେବ ବୋଲି
ବାରମ୍ବାର ବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଭରିଥିଲା,
ସେ ଏବେ ନିଜ ଇଚ୍ଛାରେ
ଅଧା ବାଟେ ତ ରହି ଗଲା।

ମୁଁ ବନ୍ଧା,
ତ୍ରିଭୁଜର ସୀମାରେଖାରେ,
କୋଉଠି ବି ମିଳେନି,
ନା ବଦଳୁ ଥିବା ଦୁଃଖରେ
ନା ତମ ଲୁହର ଝରରେ।

ନଈ ଆଉ ନାରୀ
ଦୁହେଁ ଏକାପରି।
ଦୁହିଁଙ୍କୁ ଗଢିଛି ଵିହି
ଆଦ୍ୟାଶକ୍ତି, ଶ୍ରୀମୟୀ
ଶୀର୍ଷ ସୁନ୍ଦରୀ କରି।

ତଥାପି ଵି,
କେହି ଯେଵେ
ରୌଦ୍ର୍ୟ ର ରୁକ୍ଷ ଯାତନା ଦେଇ
ଵହମାନ ଶ୍ରୀପାଦରେ ତାର
ବାଡ଼ବାନ୍ଧି ରୋଧ କରେ ପଥ
ଅଵରୁଦ୍ଧ ନଈଟି ଵିଚାରୀ
ନାରୀ ପରି ମରୁଥାଏ ;
ମଲାନଈ,ଅଭିଶପ୍ତା ନଈ
ପୀଡ଼ିତା ବାଳିକା ପରି
ସମୟର ଚାତୁର୍ଯ୍ୟକୁ
କିଛି ବୁଝି ପାରେନାହିଁ।

ନଈର ବି ନାରୀ ପରି
ଠିକଣା ବଦଳେ।
ଝରଣାରୁ ନିର୍ଝରିଣୀ ହୋଇ
ଶିଖରରୁ ସମତଳ ଦେଇ
ତଳମୁଣ୍ଡ ଛୁଇଁଲା ବେଳକୁ
ଶାଖାନଈ,ଉପନଈ ହୋଇ
ମୋଡାଣି,ବୁଲାଣି ବେଳେ
ଆଉ ଏକ ନୂଆ ନାଁ,ନୂଆ ମାର୍ଫତରେ
ପରିଚୟ ହୁଏ।

ନାରୀ ପରି ନଈ ପୁଣି
ସୃଜନ ସମ୍ଭୁତା ହୋଇ
ସ୍ନେହ, ପ୍ରେମ, ତ୍ୟାଗ, ତିତିକ୍ଷାରେ
ସଂପର୍କରେ ସଵୁଜ ସୋହାଗ ଆଣି
ଶ୍ୟାମଳ ତଟଦେଶର ନୂଆ କୁଆଁ ମେଲେ।

ଇପ୍ସିତ ପୁରୁଷ ସହ ମିଳନର କାମନାଟେ
ନାରୀ ପରି ନଈର ଵି ଥାଏ।
ଦେଖୁନ,ସମୁଦ୍ର ପୁରୁଷର ଆ` ପଣରେ
ସେଇ ଆଦରିବା ଥାଏ ଵୋଲି କେମିତି
କେଉଁ ଦୂର ଶୀଖରରୁ
ପାହାଡ ପାଚେରୀ ଡେଇଁ
ସେ ରାଜହଂସୀ ସର୍ପିଳଗାମିନୀ
ପଥକାଟି ଧାଇଁ ଆସିଥାଏ !

ଆହା !! ଅପୂର୍ବ ସେ ମୁହାଣ ମିଳନ ସ୍ଥଳ!
ସମର୍ପଣ, ଆମନ୍ତ୍ରଣ
ସ୍ଵର୍ଗୀୟ ପ୍ରେମାନୁବନ୍ଧର
ମର୍ତ୍ତ୍ୟ ସଂସ୍କରଣ !

ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣତାରେ ନାରୀ ପରି ନଈର ବି ନାଁ ଲିଭିଯାଏ।

ରତ୍ନଵେଦୀରେ
କେଉଁ ଦୀପ ଜଳୁଥାଏ ପୁଣି ଲିଭୁଥାଏ ?...
କାହା ନାଆଁରେ
ଗୋପଦାଣ୍ଡରେ ଡିବିଡିବି ନାଗରା ବାଜୁଥାଏ ?...

This house that I have lived in, all my life
My dream come true tryst with its body
The colour of the skin covering it
A dash of green here, turquoise flashes there
Fresh air to move in its many lanes
Roses, azaleas, daises in wild disarray
Myhouse, my creation, my very own.

This house, mute witness
To the living sparks of my ambition
The worlds of suffering I have slipped into
Fine layer`s of dust burying my laurels
Rivers of vanity thundering in my veins
The misty afternoons of surrender to the only one.

A day will come when the paint will peel off
Trickle of raindrops will seep into the carpet
The garden  untended, weeds plundering it`s beauty
A day will come when I won`t be well
No longer marvelling at the beauty of your toe-nails
Mad journeys into the depths of your soul
Dressed in the pain that will be only mine
I can only be with you in my dream
Unguarded, without make-up
So close you could count the wrinkles of my soul

As I look at the dregs of my life
I know it`s the last storm
I will have to leave behind everything
This house of memories
My very precious words
In gold covered books
The symphonies of summer breeze
Old photographs, dog-eared poems,
Beautiful jewellery from the world over
But more important, the landmark dates
Birthdays, anniversaries,my daughters smiles
Unexplained tragedies, unexpected happiness
Millions of bushels of my life

I know I can only tell you
My caretaker in life
Will you not be so in death?
The caretaker of this house of my life
Under the mantel-piece where we spent passionate moments
Lies the key to everything that was my life
Do what you want with it
My last gift in this hour of reckoning.
In this final going away
With all my love
My caretaker
In life and death

As if they decipher the silence in my numb eyes
And I listen to the unsaid words they try to speak
They stand with their mute glances
Humans can`t perceive
But deep within I feel
As if they hum something
A melody that reaches to my ears only
The melody that they whisper to themselves
Mingles with the air
Streaming and ringing in the leaves
I can fathom why the greens are so soothing
Lost in their own thoughts
They compose a rhythm that they sing
The sky and the air resonate them
For the mechanical world they are dumb and mute
Not all have the eyes to see beyond the sight
We live in a world full of possessions
Where humans can`t even listen to the voice of their own soul
My beliefs are turning green
The emptiness that dwells in my soul finds solace
When the green leaves sway with the sweet breeze
Humming a silent mellow tune
Planting a beautiful smile all over me

I am your mirror of silvery look
Your reflection speaks of me,
Though you grow old as winter
I grow as the kindling spring.

If I grow as a flower
Bright in your garden
you are the colors of my petals
your image so true in me!

You are my river
Boundless in love
flowing with my feet
wherever I move.

So many oceans you are!
It is an ocean in your eyes
yet another in your heart
Flooded with rain of love.

You are unchanging like the sun
Unveil light of love in every turn,
Smiles are waves on your lips
Though pained like tree in snow.

You tangle my hair in your soft palm
like breeze of spring,
you are thoughtful like the bird
sitting alone in your garden of love
Craft a song in undying words
Reach to us quickly fading grief.

You are indeed my worlds
Round off to all loveliness I dream,
You are the unforgotten letters
Of all my startling secrets.

Listlessly while
flipping through the old diary
Each time your face peeps in
through the diary pages .

The dry petals aptly slip down and scatter
Nudge to floor.
Each time the thought of you haunts me !

Over the years ,until this very moment Wandering along the blind alleys of a vague sky
I manage to strive...
Each time I miss you and confront the dark circle Underlying a lonly burning lamp
Defying the day light .

I`m chocking with exaburance but you find pleasure in my annoyance .

Each time I bleed
I scream at your indifference
I turn in to a dry rose ... That each time slips down and nudge to floor silently.

Sunday, Rest day of the Week
when I turn the pages of the morning Newspaper
and bury the simple sadness of autumn
in the spilt blood of another child`s murder,
Somehow I do not think it`s a Story at all,
In the distance comes the dying echo
of a moving train, and you are suddenly someone
old and distant, a goat hanging in a butcher`s shop,
seeing more than you`ve seen before in your life.
The leaves susurrate in the bamboo stems
to make me sense that there was something
may be behind it that was quite important,
A persistence of my own mortality perhaps.
Or the oneness between me and the world.
Grass had closed its eyes as it watched
A Prime Minister pick up the body of India
Which he felt lay battered inside his chest.
Sunday when I thought I was accountable to myself,
Was I dying within myself for the sorrows -
I suffered for the world that wasn`t with me enough?
Sometimes the coils of ropes of a country`s conscience
Straighten themselves and rise up into the air.
Into God`s hand, hanging there unseen to help, Sometimes
Someone asks himself, before he falls asleep,
Whether he was happy to live in the land that was India.
Even chaos shuns the end,
A handful of space from the size
Of a cathedral. Although no wind is there still,
The boat tied offshore has moved a little,
And tied with it the apprehension of another self.
But the world is there, beginning to speak again,
And I`ve lost the ability to disappear.
Looks as if with all its silvery light,
the world cannot touch me
with its last sentence, bold, sinless.
Cumulus darkens things, flying past.
Which part of one is it that has to be put away?
The logic of winning, or the magic of living
backwards in time? I can`t resist the urge
that takes hold of me for some unspoken chaos,
or the pain of collecting mushrooms in the wet woods,
that never fail to remind us of who we think we are.
