woman interrupted is woman radicalized
she bears witness irrespective of the skies
she has roamed and soared
how she is told that she must not slide
out an inch from the single tiled space
that she has been assigned
spaces, she is reminded again and again
are by default male, she must keep
herself loosely ungendered when she claims
ground beneath her feet, unrecognizable
her words must appear so they can be unheard
from the already colonized speech
she must quickly present and quicker leave
if recognition she claims
then the terms are made clear again and again
she must not be woman
if she is, she must be praised by men
applause is reserved for them
resoundingly it beats its disavowal into her heart
as she is met with speechlessness and awe
when she is done speaking her part
those things, she has come to understand,
are the double-bind of minds that have been taught
to whistle, hoot and clap at male glory alone
and remain torn when presented
with the discomfiting fact 
that women can be heroic,
perhaps, more by far.

eagles or doves they find
that mere ropes strung across
the ground they are asked to walk
can stop them in their tracks
but a woman interrupted is a woman radicalized
she will pick up the axe the next time
you trip her up by explaining to her
that history or the stage are male prerogatives
and in mid-flight interject
that she is running out of time,
she will hack all that binds so the ground becomes sky
seize your bullets as they face her and fill her pens
with their powder and fire out her lines
she will come back for the mic
and drench the stage with her voice-blood
finish your lies, her body all tongue and eyes
it is earth that hath no fury like a woman denied 
woman interrupted is woman radicalized

turned a hundred times to let
you know,

ଆଣିନି,
ବନ୍ଧୁ ଆସିବେ
ଲେମ୍ବୁପାଣି ତ ଟିକେ ଦେବି!

ଦୁବ କେରାଏ, ବରକୋଳି ପତ୍ରଟେ
ଛିଣ୍ଡେଇଲି
ପଡିଶା ଘର ନୁଆବୋଉ ଡାକୁଥିଲେ
ଆସ ଲୁଡୁ ଖେଳିବା,
ମନାକଲି କାମ ଅଛି ଯାଇ ପାରିବିନି
ମୁହଁ ଛାଟି ସେ କହିଲେ-
କି କାମ ମ?
ଉତ୍ତର ଦେଲି
ବନ୍ଧୁ ଆସିବେ
କଣ ଏତେ ପଚାରୁଛମ!
ଧଡ଼ କରି ଆଉଜେଇ ଦେଲି
ବାଡି କବାଟଟା ।

ଚୁଲିରେ ପାଣି ବସେଇ ଅଣ୍ଡ।ଳିଲି
ଚାଉଳ ଡାଲି ଲୁଣ ହଳଦୀ
କୂଅ ମୂଳକୁ ଦଉଡ଼ି ଗଲି
କଞ୍ଚା ଲଙ୍କା ଟେ ପାଇଁ
ଦାଣ୍ଡ ଦୁଆର ପିଣ୍ଡା
ଚାଳର ଅଳନ୍ଧୁ ସବୁ
ଝାଡିଝୁଡ଼ି ସଫାକଲି
ବନ୍ଧୁ ଆସିବେ, ଗୋଡ଼ ଧୋଇବେ
ପାଣି କୁମ୍ଭଟେ ଥୋଇଲି।

ଶେଷରେ
ସ୍ନେହ ଆଉ ସରାଗର
ଗଙ୍ଗା ପାଣି ଛିଞ୍ଚି ସଫାକଲି ମନକୁ
ରାଗ ଋଷା ଈର୍ଷା ପରଶ୍ରୀକାତରତା
ସବୁ କିଛି ଧୋଇଦେଲି
ଆବେଗର ମ।ଠିଏ ପାଣିରେ
ହସର ଚାଦର ଟେ
ଓଠରେ ଟାଙ୍ଗୀ ଦେଇ
ଅପେକ୍ଷା କଲି
ବନ୍ଧୁ ଆସିବେ ବୋଲି।

ଜହ୍ନରେ ଶହେଭାଗରୁ ଅନେଶ୍ୱତ ଭାଗ ଆଲୋକ ଖୋଜାଚାଲିଥିଲା..
ଏକ ଭାଗ ଆଲୋକ କିନ୍ତୁ ଅନେଶ୍ୱତ ଭାଗର କଳଂକରେ ମରିପଡିଥିଲା, ଏବେ ସେଠି ରାତିର ଶାସନ..ଜହ୍ନର ମୃତ୍ଯୁରେ ଆକାଶ ବିବର୍ଣ୍ଣ ! ୧।

ସେ ଗଭାରେ ପଦ୍ମମାଳ ସଜାଇ ମହମହ ବାସୁଥିଲା
ତା` ପାଖୁଡାକୁ ଛୁଇଁଲା ପରେ ଦେହସାରା କଳାନାଗର ବିଷ..ଆଖିଆଗେ ଜମାଟ ବାନ୍ଧିଥିବା ରାତି ଓ କାନପାଖେ ମୃତ୍ୟୁର ଗଜଲ !୨।

ସିନ୍ଥିରେ ସିନ୍ଦୂର, ହାତରେ ଚୂଡି ପିନ୍ଧି
ସେ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରିଥିଲା ଚିହ୍ନା ପଦଶବ୍ଦକୁ,
ଯେଉଁ ଶବ୍ଦ ତା ଜୀବନକୁ ନିଃଶବ୍ଦ କରି ଅନ୍ୟର କୁଂଜବନେ ବେଣୁରେ ସୁର ଭରୁଥିଲା !୩।

ସେ ଫୁର୍ର କରି ପବନରେ ଉଡେଇ ଦେଇଥିଲା ଅବଶୋଷକୁ ,ଦୁଃଖକୁ କାଗଜ ଡଂଗା କରି ଭସେଇ ଦେଇଥିଲା ନଦୀରେ..।
ଜାଣିନଥିଲା ସେମାନେ ଦିନେ `ଫଣି` ହୋଇ
ତା` ଅସ୍ତିତ୍ୱ ଉଜାଡିବେ !୪।

`ପ୍ରେମ`.. ଆଜିକାଲି ଗୋଟେ ବାସଫୁଲ,ବାସ୍ନାଥିବା ଯାଏଁ ଆଚ୍ଛନ୍ନ ରଖେ !
ପ୍ରତିଜ୍ଞା..ନିଆଁ ଶିଖାରୁ ଧାରେ,
ଅଖଣ୍ଡ ଦୀପପରି ନୀରବରେ ଜଳୁଥାଏ ।୫।

ସେ ତା` ପାଇଁ ସଜ ହେବାକୁ ଆଇନା ଦେଖେ
ସେ ଆସିଲା ପରେ ତା` ମୁହଁ ପରଖେ, ପୁଣି ଭାଂଗିଯାଏ ଆଇନାର କାଚ ପରି ..!୬।

ସେ ହସ !! କେଜାଣି କେତେ ବେଦନା, କେତେ ପ୍ରତାରଣାର ଖଣ୍ଡାଧାରରେ ଝରିଥିବା ଛାତିର ରୁଧିର, ଛଳନାର ସାହାରାରେ
ଲଂଘିଥିବା ସେ ଲଣ୍ଡା ପାହାଡ,
ପ୍ରବଂଚନାରେ ରଚିଥିବା ଗୋଟେ ଲେଖାଏଁ ମାୟାମହଲ..
ଛଳନାର ଜୟ ସବୁ କାଳେ, ପୁଣି ପ୍ରତି ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରେ!!୭।

ସୁନ୍ଦରତା କୋଉଠି ଥାଏ, ମନରେ ନା ଆଖିରେ !
କାହା ପାଇଁ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଆଜନ୍ମ !
ଥରୁଟେ ସେ ମୁଗ୍ଧ ସୁନ୍ଦରତା ମନକୁ ମୋହିଗଲେ
ଆଉ କଣ କିଛି ସୁନ୍ଦର ହୋଇ ରହେ.. !!
ଆମରଣ ଈଶ୍ୱରଙ୍କୁ ଭୋଗି ହେଉଥାଏ !!୮।

source_fields.body_html:
ବଢ଼ିଗଲେ କାଟିଦିଅ
ତୁମ ମୁହଁ ଦାଢ଼ି ଭଳି
ମୋ ବଢିବା, ଅରମା, ଅସଂଯତ
ମୋ ସୌଷ୍ଠବ ରେ ଯେତେ ସବୁ ଆବର୍ଜନା
ହିଂସ୍ରତା, ପଶୁପଣ

ଭାବିଲି ବଢିଯାଇ
ଛପେଇ ରଖିବି, ବାଘ, ଭାଲୁ, ହାତୀ
ତୁମେ ଗଢ଼ିବ ଭବ୍ୟ ଇମାରତ
ଗହ ଗହ ସୁନା ଧାନ କ୍ଷେତ
ହେଲା ନାହିଁ ।

ତୁମେ ଲୁଚାଇଲ
ଲଙ୍ଗଳା ଧର୍ଷିତ ଦେହ, କଟାମୁଣ୍ଡ
ଚେହେରା ଛପେଇ, ରଚିଲ ପରକୀୟା ପ୍ରୀତି
ଗଢ଼ିଦେଲ ମୋ ଦେହରେ ଗଞ୍ଜେଇ ର ବାଡ଼
ଅବା ରକ୍ତମୁଖା ନକ୍ସଲ ର ଗଡ଼

ଏବେ କାଟି ସଫା କରିଦିଅ
ସବୁ କଥା ହେଇ ଯାଉ ସାଫ
ତୁମ ଭିତର ର ପଶୁ
ଆଉ ମୋ ଭିତର ର ପଶୁ ରେ ଆଉ ଫରକ କଣ
ଫରକ କଣ ତୁମ ମୋ ଭିତର ର ଅସନା ପଣରେ ?

ତୁମେ ସଫା ହେଉ ହେଉ
ଜଙ୍ଗଲ ପାଲଟି ଯାଇଛ
ଏଥର ମୋତେ ସଫା କର
ମୋର ଆଉ ଜଙ୍ଗଲ ହୋଇ
ନାହିଁ ରହିବାର ।

।।ଏକ।।
ଦେ, ଓହ୍ଲେଇଦେ
ନିସ୍ତାର ଦେ ଆଜନ୍ମ ତଟସ୍ଥତାରୁ,
ଭଙ୍ଗାଭଙ୍ଗା ଢେଉରେ ପାଦ ଥାପିଥାପି
କ୍ରମଶଃ ଖସେଇଦେ
ଗେହ୍ଲାର ଗହ୍ଵରକୁ
ଵିଶ୍ବାସର ବିବରକୁ
ଯେଉଁଠି
ଶୀତଳ ଶୋଷର ଲହରୀ
କ୍ଳାନ୍ତ ରଜାପୁଅ
ହଳଦୀ ଗୁରୁଗୁରୁ ରଜୋବତୀ ନାରୀ
ଵାଘ ଓ ମିରିଗ
ଏକା ତୁଠେ ପାଣି ପିଉଥିବ
ଏବଂ
ଯେଉଁଠାକୁ ଗଲାପରେ
ଫେରିଵାର ବାଟ ନଦିଶିଵ।

।। ଦୁଇ।।

ତୋ ଆଡ଼କୁ ପାଦ ବଢାଇଵା
ମୋର ଅଵଧାରିତ ଭାଗ୍ୟ,
ଏଇଥିପାଇଁ ତ
ଅନ୍ଧାରରେ ଅସ୍ତାଵଲରୁ
ମୁକୁଳେଇ ଦେଲି ଅଶ୍ବ
ମସ୍ତକରୁ କାଢିନେଲି ମୁକୁଟ
ଅଙ୍ଗ ଐଵଂ ଅଵୟଵରୁ ଆଭରଣ,
ଫେରେଇ ଦେଲି
ମୋ ସଂଭ୍ରାନ୍ତ ଓ ସଂସାରୀପଣର
ସବୁତକ ଚିହ୍ନ।

ଏଇଥିପାଇଁତ
ପଶାପାଲିରେ ହରେଇ ଦେଲି
ସୁଖ ଆଉ ସଂଭୋଗର ଗୋଟି
ଶିଶୁର ଦରୋଟି।

ତୋ ଅମୄତ ଆଶ୍ଳେଷ ପାଇଁତ
ଆରମ୍ଭିଲି ଅରଣ୍ୟର ଅଭିଯାନ
ତପଶ୍ଚର୍ଯ୍ୟା ଉପାସନା
କଠୋର ସାଧନା
ତୋ ସାତ୍ତ୍ଵିକ ସାନ୍ନିଧ୍ୟପାଇଁ
ଘୂରିଲି ଗ୍ରାମ ନଗ୍ର ଜନପଦ
ଉରୁଵିଲ୍ବ ରାଜଗୄହ,
ଵରିନେଲିଅଧ୍ୟାତ୍ମ ଓ ଅଧ୍ୟାସର ଅନେକ ଯଂତ୍ରଣା।

ନିରଂଜନା !
ଦେ , ତୋ ନୀଳ ଜଳଵେଣୀରେ ପଖାଳିଦେ,
ତୋ ତଟସ୍ଥ ପିପ୍ପଳର ଛାଇରେ
ଧ୍ୟାନସ୍ଥ କରିଦେ,
ଏଇ।ମୋର ଏକ ମାତ୍ର ନିଵିଡ଼ ପ୍ରାର୍ଥନା ।।

ତୁମେ କେଉଁଠାରେ ଅଛ?
ମୋର ଯେ ପହଁଚିବାକୁ ଅଛି
ଠିକ୍ ସମୟରେ
ତୁମ ଜହ୍ନ ରାତିରେ,

ମୁଁ ଘାଣ୍ଚୁଛି କେଉଁଠି ରଖିଚି
ତୁମ ଦିଗବଳୟରେ
ଉଡୁଥିବା ପକ୍ଷୀଟିର ନାମ
ତୁମ ଛାତର ଠିକଣା
ଜହ୍ନ ଉଇଁବାର ବେଳ,

ନାହିଁ କାହା ଅପେକ୍ଷାରେ
ଏଠି ଚଂଚଳ ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାକାଳ
ସେ ବୁଝିନି ଏଯାଏଁ
ଦିନ କେବେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏନାହିଁ
ମେରିଖୁଣ୍ଟ ଚାରିପଟେ
ଅଝଟ ଆଲୁଅ ଘିରି ଘିରି ବୁଲୁଥାଏ।

ମୁଁ ଚାଲିଛି
ଶୂନ୍ୟ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତର ପାଦଚିହ୍ନ ପଛେ ପଛେ
କେହି ତ କୁଆଡେ ନାହିଁ,
ତୁମରି ବଳରେ ଲୋଡେନାହିଁ
ପାଦତଳେ ପୃଥିବୀଏ ଚଟ୍ଟାଣ
ନା ଉପରେ ଆକାଶେ ସୀମା
ତୁମେ ତ ମହାସାଗରର ସୁଅ
ତୁମେ ଛଡା କିଏ ଆଉ
ବୁଡେଇ ପାରିବ କହ?
ଉଡନ୍ତା ସମୟକୁ କାନ ଦେଲେ
ତୁମେ ଶୁଣାଯାଅ
ଅନ୍ଧକାରରେ ଏକ ଅଦୃଶ୍ୟ ରେଖାରେ
ଝଟକୁଥାଅ।

ମାତ୍ରାଧିକ କମ୍ପମାନ ନିଃଶ୍ୱାସର
ହାତ ସହ ହାତ ଛନ୍ଦି
କ ଠାରୁ ଖ ର
ଜ୍ୟମିତିକ ଦୂରତା ପାରକରୁଅଛି
ଦୁଃସାହସ ମୋର,
କହିବକି ଏ ବିନ୍ଦୁରୁ ସେ ବିନ୍ଦୁ
କେତେ ଆଲୋକ ବର୍ଷ ଦୂର?

ହୋଇପାରେ ଡେଇଁହେବନାହିଁ
ସୀମା ସରହଦ
ଦିଗବଳୟ ଛୁଇଁ ହେବନାହିଁ,
ଓଗାଳିବ ବାଟ
ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ପରେ ପଶ୍ନଂକ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ମଣ ରେଖା
ଅନୁଭବ ପୋତିବ ଦ୍ରୁମ ଭଳିଭଳି
ବାଡ ଘେରାଇବ,
ବେଢିରହିଥିବେ ଅତୀତର ହସ କାନ୍ଦ,
ରେଖାଟିଏ ଘୂରୁଥିବ କେନ୍ଦ୍ର ଚାରିପଟେ
ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ଶୂନ୍ ରୁ ତିନିଶଷାଠିଏ,
ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କୋଣଟିଏ ଆଂକିଦେଇଥିବ
ବିସ୍ତାରିତ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର
ଯେଉଁଠି ପରିଧୀ ନଥିବ,

ବୋଧହୁଏ ତୁମେ ସେତେବେଳେ
ଉଭାହେବ ଏକାନ୍ତରେ
ଉଲଗ୍ନ ରାତିର ସମ୍ମୋହରେ,
ଯବକାଚ ତଳେ
କେବେ ବଡ କେବେ ଛୋଟ ଛାଇଟିଏ
ବାଟ କଢାଇବ
ସେଇ ଜହ୍ନରାତିଆଡେ।

ଆଖିକୁ ମାନୁଥିଲା କଜଳ
ମଥା ଉପରେ ଝଲମଲ
କରୁଥିଲା ବଡ ଠୋପା ସିନ୍ଦୂର
ହାତରେ ରୁଣୁ ଝୁଣୁ କାଚ ଚୁଡ଼ି
ପିଲାଦିନରୁ ଦେଖି ଆସିଥିଲି
ହସ ବୁଣୁ ଥିବା ମୋ ମାଆ
ମାଟି ଉପରେ ଚିକମିକ୍ ତରା
ଯୁଆଡ଼େ ଗଲେ ବିଛୁରି ପଡୁଥିଲା
ସୁଖ ର ସୁନେଲି ଖରା।

ଦିନେ ଏମିତି ହେଲା
କିଏ ପୋଛିନେଲା ସେ କଜଳ
ଆଖି କୁ ଶୁଖିଲା ପତ୍ର କରି
ମଥା ଦିଶିଲା ଖାଲି ଖାଲି
ଶାଢୀରେ ଆଉ ନଥିଲେ ଶୁଆ ଶାରି
ହାତରୁ ଉଭେଇଗଲେ ସବୁତକ ଚୁଡ଼ି
କୁଆଡେ ଗଲାନି ଆଉ ସେ
ଲୁହ କୁ କରି ନେଲା ସାଥି
କେହି ଜଣେ ଦେଇ ଗଲା
ଖଣ୍ଡିଏ ସରୁ ଧଡି ର ଧୋତି।

ଘର ଭିତରୁ ଆଉ ଶୁଭୁ ନଥିଲା
ଥରକୁ ଥର, ବେଳ ଅବେଳରେ
`ହଇ ହେ ଶୁଣୁଛ`,
ଆମ ମଥା ଉପରେ ଛତା ନଥିଲା
ଆହୁରି ଅନେକ କିଛି ନ ଥିଲା,
ଏତେ ଗହଳିରେ ବି ଘର ଦିଶୁଥିଲା ଯେମିତି ଗୋଟେ ଥୁଣ୍ଟା ଗଛ।

କିନ୍ତୁ ସେତିକି ବେଳେ ଯାହା ଘଟିଗଲା
ତା ମତେ ସବୁଠୁ ବେଶି
ନିସ୍ଵ କରିଦେଲା
କେତେ କାକୁସ୍ଥ ଦିଶିଲା
ସେଇ ମୁହୁର୍ତ ରେ ମୋ ମା ର ଆଖି
କେତେ ଅଦେଖା ଭୟରେ ଜଡସଡ ତାର ଶୂନ୍ୟ ଦେହ
ରଙ୍ଗୀନ ଶାଢୀ ରୁ ଧଳା ଧୋତି
କିଏ ବା ସମ୍ଭାଳି ପାରିବ ସତରେ
ସେ ନିଆଶ୍ରୀ ସମୟର କୋହ।

ସେଇ ଦିନ ରୁ ଧୋତି ଦେଖିଲେ
ମୁଁ ଚମକି ପଡେ,
ମତେ ଭାରି ନିର୍ମାଖି ଦିଶେ
ଧୋତି ପିନ୍ଧା ସବୁବୟସ୍କା ଦେହ।
ଭାରି ନିଷ୍ଠୁର ଦିଶେ ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ
ଧଳା ଧୋତି ଫିଙ୍ଗୁଥିବା ସେ ହାତ
ଆହୁରି ଘୃଣ୍ୟ ଏସବୁକୁ ମନେ ପକାଇ ଦେଉଥିବା ସେ ବ୍ରାହ୍ମଣ ପଣ୍ଡିତ।

ମୁଁ କାମନା କରେ,
ଧଳା ରଙ୍ଗ ଲିଭି ଯାଆନ୍ତା ପୃଥିବୀରୁ
ସବୁ ଦିନ ପାଇଁ,
ସ୍ମୃତି ଭ୍ରଂଶ ହୁଅନ୍ତା ସେ ପଣ୍ଡିତ ମାନଙ୍କର
ଚିରି ଯାଆନ୍ତା ସେଇ ସବୁ ପୋଥି
ଯାହା ପିନ୍ଧେଇ ଆସିଛି
ମୋ ମା ପରି ନାରୀ ମାନଙ୍କୁ
ଅସହାୟତାର ସେ ଧୋତି।

________
ଉଦୟନାଥ ମହାବିଦ୍ୟାଳୟ
ଅଡ଼ସପୁର, କଟକ

source_fields.captured_author: Jnani Debashis Mishra/ ଜ୍ଞାନୀ ଦେବାଶିଷ ମିଶ୍ର
source_fields.body_html:
ଏତେ ସହଜ ନୁହେଁ ନଈଟିଏ ହେବା।
ମିଶୁ କି ନମିଶୁ
ସବୁତକ ଖରା ପୋଛିଦେଇ
କଣ୍ଟାଝଣ୍ଟା, ଗୋଡ଼ିପଥର ଆଡ଼େଇ
ଲୁହଲୁହାଣ ପାଉଁଜି ପିନ୍ଧି
ସମୁଦ୍ରେ ଅନୁରାଗ ଆଡ଼କୁ
ଏକମୁହାଁ ଦୌଡ଼ିବା।

ଖାଲିପାଦର ଜୀବନରେ ବି
ଖିଲିଖିଲି ହସର ଫୁଆରା ଭରିହୁଏ କେମିତି,
ନଈଟିଏ ହିଁ ଶିଖେଇପାରେ କେବଳ।
ନିଜେ ଯାଇ ନପାରିଲେ ସମୁଦ୍ର ପାଖକୁ,
ଭାଗଭାଗ କରି
ବା ମିଶେଇଦେଇ ନିଜକୁ ଆଉ କାହା ସହ
କେମିତି ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣତା ଦେଇହୁଏ ଜୀବନକୁ -
ତା` ବି ଗୋଟିଏ ନଈ ହିଁ ତ ଶିଖାଇପାରେ।

ନଈ ଭଳି ବହିଯିବା
ଜଣା ନଥାଏ ଆମକୁ ବୋଲି
ଜୀବନଆଡ଼କୁ ବଢ଼ୁଥିବା
ସବୁ ଥରିଲା ପାହୁଣ୍ଡରେ ଆମର
ଚପଲପିନ୍ଧା କୋମଳତାର ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଶା।
ଭଳିକି ଭଳି ଚପଲ ବାଛିବାରେ
ସରିଯାଇଛି ଯେତେ ଜୀବନ,
ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ଯେ ନଈ ଭଳି ବାଟଖୋଜିବା ଜଣା-
ହଲପ କରି ଜଣେ ବି କେହି
କହିପାରିବ କ`ଣ !

ପଥର ହଉ କି ମାଟି,
ଉପର, ତଳ କି ଭିତରଦେଇ
ଅନ୍ଧାର ଚିରିବା ଜାଣିଥାଏ ବୋଲି ତ
ଝରଟିଏ ନଈ ହେଇ ପାରେ-
ବୋଲି କହିଥିଲା ଯେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର,
ସେ ଆଜି ନିଜେ ଗୋଟେ ବାଲିସ୍ତୂପ।
ଏବେ ତ ନଈମାନଙ୍କୁ ଲିଭେଇଦେଇ
ପାହାଡ଼ ତୋଳିବାରେ ହିଁ
ଆମର ହାତମାନେ ବ୍ୟସ୍ତ ଓ ଅଭ୍ୟସ୍ତ।

ଏବେ ଜୀବନର ପାହାଡ଼ରେ
ସିମେଣ୍ଟ୍‌ର ମାଟି, ସିମେଣ୍ଟ୍‌ର କୁଣ୍ଡ,
ସିମେଣ୍ଟ୍‌ର ଗଛବୃଚ୍ଛ, ସିମେଣ୍ଟ୍‌ର ଝରକା-କବାଟ,
ସିମେଣ୍ଟ୍ ମଣିଷ ଆଉ ସିମେଣ୍ଟ୍‌ର ଜହ୍ନ।
ଆଉ ନଈମାନେ ବାଟବଣା,
ଚକୋର ଭାଗ୍ୟରେ ଖାଲି
ନଈଖୋଜା ଗୀତର ମରଣ।

ଆମେ ଭୁଲିଯାଇଛୁ କ୍ରମଶଃ ଯେ,
ନଈର ଜୀବନ ଅଛି, ଜୀବନ ବି ନଈ।
ଆମେ ଭୁଲିଯାଉଛୁ କ୍ରମଶଃ ଯେ,
ପ୍ରତି ମଣିଷ ଭିତରେ ଥାଏ ଗୋଟେ
ପାଣିର ଫୁଆର
କଳକଳ ନଈ ହେବାପାଇଁ।

-ଓଡ଼ିଆ ବିଭାଗ, ରେଭେନ୍ସା ବିଶ୍ୱବିଦ୍ୟାଳୟ, କଟକ,୭୫୩୦୦୩

ଚାଲ ଏ ଭିଡ଼ ଭିତରୁ ଚାଲିଯିବା
କେଉଁ ଏକ ନିରୋଳା ଜାଗାକୁ
କିଛି ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତ ପାଇଁ ବଂଚିଯିବା କୋଳାହଳରୁ
ବେଳ ବୁଡ଼ିଲା ବେଳେ ସେଦିନ
କହିଲ ଏକଥା ।

ଠିକ୍ ରେ ଶୁଣି ପାରିଲିନି ବୋଲି
କେତେ ଅଭିମାନ ଯେ କଲ,
ହେଲେ କୁଆଡେ ଯିବା ?

ଅତଏବ ଜୀବନ ବୋଇଲେ ଖାଲି ଖୋଜିବା
ଖୋଜିଚାଲିବା ନିଜପାଇଁ ଛନ୍ଦଟିଏ,
ନିଜ ନାଁର ପ୍ରତିଶବ୍ଦମାନ ତିଆରି କରି
ଗୀତଟିଏ ଗୁନ୍ଠିବାକୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବା,
ଆଉ ଅଧାଗୁନ୍ଥା
ବେସୁରା ସେଇ ଗୀତକୁ ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣେଇବା।

ଜୁଆର ଆଉ ଭଟ୍ଟାରେ ମିଳିଲା ଯୋଉ ଛନ୍ଦ
ବେଖାପ ହେଲା ସିଏ
ଖରା ଆଉ ଛାଇର ଛନ୍ଦ ସାଙ୍ଗେ,
ମିଳନରେ ବିଚ୍ଛେଦରେ ମିଳିଲା ଛନ୍ଦଟିଏ
ହେଲେ ମିଳେଇଗଲା ସେ ଛନ୍ଦ
ଯେବେ ବଦଳିଗଲା ରତୁ, ଯେବେ
ଉଡ଼ିଗଲେ ଗେଣ୍ତାଳିଆ, ଯେବେ ଝରିପଡ଼ିଲା
ଗଙ୍ଗଶିଉଳି।

ଅତଏବ ମିଳିଲା ନାଇଁ ଆପଣାର ଛନ୍ଦଟିଏ
ଛାତିତଳେ ସାଇତି ରଖିବା ପାଇଁ,
ମିଳିଲା ନାଇଁ ଛନ୍ଦଟିଏ ବଇଶାଖ ଦିପହରେ
ଛାଇ ଖୋଜୁ ଖୋଜୁ ନିଜକୁ ବୋଧ ଦବାକୁ,
ମିଳିଲା ନାଇଁ ଛନ୍ଦଟିଏ କାହାକୁ
`ନିଜର ବୋଲି ଦଉଚି` କହି
ଉଧାର ଦବା ପାଇଁ।

ତମେ ଯଦି ଛନ୍ଦଟିଏ ଖୋଜୁଚ ଜୀବନରେ
କିମ୍ବା ଏ କବିତାରେ ମୋର , ଖୋଜୁଥାଅ ।
ମିଳିଲେ ବି କହିବନି ମୋତେ, ଖାଲି
ଗାଇ ଶୁଣେଇବ ଏକୁଟିଆ ସଞ୍ଜବେଳେ
ବାଟବଣା ହେଇଯାଇଥିବା ଚଢେଇଛୁଆକୁ,
କିମ୍ବା ଆଜିକାଲି ମୋ ଘର ଆଡେ ଭୁଲରେ
ଆସୁ ନ ଥିବା ପବନରେ ଭସେଇଦବ ସେ ଛନ୍ଦ।

ଜୀବନ ବୋଇଲେ ବାକି ସବୁଛନ୍ଦ ର ମୋହ ଛଡେଇ
ଚାଲ ଖୋଜିଚାଲିବା ନିଜ ଛନ୍ଦଟିକୁ ।

source_fields.captured_author: Sunanda Pattanaik Janah / सुनन्दा पट्टनायक जाना
source_fields.body_html:
सर्द मौसम में
खनकते हैं बर्तन
जब सरसों के साग से
महकता है आँगन
रोटी पर कहीँ मक्खन पिघले ऐसे
दूर कहीँ मकानों की भीड़ में
बिना आहट धूप उतरी हो जैसे

अंधी सरहद बे -ज़ुबान लकीरों का
वजन उठाये खड़ी
नज़र और साँस फिर भी आज़ाद
पिछली बारिश में तैरता ये बीज
यहाँ घर के आगे अटक गया था शायद
जिस पर फूल आया है
इसे हिस्से में कैसे बांटे
इसकी खुशबू से खुलती है खिड़की
मेरी आँखों से
आसमानी देवदार तक
ऐसी कोई तकनीकी डोर नहीं जो
बाँध सके हवा
रोक सके खुशबू
मैं सबा हूँ छू जाऊं तो महसूस हो
सांसों में भरो तो जीवन का एहसास हो ।

source_fields.captured_title: न शिकायत है, न शिकवा है।
source_fields.body_html:
न शिकायत है, न शिकवा है।
फ़क्र है मुझे एक फौजी की बीवी होने का।
पर दिल तो है एक औरत का....

कैसे छिपाऊं हाल दर्द-ए-दिल का।
बड़ी आसानी से मुस्कुराते हुए,
झूठ कहके गए थे तुम।।

वादा कर, कहके गए थे..
जल्द लौट आऊंगा मैं।
लाल चूड़ा पहनाऊंगा मैं।
करना इन्तेज़ार तुम,
रखना अपना और अपनों का ख़्याल तुम।।

बड़ी आसानी से मुस्कुराते हुए,
झूठ कहके गए थे तुम।।

बच्चों से कहा था,
ढेर सारे खिलौना लाओगे तुम।
बूढ़ी माँ को बड़ी आसानी से गाँव ले जाने का वादा कर गए थे तुम।
न सोचा माँ ने कभी,
तिरंगे में आयेगा लिपटा,
और गाँव ले जाएगा बेटा कभी ..

बड़ी आसानी से मुस्कुराते हुए,
झूठ कह गए थे तुम।।

फ़र्ज़ अदा करने को आया जब,
ठोक सीने को अपनी
टूट पड़े जंग-ए-मैदान पर,
मुस्कुराकर शहीद हुए देश पर।।
बनाया तिरंगे को अपनी तीर,
है तू अपने देश का वीर ....

बड़ी आसानी से मुस्कुराते हुए,
झूठ कह गए थे तुम।।

भूल कर सारे वादे-इरादे,
दे गए आंखों में झूठे वादे।
हम हैं सीधे-सादे,
हो गए बिन तेरे आधे....

बड़ी आसानी से मुस्कुराते हुए,
झूठ कह गए थे तुम।।

न शिकायत है न शिकवा है,
फ़क्र एक फौजी की बीवी होने का है।
पर दिल तो एक औरत का है ....

भूल गए बच्चों के वादे तुम,
बूढ़ी माँ के आंसू को गाँव ले गये तुम।
सफेद रंग मुझे तोहफा में दे गए तुम।।

बड़ी आसानी से मुस्कुराते हुए,
झूठ कह गए थे तुम।।

साफ सुथरा हमें रास्ता चाहिये
रहनुमा से ये अब बोलना चाहिये

प्यार से गुफ्तुगू कोई करता नहीं
दौरे माज़ी का वो हमनवा चाहिये

खूबसूरत ये दुनिया का तोहफा मिला
इससे बढ़कर हमे और क्या चाहिये

फूल पत्तों से महकती रहे हमारी धरा
बचाब के लिए कदम बढ़ाना चाहिये

जिससे पहचान दुनिया में अपनी बने
कुछ अलग सा हमें सोचना चाहिएY

कौन गरिमा ये उससे कहे अब बता
तेरे बीमारे -ग़म को दवा चाहिए

काश
सरहदों की न होती ये दीवारें
ज़मीं पानी की न होती लकीरें
आसमां सा खुला होता ये जहान
मज़हब से परे होता बस इंसान ।

काश
बिन दहशत के भरा करती बेटियाँ उड़ान
पहनने ओढ़ने से न रखती सरोकार
मनचाहा करती समय का न बंधन
समझी जाती भावनाएँ और अंतर्मन।

काश
एक ही घर परिवार के न हो टुकड़े
हाथों में थामे स्क्रीन अपने अपने
रिश्तों से न दूर भागे बच्चे, बड़ें
प्यार की अहमियत अब ये जाने।

काश
समाज से बैर, धर्म ,जाति का
वैमनस्य का अब मिट जाए
धरा ये खिलखिलाए जो कभी
वसुधैव कुटुंबकम् की परम्परा
हो जाए।

Once, I said to one...
There is always
A trench...
Not narrow, but broad
Filled with nothingness;
A vacuum, a black hole.
Between
The Present
And
The Future.

The Present...
What is.
What one is.
What one does.

The Future...
What is wished, dreamt, expected.
What one wants to be.
What one wants to be doing.

In one`s life,
A time comes
When one falls
Off the cliff
Into this deep, emptiness.
No way out.
One gets stuck;
In monotony, routine.
World calls it settlement.

I was asked: Sir! How to get out?
I said: Quite easy...
When in nowhere, be a nobody.
Accept the Nothingness.
That`s how, `ChandAshoka` turned `DharmAshoka`.

I saw a hapless smile.
That`s it? He asked.
No. I replied.
Either that, Or
You manufacture a Future
Out of your Self; Full of yourself.
That`s how, Siddhartha became Shakyamuni.

Can`t one prevent this misery,
Not falling into it at all?
The inquisitive one kept on...
I said... Certainly one can.
There is a rope;
Of your dreams and aspirations
Thin, sharp and long.
Connecting the present and future.

Walk on it, steady;
Full of faith, determined.
Putting in effort, constant.
Don`t stop, till
What you are, becomes
What you wanted to be.
Though, I am saddened to say;
Most of us, end up leading
A settled life, in those dark depths.

I won`t fall, Sir!
I heard a voice, confident.
I smiled, now content.

Radiant sun starts it`s day with a dawn,
With saffon radiance it`s reflections touch every one,

From living to non-living the radiance flows,
In solar radiance everyone glows,

Plants & afforetation start their osmosis process,
Prepare their food for the day in silence,

No one knows how a tree grows,
A tiny seed grows to be a tall tree in year`s,

All are creatures of mother nature,
Evolution brings every species closure,

Since infinity the relentless process of creativity,
Carrying on it`s mundanely duties with greater vision & clarity,

Nature is God`s own creation,
Provision for everyone is it`s profession & passion,

Nature treats eveyone equal,
But we segregate them to achieve our own goal,

The ultimate goal of serving & saving the humanity ,
Striking a harmony & balance between plants, animals & humans till eternity,

The planet belongs to every one,
A tiny ant to a mammoth elephant live in the domain,

Civilization has marched ahead,
With Equality in mind for everyone in head,

In the evening I tell you
Let us write a poem tonight.
It has been really long.

We wait throughout the night
for the poem to arrive.
But nothing comes. In the morning

I decide to write
a poem about the poem
that did not arrive.

This poem is about waiting,
about a non-arrival,
about something that is not there.

You will not find in this poem
the pathos of a child sleeping
with his head on a brick as a pillow.

This poem will not play with
your sentiments or emotions.
There is a blandness about it.

In this poem nothing happens
and that is the only thing
that happens in this poem.

Perhaps this poem has been
awaiting our arrival
instead of us waiting for it.

Perhaps all poems are sleeping
with their heads on bricks as pillows
dreaming of a new poet`s arrival.

Rain does not descend
as naturally as it used to
When I was a child.

It`s now its whims and pleasure
To drizzle when mother earth desperately needs a downpour
Fueling the unending agony of the hapless farmers.

Its anger inscrutable
As if fumes hovering above
With its pitch-dark attire
Then crashes heavily in torrent
Hurling hailstones
Exerts its existence with a terrifying thunderous laughter
and its fire of anger sparks across the sky as flashes of lightening
strikes down innocent lambs and children sheltered under the tree
Its heavy sighs snap and sweep away centuries of old banyans
Uproot and engulf tall towers and buildings
Shatter everything into sherds in seconds

And then it keeps quiet like an innocent infant
As if nothing has happened
Sleeping silently under the blue blanket
After being in spit and fury being obstinate
Or as if an unconcerned Rishi in deep meditation
When the air echoes with moaning and screaming.

I reflect on my childhood days
When it used to pour over the fields and forests
Naturally with drizzleor shower
To everyone`s pastimeand pleasure
Though sometimes with tumultuous tremor
Bearing a horrifying look
But in spite of it the farmers used to sing gleefully
One hand on the ploughhead
The other holding a stick
To break the idleness of the bullocks
And we children enjoyed rain and thunder equally
Without fear
Having no over enthusiastic reporters
Giving coverage for twenty-four hours
Or weather experts forecasting weather
And full-fledged preparation by government to avert a danger.

But nowadays it does not descend
In its regular cycle
As naturally as it used to
When I was a child…!

How beautiful a blank page is!
A blank page, blank but full of space
Full of space with full of bliss
A bliss that awaits a life to grace!!

Graceful dreams sweat, bet to come
To come on blank page in a queue
A queue whose front-end yet random
And back end still in aerial view!!

That`s a view in unseen mode
A mode with hundred seeds unsown
A seed is often a boon bestowed
A blank page is but a plough land mown!!

So far flashes in memory:
A great, meaningful difference detected
Between the zealous day of my first walk
And unwillingness to step out any more today.

The crowding companions, talkative relations
Countless new roads snaking through directions different then,
Convincingly teach me today: Vein-like ways
Melt in one another; directions: upon my face-ward turns.

These days, the road I set my foot on
Finds a co-operative but competitive companion
Whom I know fairly well, since long:
Reticent, relentless, absent minded, brooding all along.

Chasing like shadow, tight-lipped, hardly sharing inner feelings
The poet in me is not mine, his concerns cover
Entire world, a supporting silhouette, following him am I
The friendless road taken: my only identity, means and me.

I drew deeper breaths ,
fragrances were pervasive.
Perhaps, Mother might have burnt Some incense, I thought.
In my vision the seven mystics breeze,
The olfactory benediction!

Lavishing rainbow colours soothing and evocative,
The lavenders, tuberoses, lilies
primroses
Sweet arc of the meditative fold envelops.
After the sprinkle of showers
The rainbow of my soul unfolds
In an enhanced encompassing embrace...

All festive celebrants, call by different names the day.
Filling colours in the rainbow blossoms.
They adore divinity.
Behold the rainbow
As the blessing of the sky
In different hues, steeping you in the same light
Diffusing the secret in subtle prisms.
You see the smile of heavens,
All the psalms huddle us to Him
The rainbow emerges without any reserve!.

source_fields.captured_title: I hug you in my dreams
source_fields.body_html:
Awaiting to steal a glance at you
Days seeming decades, pass by,
Will you come or will you not?
The lone query, my misty eyes carry.

While answering to knocks on the door
This longing heart anticipates none but you,
To walk in, wrap me in your warm arms
I pray for my delayed dream to come true.

Like the fallen leaves of maple
Rustling on the soil to hymn harmony,
Tales of our yesteryear`s union
Though bygone, yet emanates euphony.

Enduring the scathing cold at Siachen
Or tolerating blazing heat in the Thar,
You safeguard our nation with all your might
As I wait and wait, counting the stars.

Ofttimes I hug you in my dreams
Pleading you, not to join far-flung postings,
Nevertheless, as the dawn breaks, I realize
I`m a soldier`s wife, born to stay strong.

< p> Journey


A narrow passage running through the deep forest of Time
Since my birth, crossing over the foot prints of ancient
civilizations created by the temporal settlers of earth.

It never ends,
I don`t know when it began.

The woods and living animals, wonderful creatures on
this vivid earth need nothing but
love and peace,
harmony of nature and men..

I have seen the unseen and
hidden treasures of Time
since my journey began through
the womb of night..

Time and again
I return alone!

(2) Self- indulgence


I needed it
Only because
you wanted to make this world
As your own ,
As you like it.

You deserve your own home.
I don`t have any idea
What makes a home!

I had nothing to offer you-
I am a nowhere man,
I belong to no man`s land!

Still
I needed it.

Only because
We had a dream ,
But did not learn how to make
A dream more memorable
For both of us..


Need of the hour
Is self- indulgence -
Once you said
Dear love….

< p>Water, water everywhere
Immeasurable depth as a human mind
Colourless, multifarious
Green, white, blue
Big rise
Small rise

Big fall
Small fall
The sea unravels
As destiny
As the sea changes its course
So does destiny

New hopes wrapped in past despair
Come rolling forth
Like a rainbow of shells
And the glitter of the bangles
What is a man
Before the fathomless, boundless sea.

< p>Baba ( my father )was walking me home on the last night of celebration
marking his superannuation.
It was certainly not the effulgence of that silver that engulfed us that night ....
Baba so long had been our uncrowned monarch ...
The Himalayas for us ..his children ...
was he talking far too much -
was not he sounding too theatrical at times ..!
the twitch around his lip area spoke of what pain
that was driving him to asperity ...
i shook all over like the poplar leaves !
three successive tenures as the head of a college
and
now to accept the life that lay ahead ...
everything merged so uncannily with the silvery ash ..!
baba`s bleeding heart , his thin layer of hair ,
my pain
and
his exiguous jacket ...!!

You are slowly murdered by the things you don`t say,
I can listen to this ocean of love roaring inside your seashell heart.
As you run short of words to describe my beautiful soul,

I was like a chrysalis secure in your hands.
Wanting to know where did others go wrong.
Where everyone saw roses
I wanted to feel your thorns,
No judgements on past losses, forgone dreams,
Love like love loves and there`d be no vocabulary to substitute this intense heart ache,

I have been searching those missing pieces,to fix the puzzle
Alphabets to complete the sudoku charts,
This love of yours felt like drops of rain.
Which showered through my soul and purified me with all the goodness.;

Gift me those scattered treasures of abandoned autumn leaves,
To nurture and cherish thee life after life
You are the beautiful dream that woke me up from my slumber,
You are the end to all my searching,
Yes,In you I am complete.

If any day I feel lost in crowd
Puzzled n jumbled up
I strive n make sure
to go back into self
n discover in silence
again the vigour
to fight n endure storm...

Chant my real inner mantra ,
The strongest I am n will be
Solitude is my soil n hope
is my water , creativity is my light
To bloom in fine fettle
n spread positivity .

To make me aware
That am simple yet beautiful ,
Who never can relinquish
In any way or situations
But to uphold n embark
the confidence back n
Feel the wholesomeness again .

For I know the truth
am plentiful n rich in me
Yes , I am abundant n happy in self
For the ethereal beauty ,
the delicacy , the innocence
My soul possesses .

I love myself in bits
Little more each day
In different way n pace ,
Grow naturally with experiences
To relish the infinite joy around me .

Why does this happen with us?
With all of us?
The stature of emotions often falls short in front of ego!
The words of the heart remain untold,
All the feelings either remain lost or
They are kept suppressed in the darkness of the heart.
The sole task the heart gets assigned is to beat only!
Sorrows are also covered with the false cloak of happiness!
And the tears are detained in the eyes only!
But sometimes, these naughty tears somehow spill out
With the spreading of kajal!

Still the caravan of life goes on and on and on
The cycle of life too goes along
We live, we live, we live...!
Likewise, on the wounds of the heart
The layers of ointment keep on increasingand increasing and increasing…!

Still,we wait for a handful of scattered drops of happiness!
And the wait goes on and on and on…!

< p>I struggled so deeply,
In search of an answer
What was wrong being a girl?
But I failed again and again.
Desires dead, unfulfilled.
Some were obdurate and were killed.
I fell,
I crashed,
I broke,
I cried,
I was hurt,
And then......
I rose again
Under a cerulean sky
Where sublime beauty
Reflected my pristine soul
I nurtured there,
With plethora of love and affection
Where idols of Goddesses aren`t worshipped.
But live deities are!

< p>She, in faded frayed rags,
Sells mini plastic flags:
Symbols of our freedom,
The pride of our nation,
To the people in shining cars on the street
With untidy hands, brassy hair
and grubby but never-get-tired feet,
Her face a withered flower
And she an incarnation of deadly hunger,
Still, in her eyes hope flickers
That one day she`ll will defeat hunger
And her face will shine like a lovely flower
With a flag of her own
Flying to the tune of the free wind
On the roof of her home

< p>I was in a miraculous tone.
While curdling you on the phone!
Were it those specified tone?
Or was I in the comfort zone?
Indeed! It was a comfort,
Which I had felt like an embracing confusion.
And all thanks goes to your seducing seduction!
The seduction which was a semblance to revolution.
Wasn`t it more than enough for me to be a revelation!
Even in those moments when my body was about to ponder.
My soul was still in the mode of yonder!
Those moments which had left me yearning.
Were my efforts enough to make your kisses yearning!
Yep! I wanted to feel you.
Or were it the moments when I need you?
Those needs which make me to desire you.
Those desires which make me to aspire you.
Those aspirations which make me to perspire you.
Those perspiration which had been heartily desire!
Am I eligible to make my soul desire?
Am I eligible to make my heartiest wishes aspire?
Or, will I entangle in this luscious labyrinth?
Or those luscious moments will turn lascivious?
Those lasciviousness which had made us separated.
And left me in longing even to feel elated!
My heart still desire yet emotions seems deflated.
Will you come again to make me rejunavated?
Will you come again to make me passionated?
Will your seduction once again make me sedated?
Will your kisses once again make me feel animated?
Will your touch once again make me feel wanted?
Will your desire once again make me feel needed?
Or once again I will be in the labyrinth of longing.
While glaring at your miraculous tone.
Soothing myself that I am still in the comfort zone!

< p>An invisible flight of the heart:
Slowly the earth became hazy
Roads and houses disappeared from sight,
The bundle of growing age
felt lighter all at once,
can`t tell you why!

I looked out from the airplane window:
The cotton clouds were spreading colours--
Orange, pink, turquoise, purple..
Perhaps there was a colour
beyond the rainbow, too
I don`t know the name
of that eighth colour:
My heart and me
in a universe of colours!

The heart-- an entity
divided between the earth and the sky,
A silent invitation
of the bright moon and the stars,
The heart and the mind
rush towards the sky lightning fast,
But can`t stay there
There is a string that pulls the kite
down to the ground:

The shade of dense, emerald trees,
The shower of rain drops,
The cool breeze with moisture,
And the earth`s deep blue ocean
encompassing the blue beauty
of the sky
call me back.
With the slanting rays of the evening
My being settles like a bird
in the nest!

Lost a lot
Spring`s mystical intoxications
Here and now
Dark nocturnal silence ;
Ferocious mind
Bickers in anxiety,
Devils of lust
Pushed me to oblivion
Through tunnels of dark emotions.
Don`t question me
Here and now
I don`t survive as me.
Tumultuous waves
From the breast of the sea,
Calls from hills of hatred
Brazen arms of distress,
Don`t question me
Here and now
I don`t survive as me,
It`s a vicious night
It`s a treacherous night.

Whispers find their way
Laps of security
Puritan stories of my grandma.
Find in hesitance
The lanes of feelings
Strings to the merger
Ganga yamuna
Deep inside my search
Try to fathom
Sermons of Geeta Puran,
Don`t question me
Here and now
I don`t survive as me
It`s a vicious night
It`s a treacherous night.

< p>Wandering in orbit
merely results from
the force of attraction
Or may be an endeavour
to enter the navel of being

Asking for an answer
an exercise in futility

Bound by the frame of life
we remain hanging
on the wall of an exhibition
or keep on staring at the frame
like silent onlookers
– an incomprehensible process

What is simple,
is life
which is only the sum
of a few letters

First Rain in Vienna

Here the soil seldom exudes
the aroma
of earth refreshed
But in time
when the scents of the city rise
twiglets of memory shoot up
And somewhere deep down
loss strikes root.

POEMs come to me
with some consolation words
when I felt miserably sad,
thinking of the dont`s done
to the deprived calculations!

They say to me `to rise to
the occasion`
avoiding
silence and shyness when
atrocities peep!

Children, are they, trying to
play with me in my mirth
with positive attitudes!

Poems are my friends,
on some moments,
taking
to the height of nourishing thoughtfulness of
golden moments to accept
victorious vicinity!

AND

They caution me against
alluring agenda, leading
to permanent despair and
perpetual degradation...

They constantly exhort me
to remain happy with what I have!!

I feel
The world has shrunk into a web
Our dreams grow taller inside four walls
I open my window to world
I see emptiness
Nemesis of nature gives loss to everyone

I wish, I could
walk on busy roads with you

I wish, I could smell petrichor soon
and see shimmering of dew drops

I am taught
life is beyond desires
But, I still search for the pink shirt you wore.
Where should I search for you?
Tell me
Is life a peaceless affair?

When I was out on the road
Searching for warmth of a morning
I entered into an alley
Where winter had set in
A poster was declaring a girl missing.
A newspaper was flying over a drunken head
Hearts were found very old and cold.
`This is a blind alleyway`, someone said
`No, a jungle path`, cooed another
A growl was heard, a little lamb butchered.
`This is real winter`, I felt.
I wanted to return but fog was dense
A pub was full of revelry but nobody had sense
They were burning some flesh to keep them warm
What a strange place, without any charm?
Because this is winter no flowers bloom
Air is stagnant, everywhere the gloom
Has spread its wings to cover the earth
Ohh.. we need a heart to give us warmth
Life recedes back to meet its death.

Winter comes to a No-man`s land
Where people are hiding from sun
And night is soaked with blood.
Winter is the blanket they need
Thick mist that covers their plight
Or sight from the perpetrator of crime.
Winter arrives at the door of a widow
Whose white veil has pores
She seeks warms from a hearth
Whose fire is cooled by a downpour.
Winter in a shelter house rests
With restless orphans lying in empty stomach
Winter is kinder than spring
It lulls them to endless sleep.

Book launch
Sheaffar pen
hurried autographs,
thunderous applause.
Folded hands
cherubic smile.


On the table
old friend`s old notebook.
nervous sweaty fingers,
tucked it tight
in the chest of drawers.
The bouquet of red roses
on the mantle piece
rounded its lips,
sarky smile.

Chunda! Chunda! Bury now this pork
Deep into the earth,
There`s none in the world who can
Absorb such meat,
Oh! Ananda! What a bed you`ve made
Under the cover of the Saal
Saal is my favourite tree-
Saal, White Elephant, The Moon atop the elephant-head

In a lion`s poise let me recline on this bed
And recall
The Three dishes I`ve ever relished-
The pork that Chunda brought
Ananda! Let everybody know
The delight that Chunda with his pork had brought
And then the rice porridge that Sujata cooked
Ananda! Come hither
My voice has grown so feeble
It cant be heard from far
The third, the third Yashodhara gave
Or was it really the first!
Ananda! Keep a secret, please
You, with only you I confide
The divine elixir was what Yashodhara made me draw
From the golden orbs of her breasts

Oh!Ananda! Darkness descends in the woods
Kindle yourself,
Be the lamp that`ll show you light.
(Translated by Bappaditya Roy Biswas)

No one told me, the rotis wouldn`t
glisten with ghee anymore,
from the open Milton casserole,
the roundish nourishing sun,
of our roundish dining table.

No one told me,neither would they be
that soft, fluffy, and comforting.
Atta kneaded with water,
half a teaspoon patience,
and a cupful of love.

No one told me, the ghee wouldn`t
smell homemadeanymore.
Smartly bought on my
smartphone`s over-smart app,
from a new-fangled fancy organic brand.
With a smiling pink cow for its logo,
at a super-saver, super-smart 30% discount.

No one told me, the need to eat
would remain, but it`s not the same
as a belligerent hunger,
rising up from a savage intestine,
worked up by the
sukhi laal mirchi tadka given to
fresh masoor dal.

So many people hadso many things to say.
People always have, so much to say.
Yet no one told me this.

No one told me, the dining table would
never have that once white but
yellowish now, crochet tablecloth,
demurely yet cleverly covering
its slightly apologetic, chipped off edges.

No one told me, the kitchen would stop
smelling of you,
and that the sink would stop shining,
your straggly, overworked Scotch-Brite
punished to a corner,
where grief and soot hang heavy.

No one told me, dinner would become
a silent chore, without
the dutiful background score
of your chitter-chatter.

So many people hadso many things to say.
“Be strong.”
“Listen, time heals everything.”
“Don`t hold the tears in, ok?”
People always have so much to say.

Yet not a single person told me this.
That I would stop loving
ghee-soaked rotis,
once you`re gone Ma.

Not a single person told me,
that the things
you once loved so dearly,
you can start hating too.

Strangely
dawn
is late

The Sky
hesitates to
cast off
it`s nightwear

Birds
are restless
wanting to leave
their nests

A mother
reaches out
for a little more sleep
While the world
comes to a stop

Sorrows
hover about everywhere
until they
finally find it
under their microscopes

A ball
pink in colour
with needle-like spikes
prickly all around

Looking
at their frightened faces
it laughed and laughed
echoes drowning
the screams
of the dying
and the dead.

source_fields.body_html:
ବେଶ୍ କିଛି ଆଣ୍ଟିକ୍ ଲୁହ ଅଛି ମୋ ପାଖରେ !
କିଛି ଜଙ୍କ୍ ଲାଗୁନଥିବା ଷ୍ଟେନ୍ ଲେସ୍ ଷ୍ଟିଲ୍ ହସ ବି !

ତମ ମ୍ଯୁଜିୟମ୍ ପାଇଁ ନବ କି...?

ହୃଦୟକୁ ହାତକଡ଼ି ନପକେଇ ରଖିଥା`ନ୍ତି ଯେଉଁମାନେ,
ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ଫ୍ରି`ରେ ଟିକେଟ୍ ଦେବ
ତ ବିଶ୍ବାସ କର, କ୍ଷତି ବଦଳରେ ଲାଭରେ ହିଁ ରହିବ !

ଯେଉଁ ଆଖିମାନେ ଲୁହପିନ୍ଧା ଶିଖିନଥିବେ,
ପବନରେ ପାରିଜାତ ଆଙ୍କି ଆସିବେ ତମ ପାଖକୁ !
ଯେଉଁ ଓଠମାନେ ହସିବା ଶିଖିନଥିବେ,
ଲୁଣିପାଣିରେ ପ୍ରାଣାୟମ କରୁକରୁ ପହଞ୍ଚିବେ ତମ ପାଖରେ !

ଦେଖାଦେଖି ଆସିବେ ବହୁ ଭଅଁର ଓ ପ୍ରଜାପତି !
ଆସିବେ କିଛି କଅଁଳା ସକାଳ ଓ ବୁଢ଼ୀ ଜହ୍ନରାତି !
ଆସିବେ କିଛି ଶୋଷ ଓ କିଛି ମୃଗତୃଷ୍ଣା !
ଆସିବେ ମୃଗୟା ମୋହରୁ ମୁକୁଳିସାରିଥିବା
କେଇଜଣ ଆରଣ୍ୟକ ଓ କେଇଜଣ ଅଧାଗଢ଼ା ଆକାଂକ୍ଷା !

ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ତମେ ଚଢ଼ା ଦରରେ ବିକିପାର ଟିକେଟ୍ !
ବିକିପାର ଲେମ୍ବୁ ଚା` ଓ ଜଳଖିଆ ପ୍ଯାକେଟ୍ !
କାହା କାହାକୁ କରିପାର ଆଜୀବନ କି ବାର୍ଷିକ ଗ୍ରାହକ !
କାହା କାହାକୁ ତମ ମର୍ଜି ଓ ମ୍ଯୁଜିୟମ୍ ର ମାଗଣା ପ୍ରଚାରକ !

କ`ଣ ବା ଆଉ କହିବି ତମକୁ ?

କଦମ୍ବଗଛ ତଳେ କବିତା କାନ୍ଦିବା ଦିନକୁ
ମେଘ ମୁରୁକିମୁରୁକି ହସୁଛି ସତ,
ଇନ୍ଦ୍ରଧନୁ କାନ୍ଧରେ କବିର କୋକେଇ !

କୋକେଇରେ କିଛି ମଲାଫୁଲ ଓ ଶୁଖିଲା ଖଇ !
କେଇଜଣ ବେରଙ୍ଗ ଅବିରର ଶବବାହକ
ଆଉ ଗୋଟେ ନିଆଁ ରଙ୍ଗର ନଈ !

ଆଃ, ଜୀବନ ଆଉ କ`ଣ କି ?
ଅଧା ଖରା ଅଧା ଛାଇ
ଯୋଉଠି ଅଛି, ସେଇଠି ନାହିଁ...!

ତୁମକୁ ଆଉ ଗୋଟେ ନୂଆ ପୃଥିବୀ
ମୁଁ ଦେଇ ପାରିବିନି
ଏଇ ପୃଥିବୀକୁ ମୋ ବାପା ଦେଖେଇଥିଲେ ମୋତେ ମୁଁ ଚିନହେଇ ଦେଲି ।

ହେଲେ ବାପା ଯେଉଁ ପୃଥିବୀ ସହିତ ପରିଚିତ କରାଇଥିଲେ
ସେ ରୁଗ୍ଣ ,ଅସୁସ୍ଥ ହୋଇପଡିଲାଣି ।

ବାପା କେବେ ଅମ୍ଳଜାନର ଅଭାବ କଥା
କହି ନ ଥିଲେ ମୋତେ

ଅନେକ ପ୍ରକାର ଗଛ ଲଗେଇଥିଲେ ସେ ବାଡ଼ିରେ
ପଣସ ,ନଡ଼ିଆ ,କଦଳୀ,ସପୁରୀ ,ବେଲ ,ପିଜୁଳି, ଆତ ଓ ଓଉ ....
ମରୁଡ଼ି ,ବାତ୍ୟା,ନଈବଢି କଥା
କେବେ କେବେ କହୁଥିଲେ
ହେଲେ ଭୟଭୀତ ହେବାର ନ ଥିଲା
ତାଙ୍କ କଥାରେ ।

ଖାଦ୍ୟ ଅଭାବର କଥା କହି
କେବେ ଡରେଇ ମଧ୍ୟ ନ ଥିଲେ ମୋତେ ।

ଏମିତି ଗୋଟେ ଦିନ ଆସିଲା ଯେ,
ସେ ଏବେ ସବୁଠି
ପବନ ପରି , ଆଲୋକ ଓ ପାଣି ପରି

ତାକୁ ପଚାରନା ,ସେ କେଉଁଠୁ ଆସିଲା
କାହିଁକି ଆସିଲା, କେମିତି ଆସିଲା ?
ତାକୁ ଆମେ ଭୟ କଲୁ
ଘରେ ଲୁଚିକି ବସିଲୁ ।

କଳଠପ , ବଳଠପ , ପାଦଠପ , ହାତ ଠପ ।

ଯନ୍ତ୍ର ପିଠିରେ ଅଙ୍ଗୁଳି ଏବେ ଚାଲୁଛି
ଅହରହ ବଟମ ଚିପିବାରେ ।

ବିସ୍ତିର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବିସ୍ତିର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଜଙ୍ଗଲକୁ କାଟିକୁଟି
ଶୁଭଗଛ ଲଗେଇଲୁ କୁଣ୍ଡରେ ବାଛି ବାଛି ।
ଛାତରେ ,ହତାରେ ପାଚେରୀ କଡ଼ରେ
ଶୋଇବା ଘରେ , ରୋଷେଇ ଘରେ ଏବଂ ଡ୍ରଇଂ ରୁମରେ ।

ପଞ୍ଜୁରୀରେ ବନ୍ଦୀ ହୋଇ ଝୁଲୁଛନ୍ତି ପଶୁପକ୍ଷୀମାନେ
କାଚବାକ୍ସ ରେ ଖେଳୁଛନ୍ତି ରଙ୍ଗୀନ ମାଛ
ଆମ ଘର ମାନଙ୍କରେ
ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ଆମେ ପାଳିଲୁ ପୋଷିଲୁ
ନିଜ ନିଜର ଗ୍ରହ ଶାନ୍ତି ପାଇଁ ।

ପିଲାମାନେ ତୁମକୁ ଆଉ ଗୋଟେ
ନୂଆ ପୃଥିବୀ ମୁଁ ଦେଇ ପାରିବିନି
ମୁଁ ଜାଣିଛି ,
ଅମ୍ଳଜାନ ବି ମୁଁ ଦେଇପାରିବିନି
ତୁମେମାନେ ଘରେ ରହି ରହି
ଅଣନିଶ୍ୱାସୀ ହୋଇ ପଡ଼ିଲଣି

ସୂଚନିକାଟେ ଦେଇ ଯା` , ସମୟ । ।

ଦୁଇଫାଳରେ ଫିଟେଇ ରଖ 
ଗୋଲକକୁ ତୋର ,

I have a dramabaaz in my house.
Not a dog,neither a rabbit,nor a mouse.
He will roll his eyes and look at you if you his interest arouse.
Or if you give him a book, he will with full concentration browse.

When you think he is having a nap.
He is observing you with a deer stalker cap.
If I sing Rabindra Sangeet he will accompany me with a rap.
When in his good mood,he will talk like an unstoppable tap.

In our house some words are not to be uttered.
If you do, with screeching and squawking your ears will be shattered.
So we spell out words like `juice` and `ice-cream`.
Otherwise he, for his favourite foods screams.

He loves to talk to sparrows but not the crows.
Crows are his enemies so for them he has shut all friendship doors.
Never,never give his sunflower seeds to the crows, never be so bold.
He will shout at you and at the top of his voice scold.

My dramabaaz feels shy when he sees a stranger,but that`s only for a while.
Give him time,he will then say `hello` and talk to you in style.
When we were working from home and were on the computer long.
He too joined in with his chatter and song.

Let poems be simple, and sound at everybody`s heart
Let every lip lift up a stanza of poem
Let poems roam about
Every meandering road in darkness and light
Every undulating land rivers forests hills mountains caves sky in day and night
In call of animals and birds, in all living and non-living things of the earth

Let poems flow with sonorous torrent of river
Let them shine like stars, celebrate the festival of light in the sky
Let them be melodious with ambrosial strains
Let poems thunder like clouds, make the heart of the earth drenched with drizzle
Like forest let them embosom the green
Like the sea let them fall in love with sailors, let them be sandbank for snails

Let poem be real
Like day and night like sunshine and wind
Like morning and evening like fire like water like earth
Like the blade of sword like life and death

Let poems be for rocks, yet not like rocks
Let them be for winter, yet not like winter
Let them be for the dead, yet not like the dead
Let them be for darkness, yet not like darkness

The feeling arisen by closeness of blood with blood, breast with breast, breath with breath
And the thrill arisen by the quivering of nerve vein bone breast
That light up the darkness of mind
Let poems shine amid them

Let poems be like roaming birds, let them rejoice the pleasure of wanderings
Let them bring news from horizon
Let them be source of nectar, let them bring sap from immaculate source
Let them bring colours from scenic frontier to insipid life
Let the strain and beauty of poem reverberate in every heart

Let poems be simple, not like leafless tree
Let poems be river, not stagnant water body.

Let poems be simple.
Translated by Dr. Binod Kumar Gogoi

checking the extent to which it can hurt you - trying the boundaries.
Then you luxuriate in the pain and the pulse -
sometimes even blessing it with tears -
feeling you are the Queen of your tragedy,
feeling that invisible crown or halo.
You feed on the pain, the burst,
the grind of cleaning and dressing it,
depending on how deeply you are cut.
Then, as the scab grows back, you feel brave -
rather a hero - `cause the hurt no longer hurts -
and the scar becomes beautiful —

Till one day it disappears - and only lingers in a memory -
and then that goes away too.

Love is just such a cut on a finger.

The cicadas fill the afternoon with their monotonous shrill, 
The sun adorns the sky like a pendant of gold. 
Somewhere in eerie silence 
Mind fills with cries. 
A fusion of voices and music 
Brims up in the empty spaces 
I remain untouched, unmoved 
In my solitary land. 
A bitter taste soars in my mind`s castle 
And I drink it again and again, 
I had stored since years 
My tears, my unfulfilled desires 
Under the shadow of oblivion. 
My thoughts unchain from deep slumber 
My wings of fancy want to touch the blue horizon 
Dark shadows of pain move in the breeze 
Waving the flag of my youthful memory 
Which I can not forget or share with others 
Let the silence be spread through the unseen void 
Drinking the sweet nectar of moon.

Dear Life!
You can stick the label of a sinner on me to
Uphold your sacred codes, if you want to,
I haven`t forgotten how you have coerced me to surrender to all your injustice, too;

I haven`t forgotten how you have kept me chained in your deluxe caves and crushed and battered all my tender stuff to forge out a slave, a soldier and a saint out of me,
And I have submitted to all your 
Erratic demands ungrudgingly;

Now that I deny to accept 
Your false promises and plea 
And let myself go unshackled, free,
You call it a profanation 
Let it then a profanation be;

Profanity is a better evil than hypocrisy 
So I let my sinning soul transgress the
Sacred bounds you have drawn out  for me,
To seek me in me, to seek my truth beyond
A yet to be discovered galaxy,
Or go crumbling down to the netherworld 
To get consumed  in the heatless 
blue flames by the river of 
The unexplored ecstasy;

Mine is a soul that by some ancient charm 
Is inveigled to a mysterious journey, 
Dear life! For all it matters to me,
 if you want to do so
You can call it a blasphemy!

Every night they come rushing
Surround me and
Haunt me
With questions about
Meaning of life
Reason for existence
Whom do you belong to
Who belongs to you
And they give me enough reasons
To end it all
I try to convince and persuade
But they are adamant and persuasive
I Shut them all
Shew them away
Get deaf to them
Struggle to sleep
With teary eyes
Heart pounding
Breathlessness
Yet here I am
To another night
Finding answers to
Meaning of life
Reason to existence

You are your own sacrificial goat
when you lead yourself to the altar
and wield your own scimitar to
chop off your head
again and again
for you have been taught that
sacrifice is the highest virtue
and that’s what the life is meant for.
You are constantly reminded of
the three fingers
that point at you
when you point one to the other
and you are told
that self flagellation
leads you
on the path to salvation.
It’s noble to be humble
and not to blow your trumpet
or spend time in front of the mirror
or even take a selfie
for that spells out your vanity
self love and self importance
reflects your narcissistic attitude
and you are reminded of
that you are just a speck in the infinite universe
or just a little tittle in the vast
epic verse…
You let people trample you
and use you as a doormat
but you just grin it and bear it
no protests of whimper
not a word in defence
and you attain
a kind of martyrdom....
But ultimately the time comes
when you let yourself
dissolve into
the miasma of anonymity
allow the black hole
to swallow you up
or you look for a safe
hiding place in your
very own shadow…

potted plants of different shapes and sizes

Winter was approaching
And then one day, it caught my eye
a little bloom on the vine
joyfully dangling enjoying the sun
celebrating life
I recalled my mentor’s words;
‘winter always turns to spring.’

A billion stories are remain untold
And a million voices are going unheard.
Each passing day
We are racing fast against the time
When our folks needed our time
To sit by them and talk for a while
We were always running out of time.
By the time we realise
We should have listen to them for a while;
They are now no longer around.
Perhaps they exist beyond this mortal world’s physical entity.
It hurts
Because something left unspoken.
And that never going to be heard anymore.
Nothing hurts that much like your unsaid words.
In spite of your thousands trying when you are unable to tell those words.
That remains within you and left unshared.
It pains
When your story remains untold.
Even with an ocean of relations when you’re badly struggling
To find that someone to share your emotions.
The Pain of unsaid words are immeasurable.
Then why not building up a strong hold with the possession you have now ?
You never know
Spending times listening to their sides
May save you from that lifelong mourning
That you’re not there at the time of need to listen.

A feeling slowly fades, and time slowly heals
sweating through the summers,
getting into the warm covers in winter,
we cover a distance unknowingly
-between moments: singular, collective, ten years, a year ago, yesterday.
We melt so quickly into the present
that one day a memory becomes a story.
We outgrow everything until the last day,
accommodating to any situation,
not ready to accept any stagnation or stuntedness.

On a smartphone, the fingerprint scanner
In a house, the biggest photo on wall
In a village, the chabutra under the ancient tree
In a city, the oldest bus stop...
Such are the places for each body
Which open the portals to their deepest secrets!

Needed is a touch—tender—like
Just under a beloved`s ears!
An eye to catch the un-shed tear
That your love hides beneath the lashes!
An ear to hear the faintest change
In heartbeats, while speaking of dreams and memories!
A foot to step on existing foot-marks
Telling tales of meeting and parting!

All bodies whether they be animate or inanimate
Are locked, hiding their own keyholes—places—
Which wait to be sought, by the deserving
To be opened, entered, explored and known!
What places have you found till now?
Have you found the place on your body?
